description:
Job Location: Pune
  
  
Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country
  
  
Req Id: 14144
  
  
Posting Start Date: 11/5/26
  
  
At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.
  
  
With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
  
  
Job Title-SAP S/4HANA Project Manager – Greenfield Implementation -
**14144**
**Shift: 2:00PM- 11:00PM**
**Locations: Pune, Bangalore, Chennai, Noida, Hyderabad**
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced
**SAP S/4HANA Project Manager**
with expertise in
**Greenfield implementation**
and transformation from
**SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA using the SAP Activate Methodology**
.
  
  
The Project Manager will play a pivotal role in overseeing all phases of the migration project, from planning and execution to delivery, ensuring a seamless transition with minimal disruption to business operations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Project Planning and Strategy
* Develop and implement a comprehensive project plan for the migration from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA using Greenfield implementation.
* Define project scope, objectives, timelines, and resource requirements in alignment with business goals and objectives.
* Establish project governance structure, roles/responsibilities, and communication protocols to ensure effective project management.
* Team Leadership and Management
* Lead and manage cross-functional project teams, including SAP consultants, technical experts, and business stakeholders.
* Provide clear direction, guidance, and support to team members to ensure alignment with project goals and objectives.
* Foster a collaborative and inclusive team culture, promoting open communication and knowledge sharing.
* Greenfield Data Loads
* Oversee all aspects of the migration process, including data extraction, transformation, and loading using DS/ETL.
* Collaborate with technical teams to ensure data integrity, accuracy, and consistency throughout the migration process.
* Monitor progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies to minimize downtime and disruptions during migration.
* Stakeholder Engagement and Communication
* Act as the primary point of contact for key stakeholders, including business leaders, IT management, and project sponsors.
* Provide regular updates, progress reports, and presentations to stakeholders on project status, milestones, and risks.
* Proactively address stakeholder concerns and expectations, ensuring alignment and buy-in throughout the migration process.
* Quality Assurance and Risk Management
* Implement quality assurance processes and controls to ensure the successful delivery of the migration project within scope, budget, and timeline constraints.
* Identify potential risks, issues, and dependencies early in the project lifecycle and develop proactive mitigation strategies.
* Conduct regular reviews and audits of project activities to monitor progress and address any deviations from the project plan.
* Change Management and Training
* Develop and execute change management strategies to facilitate user adoption of SAP S/4HANA and minimize resistance to change.
* Plan and coordinate training programs and knowledge transfer sessions to educate end-users on the new system and processes.
* Provide ongoing support and assistance to end-users during the transition period to ensure a smooth migration experience.

**Qualifications**
Education & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Master’s degree preferred.
* 12+ years of experience in project management, with a focus on:

+ SAP S/4HANA Greenfield implementations
+ Brownfield implementations
+ Selective Data Transfer/Bluefield implementations
+ SAP migrations

* Proven experience leading SAP S/4HANA migration projects, particularly using Greenfield implementation.
* Experience leading onshore and offshore SAP functional and technical teams.
* Strong understanding of SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA modules, architecture, and migration tools.

Certifications
  
  

* PMP certification or equivalent project management certification is highly desirable.
* SAP Activate Methodology Certification is a plus.

Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Experience with change management, stakeholder engagement, and risk management methodologies.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to anticipate challenges and develop proactive solutions.
* Positive attitude and proactive nature to work with cross-teams.
* Working knowledge of Agile and Waterfall development methodologies.
* Self-motivated with strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills.

Relocation Supported: No
  
  
Visa Sponsorship Approved: No
  
  
At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

title: Manger/Sr Manager Project (Pune,Mumbai,Bangalore)
description:
The Project Manager will support the planning, coordination, execution, and handover of school, campus, infrastructure, fit-out, refurbishment, and related projects across India, ensuring alignment with approved scope, budgets, timelines, quality standards, safety requirements, compliance obligations, and operational needs.

**Roles and responsibilities**

**Leadership:**

* Coordinate project teams, site teams, consultants, contractors, and vendors to support effective delivery of assigned projects across India.
* Work with senior leadership to translate business priorities, budgets, timelines, approval requirements, and organizational objectives into clear project execution plans, milestones, deliverables, accountability structures, and governance practices.
* Promote consistent project management practices, reporting discipline, documentation standards, timely information sharing, and cross-functional coordination to minimize disruption during execution.

**Financial management:**

* Support preparation, review, and monitoring of project budgets, cost estimates, BOQs, cash flow projections, funding requirements, and budget variance reports in coordination with Finance and senior management.
* Review contractor/vendor quotations, comparative statements, work orders, invoices, running bills, variation claims, final bills, change requests, additional works, and scope variations before recommending approval.
* Ensure all cost changes are justified, documented, approved, assessed for budget impact, and coordinated with Finance, Procurement, and internal stakeholders for timely payment processing while protecting commercial interests.

**Functional responsibilities**

**Operations:**

* Support site evaluation, feasibility review, due diligence, and early-stage inputs for new schools, expansions, fit-outs, refurbishments, and infrastructure upgrades in India.
* Review site conditions, access, utilities, statutory constraints, operational needs, construction risks, design drawings, specifications, material selections, authority submissions, and execution methodologies.
* Coordinate with architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, vendors, campus teams, and internal stakeholders to define requirements and ensure execution aligns with approved scope, drawings, specifications, timelines, budgets, quality standards, safety requirements, compliance obligations, and school operational needs.
* Track statutory approvals, permits, fire and life safety requirements, building compliance, environmental requirements, and local authority coordination for each project.

**Project planning:**

* Develop project execution plans covering scope, deliverables, timelines, resources, procurement requirements, approvals, dependencies, risks, reporting cadence, schedules, milestone trackers, resource plans, approval trackers, risk registers, issue logs, and action trackers.
* Identify design, approval, procurement, funding, site, vendor, safety, and operational risks early, develop mitigation plans with clear ownership and timelines, and align planning with academic calendars, school operations, admissions timelines, and business commitments.

**Integration management:**

* Identify and coordinate key stakeholders, including leadership, campus operations, academics, finance, procurement, legal, consultants, contractors, vendors, and statutory authorities.
* Resolve coordination gaps, support timely decisions on design, cost, procurement, approvals, execution, and handover matters, and balance business expectations, compliance requirements, operational constraints, cost considerations, and project timelines.
* Facilitate project review meetings, document key decisions, track action items, and escalate critical issues through the appropriate reporting line.

**Schedule management:**

* Prepare and monitor realistic project schedules aligned with academic calendars, admissions targets, statutory approvals, procurement lead times, and school operational requirements.
* Track progress against approved timelines, identify delays, dependencies, and bottlenecks, coordinate timely completion of design, approvals, procurement, execution, testing, commissioning, and handover, and escalate critical delays with recovery plans.

**Procurement management:**

* Support vendor identification, prequalification, tendering, technical evaluation, commercial comparison, negotiation, recommendation, and review of contractor/vendor capability, market presence, delivery timelines, after-sales support, compliance, safety practices, and past performance.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and user departments for timely work orders, purchase orders, contracts, approvals, material/equipment/service deliveries, and procurement lead-time monitoring.
* Ensure procurement decisions balance cost, quality, compliance, durability, maintainability, and operational suitability for Indian campus conditions.

**Risk management:**

* Identify, monitor, and mitigate risks related to approvals, statutory compliance, cost, schedule, procurement, site conditions, safety, quality, contractor performance, and operational readiness.
* Maintain risk registers, issue logs, change trackers, escalation records, follow-up actions, and lessons learned, and apply preventive controls to avoid repeated issues in design, procurement, execution, documentation, and handover.
* Regularly review site safety, compliance, quality, and risk controls during project execution.

**Execution and handover:**

* Monitor site execution through site visits, coordination meetings, progress reports, quality checks, safety observations, and contractor/vendor performance reviews.
* Ensure works are completed as per approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, timelines, and contractual commitments.
* Coordinate testing, commissioning, inspections, snagging, rectification, statutory readiness, operational preparedness, and engagement with Operations, Facilities, IT, Procurement, Finance, School Leadership, and other relevant teams for smooth transition to operations.
* Complete structured handover of as-built drawings, warranties, manuals, specifications, test certificates, compliance documents, asset information, vendor contacts, snag lists, maintenance requirements, and project closure reports covering cost, timelines, approvals, variations, pending actions, lessons learned, and future improvement recommendations.

**Key performance indicators**

* Schedules are regularly prepared, monitored, updated, tracked against approved timelines, and supported by recovery plans where delays occur.
* Costs are monitored against approved budgets, with timely reporting of variances, commitments, savings, overruns, corrective actions, bills, variations, and approvals.
* Statutory approvals, permits, authority submissions, fire and life safety requirements, and compliance documentation are tracked and completed within required timelines.
* Execution meets approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and operational expectations of the school or campus.
* Vendor, contractor, consultant, procurement, risk, issue, approval, action, and stakeholder trackers are maintained accurately and submitted on time for management review.
* Risks related to cost, schedule, approvals, safety, quality, procurement, vendors, and operations are identified early and mitigated through clear action plans.
* Testing, commissioning, snag closure, operational readiness, handover documentation, and project closure reports are completed before closure.

**Job requirements**

**Qualification:**

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification or professional certification in Project Management, Construction Management, or Contract Management is an added advantage.

**Experience:**

* good years of experience in project management, infrastructure development, construction management, or campus development, preferably within India.
* Hands-on experience supporting or delivering school, institutional, commercial, fit-out, refurbishment, or campus infrastructure projects from planning through execution and handover.
* Working knowledge of Indian construction practices, statutory approvals, municipal authority requirements, building codes, fire and life safety norms, environmental requirements, and regulatory processes.
* Experience coordinating with architects, consultants, contractors, vendors, government authorities, school leadership, operations teams, and internal management stakeholders.
* Ability to support project budgets, cost estimates, BOQs, tendering, vendor comparisons, contracts, change requests, billing reviews, cost control, procurement, and local material/contractor coordination.
* Practical experience in planning, scheduling, site execution monitoring, quality coordination, risk tracking, safety compliance, issue resolution, and adherence to approved scope, specifications, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Ability to prepare project reports, dashboards, progress updates, risk registers, approval trackers, action trackers, and handover documentation for management review.
* Good communication, coordination, negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently under guidance and collaborate effectively across teams.

title: Project Leader - Planisware Governance
description:
Our solutions are a key part of most industries - electronics, medical research, renewable energy, food production, infrastructure and many more. Working with us means working with the latest technologies and groundbreaking, sustainable innovations.
  
  
**Join us on our journey for a better tomorrow.**
**Role Summary**
As
**Project Management Platform Lead**
, you will lead the team responsible for the governance, adoption and continuous development of Planisware as a strategic Project & Portfolio Management (PPM) platform across multiple divisions of Atlas Copco.
  
  
You will take
**end-to-end ownership of the Planisware platform from a governance and business perspective**
, ensuring that the platform remains sustainable, cost-effective, scalable and aligned with evolving business needs. This includes managing platform governance, cost, usage, growth, adoption, support and continuous improvement.
  
  
Operating in a decentralized organization, success in this role depends on your ability to
**create alignment and drive action across divisions, Product Companies, IT, business stakeholders and external partners, often without formal authority**
.
  
  
We are primarily looking for a
**strong project leader with a solid understanding of project and portfolio management methodologies, excellent communication skills and a proactive mindset**
.
**Advanced technical knowledge of Planisware is not required from day one.**
However, you will be expected to rapidly develop a strong functional understanding of the platform, allowing you to become a credible platform owner and sparring partner for business users, stakeholders and technical specialists.
  
  
This is therefore not purely a platform management role. You will be expected to take ownership, identify what needs to happen, bring the right stakeholders together and drive initiatives through to completion.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Planisware Platform & Governance Leadership
* Lead the Planisware Governance Team and coordinate the activities required to operate and further develop the platform.
* Take ownership of the overall Planisware governance and operating model across participating divisions.
* Define priorities and translate business needs into clear initiatives, actions and platform improvements.
* Establish clear decision-making, ownership, escalation and approval mechanisms.
* Maintain and evolve the Planisware roadmap in alignment with business priorities and strategic objectives.
* Provide clear and structured reporting to Steering Committees and key stakeholders on platform performance, risks, costs, adoption and improvement initiatives.
* Cost, Growth & Value Management
* Take an active role in managing the cost, usage and sustainable growth of the Planisware platform.
* Monitor platform-related costs and ensure transparency toward participating divisions and stakeholders.
* Anticipate the impact of increasing adoption and organizational growth on platform costs, support requirements and governance.
* Drive responsible growth of the platform by balancing business demand, standardization, scalability and cost.
* Monitor adoption, usage and platform value and translate these insights into concrete improvement actions.
* Ensure that investments and enhancements contribute to measurable business value.
* Stakeholder Management & Organizational Alignment
* Act as the central point of coordination between divisions, Product Companies, business controllers, IT, Planisware and implementation/support partners.
* Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships across the organization.
* Proactively engage stakeholders rather than waiting for issues or requirements to emerge.
* Drive decisions and follow-up actions across organizational boundaries.
* Communicate complex topics in a clear and pragmatic way to both operational and management audiences.
* Navigate conflicting priorities and create alignment in a decentralized, international organization.
* Build support and momentum for decisions even when there is no direct hierarchical authority.
* Project Leadership & Execution
* Lead cross-divisional Planisware initiatives from definition through implementation and follow-up.
* Apply strong project management practices covering scope, planning, resources, budget, risks, dependencies and stakeholder communication.
* Use a sound understanding of project and portfolio management methodologies to help shape both the platform and its governance.
* Create structure in complex or ambiguous situations and translate issues into clear actions, responsibilities and decisions.
* Proactively identify risks, bottlenecks and opportunities and take the initiative to address them.
* Drive actions to completion and ensure commitments made through governance forums are followed through.
* Coordinate internal teams, business stakeholders and external partners to achieve agreed outcomes.
* Functional Ownership & Methodology Alignment
* Own the functional alignment of Planisware with Atlas Copco project and portfolio management practices.
* Ensure alignment with CtP 2.0 engineering project methodology as a core foundation.
* Develop a strong functional understanding of Planisware and how the platform supports project and portfolio management processes.
* Translate business and project management requirements into appropriate platform requirements and priorities.
* Drive appropriate standardization of processes, templates, data structures and reporting within Planisware.
* Balance common standards with controlled flexibility for different divisions and Product Companies.
* Challenge requirements where unnecessary complexity or customization could negatively affect platform sustainability.
* Adoption, Support & Continuous Improvement
* Drive sustained adoption and increasing usage maturity across participating organizations.
* Monitor usage, user feedback and recurring support topics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Establish and continuously improve the first-line support and governance model.
* Ensure effective knowledge sharing, onboarding, training and refresher activities.
* Build a community around Planisware that encourages knowledge exchange and common ways of working.
* Continuously develop platform maturity, usability and business value.
* Vendor & Partner Management
* Manage collaboration with Planisware and external partners with clear expectations, priorities and accountability.
* Monitor delivery quality, commitments, costs and dependencies.
* Ensure external services support the long-term sustainability and scalability of the platform.
* Escalate issues when required and drive them toward resolution.
* Ensure service quality and contractual commitments are consistently met.

**To succeed, you will need**
Educational Requirements
  
  

* BE / B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Computer Engineering or equivalent relevant education.

Professional Experience
  
  

* 6-10+ years of experience in project leadership, project/program management, PMO, enterprise platforms, governance or digital transformation.
* Strong understanding of project and portfolio management principles and methodologies, with the ability to apply them pragmatically in a business and engineering environment.
* Proven ability to lead complex initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, organizations and competing priorities.
* Strong project management capabilities, including scope, planning, budget management, reporting, risk and dependency management and stakeholder communication.
* Experience working within decentralized or matrix organizations where influence is often more important than formal authority.
* Experience driving adoption and organizational change across multiple business units or Product Companies.
* Experience working in international and multicultural environments.
* Experience with SaaS platforms and external vendors or implementation partners.
* Experience within engineering and project management environments is a strong advantage.
* Familiarity with CtP 2.0 methodology is preferred.
* Previous Planisware experience is an advantage, but not a prerequisite. The ability and willingness to rapidly develop strong functional knowledge of the platform is essential.

Software, Platform & Methodology Knowledge
  
  

* Strong understanding of project and portfolio management concepts, methodologies and processes is essential.
* Experience working with PPM solutions or enterprise project management platforms is an advantage.
* Prior Planisware experience is beneficial, but advanced technical Planisware knowledge is not required at entry.
* The successful candidate must be willing and able to develop a strong functional understanding of Planisware, including its capabilities, processes and data structures.
* The ability to translate project management and business requirements into effective platform usage is more important than technical configuration expertise.
* Good understanding of SaaS concepts and platform governance.
* Experience with Microsoft Project Online / Project Server, SharePoint and Power BI is an advantage.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word.

Knowledge Areas
  
  

* Project & Program Management
* Project Portfolio Management
* Agile & Waterfall methodologies
* Engineering project methodologies, including CtP 2.0 where applicable
* Platform and product governance
* SaaS operating models
* Change management and adoption
* Budget and financial management
* Risk and dependency management
* Continuous improvement and platform maturity

Personality & Behavioural Competencies
  
  

* Proactive Ownership - does not wait for instructions or problems to escalate; identifies what needs to happen and takes the initiative to move it forward.
* Strong Communicator - communicates clearly and confidently with stakeholders ranging from end users and specialists to senior management.
* Natural Project Leader - creates structure, establishes priorities and keeps people focused on decisions, actions and delivery.
* Influential - creates alignment and drives results without relying on hierarchical authority.
* Result-Oriented - follows through on commitments and maintains momentum until outcomes are achieved.
* Pragmatic & Structured - establishes sufficient governance and standardization without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Business-Minded - understands that platform decisions must balance functionality, adoption, cost, scalability and business value.
* Curious & Quick to Learn - brings strong project management fundamentals and actively develops the Planisware knowledge required to become a credible platform owner and sparring partner.
* Comfortable with Ambiguity - creates direction when responsibilities, requirements or organizational boundaries are not initially clear.
* Collaborative & Culturally Aware - builds effective relationships across functions, divisions, Product Companies and geographic locations.
* Continuous Improvement Mindset - actively looks for opportunities to simplify, standardize and improve the platform and its operating model.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills
* Leadership without formal authority
* High-level planning and prioritization
* Strong facilitation and decision-driving skills
* Analytical and problem-solving mindset
* Ability to translate business requirements into actionable priorities
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a decentralized environment
* Strong follow-up and execution discipline

**In return, we offer you**

* A work culture known for respectful interaction, ethical behavior and integrity.
* Access to global job opportunities as part of Atlas Copco Group.
* Opportunities to grow, develop and see your ideas realized.
* The opportunity to have a visible impact on a strategic, cross-divisional platform and its future direction.
* An international environment with exposure to multiple businesses and stakeholder groups.
* New challenges and continuous learning.

**Diverse by nature and inclusive by choice**
Bright ideas come from all of us. The more unique perspectives we embrace, the more innovative we are. Together we build a culture where difference is valued and we share a deep sense of purpose and belonging.

Run two or three projects at a time, each with a one-page brief, a weekly status and a clear close-out.

Incubate new bets until they are ready for an owner: new categories, new formats, franchise and partner models, brand collaborations and international expansion.

Build business cases for new stores, cities, channels and acquisitions, and help the founders decide fast.

Track competitors, market trends and benchmarks, and turn them into clear recommendations.

Maintain the data room and support due diligence during fundraises and debt raises.

Track board action items and investors ask for closure.

Build the founders’ dashboard: the handful of numbers that show how the business is doing each week.

Run deep dives when a number moves, from a store’s sales dip to a rise in customer acquisition cost.

Turn what works into SOPs, templates and playbooks so teams stop reinventing them.

Spot broken processes across teams and fix them, from approvals and vendor onboarding to hand-offs between departments.

Prepare the founders for key meetings, write first drafts of important documents and follow up on what was agreed.

Support senior hiring: scorecards, case assignments and candidate evaluations.

Step in during escalations and launches, and handle special situations quickly and quietly, from a vendor crisis to an urgent partner negotiation.

4–8 years of experience, including founding or co-founding a startup and running it day to day.

A true generalist: has worked across operations, growth, finance and people, not in one function only.

Moves fast and finishes: can take a vague brief, structure it, and deliver it in days, not months.

Brings teams together without formal authority, and is trusted by both store teams and senior leaders.

Strong with numbers: comfortable with P&Ls, unit economics, Excel or Google Sheets, and building a clear business case.

Writes and presents clearly, from a one-page brief to a board slide.

High ownership and discretion: handles confidential founder, investor and people matters with care.

**Good-to-haves**

Experience in consumer brands, retail, D2C or quick commerce.

**•**
Earlier time in consulting, investment banking, venture capital or a founder’s office at a fast-growing startup.

**•**
Has raised capital or worked closely with investors and boards.

**•**
Hands-on with AI and no-code tools to automate work and move faster.

**Why Uni Seoul**

**•**
See how a fast-growing consumer brand is built, up close, from the founders’ desk.
**•**
Real ownership from week one, across every part of the business.

**•**
A clear path to Chief of Staff, or to lead a business unit or new initiative you helped build.
**•**
Competitive compensation with ESOP eligibility.

Send your CV to

title: Program Manager
description:
****Who we are****
Mindtickle is the leading AI-powered revenue enablement platform, helping sales teams learn faster, practice smarter, and perform at their best. We bring together onboarding, training, coaching, content, digital sales rooms, conversation intelligence, and AI role-plays into one platform so revenue teams have everything they need to build winning sellers.
  
  
Global companies, like Fortune 500 organizations, trust Mindtickle to support their revenue teams. Customers and industry analysts have also recognized us. G2 has ranked us the #1 Sales Training & Onboarding platform for 28 consecutive quarters, and Forrester has recognized Mindtickle as a Leader in revenue enablement. Mindtickle was also recognized as AI-Based Sales Solution of the Year by the 2025 AI Breakthrough Awards and has received Stevie Awards for Technology Innovation and Customer Support Excellence.
  
  
At Mindtickle, we're helping companies create high-performing revenue teams, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.
  
  
****Role summary****
The Program Manager, Services runs the internal programs that make Mindtickle Services efficient, predictable and profitable. The role spans all four service lines — Professional Services, Content as a Service (CaaS), Managed Services and Technical Solutions — rather than a single customer engagement.
  
  
You will own portfolio-wide visibility into cost, revenue, margin and sourcing (in-house vs. outsourced); run strategic Services initiatives from charter to closure; coordinate internal response on escalations and accounts that need operational support; and build the executive narratives that leadership uses with founders, Sales and customers.
  
  
This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for a structured operator who is equally comfortable in a spreadsheet, a platform, a cross-functional working session and an executive deck.
  
  
****Key responsibilities****

* Services portfolio governance & visibility
* Build and maintain a single source of truth across PS, CaaS, Managed Services and Technical Solutions: active programs, capacity, utilization, delivery health and risk.
* Run the Services governance cadence — weekly portfolio reviews, monthly business reviews and quarterly planning — with clear decision logs and action tracking.
* Define and standardize portfolio metrics and reporting so leadership can see issues early and act on data, not anecdotes.
* Program financials: cost, revenue & sourcing
* Track Services revenue, cost and margin by service line, account and program; surface variance and its drivers.
* Maintain clear visibility into what is delivered in-house versus outsourced — vendor spend, contractor utilization and the cost/quality trade-off of each.
* Support pricing, estimation and capacity models with leadership, Finance and Presales; flag margin risk before deals are signed and during delivery.
* Prepare inputs for budgeting, forecasting and headcount planning.
* Strategic initiatives
* Charter, plan and drive Services-wide initiatives end to end — e.g., AI-led delivery transformation, new service packaging, operating-model changes and tooling rollouts.
* Own initiative governance: scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, RAID logs and success metrics.
* Hold cross-functional owners accountable and report progress and outcomes to leadership.
* Escalation & account operations support
* Act as the program lead on escalations: assemble the right internal team, run the recovery plan, track commitments and close the loop.
* Provide operational support to accounts that need it — resourcing gaps, cross-team dependencies, commercial or scope clarity — without becoming the day-to-day delivery owner.
* Capture root causes and turn recurring issues into process or product fixes.
* Operational efficiency & process improvement
* Identify inefficiencies across service functions — hand-offs, duplicated effort, tooling gaps, manual reporting — and drive measurable fixes.
* Standardize playbooks, templates and operating rhythms across service lines.
* Partner with team leads to apply AI and automation to internal workflows (reporting, estimation, resource allocation).
* Executive communication & storytelling
* Build executive presentations for founders, leadership reviews, Sales/GTM forums and customer executive meetings.
* Turn operational data into a clear narrative: what is happening, why it matters and what decision is needed.
* Draft briefs, business cases and updates for Services leadership.

**Tools, cadences & metrics**
**Tools:**
Jira, Rocketlane, Excel/Google Sheets, Salesforce (inputs), BI dashboards, Google Slides/PowerPoint, and AI assistants for analysis and drafting.
  
  
****Our Culture & Values****
We hire builders, people who move fast, learn from failure, and use AI as a default part of how they work. Our values- Delight Your Customers, Act as a Founder, and Better Together- aren't wall decor. They're how we make decisions here.
  
  
Growth at Mindtickle looks like owning more, not just doing more. Your scope will outgrow your job title if you want it to. You'll work alongside people who've scaled revenue tech globally, get direct feedback from leaders invested in your development, and take on challenges before you feel ready because that's how the best growth happens.
  
  
Our team spans 5+ countries, backgrounds, and perspectives. We believe the best products are built by people who bring different ways of seeing the same problem - and everyone has a seat at that table.
  
  
We hire for potential. Apply even if your experience doesn't match every requirement; your skills, perspective, and drive matter here. At Mindtickle, you can be yourself, build your career, and do the best work of your life alongside people who genuinely want to see you succeed.
  
  
We believe the best products are built by teams with different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of seeing the world. We welcome every unique identity, and we mean that.
  
  
**Mindtickle is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer**
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Your Right to Work: In compliance with applicable laws, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the respective work locations and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Global MOH Digital Lead & Asia/ANZ Regional Lead
description:

The role acts as the primary Corporate Center focal point for MOH governance, digital health transformation, vendor management, compliance oversight, and operational implementation across Asia and ANZ. * Support implementation of standardized regional service models and minimum requirements.

* Partner with IT, Data & Analytics, HR and SHE teams on systems integration.
* Support health-data governance, privacy, cybersecurity, and compliance requirements.
* Support development of digital workflows, reporting dashboards, automation opportunities, and AI-enabled ways of working.
* Ensure consistent use of approved MOH systems and reporting standards across the region.

* Coordinate local adoption, training, testing, and implementation readiness activities.

* Support implementation of global MOH policies, standards, and minimum requirements.
* Ensure adherence to applicable regulatory and privacy requirements.
* Identify governance gaps and drive remediation activities.
* Support management of fitness-for-work, occupational disease, health surveillance, and medical governance processes.
* Contribute to audit readiness and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support enterprise health-risk governance and reporting processes.
* Reporting & Health Intelligence
* Support implementation of MOH metrics and reporting frameworks.
* Monitor regional performance indicators and identify emerging risks and trends.
* Ensure data quality and reporting discipline across countries.
* Contribute to development of enterprise health analytics, dashboards, and health-risk indicators.
* Translate data into actionable recommendations for business leaders.

**We're Looking For Someone Who**

* Medical, Occupational Health, Health Sciences, Nursing, Public Health, Healthcare Management, or related degree.
* Significant experience in Medical & Occupational Health, Health & Wellbeing, Healthcare Operations, SHE, or a related field.
* Experience managing multiple countries and stakeholders across complex organizations.
* Experience leading transformation, implementation, or change programs.
* Experience working with external providers and vendor-governance frameworks.
* Strong understanding of health-data governance, compliance, and confidentiality requirements.
* Experience with Enterprise Health, Cority, Workday, Enablon, or similar systems.
* Experience in FMCG, manufacturing, supply chain, or multinational environments.
* Experience in digital transformation and health analytics initiatives.

**What You'll Get**
Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes
  
  

* Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards
* Flexible ways of working
* Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work
* Time off to rest and recharge
* Ongoing learning and development opportunities
* Global exposure and cross-functional career experiences
* Career growth through internal mobility and talent programmes
* A diverse, inclusive and values-led workplace culture
* Recognition & rewards - Celebration of individual and team success
* Modern, collaborative workspaces designed for connection and innovation
* Regular moments that bring our people together through networking, learning and community events

**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
  
  
**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
  
  
**Additional Information**
The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare technical proposals/quotations and identify applicable standards, directives, and testing requirements.
* Provide technical guidance to clients on ATEX, SIL, Machinery Safety, CE Marking, and regulatory compliance.
* Conduct machinery Risk Assessments in accordance with EN ISO 12100 and EN ISO 13849-1.
* Perform FMEA, SISTEMA assessments, Technical File Validation, and machinery safety assessments.
* Conduct explosive atmosphere and ignition hazard assessments for electrical and mechanical equipment in line with ATEX requirements.
* Handle ATEX technical compliance documentation and Declarations of Conformity (DoC).
* Conduct on-site EMC testing, safety audits, and hazard assessments.
* Perform/support SIL and Functional Safety assessments, including HAZOP, LOPA, FTA, ETA, FMEA, and FMEDA.
* Support end-to-end SIL 2/SIL 3 certification projects.
* Manage project delivery, client coordination, and achievement of assigned monthly revenue targets.

**Education & Experience**
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Instrumentation, Automation Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Relevant experience in industrial product compliance, machinery safety, functional safety, testing, inspection, or certification.
* Strong working knowledge of:

+ ATEX 2014/34/EU and 1999/92/EC, IECEx, DSEAR and NEC
+ Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230
+ EN ISO 12100, EN ISO 13849-1 and EN 60204-1
+ SIL, HAZOP, LOPA, FTA, ETA, FMEA/FMEDA

* Hands-on experience in Risk Assessment, FMEA, SISTEMA, Technical File Validation, and CE Marking.
* Experience in ATEX/explosion protection assessments and SIL certification projects, preferably SIL 2/SIL 3.
* CompEx certification (Ex01–Ex04/Ex05–Ex06) or ATEX Inspector certification would be an advantage.
* Strong client management, technical documentation, communication, and commercial skills.

title: Supervisor, Global Sample Solutions
description:
Position Summary
  
  
The Supervisor, Global Sample Solutions is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the day-to-day activities of the Global Sample Solutions Site Outreach team. The role ensures timely resolution of sample discrepancies, effective site outreach, accurate data investigations and discrepancy resolution.
  
  
The Supervisor provides operational guidance, training, workload prioritization, and escalation support to Global Sample Solutions Specialists. This position monitors key performance indicators (KPIs), turnaround time (TAT), quality, and backlog aging while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  
  
**Essential Functions Of The Job**
Team Leadership & Operational Oversight
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and support Global Sample Solutions Specialists responsible for site outreach, discrepancy resolution, and study support activities.
* This role will provide direct supervisory oversight for assigned team members.
* Coordinate daily workload assignments and priorities to ensure timely follow-up and closure of open discrepancies.
* Monitor team productivity, quality, KPIs, service-level expectations, and backlog aging; communicate risks and recovery plans to leadership.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex discrepancy investigations, customer communication challenges, and cross-functional operational issues.
* Provide onboarding, role-specific training, coaching, and ongoing development for team members.
* Conduct routine workload and quality reviews and identify opportunities to improve consistency, efficiency, and compliance.
* Partner with leadership to support resource planning, workload forecasting, and operational readiness.
* Role requires flexibility to support global time zones, including overlap with U.S. business hours as business needs require.

Customer/Site Outreach, Discrepancy Tracking & Resolution
  
  

* Maintain global oversight of unresolved discrepancies identified by internal sample management teams for incoming and outgoing shipments.
* Ensure adherence to project-specific communication plans, established outreach timelines, documentation standards, and escalation procedures.
* Liaise with sites, sponsors, CROs, clients, and internal teams to obtain missing information and facilitate timely discrepancy resolution.
* Review complex or high-impact discrepancies and guide the team on appropriate resolution actions.
* Ensure resolution actions are clearly documented and communicated to meet customer and business deliverables for TAT.
* Monitor first, second, and final outreach activities, including shipment tracking information and response status, to ensure appropriate follow-up.
* Monitor discrepancy aging and trends and implement recovery or corrective action plans when performance is at risk.
* Provide oversight for study close-out activities, including data review, outstanding query resolution, reconciliation support, and sample disposition follow-up.
* Independently prioritizes daily workload, resolves routine operational issues, and escalates high-impact risks to leadership.

Database Troubleshooting & Data Resolution Support
  
  

* Provide oversight for unresolved sample data requests, reconciliation queries, and database-related discrepancies.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to investigate, document, and implement approved corrections for data modifications or errors.
* Support reconciliation between source documentation, sample inventory systems, clinical databases, EDC systems, and client-provided data, as applicable.
* Ensure sufficient documentation and audit trails are maintained for data corrections and resolution activities.
* Escalate system or process issues that may affect data integrity, operational timelines, or customer deliverables.

Quality Control & Compliance
  
  

* Ensure team activities comply with company SOPs, study-specific requirements, documented procedures, and applicable quality standards.
* Oversee or perform quality control reviews of outreach documentation, discrepancy resolution records, and data updates.
* Review quality findings and coordinate corrective actions, retraining, or process updates as needed.
* Maintain audit-ready documentation and support internal audits, client audits, and regulatory inspections, as required.
* Demonstrate behavior consistent with company values and promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, clinical research, healthcare administration, business, or a related field preferred.
* An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* Six or more years of relevant experience in sample management, clinical trial operations, laboratory operations, data management, project coordination, or a related environment preferred.
* Two or more years of experience leading people, projects, workflows, or operational initiatives preferred.
* Experience with customer- or site-facing communications, discrepancy management, issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination.
* Experience working with biospecimen inventory systems, clinical databases, reconciliation activities, or operational reporting tools preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Strong leadership, coaching, workload management, and team development skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to manage sensitive or escalated customer interactions professionally.
* Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving capabilities with consistent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, changing deadlines, and global stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to interpret operational data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear actions.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office applications, reporting tools, and operational dashboards.
* Strong knowledge of data integrity, documentation, and quality principles.
* Ability to work effectively across global teams and time zones.

title: Project Engineer / Senior Project Engineer - IAT
description:
**Your Role**
-------------

As a **Project Engineer / Sr. Project Engineer – Industrial Air**, you will be responsible for the design and development of **Oil Injected screw Air Compressors, small Piston Compressors and related Industrial Air products** at our product company in Chakan, Pune.

Reporting to the Engineering Manager – IAT, you will lead engineering projects from concept through prototype, validation and industrialization. Your mission is to develop **innovative, reliable, modular and cost-efficient products** that deliver superior quality, performance, energy efficiency and customer value.

You will apply **Lean Engineering and first-time-right principles** to improve product quality, manufacturability, standardization and Time-to-Market while ensuring projects meet defined cost, performance and timeline targets.

**Your day-to-day**
-------------------

* Lead product-development projects from concept through design, prototype, validation and industrialization. (Concept to Product)
* Develop 3D models, assemblies, engineering drawings and BOMs using CAD tools.
* Design and validate robust products considering performance, reliability, tolerances, manufacturability, ease of assembly and cost.
* Apply Lean Engineering, DFMA, Poka-Yoke and standardization principles.
* Coordinate prototype builds and work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Purchasing, suppliers and other stakeholders.
* Conduct design and qualification reviews, ensuring engineering documentation is accurate and complete.
* Apply FMEA, 5 Why, root-cause analysis and PDCA to proactively improve product quality and resolve field or warranty issues.
* Plan and track engineering activities using structured project-management tools, highlighting risks and deviations proactively.
* Drive cost reduction and value engineering through design optimization, component reuse and standardization.
* Capture lessons learned and contribute to continuous improvement, innovation and the engineering knowledge base.
* Ensure compliance with applicable engineering standards, procedures, safety and SHE requirements.

**Your skills and experience**
------------------------------

* + Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  + 4 to 8+ years of experience in mechanical product design and development, preferably in compressors or similar industrial products.
  + Strong technical understanding of compressors, motors/drives, coolers, fans, electrical panels and sheet-metal components.
  + Good working knowledge of 2D/3D CAD, mechanical design, engineering drawings, tolerances and BOM creation.
  + Knowledge of pneumatic and hydraulic systems, manufacturing processes and supplier fabrication methods.
  + Understanding of FMEA, root-cause analysis, Lean Engineering, DFMA and Poka-Yoke.
  + Experience with FEA and/or CFD will be an advantage.
  + Working knowledge of relevant engineering and business tools such as CAD, ERP, SAP, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Project and SharePoint.
  + Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a customer-focused and results-oriented mindset.
  + Good communication, teamwork and leadership skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions.
  + Proactive, innovative and organized, with a strong sense of **ownership and accountability**.
  + Good written and verbal communication skills in **English**.

**Job Title-SAP S/4HANA Project Manager – Greenfield Implementation -** **14144**
=================================================================================

**Shift: 2:00PM- 11:00PM**

**Locations: Pune, Bangalore, Chennai, Noida, Hyderabad**

### **Position Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **SAP S/4HANA Project Manager** with expertise in **Greenfield implementation** and transformation from **SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA using the SAP Activate Methodology** .

The Project Manager will play a pivotal role in overseeing all phases of the migration project, from planning and execution to delivery, ensuring a seamless transition with minimal disruption to business operations.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Project Planning and Strategy**

* Develop and implement a comprehensive project plan for the migration from **SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA using Greenfield implementation** .

The role works closely with Program, Finance, and Operations teams to support project implementation, strengthen operational processes, and ensure compliance with partner and organizational requirements.

title: Live Music & Event Producer
description:
**AI-Powered Live Music & Event Producer: Booking & Live Events**

Full-time | Louder Studio, Lajpat Nagar, New Delhi

**About Louder**

Louder is a live events and entertainment company promoting art, music and culture. We work with artists, agents, venues and brands to create memorable live experiences and build audiences for creative talent, with events, tours and nightclub nights across India, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore and other international markets.

**Role Overview**

You'll identify, develop and secure talent, and run everything that turns a booking into a sold-out show, from first pitch to post-event settlement. At Louder, a producer doesn't do this with spreadsheets and phone calls alone.
**You'll run a team of AI agents.**
They research, get quotes, help book artists and production, plan travel, build budgets and keep every show on track. You stay in charge of the relationships, the judgment calls and the deal. If you don't use AI every day, this role is not for you.

**Key Responsibilities, and how AI helps**

**Research & Talent**

**Research markets, cities and venues; map artists to the right audiences and evaluate profitability and market potential.**

* Use AI research agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity or similar) to analyse:
* each artist's past tours, ticket sales and pricing
* streaming and social growth
* where their audience lives
* what is already selling in each city
* Then build data-backed cases for which shows to do, where, when and at what price, including AI sales forecasts and break-even scenarios.

**Track emerging talent, indie artists and pop-culture trends worth booking.**

* Set up AI agents to watch charts, playlists, viral moments and indie scenes, and alert you to artists who are rising in our markets.

**Analyse international markets, audience presence and other metrics to gauge opportunity.**

* Use AI to compare cities and countries on audience size, diaspora population, competing events, venue costs and ticket prices, and to monitor competitor line-ups so we avoid clashes and find gaps.

**Booking & Deal-Making**

**Pitch concepts and opportunities to artists, agents and creative teams.**

* Use AI to find the right agent and manager contacts, draft personalised offers and pitch decks, translate for international agents, and follow up automatically.

**Support artist negotiations, review contract notes and capture negotiation details.**

* Use AI to summarise and compare contracts and riders, flag risky or unusual clauses, and keep a log of every deal term. AI meeting notetakers capture every call.

**Secure venue availability and backup holds; negotiate booking terms with venues.**

* Use AI to shortlist venues by capacity, cost, location and past events, send availability requests to many venues at once, and track holds and deadlines.

**Coordinate key sales points and rider requirements for artists.**

* Use AI to read tech and hospitality riders and turn them into checklists and vendor briefs, and to source local options for hospitality and F&B in each city.

**Book diverse, credible line-ups that maximise ticket sales.**

* Use AI to test line-up combinations against audience overlap and sales data, and to find support acts that fit.

**Touring & Show Planning**

**Draft event business plans and marketing plans.**

* Have AI produce first drafts from our templates and market research, then refine them.

**Build itineraries, routing plans and touring strategies; manage event calendars and capacities.**

* Use AI agents to plan the most efficient routes and research and compare the best flights, hotels, ground transport, visas and work permits for artists and crew. Build day sheets and run sheets that update instantly when plans change.

**Build event budgets, capacity plans and financial projections.**

* Use AI to build budgets and P&L models, run "what if" scenarios on ticket price, capacity and costs, and forecast sales.

**Financials & Admin**

**Manage deposits, settlements, expenditure tracking and event P&Ls.**

* Have AI reconcile invoices, receipts and payouts against budget, flag overspend early, and prepare settlement sheets.

**Follow up on third-party quotes and invoices; manage expense reports and contracts.**

* Send AI agents to request, chase and compare quotes for:
* sound, lights, LED, staging and backline
* security and staffing
* décor, printing and merch
* photographers, videographers and production writers
* AI also extracts data from invoices and receipts for expense reports.

**Build systems and templates that make booking, budgeting and reporting repeatable; run post-event evaluations.**

* Build reusable AI workflows and prompts for each stage of a show, and use AI to turn sales, attendance and feedback data into post-event reports and lessons.

**Marketing, Ticketing & Sellouts**

**Own the marketing for your shows end-to-end so every show sells out.**

* Plan city-specific ad campaigns with AI (targeting, budget split, timing and messaging for each market) and work with marketing to generate AI creatives, reels and copy for each show.

**Sell TixMojo, our in-house ticketing platform, to event organisers.**

* Use AI to find and research organisers, write personalised pitches and prepare demos.

**Pitch tickets and sponsorship via call, email and SMS/WhatsApp.**

* Use AI to identify likely sponsors, build tailored sponsorship decks, and send personalised outreach at scale.

**Collaborate with influencers, promoters and industry partners to help sell out shows.**

* Use AI to find the right influencers and promoters in each city and track who actually sells tickets.

**Manage the full grant lifecycle: find, pitch, write, win, deliver and report.**

* Use AI to find grants, check eligibility, and draft proposals and reports to each funder's criteria.

**Platform & Data**

**Help lead development of our AI-powered event management platform, automating event work end-to-end.**

* Work with our engineers to design, test and improve the AI agents producers use: quotes, bookings, travel, budgets and settlements.

**Maintain our talent and market database city by city, tracking which shows, genres and languages perform in every market.**

* Use AI to collect, clean and update this data automatically and surface insights for future bookings.

**Remote, On-Site & Logistics**

**Project-manage end-to-end logistics for your events: staffing, technical and logistics suppliers, production and venue operations.**

* Use AI to build production schedules, crew lists, stage plots and venue layout mock-ups, and to prepare risk, weather, permit and licence checklists for each city.

**Source vendor quotes and provide remote support across event countries and time zones.**

* Use AI agents to find and contact vendors in each city, translate where needed, and keep everyone updated across time zones.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Daily, hands-on use of AI tools and agents for research, planning, booking and content. In the interview, we'll ask you to show us how you'd use AI to plan a show.**
* Minimum 2 years' experience in live music/comedy booking, event production, venue booking, promoting, artist management or client servicing (as a venue booker, agent, promoter or assistant, gained professionally, independently or through grassroots/DIY work)
* Experience across all aspects of producing a show: booking/buying, marketing, production and settlement
* Ability to run a tour end-to-end: finding venues, routing, scheduling and executing across a city or country
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills and confidence building and tracking event budgets
* Working knowledge of lighting, sound and AV as used in live events
* Wide knowledge of Indian and international artists, DJs, comedians and entertainers, with genuine engagement in pop culture and emerging talent
* Comfortable selling and pitching a product or service to clients and organisers
* Strong written and verbal communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills
* Strong organisational and time-management skills; able to manage multiple projects and deadlines at once
* Comfortable working with data to track and improve outcomes
* Genuine interest in music, comedy, pop culture and live entertainment

Some travel and work across international time zones may be required.

**One More Thing**

"It's not my job" isn't part of our vocabulary. We stuff envelopes. For a fake shaadi, we sourced every costume and element an Indian baraat needs, then found musicians in another country and briefed them on the songs and instruments so it went off seamlessly. We make mistakes, and we learn from them.

title: Partner Onboarding Lead – O&M
description:
**About Claro Energy**

Claro Energy is a leading clean energy company in India with 15+ years of experience in building decentralized renewable energy solutions. We have delivered 1,00,000+ solar projects across solar irrigation pumps, rooftop solar, and large-scale clean energy programs, working closely with farmers, households, institutions, and government initiatives across multiple Indian states. As we scale further, we are building an AI-first data and intelligence foundation to power automation, forecasting, and faster decision-making across operations, growth, inventory, and finance.

**About The Role**

Our installed base is growing faster than any in-house service team can cover. We are building a freelance O&M partner network: certified solar technicians who handle servicing, breakdowns, preventive maintenance, and warranty calls for rooftop solar and solar pump systems in their own districts.

You will own this network from start to finish. You will source partners, verify them, onboard them, activate them, and keep them. Think of it as the partner/supply lead role at a mobility or home-services platform, applied to solar field service. You will also work with the tech team on bringing AI into processes to smoothen up operations, from partner screening to job allocation.

**Key Responsibilities**

Partner Acquisition

• Build supply pipelines of freelance technicians district by district, using ITIs, local electrical contractors, ex-installer networks, dealer referrals, and digital channels

• Map coverage gaps against our installed base and service ticket density, then prioritize recruitment accordingly

• Run referral and drive-based hiring campaigns to hit district-level partner targets

Verification & Onboarding

• Own the onboarding funnel from lead to document collection, KYC, and background check, through skill assessment and agreement signing, and finally activation

• Run practical skill assessments for both rooftop (on-grid/hybrid) and solar pump (AC/DC, VFD controllers) systems

• Get partners onboarded onto the partner app/CRM, covering job acceptance, photo-proof uploads, and closure workflows

Training & Certification

• Design and run induction and certification modules on Claro product lines, safety standards, RMS diagnostics, and service SOPs

• Build a tiering system (e.g., Bronze/Silver/Gold) based on skill level, ratings, and SLA performance, and tie it to job priority and payouts

Activation, Quality & Retention

• Track first-job activation, ensure partners complete their first jobs within defined timelines, and fix drop-offs

• Monitor partner performance on TAT, first-time-fix rate, customer ratings, rework, and photo-proof compliance

• Run quality audits and field spot checks, and manage escalations, warnings, and offboarding

• Work with Finance on rate cards, incentive structures, and on-time payouts, since payouts are the top driver of partner retention

• Run partner engagement through WhatsApp communities, monthly calls, and recognition programs

Process & Data

• Maintain a clean partner database with skills, coverage pincodes, tier, tools owned, and availability

• Work with the tech team to automate screening, reminders, and job-routing using n8n/Make and AI agents

• Publish weekly dashboards covering funnel conversion, active partners, district coverage, SLA adherence, and churn

**What We're Looking For**

• 3–6 years in partner/supply onboarding, field operations, or service network management. Gig/marketplace platforms (mobility, home services, logistics) or solar/electrical service companies are ideal backgrounds

• Proven track record of building and scaling a distributed partner or vendor network across multiple geographies

• Enough technical comfort with solar systems to assess a technician's skill. You do not need to be an engineer

• Strong data discipline: you run the funnel on numbers, not gut feel

• Comfortable in Tier 2/3 towns and rural geographies; fluent in Hindi and English, and regional languages are a plus

• Comfort with CRMs, Google Sheets, and automation tools; exposure to n8n, Make, or AI tools is a strong plus

**Success Metrics — First 6 Months**

• Active, certified partners in target districts against plan

• Lead-to-activation conversion rate and time-to-activate

• Service TAT and first-time-fix rate across partner-handled tickets

• 90-day partner retention rate

**Why Join**

• Build a field service network from zero, with direct impact on customer uptime across 1,00,000+ installations

• Run a marketplace-style operations model in solar, a space where very few companies have built one

• Work closely with leadership and the tech team on automating a ground-level operation

**How to Apply**

Click Apply — you'll be redirected to our careers portal. Once there, click Apply Now again and fill out the short form with your LinkedIn ID, resume, and contact details. Alternatively, send your updated resume directly to hr@claroenergy.in with the subject line: Application –
Partner Onboarding Lead – O&M
[Your Name]

title: Head of Operations
description:
**About Fraganote**

Fraganote is an Indian fragrance house making everyday fragrances fun, interesting, premium, and aspirational. We create scents people love to wear and love to talk about, from our signature gourmands that smell like vanilla, coffee, caramel, and chocolate to fresh new launches. Since 2023, we've built a community of 300,000+ active customers with a 38% repeat purchase rate, across 30+ SKUs. We sell on our own website, Amazon, Nykaa, Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, and in modern trade and offline retail. We're Series A funded, based in Delhi, and growing fast.

**The Role**

You will own everything that happens between a finished product and a customer's doorstep. Warehouse, procurement, 3PL partners, D2C fulfilment, B2B and marketplace dispatches, offline and modern trade supply. You'll build the operating backbone that lets us scale without breaking.

**What You'll Own**

**Warehousing and fulfilment**

* Run warehouse operations end to end: inbound, storage, picking, packing, dispatch, returns
* Lead a mixed team of blue collar and white collar staff. Hiring, shift planning, training, productivity, and safety
* Set and hit SLAs for D2C orders, including gifting and customised orders
* Keep inventory accuracy above 99% through cycle counts, audits, and clean processes

**Channel dispatches**

* Manage dispatches to Amazon FBA, Nykaa, Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, modern trade, and offline distributors
* Meet every channel's appointment, labelling, packaging, and compliance requirement. Zero rejected consignments is the goal
* Plan peak season logistics for OND, Rakhi, Valentine's, and campaign spikes

**Procurement and supply**

* Own procurement of raw materials, packaging, and finished goods with suppliers and contract manufacturers
* Negotiate costs, lead times, MOQs, and payment terms
* Build vendor scorecards on quality, timeliness, and cost

**Inventory planning**

* Work with Revenue, Growth, and Finance on demand forecasting and channel allocation
* Prevent stockouts on hero SKUs and flag dead or slow moving stock early
* Manage stock transfers across warehouse, FBA, and qcomm dark stores

**3PL and logistics partners**

* Manage courier and 3PL partners. Negotiate rates, track RTO, delivery TAT, and damage rates
* Own the order flow across Shopify, OMS, and shipping partners. Support ERP evaluation and rollout (Odoo or equivalent)

**Cross functional**

* Partner with NPD on launch readiness, Finance on landed cost and inventory valuation, Customer Service on delivery and returns issues

**KPIs**

* Order dispatch TAT and on-time delivery %
* Inventory accuracy and stockout days on top SKUs
* Fulfilment cost per order and logistics cost as % of revenue
* RTO %, damage %, channel PO fill rate
* Procurement savings and supplier on-time delivery

**What You Bring**

* 8 to 12 years in operations and supply chain, at least 4 in a D2C, beauty, personal care, or FMCG brand
* Hands-on experience running a warehouse with blue collar teams
* Deep familiarity with Amazon FBA, quick commerce inbound, and modern trade dispatch norms
* Comfort with OMS, WMS, and ERP tools (EasyEcom, Unicommerce, Odoo, SAP, or similar) and strong Excel skills
* A builder mindset. You fix processes, not just fires

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with fragrance, cosmetics, or regulated product categories (Legal Metrology, BIS labelling)
* Gifting and kitting operations experience

title: Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textiles
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
**Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textile**
Quince is a US-based, hyper-growth tech retail start-up experiencing 100%+ YoY growth and serving millions of users each month. Backed by over USD 500 million in funding, we continue to scale rapidly. At Quince, we didn’t just build a $2B+ retail brand—we completely rewrote the playbook on cross-border e-commerce.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textile**
to join our growing team at Quince. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring products are launched in a timely manner while achieving the highest quality standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Own and actively manage day-to-day product development timelines across new products, color and size extensions, vendor transitions, and refreshes, tracking milestones and escalating risks early.
* Serve as the central point of coordination across Merchandising, Sourcing, Fit, Technical Development, Materials, QA, Creative, and Vendors to ensure alignment on development status and dependencies.

title: AI ENABLED PRODUCER
description:
**AI ENABLED PRODUCER**

BOXmedia · Remote, India · Part time to start, moving to full time after probation

**ABOUT BOXMEDIA**

BOXmedia is a video marketing agency in Leeds, UK, helping businesses grow with the power of video. We run the 1 10 100 podcast and Signal Reel, our offer that turns one recording into a month of reels, carousels, statics and stories that bring in leads. Our content engine is built around Claude, Notion, Frame.io, Metricool, GoHighLevel and n8n.

**THE ROLE**

You'll own every content job, from the moment a recording lands to the day it goes live and the results come back. You'll run our AI content engine, keep the team's week moving and make sure clients approve on time, so nothing waits for the founder.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

1. Run each podcast episode and client recording through our AI content engine, from finding the ideas to setting the posting schedule.
