3. Manage every piece of content in Notion, including approval boards and client portals.
4. Assign and plan work for our editor, motion designer and graphic designer.
5. Send work for review in Frame.io, chase approvals and turn changes round within 48 hours.
6. Book approved content in Metricool at least two weeks ahead.
7. Review weekly results, pick posts to promote as ads and send a Friday report.
8. Keep an eye on our n8n automations and flag any errors.

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED**

1. At least three years as a producer, project manager or account manager in a creative, digital or video agency.
2. Real clients or campaigns you owned, not just supported.
3. Excellent written English, confident with UK business clients.
4. Daily, hands on use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT in your real work.
5. Experience with Notion, Asana, Monday or ClickUp.
6. A highly organised person who closes loops without being reminded.
7. Able to work hours that overlap with the UK working day.

**NICE TO HAVE**

1. Experience with Frame.io, Metricool, GoHighLevel or n8n, an eye for what makes social content stop the scroll, and enough editing knowledge to review a cut in DaVinci Resolve.

**HOW THE ROLE GROWS**

1. You'll start part time on a probation period. Once probation is passed and the work is running smoothly, the role moves to full time.

**HOW TO APPLY**

1. Send your CV, a short note on how you use AI tools in your work today, and one example of a project you ran. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a paid one day trial task. The full job description is available on request.

title: Program Lead
description:
**Strategy & Programme Lead | India**

**Location:**
India, with regular travel, including to the Himalayan region

**Level:**
Senior
Manager / Director, depending on experience

**Contract**
: Initially contractor set up and then, depending on experience and programme needs we can look at staff or fixed term arrangement

**About Systemiq**

Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.

As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with practical, on-the-ground work, partnering with businesses, governments, investors and civil society to deliver system change. Our international teams work across sectors and geographies, bringing together diverse expertise to address interconnected sustainability challenges.

**The opportunity**

Systemiq is seeking an experienced Strategy & Programme Lead to help deliver and grow our portfolio of work in India, initially taking a leading role in our Himalayan systems change programme.

Building on our report,
*Prosperous and Resilient Himalayas*
, this programme aims to translate an ambitious agenda for sustainable economic growth and resilience into practical initiatives, partnerships and financing solutions. Work may span water security, climate and disaster resilience, sustainable tourism, mountain products, enterprise development and policy.

Alongside leading this programme, you will contribute to other strategic advisory and systems change projects across India, working with colleagues across Systemiq's global platforms. You will also help identify and develop new opportunities, build relationships with potential clients and partners, and contribute to expanding our presence and impact in India.

We are looking for someone who combines strong management consulting capabilities, practical programme leadership and commercial judgement with a deep understanding of India's economic, policy and institutional landscape.

At Systemiq, our leaders remain closely involved in the substance and delivery of our work. This role offers significant autonomy and requires someone equally comfortable shaping strategy, leading complex engagements and turning new opportunities into funded work.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead strategic programmes and engagements. Take ownership of the Himalayan programme and contribute to other advisory projects across India, shaping priorities, analytical approaches, workplans and delivery.
* Drive business development and growth. Identify and develop new project opportunities across sectors, build relationships with potential clients and funders, lead proposals and help convert opportunities into funded engagements.
* Provide strategic and analytical leadership. Guide complex research, economic and financial analysis, business cases and feasibility assessments, translating findings into clear recommendations and practical solutions.
* Build senior stakeholder relationships. Develop trusted relationships with government, businesses, financial institutions, funders and other partners, navigating complex institutional and commercial environments.
* Translate strategy into implementation. Turn policy, sustainability and financing challenges into actionable programmes, partnerships and investment propositions that can deliver measurable impact.
* Lead and develop teams. Provide direction, oversight and mentorship to multidisciplinary project teams, ensuring high-quality delivery, sound project economics and effective collaboration.
* Collaborate across platforms and geographies. Work with Systemiq colleagues internationally, bringing together expertise across nature, energy, finance, materials and economic development to address interconnected challenges.

**The experience and capabilities we are looking for**

**Consulting and strategic leadership**

* Typically 7+ years of relevant experience in management consulting, strategy advisory or an equivalent consulting-led environment, with seniority reflecting experience.
* A strong generalist consulting toolkit, including structured problem-solving, quantitative and qualitative analysis, strategic synthesis and executive-level communication.
* Proven experience independently leading complex consulting engagements or strategic programmes, managing teams and delivering high-quality recommendations.
* Strong commercial judgement, with experience identifying opportunities, developing proposals, winning work or building client relationships.
* The ability to work across different sectors and subject areas, quickly developing an understanding of unfamiliar challenges and translating analysis into practical solutions.

**Relevant sector and regional experience**

* Significant professional experience in India, with a strong understanding of its economic, policy, institutional and business environment.
* Experience engaging senior stakeholders across government, business, finance, development institutions or philanthropy.
* Relevant experience in sustainable development, climate resilience, natural resources, economic development, sustainable finance or related sectors.
* Experience in the Himalayan region, mountain economies, rural livelihoods, sustainable tourism or nature-based economic development would be an advantage.
* Sound economic and financial literacy, including experience developing business cases, investment propositions or financing strategies.

**Leadership and personal attributes**

* An entrepreneurial, commercially minded leader who combines strategic thinking with practical delivery.
* Confident operating independently, managing ambiguity and taking ownership of complex engagements.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the credibility to engage senior stakeholders.
* Adaptable and intellectually curious, with the ability to move between different projects, sectors and challenges.
* Able to think across policy, markets, finance and environmental systems, recognising how they interact and identifying opportunities for wider systems change.
* A collaborative leader committed to Systemiq's mission and to advancing sustainable, inclusive economic development.

**Languages and travel**

* Fluent English is essential. Hindi and/or another relevant Indian language would be an advantage.
* Willingness to travel regularly across India, including field visits in the Himalayan region, is essential.

**What we offer**

* Meaningful leadership: Take a leading role in a high-impact Himalayan initiative while contributing to Systemiq's wider portfolio in India.
* Entrepreneurial opportunity: Help shape new projects, partnerships and opportunities across an evolving regional portfolio.
* Diverse project experience: Work across strategy, policy, finance, sustainability and implementation, with opportunities to influence work beyond a single sector.
* Local focus, global collaboration: Build relationships in India while working with international colleagues and accessing Systemiq's global expertise.
* Autonomy and influence: Take ownership of major engagements and contribute directly to the growth and impact of our work.
* Flexible engagement arrangements: We are open to considering both fixed-term employment and consultancy arrangements, depending on experience and programme needs.

**Reward and Recognition**
The remuneration and benefits package will reflect the successful candidate's experience and expertise.

title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering (Singapore)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
  
  
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Sell

+ Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
+ Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
+ Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
+ Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements

**Deliver**

* Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite
* Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions
* Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
* Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
* Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

**Manage People**

* Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
* Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
* Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
* Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job
* You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement
* You've built and scaled IC-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Meet the Team**
The Splunk Agent Resilience team is defining the future of AI resilience. Together our team provides scalable, cost-effective evaluation and guardrails that ensure AI agents behave as intended, improving reliability and reducing risks. This unified approach empowers our customers to expertly deploy and manage AI-powered applications with enhanced observability and control.
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you'll work at the intersection of software engineering, customer engagement, and product innovation to help some of the world's largest enterprises successfully deploy AI into production. You'll partner closely with external customers to solve complex technical challenges while collaborating with internal Product and Engineering teams to improve the platform based on real-world customer needs.
  
  
If you enjoy solving hard engineering problems, working directly with customers, and building technology that scales beyond a single implementation, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**As a Forward Deployed Engineer, You Will**

* Partner with enterprise customers to understand technical requirements and business goals.
* Design scalable AI solution architectures and guide customers through production deployments.
* Build integrations, prototypes, and reusable tools that accelerate customer success.
* Lead technical workshops, architecture discussions, and troubleshoot complex production issues.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to share customer feedback and influence future product enhancements.
* Create documentation, reusable best practices, and technical assets that benefit future deployments.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* 4+ years of strong software engineering experience building production-grade applications.
* Experience with APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or backend development.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, cursor, etc.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across multiple layers of the technology stack.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with enterprise customers.
* Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
* Interest in AI, Machine Learning, or developer platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience deploying or supporting Generative AI, LLM, or Machine Learning applications in production.
* Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, observability, or MLOps.
* Experience building customer-facing technical solutions or integrations.
* Experience creating reusable developer tools, frameworks, or open-source contributions.
* Consulting, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Customer Success experience in enterprise environments.
* Experience with programming language such as python, Java, etc.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Design Delivery Lead - Production Design Operations
description:
**Role Summary**

We are looking for a Design Delivery Lead to own and drive creative design and multimedia delivery across the organisation. You will lead a team of graphic designers, multimedia specialists, and creative professionals. Your team will deliver high-quality visual communication and digital content aligned with business and client objectives.

You will set the creative strategy, oversee design execution, and partner with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. The goal is to deliver impactful, consistent brand experiences across presentations, campaigns, digital channels, and client-facing materials. You will also build scalable workflows, quality standards, and AI-enabled ways of working that raise the team's efficiency and creative output.

**What will you do?**

**Team Leadership and People Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of graphic designers, multimedia specialists, and creative professionals.
* Set clear goals, track performance, and conduct regular performance reviews.
* Provide constructive feedback and creative guidance to build design capability and a culture of quality.
* Plan team capacity, resourcing, and shift coverage to support odd operating hours and global delivery.

**End-to-End Delivery Ownership**

* Own planning, prioritisation, execution, quality assurance, and on-time delivery of creative and multimedia projects.
* Manage multiple projects at once, balancing priorities, timelines, resources, and stakeholder expectations.
* Track delivery against SLAs, turnaround times, and quality metrics, and escalate risks early.
* Report on delivery performance, productivity, and quality to senior leadership.

**Creative Strategy and Concept Development**

* Develop creative concepts and visual strategies for presentations, campaigns, digital assets, social media, internal communications, and client-facing materials.
* Translate business objectives and brand guidelines into clear, effective visual solutions.
* Keep the team informed on design trends, emerging formats, and multimedia best practices.

**Quality, Brand Compliance, and Governance**

* Review and approve creative outputs for quality, consistency, brand compliance, and adherence to client requirements.
* Establish creative standards, templates, style guides, and quality frameworks.
* Maintain version control, asset management, and review and approval workflows.

**Stakeholder and Client Management**

* Partner with business leaders, marketing and communications teams, and client stakeholders to gather and clarify requirements.
* Set expectations, manage feedback cycles, and resolve conflicting priorities or escalations.
* Act as the senior point of contact for design delivery.

**What will you need?**

* **Experience:**
  14–16 years of overall experience, including 9–12+ years in Production and Design Operations, creative services, graphic design, multimedia, or visual communications.
* **Leadership:**
  Proven experience leading and managing creative teams, with strong mentoring and performance management skills.
* **Delivery management:**
  Demonstrated experience managing large-scale, multi-project creative delivery with tight deadlines.
* **Design expertise:**
  Strong understanding of graphic design, visual communication, typography, layout, and branding.
* **Tools proficiency:**
  Hands-on knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro) and Microsoft PowerPoint.
* **Multimedia knowledge:**
  Working understanding of video, animation, motion graphics, and digital content production.
* **Quality and brand governance:**
  Strong eye for detail, with experience reviewing outputs and ensuring brand compliance.
* **Stakeholder management:**
  Excellent communication and negotiation skills with senior business leaders, marketing teams, and clients.
* **Process orientation:**
  Experience building workflows, templates, SOPs, and quality frameworks.

title: Implementation Team Lead
description:
**Team Lead, Implementation**

*Cvent Implementation Team | Full-Time| People-Leadership Role |AI-Augmented*

**About the Team**

The Cvent Implementation team configures and deploys Cvent software for new and existing clients. Our mission is to provide expert guidance and hands-on technical execution so every client successfully launches, adopts, and realizes value from their Cvent products.

The work blends project management, technical configuration, and client-facing consulting — and increasingly, the smart use of AI tools to move faster, reduce manual work, and deliver a sharper, more consultative client experience. As a Team Lead, you own the performance, growth, and delivery economics of a pod of Implementation Consultants operating in exactly this environment.

**Role Overview**

As Team Lead, Implementation, you lead a pod of Implementation Consultants and Senior Implementation Consultants — accountable for their delivery quality, client outcomes, professional growth, and the financial performance of your pod's portfolio. You operate as a player-coach: close enough to projects to unblock complex escalations and guarantee delivery standards, while owning the coaching, capability-building, and pod-level P&L that turn a group of strong ICs into a high-performing, predictable delivery team.

You are the first line of business accountability for delivery economics and the first line of client governance, running business reviews at the pod and skip-level, and mentoring your team on AI-first ways of working.

**Recruitment Scam Notice:**
Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “name@cvent.com” email addresses. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.

If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.

For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice: https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud.

**Key Responsibilities**

**People Leadership & Coaching**

* Lead, coach, and develop a pod of Implementation Consultants and Senior Implementation Consultants, owning their performance, growth, and engagement end-to-end.
* Run structured weekly or bi-weekly 1:1s (more frequent for new hires) focused on project coaching, skill development, and career progression — not just status updates.
* Conduct at least one live coaching/feedback client call per direct report per month, using real client interactions as the basis for targeted development.
* Write and conduct mid-year and annual performance reviews; build and execute individual development and ramp plans; actively manage under-performance and grow bench strength.
* Own new-hire onboarding and ramp for the pod — ensure training is completed thoroughly and new hires reach productivity on plan.
* Balance and monitor individual workloads across the pod, reallocating capacity to protect delivery quality and prevent burnout.

**Delivery & Financial Ownership (P&L)**

* **Own the P&L for your pod's project portfolio**
  — accountable for utilization, burn rate, project profitability, cost-to-serve, and gross margin at the pod level, and take corrective action where performance drifts.
* Manage the health of all projects across the pod — timeliness of deliverables, quality of client deliverables, scope adherence, customer satisfaction, and portfolio risk.
* Track time and profitability across engagements and drive recommendations on streamlining, automation, or process redesign to improve delivery economics.
* Enforce SOP and quality compliance across all client-facing deliverables — workflow diagrams, MRFs, AM templates, step-by-step guides, and configuration output — ensuring consistent, high-quality material leaves the pod.
* Own escalation management for all direct reports and projects: course-correct, put action plans in place, and mitigate delivery and relationship risk before it reaches leadership.

**Client Governance & Business Reviews**

* **Conduct Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews (MBRs / QBRs)**
  with clients and skip-level stakeholders (Sr. Manager / Director of PSO), using business storytelling to connect delivery and financial metrics to clear recommendations and actions.
* Join new-customer Kick-Off and project Close-Out calls for direct reports, and maintain regular executive check-ins with key client stakeholders across the pod's portfolio.
* Translate pod performance into executive-ready narratives — trends across delivery quality, utilization, margin, cost-to-serve, customer sentiment, and delivery risk — for skip-level and senior leadership.
* Provide proactive, structured communication to senior leadership on team feedback, performance signals, customer risks, and recognitions.

**AI-Enabled Delivery Leadership**

*AI is now a core part of how implementation work gets done. As a Team Lead, you are expected not only to use AI fluently, but to raise the pod's AI capability:*

* **Model and coach AI-first ways of working**
  — help your pod use generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to accelerate requirements docs, process maps, configuration workbooks, test cases, training material, and client communications.
* **Own quality of AI-assisted output at the pod level**
  — set and enforce human-in-the-loop review standards so AI-generated configurations, documentation, and client communications are validated before they reach the client.
* Identify and champion lightweight automations and AI-agent workflows for repetitive delivery tasks — status updates, test-case generation, FAQs — and scale what works across the pod.
* Use AI-powered analytics on usage patterns, support tickets, and historical project data to proactively flag delivery risk and improve implementation quality across your portfolio.

**Technical Depth & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Stay hands-on enough to assist with complex issue resolution and configuration work, and to guarantee delivery standards on the pod's most challenging engagements.
* Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Customer Success where implementation expertise supports adoption, renewal readiness, and expansion — surfacing opportunities to those teams (retention and expansion targets remain owned at the Manager level).
* Interface with Product to convey client feature requests and delivery friction identified across the pod.
* Carry 1–2 team-wide internal initiatives (e.g., SOP/SME workstreams, scope team, training series, product readiness) that improve how the broader team operates.

**Required Skills, Experience & Qualifications**

* **10+ years of overall work experience**
  in implementation, professional services, project delivery, or client-facing roles — preferably in SaaS, corporate meetings/events, software, or high-tech.
* **Minimum 3–4 years of direct people-management experience**
  , leading client-facing delivery or implementation teams.
* Demonstrated ownership of delivery economics — utilization, project profitability, and margin — with a track record of improving them through coaching and process change.
* Proven ability to run client-facing business reviews (MBRs/QBRs) and translate operational and financial metrics into clear, executive-ready recommendations.
* Strong coaching and development track record — measurably improving IC performance, ramp speed, and retention.
* Strong project management discipline — scoping, planning, RAID/risk logs, milestone tracking, and status reporting across multiple concurrent client engagements.
* Ability to translate customer goals into objective, measurable success criteria (adoption, time-to-value, cycle time, ROI) and hold the pod accountable to them.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with confident client-facing presence and strong presentation skills.
* Ability to diagram intermediate-to-complex process flows and identify efficiency opportunities.
* Proficiency with core productivity tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio/Draw.io) and CRM/PSA tooling (e.g., Salesforce).
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent applicable experience.

**AI & Technology Fluency**

* Hands-on, practical experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to accelerate delivery work, and the ability to coach others in doing the same.
* Comfort operating and enforcing a human-in-the-loop model — reviewing, validating, and correcting AI-generated outputs before they reach clients.
* Working understanding of how AI agents and automated workflows apply to onboarding, configuration, and reporting (formal AI/ML background not required).

**Preferred, Not Required**

* Experience with AI-assisted meeting transcription/summarization tools (e.g., Copilot, Glean, Claude).
* Exposure to no-code/low-code automation (e.g., Zapier, Power Automate) or agentic workflow builders.
* Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum) or Six Sigma (Green Belt+).

title: BI&A Manager
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
BCG’s Business Intelligence and Analytics (BI&A) Services Hub is a centralized global reporting and analytics capability that enhances how management consumes and uses information to drive better business outcomes. As an integral part of BCG’s Global Enterprise Services, the team provides meaningful insights and analysis supported by accurate, reliable data to guide and influence decision-making.
  
  
As part of the BI&A Services Hub, the Non-Financial Reporting (NFR) team is accountable to deliver high-quality ESG and non-financial reporting to stakeholders. The NFR Manager leads this effort, ensuring accurate, consistent, and timely reporting by translating regulatory and reporting framework requirements into structured processes, robust data models, and actionable insights that support informed decision-making.
  
  
In this role, you will lead and manage ESG reporting and disclosures across key global regulatory requirements and reporting frameworks, including but not limited to EU CSRD/ESRS, AASB, GRI, and SBTi, alongside an expanding range of jurisdiction-specific climate, carbon, and human rights disclosure requirements. You will take ownership of end-to-end project delivery, managing timelines, priorities, dependencies, and multiple stakeholders to ensure accurate, consistent, and audit-ready disclosures.
  
  
The role requires strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to engage confidently with senior leadership, manage expectations, constructively challenge requests, and make informed decisions on priorities and scope when necessary. You will collaborate closely with a diverse network of NFR partners and cross-functional teams to coordinate ESG data collection, strengthen reporting controls, and support double materiality assessments. You will also be expected to bring a collaborative and open mindset, actively seek and embrace new ideas, proactively recommend improvements, and identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and enhance reporting processes. As the regulatory landscape evolves, you will play a key role in translating emerging requirements into scalable reporting solutions while balancing business needs, regulatory obligations, and delivery priorities..
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Sustainability, Environmental Studies, Business, Finance, or a related field
* Minimum 8+ years of relevant experience in sustainability consulting, ESG reporting, or related roles
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication skills; written and oral
* Flexible working across time zones
* Advanced computer literacy

+ Experience with advanced excel, building reports, and diagnosing issues
+ Experience in using Gen AI (Claude, ChatGPT etc.) for personal and team productivity

Who You'll Work With
  
  
As a member of the NFR Team, you will interact extensively with a diverse range of stakeholders from across the business, both geographically and functionally. This includes, but is not limited to Local, Regional, Global, and Practice Area analysis teams, as well as, the overall Global sustainability team.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**YOU’RE GOOD AT**
Sustainability / ESG & Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong understanding of ESG frameworks, sustainability regulations, and non-financial reporting requirements
* Hands-on experience with ESG reporting frameworks including CSRD / ESRS, ISSB, AASB, SBTi, and ability to build fluency across regimes as scope expands
* Strong data-driven mindset with the ability to interpret ESG data and understand business implications
* Hands-on experience with ESG/NFR reporting platforms (e.g., Workiva, Novisto, Watershed, or comparable systems of record), including governance and controls such as role-based access and permissions, workflow management, and audit trail/version control

Problem Solving and Analytical Skills
  
  

* Ability to structure ambiguous sustainability and ESG challenges into clear analytical approaches
* Experience conducting CSRD-aligned materiality and double materiality assessments, including climate-related risks and opportunities
* Comfortable working with evolving regulations across multiple jurisdictions, complex datasets, and iterative problem-solving environments

Strategy, Collaboration, and Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Ability to support the development and execution of ESG and sustainability strategies
* Experience translating ESG priorities into strategic initiatives, KPIs, and governance structures
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills, including coordination across internal teams, clients, and external partners
* Ability to support and facilitate ESG-focused workshops and senior stakeholder discussions

Work Management, Organization, and Planning
  
  

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple ESG workstreams simultaneously
* High attention to detail to ensure accuracy, consistency, and audit readiness of ESG outputs
* Demonstrates sound judgment and ownership in day-to-day project execution

"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, business acumen, writing, research and presentation-building skills; attention to detail and striving to produce defect free deliverables
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global team environment

title: Senior Program Manager — Business Operations & Execution
description:
**Senior Program Manager — Business Operations & Execution**

**Department:**

Business Operations / Founder's Office

**Location:**

Gurugram, Haryana

**Experience:**

4-8 years

**Reporting to:**

Founder / CEO / COO

**Employment Type:**

Full-time

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly driven Senior Program Manager to bring structure, accountability, and execution discipline across the organization. This role will work closely with the Founder and department heads to translate business priorities into actionable plans, streamline cross-functional workflows, and ensure critical initiatives are delivered on time with measurable outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines strong program management, business operations, analytical thinking, and stakeholder management skills. They should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, addressing ambiguous challenges, improving existing processes, and driving accountability across teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Planning & Execution**

* Translate company goals and leadership priorities into actionable plans with defined owners, milestones, dependencies, and deadlines.
* Maintain a centralized tracker of company-wide priorities, strategic initiatives, and critical deliverables.
* Coordinate execution across departments and ensure alignment on priorities and expected outcomes.
* Identify execution bottlenecks and drive timely resolution of dependencies and blockers.

**2. Cross-Functional Program Management**

* Lead strategic initiatives involving multiple departments, ensuring clear ownership and accountability.
* Establish weekly delivery reviews with department heads to assess progress, risks, delays, and corrective actions.
* Identify potential delays early and facilitate decisions to keep initiatives on track.
* Ensure commitments are realistic, progress is transparent, and outcomes are delivered as agreed.

**3. Process Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Identify gaps in existing workflows, handoffs, ownership structures, and operating processes.
* Design and implement scalable SOPs, workflows, review mechanisms, and accountability frameworks.
* Investigate recurring operational issues and implement corrective actions to prevent repetition.
* Drive adoption of improved processes and continuously evaluate their effectiveness.

**4. Performance Monitoring & Reporting**

* Build dashboards and management reports to track delivery timelines, quality, backlog, productivity, and business outcomes.
* Prepare concise weekly updates for the Founder covering progress, risks, decisions required, and key deviations.
* Use data and root-cause analysis to identify inefficiencies and recommend improvements.
* Establish measurable KPIs for strategic initiatives and track results against agreed targets.

**5. Stakeholder Management & Leadership Support**

* Work closely with the Founder and department heads to align priorities, resolve conflicting demands, and improve execution.
* Facilitate cross-functional decision-making and ensure action items are closed.
* Influence stakeholders through structured problem-solving, data-backed recommendations, and clear communication.
* Drive operational change while ensuring teams understand and adopt new ways of working.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 5–8 years of experience in Program Management, Business Operations, Strategy & Operations, Founder's Office, Chief of Staff, or Business Transformation.
* Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional initiatives from planning through execution.
* Experience building operational processes, dashboards, trackers, KPIs, and management reporting systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities and influence stakeholders across departments.
* Advanced working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets and presentation tools; familiarity with project management platforms is preferred.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Background**

* Experience in a high-growth startup, digital business, SaaS company, technology company, or consulting environment.
* Experience working directly with founders, CEOs, or senior leadership.
* Exposure to process automation, workflow optimization, and change management.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Business, Management, Operations, or a related discipline is preferred.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Clear ownership of company-wide priorities and strategic initiatives.
* Improved on-time delivery and fewer recurring execution delays.
* Better coordination and handoffs between departments.
* Documented, scalable processes that teams consistently follow.
* Reliable management reporting and early visibility into risks.

Measurable improvements in operational efficiency and business outcomes.

**Core mandate :Company-wide execution, process improvement, accountability, reporting**

The objective of the GRC Control Management (CM) and Transformation role will coordinate and support control testing activities, develop executive reporting and insights, partner across risk organizations, to strengthen the control environment. This role will drive process standardization and continuous improvement, leverage data and AI-enabled solutions to enhance efficiency and provide actionable reporting to support risk and control management decisions.

It will involve extensive collaboration with multiple partners across numerous business units, functional areas, and geographies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The Manager, GRC, Control Management and Transformation will:
  
  

* Coordinate and support control testing activities across multiple GRC stakeholders, including tracking testing execution, results, and remediation efforts.
* Develop executive reporting, dashboards, and presentations that clearly communicate control performance, risk trends, program status, and actionable recommendations.
* Perform data validation, quality assurance, and analysis of control management data to identify key trends, risks, insights, and opportunities for improvement.
* Review Regulatory Change Management (RCM) to ensure appropriate stakeholder is assigned, updates are made, and effective challenge of RCM closures.
* Support regular status updates and communicate progress, findings, and risks to key stakeholders and leadership teams.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**

* Strong project management and organizational skills, with experience tracking deliverables, managing timelines, coordinating across multiple stakeholders, and driving initiatives to completion.

title: Production Manager
description:
**Company Description**
WEVOW is a leading Indian ethnic wear brand specializing in handcrafted sarees, blouses, and jewelry that showcase the richness of Indian culture. The brand blends traditional craftsmanship with contemporary design to create distinctive, high-quality pieces for a modern audience. WEVOW focuses on preserving artisanal techniques while offering products that are relevant to current fashion trends. Team members work in a creative, detail-oriented environment closely connected to skilled artisans and designers. More information about WEVOW and its collections can be found at www.wevow.in.
  
**Role Description**
The Production Manager will oversee end-to-end production operations for ethnic wear and accessories, ensuring quality, timely delivery, and efficient use of resources. Day-to-day responsibilities include planning and scheduling production, coordinating with artisans and suppliers, monitoring inventory of fabrics and materials, and supervising the workflow from sampling to final dispatch. The role involves implementing quality control processes, resolving production issues, optimizing costs, and maintaining clear communication with design, merchandising, and logistics teams. The Production Manager will also be responsible for documenting processes, tracking production metrics, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Kolkata.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong production planning and coordination skills, including scheduling, resource allocation, and workflow management in apparel or textiles.
* Experience with quality control and assurance, including inspection standards, defect tracking, and continuous improvement in manufacturing processes.
* Proficiency in vendor and artisan management, including sourcing, negotiating timelines and costs, and maintaining collaborative relationships.
* Inventory and materials management skills, including tracking stock levels, overseeing procurement, and minimizing wastage.
* Knowledge of garment construction, fabrics, and traditional Indian ethnic wear production techniques is highly beneficial.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and deadline-focused execution.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead and motivate production teams in a diverse environment.
* Comfort with basic digital tools (spreadsheets, production tracking software, or ERP systems) for reporting and planning.
* Relevant experience in apparel manufacturing, textile production, or fashion industry; prior work with handcrafted or artisanal products is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Production Management, Textile Engineering, Fashion Technology, or a related field preferred.

We are a fast-growing marketing, communications and technology group undergoing a significant transformation. Through a series of acquisitions and integrations, we are bringing together diverse capabilities across digital marketing, full service advertising, events as well as social media listening and intelligence, web, app and technology solutions.

We partner with leading brands across consumer goods, cement, real estate, industrial and various other sectors with offices in Kolkata, Delhi and Mumbai.

Our focus is on building a unified, integrated group by establishing new business units, developing shared systems and teams, strengthening collaboration across verticals and expanding into new cities and international markets. **Founders’ Support, Leadership Coordination and Strategic Initiatives**

* Act as a sounding board for new ideas, leads and opportunities raised by the founders.

**Research and Analysis**

* Conduct research on new markets, business opportunities, competitors and potential partnerships.
* Assist in preparing business presentations, proposals and strategic discussion documents.
* Support special projects and ad hoc assignments initiated by the founders.
* Help evaluate opportunities for operational improvements, process standardisation and business expansion.

* Support monthly and quarterly business reviews through data collation, presentation preparation and follow-up.
* Ensure information presented to leadership is accurate, structured and available on time.

* Proficiency in Google Workspace, MS Office and other productivity tools.

title: Design Lead - Interiors & Architecture
description:
About Sinclairs

Sinclairs Hotels & Resorts is one of eastern India's most established hospitality names, operating nine properties across the country's hills, plains and coastline, from Himalayan resorts to a beachfront hotel in the Andamans. We are a listed, debt-free group with a strong cash position, now in an active expansion phase and transforming how we run: our commercial discipline, our people systems and our technology.

The Role

We are bringing design in-house. You will own interior design and architecture across the estate: a new-build destination property on our 22-acre site at Chalsa in the Dooars, refurbishments and new outlets across nine properties, kitchens and back-of-house, and FF&E. You take a space from concept to working drawings to a finished, snagged, opened room, and you manage external consultants where a project needs them.

We are inviting both interior designers/decorators and architects, provided you have real project execution experience: you have drawn it, specified it, stood on site and delivered it.

What You'll Own

* Design language for Sinclairs, rooted in each region, applied to rooms, public areas, F&B outlets, banqueting, spa and exteriors
* - Concepts, mood boards, space plans and 3D visuals; full working drawing sets, finishes schedules, joinery and furniture details, MEP coordination
* - Specifications, BOQs, cost estimates and value engineering
* - Site execution: contractor briefings, shop drawings, mock-ups, quality checks, snagging and handover
* - FF&E design, sampling and sourcing with our Purchase Manager (imported and local carpenter-built)
* - Selecting, briefing and managing external architects and specialist consultants

Hard Skills

* AutoCAD at expert level
* - SketchUp with V-Ray, Enscape or Lumion
* - Photoshop and InDesign; Excel for BOQs and schedules
* - Able to read and coordinate structural and MEP drawings
* - Revit/ArchiCAD, 3ds Max and MS Project are a plus

What We're Looking For

* Degree in architecture or interior design; capability across both disciplines
* - 6+ years, with at least two hospitality projects (hotels, resorts, restaurants, bars) taken from concept to a completed, operating space
* - A portfolio showing concept work and the working drawings behind it
* - Site supervision experience with contractors and fabricators
* - Hands-on FF&E specification and vendor management
* - Willing to travel extensively to properties and sites, including remote hill and island locations

Where This Goes

Founding design seat in a group that is about to build more than it has in decades. Progression to Head of Design & Projects as the pipeline grows.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY - GDS Consulting**
–
**GRC Technology – SAP GRC AC – Manager**
As part of our EY-GDS GRC Technology team, you will drive complex GRC Technology (SAP Security & GRC) engagements and help solve broader risks through solution implementation. You will be responsible for ideating, developing & launching new services in line with the SAP roadmap for enterprise solutions. You will be the SMR to recommend, design, develop, document, test and debug new and existing implementations and/or applications for internal use, for difficult business problems. In addition, participate in solution designing and consult with business clients/onsite team to understand and meet business needs, and achieving business and technology initiatives.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Manager with expertise in
**SAP GRC AC (Access Controls)**
to join the leadership group of our
**EY-GDS GRC Technology Team**
. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of the service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Actively aid the team in different phases of the project including problem definition, effort estimation, diagnosis, solution generation, design and deployment
* Share responsibility, provide support, foresee challenges, maintain clear communication channels with the senior management as well as possess a strong grasp on engagement nitty-gritties
* Should possess the technical prowess to drive the projects and the capability to lead a team
* Build connect with client stakeholders, understand their business challenges/pain areas a work with leadership to propose innovative solutions
* Lead process walkthrough discussions to document end-to-end business processes and functional requirements
* Demonstrate a detailed knowledge of market trends, competitor activities, EY products and service lines
* Generate innovative ideas and challenge the status quo
* Build and nurture positive working relationships with clients with the intention to achieve exceptional client service
* Identify opportunities to improve engagement profitability
* Help manage the financial aspects of engagements by organizing staffing, tracking financials, proactive Project management and tracking of issues
* Support leadership to drive business development initiatives and account mining activities.
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Support business development activities through both leading pursuits and developing strong relationships with existing clients
* Contribute in development of intellectual capital in your industry of expertise
* Be a part of case teams to provide solutions to unstructured problems

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong communication, presentation and team building skills and experience in producing high quality reports, papers, and presentations
* Develop people through effective coaching and mentoring
* Experience in executing and managing research and analysis of companies and markets trends, preferably from a commercial due diligence standpoint
* Contribute to people-related initiatives including recruiting, retaining, appraisal and training
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop skills of team members and self

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* CA/MBA/M.Sc./B.Tech with a minimum 8+ years of consulting / auditing experience
* Manage complex S4HANA transformation projects and drive delivery of SAP GRC and Security solutions
* Drive client discussions to design robust SAP GRC solutions for complex SAP landscapes
* Rich experience in strategizing GRC architecture, implementing key controls and driving innovations within the projects
* Good exposure to designing processes for managing key controls within the organisation
* Experience in at least 4-6 implementation, upgrade or migration projects for SAP GRC and has led at least 1 end to end S4HANA implementation or migration project
* Ability to independently lead/drive pursuits and sales discussions
* Should be able to independently drive strategic initiatives within the firm
* Preferable and added advantage, comfortable with SAP Security architecture and implementations, ability to design robust SAP Security solutions for complex SAP landscapes
* Good to have experience managing ITGC framework and logical access review/assessments, defining the best practices/KPIs for configuration and settings of change management and logical access controls, assessing current ITGC controls and deliver remediation roadmaps
* Good exposure to regulatory requirements like SOx, GDPR, GxP etc. and its impact on SAP GRC solutions
* Exposure to GRC products other than SAP will be an added advantage (For e.g. Oracle GRC,Archer, ServiceNow GRC, IBM Open pages etc.)
* Clear understanding of project lifecycle managements for e.g. SDLC, Agile and its deliverables
* Project management skills
* Good knowledge of MS Office tools
* Good to have certifications - CISA, PMP, SAFe Agilist, SAP GRC AC, SAP Security professional or SAP authorization and auditing
* Innovative mindset to drive automation agenda within the team
* Exposure to RPA transformation program approach and understanding of RPA tools like Blue Prism, UI Path
* Working knowledge of analytical tools and software to support data analysis and visualization engagements

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis

* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reports, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 5-7 years of experience in installing and implementing PAM solutions like CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Thycotic, Conjur/Hashicorp Vault
* Experience using Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and knowledge of Application container tools and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Image Registries
* Experience in integration of Conjur/Hashicorp Vault with enterprise applications, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps application (Jenkins, Ansible etc) will be an added advantage
* Experience in managing Windows/Linux environments and Database (PostgreSQL ideal)
* Proficiency in scripting languages- Python, JSON, Ruby, C#, PowerShell, YAML
* Knowledge of the function and use of REST APIs
* Working knowledge of common and industry standard cloud-native/cloud-friendly authentication mechanisms (OAuth, OpenID, etc)
* Define and describe Conjur/Hashicorp architecture, requirements, and workflow
* Integration of Secret Management solution with 3rd party solutions (LDAP/ SIEM)
* Ability to conduct workshops to understand existing service models, analyse DevOps procedures and security requirements, and identify required secret management functions and relevant use cases
* Supports and oversees the planning, maintenance and change management for risk system strategies, process changes, system parameter changes, production schedules, and operational tasks.
* Works with stakeholders to resolve issues and provide solutions that ensure service delivery and effectiveness.
* Ability to provide PAM best practices recommendations to the client
* Supports the development and maintenance of system and process documentation / process controls / knowledge assets required for the operation

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in Privileged Management Solutions like CyberArk, Thycotic, Hashicorp
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 5-7 years’ Work Experience
* CyberArk CDE or relevant product certification

**Certifications:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Hashicorp Vault/ CyberArk Conjur

**What We Look For**

* Who has hands on experience in setting up the Identity and Access Management environment in standalone and cluster environment.
* Who has hands-on Development experience on Application and Directory Integration, User Provisioning, Okta Workflows, triggers, Rules and customizing the tool as per the requirements.

**What We Offer You**

title: Project Manager-SAP HANA
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a seasoned Project Manager: SAP HANA, you will lead SAP HANA implementation projects from initiation to delivery, ensuring successful implementation of SAP HANA solutions that meet business objectives. You will manage cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and vendors to deliver projects on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Develop and Execute Project Plans: Develop and execute project plans, resource allocation, and budget management to ensure successful project delivery. This includes managing project schedules, milestones, and deadlines.
* Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams, including SAP HANA consultants, IT, and business stakeholders to ensure effective collaboration and project delivery.
* Manage Vendor Relationships: Manage vendor relationships and contracts to ensure successful project delivery and quality assurance.
* Ensure Quality Assurance: Ensure quality assurance and testing of SAP HANA solutions to meet business objectives and customer needs.
* Communicate Project Progress: Communicate project progress, issues, and changes to stakeholders to ensure transparency and effective project management.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Deep Expertise in SAP HANA Implementation: Proven experience in managing large-scale SAP HANA implementation projects, with a strong understanding of SAP HANA products and project management methodologies.
* Experience with Cross-Functional Team Management: Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate cross-functional teams, including SAP HANA consultants, IT, and business stakeholders, to deliver projects on time and within budget.
* Strong Project Planning and Execution Skills: Experience in developing and executing project plans, resource allocation, and budget management, with a focus on ensuring successful project delivery.
* Vendor Relationship Management: Proven ability to manage vendor relationships and contracts to ensure successful project delivery and quality assurance.
* Quality Assurance and Testing: Experience in ensuring quality assurance and testing of SAP HANA solutions to meet business objectives and customer needs.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* SAP HANA Product Knowledge: Deep understanding of SAP HANA products, including their features, functionality, and implementation best practices. Experience with SAP HANA product roadmaps and release cycles is beneficial.
* Agile Project Methodologies: Familiarity with agile project management methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban, and experience in applying these methodologies to SAP HANA implementation projects.
* IT Service Management: Knowledge of IT service management frameworks, such as ITIL, and experience in applying these frameworks to ensure high-quality SAP HANA solutions and services.

title: S&C GN - Tech Strategy & Transformation - AI Architect - Consultant
description:
**AI Architect — Consultant**
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to enable our most strategic clients to realize exceptional business value from AI and GenAI architecture.
  
  
**Practice**
: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
  
  
**Areas of Work**
: GenAI Strategy & Architecture
  
  
**Level**
: Consultant
  
  
**Location**
: Bangalore / Gurugram / Mumbai / Pune / Chennai / Kolkata / Hyderabad
  
  
**Years of Experience**
: 5 to 9 years
  
  
**Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture**
Do you believe in creating an impact? Are you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformative strategies for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
  
  
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation.
  
  
**The Practice — A Brief Sketch**
The Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on the clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.
  
  
As part of this high-performing team, you will work on scaling AI — and the data that fuels it — to power every single person and every single process. You will design and guide enterprise-wide AI & GenAI solutions, from advisory through to production-grade deployment, working at the intersection of strategy and technology.
  
  
**Business Case & Value Transformation:**
Assessment of AI potential and development of use cases — including process hotspot identification using process mining and value-led prioritisation — that can transform business operations.
**Agentic AI Design:**
Help design agentic workflows, multi-agent orchestration, and AI agent architecture for production-grade deployment using LLMs and GenAI platforms.

* Understanding of ML, deep learning, NLP, predictive analytics and the end-to-end AI lifecycle.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, MLOps, LLMOps, observability and production support.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture, data governance, model risk, Responsible AI, privacy, cybersecurity, accessibility and regulatory controls.
