* Escalates technical risks, platform dependencies and roadmap gaps to Portfolio leadership proactively
* Maintains regular alignment with the Portfolio Manager and Portfolio Leadership on roadmap priorities, backlog direction, and technical outcomes; raises conflicts between technical demands and roadmap commitments proactively
* Maintains a minimum of two sprints of groomed and estimated backlog at all times for assigned teams.
* Contributes to epic-level roadmap tracking across quarters in coordination with the Portfolio Manager and/or Manager, Service Solutions for assigned domains
* Participates in pod-level planning, estimation sessions and steerco readouts as required
* Ability to travel up to 20%

**KEY COMPETENCIES**

* Balance of technical knowledge and business acumen
* Provides updates on backlog health, sprint progress and delivery risks to the Portfolio Manager and/or Manager, Services Portfolio to support roadmap tracking and stakeholder communication
* Customer first mind set
* Backlog execution – prioritizes and manages the sprint backlog in alignment with the product roadmap defined by the Portfolio Manager
* Proactive, self-starter with excellent project management skills and ability to manage multiple tasks effectively
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire partners and stakeholders to drive collaboration and alignment
* High degree of organization, individual initiative, and personal accountability
* Ability to assess risks, dependencies and propose mitigation strategies to overcome obstacles
* Skilled in leading meetings, setting agendas, driving decisions, and negotiating.

**REQUIRED Qualifications, EDUCATION, CERTIFICATES And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of professional experience, preferably in product ownership, project management or business analysis
* At least 1 year of experience in Product Management and/or Product Development
* Established background in launching software services in partnership with Engineering teams and high degree of proficiency in prototyping, iterative development and experience working within an Agile scrum team environment

**PREFERRED Qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare IT, supply chain, or SaaS environments
* Familiarity with B2B integration or EDI transaction workflows (e.g., 810, 855, 850 document standards) a plus familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, AI-assisted product tools, and agile tooling
* Experience in platform and integration-oriented technical domains, preferably within an operations-driven environment

description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
The Endoscopy Operating Unit develops software-enabled technologies that support the detection, prevention, and treatment of gastrointestinal diseases and cancers. The team partners across engineering, quality, systems, clinical, and regulatory functions to deliver software solutions spanning web, mobile, desktop, and cloud platforms for medical device applications.
  
  
This role is based in Hyderabad within the Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC) and leads a software engineering team responsible for product development, delivery, and sustainment activities.
  
  
As an Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of software engineers responsible for developing and maintaining software applications that support medical device products. You will balance people leadership, technical execution, and delivery management while partnering closely with cross-functional teams to achieve product, quality, and business objectives.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop a team of software engineers delivering web, mobile, desktop, and cloud-based applications.
* Manage sprint execution, backlog prioritization, task assignments, and delivery commitments across multiple projects.
* Partner with Quality, Systems, Program Management, and other cross-functional teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Drive software development best practices, engineering processes, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support software architecture, design reviews, verification and validation activities, and technical decision-making.
* Remove execution barriers, manage risks, and ensure predictable delivery of project milestones.
* Mentor and coach engineers through performance development, career growth, and technical skill-building.
* Represent the team in organizational planning, stakeholder reviews, and cross-functional discussions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 15+ years of relevant experience in software development, with a proven track record of delivering successful software projects.
* 5+ years of experience in software development within the medical device or regulated industry, demonstrating a deep understanding of regulatory requirements.

description:

**Location: Pune, India
  
  
Experience: 5–12 years**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a
**Technical Scrum Master**
who combines Agile leadership with hands-on technical expertise. The ideal candidate will facilitate Scrum ceremonies, coach teams on Agile best practices, remove impediments, and drive successful sprint delivery while also contributing to development activities using
**Java/Python/Angular**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement.

* Partner with Product Owners and stakeholders to ensure effective backlog management and sprint execution.
* Track and report Agile metrics such as velocity, burndown, and sprint progress.
* Contribute hands-on to software development, code reviews, debugging, and technical design discussions when capacity permits.
* Support delivery of high-quality, scalable solutions using Java and/or Angular technologies.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of Scrum Master experience in Agile environments
* Strong understanding of Scrum, Kanban, and Agile delivery practices
* Understanding of API design and web security best practices
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar Agile tools
* Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

**Technical Skills**
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in Java/Python/Angular development
* Proficiency in:

+ Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs or Python, Flask, FastAPI webservices
+ HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Angular

**Preferred Certifications**

* Certified Scrum Master (CSM)
* Professional Scrum Master (PSM)
* SAFe Scrum Master (SSM)

**What We Expect**
A highly motivated servant leader who empowers teams to succeed while actively contributing to technical decisions and delivery execution. This role requires a strong sense of ownership, the ability to remove obstacles, and a passion for building high-quality products.
  
  
At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.
  
  
**Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles**

* Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
* Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
* All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
* Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

* Creating agile maturity assessments and guidelines, frameworks to support teams
* Analyse and optimize value streams for better flow and customer value delivery
* Creating effective Agile training materials and programs for various roles
* Facilitating Program level Agile ceremonies using virtual collaboration tools in a remote or hybrid environment
* Analyze Portfolio and Team Agile metrics to assess progress and guide continuous improvement
* Facilitate strategic retrospectives and collaborative problem-solving sessions
* Build trust, influence and motivate teams and enable them to become autonomus
* Commitment to ongoing learning and staying current with evolving Agile practices and tools

* One or more of Industry certifications: ICP-ACC, SPC or similar
* Strong Knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), MS Project, MS Server
* Flexible to work in US and UK time zone

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Senior Architect – AIDLC
description:
**About the Role**

The organization is moving beyond AI-assisted engineering towards a full AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) — an AI-native way of working where AI agents drive the bulk of planning, code, and test generation under human oversight, across the Inception, Construction, and Operations phases. We are looking for a senior architect to own the vision and hands-on execution of this shift across the Software Engineering and testing landscape. This person is the transformation change driver who defines AI-first engineering and quality practices, proves them on real workloads, and scales them into standard operating practice.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the vision and hands-on execution of the shift to a full AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) across the Software Engineering and testing landscape.
* Act as the transformation change driver who defines AI-first engineering and quality practices.
* Prove AI-first engineering and quality practices on real workloads.
* Scale AI-first engineering and quality practices into standard operating practice.
* Architect end-to-end AI-DLC workflows: Define AI-enabled delivery across inception, construction, and operations, with human approval gates, traceable artifacts, and clear accountability for architectural decisions.
* Demonstrate hands-on GitHub Copilot expertise: Configure repository instructions, reusable prompt files, and custom agents; apply Copilot to development, testing, code review, and pull-request workflows.
* Implement spec-driven development using AWS Kiro: Create and maintain specifications, steering files, and agent hooks to enforce architectural standards and automate code, documentation, and test-generation activities.
* Demonstrate hands-on Claude Code expertise: Use codebase exploration, Plan Mode, multi-file implementation, debugging, and refactoring; configure CLAUDE.md, skills, hooks, and subagents for repeatable engineering workflows.
* Establish context-engineering standards: Structure repository knowledge, coding conventions, architectural constraints, and reusable instructions so agents receive relevant context without unnecessary context-window consumption.
* Integrate agents with enterprise engineering tools: Design controlled Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations with approved tools and APIs, and incorporate agent-driven tasks into existing development and CI workflows.
* End-to-end engineering orchestration: Architect workflows spanning requirement analysis, codebase exploration, implementation, testing, and pull-request creation, combining deterministic controls with agent-driven planning where appropriate.
* Codebase intelligence and context management: Architect context-gathering services that help agents discover relevant files, understand existing implementation patterns, and access project knowledge while managing context-window limits.
* Agent evaluation and quality gates: Build evaluation harnesses using representative engineering tasks, automated tests, build results, and independent verification to assess agent changes before release.
* Platform observability and optimization: Implement execution traces, tool-call visibility, failure diagnostics, and performance monitoring to investigate agent behavior and optimize production workflows.
* AI Red Teaming & Security Testing: Prompt injection testing, jailbreak testing, data leakage testing, adversarial testing, and AI-to-AI testing.
* Test Automation & AI QA Tooling: TestSprite and Playwright for AI-assisted and end-to-end test automation.

**Required Skills**

* Practical experience with AI-native SDLC methods and agentic coding workflows (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, AWS AI-DLC / Kiro / Amazon Q Developer style adaptive workflows, or equivalent).
* Must have successfully implemented Legacy Modernization and Brownfield Enhancements using AIDLC framework in GitHub Copilot, Cursor, AWS Kiro for Java, .NET, Mainframe programming languages.
* Strong grounding in agent architectures — tool/function calling, orchestration, memory, retries, and guardrails.
* Building Agent Harness using GitHub Copilot, AWS Kiro, Claude Code.
* Experience building enterprise Agentic AI platforms for software engineering AIDLC.
* Hands-on experience with Java Springboot, Python, React technologies and Azure and AWS cloud for application development and testing tools.

You are both the people manager and the team's Tech SME / Solution Architect — this is deliberately not a purely managerial role. You stay hands-on: designing solutions, reviewing code, and contributing to build on complex or foundational work, increasingly using an AI-assisted SDLC.
  
  
The team builds traditional software — operational tooling, applications, front ends and integrations (for example with SimCorp's product platform) — with a strong data-platform component built on Snowflake. You will work closely with the SMBS AI team, the Change & Upgrade engineering team (which provides shared QA), and SimCorp Platform & Infrastructure.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

title: Associate Product Engineer
description:
**About Docyt**
Docyt (pronounced "docket") builds an AI-native ERP for hotels, restaurants, retail, and franchises. One platform runs accounting, payments, and business intelligence on one ledger. Bookkeeping happens every day, so month-end becomes a review.
  
  
Docyt has processed more than $1.3 billion in invoice volume and connects with 30+ POS and PMS systems. The platform is SOC 2 Type 2 certified.
  
  
Docyt is venture funded and headquartered in Mountain View, California. This role is in our Noida Sector 62 office.
  
  
**The Role**
You take a piece of work all the way: understand the customer's problem, find the root cause, build the fix, prove it works, ship it, and confirm it is fixed in production. This is not a ticket-in, pull-request-out job. The engineer who does this well here investigates before coding, tests their own work on our QA environment, records a short Loom walkthrough so product can accept without a meeting, and stays with the change through staging and deploy until the customer's issue is closed. That is the bar.
  
  
**What End-to-End Means Here**
**01 Understand the problem.**
Read the support escalation, reproduce it on QA, and trace the root cause in code and in production data. Say clearly whether it is a product defect, a data gap, or working as designed, and bring the evidence.
  
  
**02 Build the fix.**
In Java (Spring Boot) or Ruby on Rails, with tests. A React change when the fix needs one.
  
  
**03 Get it reviewed.**
Open the pull request, answer review comments, keep CI green.
  
  
**04 Test it yourself on QA.**
The main user flow plus the edge cases from the ticket. Screenshots and the resulting database state go on the ticket.
  
  
**05 Record a Loom for acceptance.**
Before and after, in under five minutes. Product accepts from the recording.
  
  
**06 Ship it and close the loop.**
Take the change through staging to production, watch the deploy, verify it in production, and update the original support ticket.
  
  
**What You Will Work On**
Customer escalations and product features across accounts payable and bill pay, month-end close, AI transaction categorization, financial reporting and ledger migration. Some weeks it is a two-line fix with a long investigation behind it. Some weeks it is a new feature from a product spec to a working screen.
  
  
**BACKEND:**
Ruby on Rails, Java 17 / Spring Boot
  
  
**FRONT END:**
React, TypeScript
  
  
**DATA:**
PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ
  
  
**DELIVERY:**
Bitbucket, CircleCI, Jenkins, Kubernetes
  
  
**AI TOOLING:**
Claude Code, daily
  
  
**TRACKING:**
Jira, Loom, Slack
  
  
**How We Support You**
We move fast, and you will ship from your first week. A senior engineer reviews your work and helps you learn the codebase. Within your first month, you take a customer issue from start to finish.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 1 to 3 years of software engineering, or a new graduate who has shipped at least one project
* Java and Ruby on Rails. Strong in at least one, with clear evidence you can pick up the other quickly. You will work in both
* SQL you can use to prove a point. You can read production data to confirm or reject a theory before you write code
* Root cause before fix. You are uncomfortable patching a symptom
* You write clearly. Tickets, pull request descriptions, Loom narration. People should be able to follow your work without a call
* Genuine appetite for AI tooling. You have already used Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar seriously, and you want to get much better at it
* Intent and ownership. You want to be the person a delivery depends on, and you follow through
* This role requires some overlap with US time zones

**Nice to Have**

* React and TypeScript in a production codebase
* Kubernetes, CI pipelines, or a deploy you have managed yourself
* Basic accounting literacy: chart of accounts, journal entries, bank reconciliation
* Experience on a product team that talks to customers directly

**How To Apply**
When you apply, include a link to a project you shipped. A short Loom walkthrough of it is a plus.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, plus Medical Insurance, Term Insurance, PF, and Gratuity
* Great growth potential at a fast-growing startup. We want you to grow with us!
* Company-provided laptop and necessary hardware to ensure you are set up for success
* Inclusive and motivating work culture that values team collaboration

title: Associate - Digital Product Management
description:
**Job Description**
The Global Risk & Compliance team is seeking a highly motivated
**Associate, Digital Product Management**
to join the Financial Crimes Products & Capabilities team and support several high-impact modernization initiatives.
  
  
In this role as a data product owner, you will help advance modernization of the Customer Risk Rating (CRR) engine, enhance data sourcing and integration, and transition legacy capabilities to modern, scalable platforms. You will collaborate with Product, Technology, Compliance, Data Governance, and business stakeholders to define requirements, strengthen data quality, and deliver enterprise-wide solutions that enable accurate and consistent customer risk assessments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As an Associate, you will support the delivery of CRR modernization initiatives by performing data analysis, identifying authoritative data sources, improving data quality and defining data standardization to ensure accurate, consistent and reliable data for customer risk assessments.
  
  
You will partner closely with Product, Technology, Compliance, Data Governance, Platforms, and Technology to align priorities and execute modernization roadmaps.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Translate business needs and requirements into clearly defined product capabilities, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog in partnership with Product, Technology, and business stakeholders.
* Drive alignment across stakeholders on data requirements, business rules, product, delivery and data decisions, balancing trade-offs, dependencies, and enterprise impact.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies and partner with cross-functional teams to identify challenges, evaluate solutions, and support successful delivery.
* Analyze data requirements, identify appropriate sources of record, and define data mapping and standardization logic.
* Partner with use-case owners and stakeholders to deliver end-to-end products and capabilities while identifying opportunities, dependencies, and gaps.
* Assess data availability, completeness, quality and gaps across products, markets and customer segments to support reliable customer risk assessments.
* Facilitate cross-functional working sessions, document decisions, and ensure clear ownership and follow-through on action items.
* Support modernization of roadmaps, including milestone planning, dependency tracking and risk identification.
* Communicate the value, progress, and impact of shared platform capabilities to leadership and partner teams.

**The Ideal Candidate Is**

* Comfortable with ambiguity: Able to operate effectively in strategic platform environments where solutions may not be fully defined.
* A systems thinker: Understands how decisions within one component or platform can impact upstream and downstream products, processes, and teams.
* Self-directed and proactive: Identifies areas requiring analysis, documentation, or alignment and moves work forward with appropriate autonomy.
* Highly collaborative: Builds effective partnerships across Product, Technology, Compliance, Data, and other disciplines.
* Detail-oriented: Maintains attention to execution details while keeping broader business and platform objectives in view.
* An effective communicator: Builds credibility across technical and non-technical stakeholders and communicates complex topics clearly.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in product management, product analysis, business analysis, or a related role.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated experience gathering and documenting requirements, including user stories, product requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience working with platforms, infrastructure, data, or other technically complex products.
* Ability to identify and manage cross-team dependencies, trade-offs, and competing priorities.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe.
* Familiarity with product and delivery tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to synthesize complex information and develop clear narratives and presentations for senior leaders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with data migration, data analysis, or platform modernization initiatives.
* Technical fluency with data flows, APIs, system integrations, and modern platform architectures.
* Experience with data strategy, data quality, data governance, or related data management disciplines.
* Working knowledge of SQL, Database design or similar data querying and analytical tools.
* Familiarity with dashboarding, reporting, or data visualization tools.

**Nice to Have**
We do not expect candidates to be experts in all the following areas. We are looking for someone who is curious, technically minded, and eager to continue developing their skills alongside the team.
  
  

* Familiarity with Financial Crimes domains such as AML, KYC/EDD, sanctions screening, Customer Risk Rating, or transaction monitoring.
* Interest in AI-assisted product workflows.
* Experience with GCP or other modern data and analytics platforms.
* Experience with software development or technical product management.
* Willingness to learn new tools and technology
* Candidate must be comfortable working in 2pm - 11pm IST shift timings.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

title: Tech Lead
description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
**We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**
**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.**
**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 11 years of professional software development in Python, including 5 years of architecture across multiple systems.
* 3 years of experience owning engineering standards adopted beyond your own team, and mentoring senior engineers.
* Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with engineering, product and business stakeholders in other regions.
* Language and craft. You are an expert in Python. You write idiomatic, fully typed Python, understand asyncio and the GIL in depth, and can diagnose concurrency, CPU and memory problems in production. You set our Python version strategy, dependency policy, framework choices (FastAPI or Django) and coding patterns, and you are a practitioner in at least two other crafts.
* APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI from first principles: resource modelling, HTTP semantics, pagination, consistent error formats, versioning, idempotency and rate limiting. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and how to evolve both without breaking consumers. You set our API and serialisation standards and decide on exceptions.
* Data. You are fluent in PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, query plans, transactions and zero-downtime migrations with SQLAlchemy and Alembic. You design DynamoDB and MongoDB models around access patterns, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload. You own our data-architecture standards, including how datastores are introduced and retired.
* Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design event-driven systems on queues and streams such as SQS, Kafka and Celery or Arq, using retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent consumers so that at least-once delivery is safe. You know the outbox and saga patterns and when orchestration is better than choreography. You own our reference architecture for reliability.
* Cloud and platform. You have built and run production services on AWS or GCP, both as Lambda functions and as Kubernetes workloads, and you understand the trade-offs between them: cold starts, concurrency, cost, capacity and deployment risk. You define infrastructure as code with Terraform or AWS CDK and release safely with canary and blue/green deployments. With Platform Engineering, you decide when we use serverless and when we use Kubernetes, and you set the reference architectures for both.
* Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and expect every team to do the same. You build balanced test suites: unit tests with pytest, integration tests with Testcontainers, contract tests with Pact, and Playwright end-to-end tests that gate releases. You set our quality standard and approve any exceptions to it.
* Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry and use Datadog and CloudWatch to find problems before users do. You profile with flame graphs, measure p95 and p99 latency, and fix causes rather than symptoms. You set our standards for SLOs, dashboards, alerting and performance budgets, and you lead the hardest incidents to their root cause.
* Security and identity. You write secure code by default and apply the OWASP Top 10 and API Security Top 10 in practice. You design authentication and authorisation with OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, secure service-to-service traffic with mTLS and workload identity, and integrate identity providers such as Okta, Keycloak and Cognito. You set our identity and security standards and own security reviews with the Security team.
* Architecture and design. You design systems that span many services and teams, and you write architecture decision records that make the trade-offs explicit. You own our technical roadmap and style guide, act as the arbiter on standards, and decide on evidence rather than authority. You are able to trace many symptoms back to a single root cause and fix it once.
* Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow, small changes and feature flags, and you know CI/CD pipelines inside out. You have led deprecations and migrations all the way to switching the old system off. You set our Git, CI/CD and dependency policies, and you make large-scale change routine rather than exceptional.
* AI-first engineering and LLMs. You use Claude Code every day and understand how large language models work: tokens, context windows, cost, structured output, embeddings and retrieval. You have built production features with the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs, including tool calling and evaluations, and designed agentic services with clear guardrails and human review. You set our AI-first operating model, covering approved models and frameworks, Claude Code conventions, evaluation and release gates, and governance.
* Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely in writing and in conversation, and you adapt your message for engineers, product leaders and executives. You understand complex problems quickly, ask the right questions and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and cultures, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly between time zones. You are proactive: you spot problems and opportunities before you are asked, propose solutions and innovations of your own, and drive them through without waiting for instructions.
* Leadership and behaviours. You lead without authority and influence engineering heads and teams across the organisation. You define the hiring bar for each level, calibrate interviewers and give Talent Acquisition clear screening criteria. You mentor senior engineers into technical leaders, build an engineering practice that does not depend on you, and hold the bar under commercial pressure. You say "I don't know" when you don't, and you dig in until you do.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* Experience maintaining a widely used open-source library.
* Experience with multi-region and disaster-recovery architecture.
* Experience mapping engineering controls to SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
* Experience with multi-agent systems and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK or the Anthropic Agent SDK.
* Experience running an engineering-productivity measurement programme.
* Experience in TypeScript.

**About the job:**
WPP Open is WPP's AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Principal Engineer you own architecture and engineering standards for Python across teams. You stay hands-on and set the bar for hiring. Our interviews are practical and hands-on.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Own the architecture of Python systems across multiple teams, and set the technical roadmap that takes them from where they are today to where the platform needs to be.
* Stay hands-on: write, review and ship production code, lead by example on test-driven development, profiling and AI-first delivery, and take on the hardest technical problems yourself.
* Set and maintain our engineering standards for API design, data, reliability, security, observability and testing; publish them as a style guide and reference architectures, certify teams against them, and decide on exceptions.
* Review designs and architecture decision records across teams, challenge assumptions, and make sure decisions are made on evidence and recorded with their trade-offs.
* Decide, with Platform Engineering, how we use AWS Lambda and Kubernetes, and own the cost, capacity and reliability consequences of those choices.
* Lead the response to the most serious production incidents and performance problems, find the root cause and make sure it does not happen again.
* Drive large-scale change such as migrations, framework upgrades and deprecations across many codebases through to completion, including switching off what has been replaced.
* Define how we build with AI: the models, SDKs and agentic frameworks we use, how Claude Code is used day to day, and how AI-written code and AI features are evaluated and released.
* Work with product, engineering and business leaders in other regions to shape what we build, turn business goals into technical plans, and make trade-offs visible.
* Set the hiring bar for Python engineers at every level, write interview material, calibrate interviewers and give recruiters clear screening criteria.
* Mentor senior engineers, grow the next generation of technical leaders, and build a community of practice through reviews, talks and knowledge sharing

**Who you are:**
**You're open
*:***
we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
  
  
**You're optimistic
*:***
we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
  
  
**You're extraordinary:**
We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
  
  
**What we'll give you:**
**Passionate, inspired people**
– we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work
  
  
**Scale and opportunity**
– we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
  
  
**Challenging and stimulating work**
– unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers.
  
  
**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.**
**WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.**

title: Global IT Quality Engineer Manager
description:

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do

We enable global technology for BCG’s People Function, including Recruiting; Talent Management (Staffing, Mobility & Career Development); L&D; and Core HR (including Workday, Compensation and Benefits).
  
  
  
  
We are seeking a
**Global Quality Engineer Manager**
to lead quality engineering execution for our
**Vendor Management System (VMS)**
products. This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on ensuring the quality, reliability, and scalability of enterprise SaaS applications through effective manual and automated testing.
  
  
  
  
**You Will**

* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS applications, APIs, integrations, databases, and workflow-driven systems.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You’ll work with a globally distributed, cross-functional team of
**product owners, business analysts, software engineers, DevOps engineers, architects, quality engineers, and business stakeholders**
in a fast-paced Agile environment.
  
  
  
  
As a hands-on technical quality leader, you will mentor quality engineers and partner with product and engineering teams to ensure quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle

title: Engineer II, QA
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

**About the Role**

We're pioneering a new role focused exclusively on quality assurance for GenAI systems. As our AI QA Engineer, you'll develop testing strategies for full stack application testing, evaluation frameworks, and quality metrics specifically designed for LLM-powered applications. This role requires a unique blend of QA expertise, understanding of GenAI behaviour, and automation skills

to ensure our AI features are reliable, accurate, and trustworthy

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement comprehensive testing strategies for GenAI features including conversational AI, agentic systems, and LLM-powered workflows
* Develop automated test suites for prompt testing, including regression tests that detect unintended changes in model behaviour
* Create evaluation frameworks to measure GenAI quality across multiple dimensions (accuracy, relevance, safety, consistency, latency)
* Build and maintain test datasets and golden examples that represent diverse user scenarios and edge cases
* Implement monitoring and alerting systems to detect quality degradation in production GenAI features
* Perform adversarial testing to identify potential failures, hallucinations, biases, or security vulnerabilities in AI systems
* Collaborate with engineers to define acceptance criteria and quality gates for AI feature releases
* Develop tools and frameworks that make it easy for engineers to test their GenAI implementations
* Conduct user acceptance testing and gather feedback on AI feature performance from internal users
* Document testing procedures, known issues, and quality metrics in clear, accessible formats
* Partner with Product and Design teams to ensure AI features meet user experience standards
* Stay current with GenAI testing methodologies, tools, and industry best practices

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of QA or test engineering experience, preferably with AI/ML systems.
* Strong understanding of GenAI technologies including LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI application patterns
* Experience with test automation frameworks and scripting (Python, JavaScript) UI testing(Playwright , Puppeteer),Performance testing, scenario testing and have some exp working in Gen AI Systems+ product dev.
* Knowledge of software testing methodologies (functional, integration, regression, performance, security testing)
* Ability to design test cases and evaluation criteria for non-deterministic systems
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
* Experience with API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured) and backend testing
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing integration
* Excellent communication skills for documenting issues and collaboration

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience testing conversational AI, chatbots, or agentic systems
* Knowledge of ML model evaluation metrics and techniques
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, PromptFoo, Ragas)
* Experience with performance testing and load testing AI APIs
* Understanding of responsible AI principles including fairness, transparency, and safety testing
* Background in enterprise software or SaaS QA
* Experience with test management tools (TestRail, Zephyr, Jira)
* Knowledge of security testing methodologies for AI systems
* Scripting experience with Python, including working with LLM APIs

**What Makes This Role Exciting**

* Define QA practices for GenAI applications
* Work on cutting-edge AI technologies and help ensure they're reliable and trustworthy
* Shape quality standards that will impact millions of enterprise users
* Collaborate closely with engineers, data scientists, and product teams
* Grow expertise in a highly specialized and increasingly important domain
* Influence the entire AI product development lifecycle from design to release
* Join a team that values quality as a first-class concern, not an afterthought

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.
  
  
Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.
  
  
Visit gomotive.com to learn more.
  
  
**Job Description**
The opportunity Help us reinvent how fleets turn data into action. As the Senior Product Designer for Spend Management, you’ll be a design lead for our Motive Card and spend management platform. You’ll partner with product, data, and engineering teams to translate complex business questions into intuitive, high-performance dashboards and self-serve tools that empower customers of every technical level.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the UX end-to-end – from problem framing and research through polished UI and QA.
* Deep-dive into customer workflows to surface the highest-impact use-cases.
* Champion performance & scalability by collaborating with data-engineering to understand workflow funnels, hangups/dropoffs, and graceful error handling.
* Prototype and validate product concepts quickly using AI with realistic, representative data whenever possible.
* Ship, measure, iterate. Set success metrics, listen to quantitative / qualitative feedback, and refine for continual improvement.
* Contribute to our design system with financially-specific components and visualization guidelines.
* Mentor teammates and elevate our overall design culture.

**What You’ll Need**

* 5+ years designing complex web products; at least 2 in fintech or other data-heavy domains
* A portfolio that shows elegant solutions to gnarly information-architecture and data-visualization problems
* Fluency with AI prototyping tools (e.g., Claude, Replit, Cursor) and the trade-offs between power and usability
* Expertise in interaction, interface, and visual design; able to move from low-fi flows to polished prototypes swiftly and effectively
* Proven ability to drive alignment across product, engineering, and data stakeholders through crisp storytelling and documentation
* Comfort working in fast-moving, ambiguous spaces and turning complexity into clarity
* Bonus: knowledge of accessibility standards for data viz, or experience designing for performance-constrained environments

*Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.*

(“Employer”) discloses candidates may be required to execute a non-compete covenant with the Employer. title: UIUX Design Lead
description:
**Description -**
**Job Summary**

* This role is responsible for managing the overall user experience design strategy, ensuring it aligns with company objectives and user needs. The role leads teams of experienced designers in crafting digital user experiences that seamlessly blend visual design excellence, fluid interaction design, and functionality. The role drives design excellence and fosters a culture of creativity, innovation and collaboration, with a particular focus on elevating visual craft, motion design, and interaction fidelity across all touchpoints. The role provides visionary design direction, setting a high standard for user experience design, visual design, and usability. The role assigns projects, sets priorities, and ensures timely and high-quality deliverables.

**Responsibilities**

* Develops a future vision that continuously balances the needs of the user, business objectives and requirements, and is also technically feasible, while demonstrating proper use of the organization's design system, including its visual language, motion principles, and interaction patterns.
* Champions the development and evolution of visual design standards (typography, color, iconography, layout systems) and interaction/animation guidelines (transitions, micro-interactions, motion timing and easing) to ensure consistency across products.
* Leads UX and visual design for Android-based devices — ensuring designs account for hardware, display/input variants, and software-hardware co-design tradeoffs.
* Partners with engineering, design teams, and platform/software leads to align UX decisions across the product lifecycle, from concept through launch.
* Creates user experience goals, priorities, and deliverables that align with product milestones, coordinates multiple projects to completion, and drives adoption of user experience, visual design, and motion/interaction design practices.
* Partners with engineering to ensure animation and interaction specifications are feasible, performant, and faithfully implemented from prototype to production.

Recommended**

title: Human Factors, Usability & User Technology Manager - R&D Devices
description:
**Manager – Human Factors, Usability & User Technology Requirements**

**Role in a nutshell :**

* Lead the Usability Engineering activities for drug delivery systems with direct responsibility of assessment of user interfaces, risk management, planning and overall execution of usability testing activities
* Establish internal capabilities and external relationships needed for all HF & Usability engineering needs of the organization.
* Lead Voice of Customer activities with patients, HCPs, KOLs and other intended users to identify unmet needs and translate user insights into requirements for new drug-delivery technologies and device concepts.
* Translate user and KOL insights into actionable user needs, design inputs and technical requirements, working closely with Device Engineering, Clinical, Medical and Commercial teams
* Ensure design, testing, documentation and regulatory filing requirements are fully compliant to all Human Factors and usability engineering related guidance and standards
* Collaborate with product engineering to identify intended users and use environments as well as potential use related hazards.
* Determine product use cases, carry out user task analyses, identify critical user tasks and assist in derivation of user requirements & technical specifications.
* Responsible for execution of usability engineering & HF deliverables for each development life cycle phase
* Collaborate with internal and external partners in planning, structuring, recruiting for, and execute formative and summative evaluations
* Work closely with different systems engineering & sub-systems team (mechanical & electronics) to understand overall system level architecture, user interface elements, identify critical safety and quality characteristics to develop usability test plan & protocols for execution

**Qualifications:**

* BE / MTech in Engineering or equivalent degree
* 8-12 years of total experience

**Skills & Experience:**

* Atleast 3 years of experience in Human Factors/Usability engineering of medical devices (FDA Class II/III medical device experience desired)
* Experience with various HF methodologies such as ethnographic research, user group interviews, contextual inquiries, focus group discussions, technical assessments, user interface evaluation, task analysis, hazard analysis & risk assessments.
* Hands-on skills with the proven ability to execute formative and summative testing of complex medical devices/systems
* Experience using user research to support early-stage technology assessment, concept development and device selection.
* Ability to translate qualitative user insights into user needs, design inputs, product requirements and measurable engineering specifications.
* Experience working with external service providers and certification agencies is preferred
* Required to have experience in complete medical device product development lifecycle
* Strong understanding of medical device product design and regulatory processes
* Working Knowledge & understanding of medical device regulations like ISO13485, EU MDD/MDR & US FDA 21 CFR Parts 4 & 820 & standards requirements like IEC60601, ISO14971, IEC62366, ANSI/AAMI HE75 etc...
* Possess a high level of integrity with a passion to work with entrepreneurial teams in a rapidly growing organization
* Strong collaboration, active listening & excellent written and verbal communication
* Strong presentation & documentation skills
* Ability to drive change in culture and behavior & demonstrate outstanding work ethic

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants, regardless of background, identity, or personal characteristics.*

title: Graphic Designer
description:

.

to create impactful designs that strengthen brand presence, communicate ideas effectively, and drive
  
  
engagement across digital channels. You’ll have the opportunity to work on a diverse range of creative projects, from

* Ensure all visuals align with brand guidelines and maintain consistency across digital channels.
* Collaborate with content and account management teams to understand creative briefs and deliver projects within deadlines.

Benefits
  
  

* Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
* Health insurance coverage for you and your family.
* Opportunity to work with a creative and passionate team.
* Fast-paced, dynamic, and collaborative work environment.
* Opportunity to work with leading global B2B technology brands.

title: Interaction and Motion designer
description:
**Description -**
**About the Role**
We're building the operating system for a next-generation device, and we're looking for a talented Interaction Designer to shape
**how it feels to use**
.
  
  
This role is centered around interaction design and motion — the details that make an interface feel alive, responsive, intuitive, and delightful. You'll define how the OS behaves at a moment-to-moment level: how things move, respond, transition, provide feedback, and communicate state.
  
  
Your primary focus will be bringing
**craft, consistency, and delight**
to the experience across the OS. You'll help define the interaction language of the product and ensure that interactions feel cohesive rather than a collection of individual features.
  
  
Alongside this, you'll contribute to selected UX and UI projects with the broader design team, either independently or in collaboration with other designers.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Define what "delight" means for the product and translate it into thoughtful, purposeful interactions across the OS.
* Own the interaction design and micro-animation layer of the OS, including transitions, spatial relationships, feedback, gestures, states, loading, success/error, sound, haptics and other moment-to-moment behaviors.
* Collaborate with product designers, product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to brainstorm and develop interaction concepts for the device.
* Define and maintain a consistent interaction language so that behaviors across the OS feel unified and intentional, across different modal behaviors like touch, trackpad, keyboard and stylus.
* Build, maintain, and evolve an interaction library covering reusable patterns, behaviors, motion principles, timing, and transitions.
* Contribute to the broader design system and work with other designers to ensure interaction patterns are documented, consistent, and reusable.
* Prototype interactions using tools such as Figma, Principle, ProtoPie, After Effects, or code-based prototyping.
* Use prototypes to communicate not just visual behavior, but also motion, timing, sound, feedback, and overall feel.
* Partner closely with engineering throughout implementation to ensure interactions are brought to life with a high level of design fidelity.
* Review builds, identify interaction or motion inconsistencies, and work with engineers to refine the experience while taking feasibility and performance into account.
* Explore emerging interaction patterns, motion techniques, and interaction paradigms across leading products globally, bringing relevant ideas and inspiration into the product.
* Contribute to UX and UI projects across the product team, either independently owning selected projects or supporting other UX designers with interaction design and prototyping.

**What We're Looking For**


* A portfolio that clearly demonstrates strong interaction design and motion/micro-animation craft. This is the most important qualification for this role.
* The ability to take ownership of interactions across an OS and drive them from concept through implementation with engineering.
* Strong prototyping skills — you're comfortable communicating interactions through working prototypes rather than static screens alone.
* An understanding of motion as a tool for usability, hierarchy, feedback, continuity, and delight — not simply as visual decoration.
* Strong design judgment and restraint: knowing when motion adds value and when simplicity is the better experience.
* Working knowledge of design systems and how interaction patterns can be made consistent, reusable, and scalable.
* Comfort working across both craft-heavy interaction design and broader product design work.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions to product managers, designers, engineers, and leadership.
* The ability to work directly with engineers on implementation details and advocate for interaction quality and design fidelity.
* Experience working with sound or other forms of sensory feedback as part of interaction design.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience designing for an OS-level, system-level, or gaming platform, rather than only individual applications.
* Experience with tablet, mobile, or multi-modal interaction design involving combinations of touch, keyboard, pen, or other input methods.
* Familiarity with the performance considerations of animation on devices, including frame rates, GPU constraints, and how these influence interaction design decisions.
* A background in motion design, game UI, or consumer products with rich micro-interactions.

****Education & Experience**
Recommended**

* Four-year or Graduate Degree in Design, Human Factors Engineering, Social Sciences research, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.

Around

across UI, UX, and, most importantly, interaction design.

title: Founding Product Designer - Plum Personal
description:
**About Plum**

Plum is an employee insurance and health benefits platform focused on making health insurance simple, accessible, and inclusive for modern organizations.

Healthcare in India is seeing a phenomenal shift, with healthcare cost inflation growing at 3x the rate of general inflation. A majority of Indians are unable to afford health insurance independently, making employer-sponsored insurance an increasingly important part of healthcare access.

Plum is on a mission to provide the highest-quality insurance and healthcare to 10 million lives by FY2030, through companies that care. We are backed by Tiger Global and Peak XV Partners.

**About the Role**

Plum's New Initiatives team builds new products and experiences from the ground up. We are looking for a
**Product Designer**
to shape one of our next consumer experiences from 0→1.

This is an opportunity to go beyond designing screens and flows. You'll help define what the product should be, understand the problems worth solving, experiment with ideas, and bring entirely new experiences to life.

You'll work closely with a small, cross-functional team of Product, Engineering, and Business stakeholders, with the autonomy to influence product direction, shape its identity, and see your ideas move from concept to launch.

**What We Believe**

Too many products run on pressure: urgency, fine print, and funnels you can't leave.

We believe people make better decisions when they're given the whole picture and the time to use it.

**The user should own the journey, not the funnel.**

**What You'll Do**

* Decide what the product is, not just how it looks.
* Be a thought partner to a small team across Product, Engineering, and Business.
* Take a hunch on Monday to a working prototype in front of users by Friday.
* Shape the voice, feel, and identity of a brand that doesn't exist yet.
* Be willing to kill your own ideas when the evidence points elsewhere, and defend them when it doesn't.
* Own the numbers your design moves, not just the files you hand off.

**You Might Be the One If**

* You have 2–5 years of experience, ideally in a startup, early-stage environment, or building something independently.
* You've designed something from zero, navigated evolving requirements, and actively influenced the product's direction.
* You're obsessed with users. You speak to them often and advocate for their needs, even when it's inconvenient.
* You can think through product, brand, and copy problems simultaneously.
* You have a sharp eye for visual design: typography, layout, colour, and spacing. You sweat the details and can articulate why something works.
* You've worked with numbers: funnels, conversion rates, and drop-offs. You define success metrics before designing and evaluate them after launch.
* AI is already part of how you work. You'd rather build and test a live prototype than present a static flow.

**The Deal**

* **Engagement:**
  Full-time or consultant (minimum 6 months). We're open to both.
* **Location:**
  Bangalore (Whitefield).
* **Work mode:**
  In-office.
* **Opportunity:**
  Own and shape a new consumer product experience from 0→1, with significant creative and product ownership.

title: Junior Graphic Designer Consultant

description:

We operate with a start-up spirit, embracing growth, valuing relationships, and continuously evolving. Today, we are a fast-growing consumer brand with a strong presence across Amazon, Walmart, Target, and our DTC Shopify store. At our core, we are more than a company, we’re a family driven by purpose, progress, and a commitment to exceptional customer experiences.

**About the role**

We’re an e-commerce brand in the baby/parenting space, selling mainly to US customers. We’re looking for a junior designer who is quick in Figma, uses AI tools to work faster, and understands how design drives sales.

**What you’ll do**

* Design e-commerce assets in Figma: product page sections, landing pages, banners, ad creatives and social graphics.
* Design email campaigns and flows such as welcome, abandoned cart and promotions.
* Edit short-form video for social and ads (Reels, TikTok, UGC-style content).
* Use AI tools to speed up concepting, image generation, editing and resizing.
* Iterate on designs based on feedback and performance data.

**What we’re looking for**

title: Frontend Intern
description:
**About TrueFoundry**
Every production AI system whether it's powering customer support, writing code, analyzing financial data, or diagnosing medical conditions needs the same foundational infrastructure.A way to route between models. A way to manage tools and integrate them securely. A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance. A unified compute layer to run it all.
  
  
**That infrastructure layer is being built right now.**
We're TrueFoundry, and we're building it. We're looking for a Frontend Intern to join our Enginerring team.
  
  
**The Problem We're Solving**
Companies are moving beyond simple chatbots to production agentic systems. These systems route between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and self-hosted models. They integrate dozens of tools via protocols like MCP. They orchestrate multi-agent workflows where agents coordinate with other agents.
  
  
The infrastructure to support this doesn't exist yet. You can't just duct-tape together a few API calls and call it production-ready.
  
  
**You Need a Control Plane That Handles**

* Intelligent routing with observability, cost policies, and fallback logic
* Centralized tool and MCP server management with security and lifecycle controls
* Agent orchestration with governance and guardrails
* A unified compute layer to run self-hosted models, custom tools, and agents

**We've Built Two Products To Solve This**
**AI Gateway**
is the control plane five composable components (Prompts, LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, Guardrails, Agent Gateway) that handle routing, orchestration, and governance.
  
  
**AI Deploy**
is the compute layer of Kubernetes-based platform that abstracts ML workloads as standard software primitives, so everything runs on unified infrastructure.
  
  
We're Series A, backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia. Companies like CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys, and Zscaler run production AI workloads on our platform.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for
**Frontend Engineering Interns**
who are excited about building developer-focused products and modern web applications. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams to craft intuitive, high-performance user interfaces for AI/ML platforms used by developers and enterprises globally.
  
  
This is a hands-on role where you will ship real features to production.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build and improve frontend features for TrueFoundry’s core platform
* Develop responsive, high-quality UI using modern frontend frameworks
* Collaborate with backend, design, and product teams to ship end-to-end features
* Optimize performance, usability, and scalability of the frontend
* Work on dashboards, developer tools, and AI workflow interfaces
* Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code
* Participate in code reviews and engineering discussions

**Tech Stack**

* Languages/Frameworks: JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, Next.js
* Styling: TailwindCSS / CSS / Component libraries
* Tools: Git, GitHub, REST APIs, modern build tools
* Good to know: Basic understanding of AI/ML platforms or developer tools (not mandatory)

**Who You Are**

* Pursuing B.E/B.Tech in Computer Science
* Strong fundamentals in HTML, CSS, JavaScript
* Familiarity with React.js or modern frontend frameworks
* Understanding of APIs and web application architecture
* Eye for UI/UX and detail-oriented development
* Strong problem-solving and learning mindset
* Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
Cab9 is an innovative dispatch solution and comprehensive operating system offering powerful driver and passenger apps that seamlessly integrate with ground transport workflows.

With offices in London, Bangalore and Madrid, Cab9 brings together a diverse, international team of talented professionals, combining global expertise with a shared commitment to delivering innovative technology and seamless transport experiences.

**Who You Will Work With**

We foster a culture of continuous improvement in a diverse and inclusive workplace where people feel valued and included. Accountability matters.

At Cab9, we bring together remarkable people and help them be themselves as part of a collaborative team that innovates.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced and motivated **UX/UI Designer** to help design, develop and improve our digital products and user experiences. You will be responsible for translating user needs and business requirements into intuitive, visually engaging and functional digital interfaces.

Working closely with our Product and Development teams, you will contribute to the design process from initial research and user flows through to wireframing, prototyping, user interface design and final developer handover. You will help ensure our digital products are intuitive, accessible, consistent and aligned with user needs.

You will primarily focus on UX/UI and digital product design. You may occasionally assist our in-house Graphic Designer with relevant design tasks and will work collaboratively with the Graphic Designer and Head of Brand to ensure our digital products maintain visual consistency with the wider brand identity.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* **User Experience (UX) Design:** Understand user needs, business requirements and product objectives to create intuitive, effective and user-centred digital experiences.
* **User Interface (UI) Design:** Design clean, modern and visually engaging interfaces for web portals, websites, mobile applications and other digital products.
* **User Journeys and Information Architecture:** Map user flows, structure information and simplify complex processes to create seamless and logical user journeys.
* **Wireframing and Prototyping:** Develop wireframes, interactive prototypes and high-fidelity mock-ups to communicate concepts, test ideas and validate design decisions before development.
* **Responsive Design:** Create digital experiences that work effectively across desktop, tablet and mobile devices, maintaining usability and consistency across different screen sizes.
* **Design Systems and Components:** Build, maintain and improve reusable UI components, design libraries and documentation to support consistency, scalability and efficient product development.
* **User Research and Usability Testing:** Support user research, usability testing and feedback gathering to identify usability issues and opportunities for improvement.
* **Product Improvement:** Review existing digital interfaces and user journeys, identify areas for improvement and recommend solutions based on user needs, feedback and product objectives.
* **Developer Collaboration and Handover:** Work closely with developers to ensure designs are implemented accurately, providing the necessary specifications, assets and guidance throughout the development process.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Collaborate with Product and Development teams to understand requirements, discuss solutions and ensure design decisions support both user needs and business objectives.
* **Brand Consistency:** Work alongside the Graphic Designer and Head of Brand to ensure digital interfaces align with the wider brand identity, visual guidelines and design principles.
* **Graphic Design Support:** Occasionally assist the in-house Graphic Designer with relevant design requirements when needed, while keeping UI/UX and digital product design as your primary responsibility.

**What You'll Need to Make the Most of the Role**

* **Experience:** A minimum of 5 years of experience in UI/UX design, product design or a similar digital design role, with a strong body of work demonstrating your design process and practical execution.
* **Strong UX/UI Fundamentals:** A thorough understanding of user-centred design, interaction design, information architecture, user flows, visual hierarchy and usability principles.
* **Web Portal and Mobile App Design:** Proven experience designing digital products across complex web portals, dashboards, and SaaS platforms and mobile applications (iOS and Android), with an understanding of the different requirements and user behaviours associated with each.
* **Proficiency in Figma:** Strong working knowledge of Figma for wireframing, high-fidelity interface design, interactive prototyping, reusable components and design documentation.
* **Responsive Design:** Experience creating responsive interfaces and adapting designs for different devices, screen sizes and user contexts.
* **Design Systems:** Experience developing or maintaining design systems, component libraries, typography, spacing, colour systems and consistent UI patterns.
* **Research and Problem-Solving:** The ability to understand user needs, identify design challenges and develop practical solutions informed by research, feedback and usability testing.
* **Developer Handover:** A clear understanding of preparing designs and specifications for development and collaborating with engineers throughout implementation.
* **Attention to Detail:** A strong eye for visual quality, usability, accessibility, consistency and functional detail.
* **Communication and Collaboration:** The ability to communicate design decisions clearly, receive feedback constructively and work effectively with developers, product stakeholders, the Graphic Designer and Head of Brand.
* **Organisation and Time Management:** The ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently and deliver high-quality design work within agreed deadlines.
* **Positive and Proactive Approach:** A collaborative, curious and solutions-focused attitude, with a commitment to continuous learning and improving the user experience.

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with accessibility standards and inclusive design principles, including WCAG.
* Experience conducting usability testing and interpreting user feedback or product analytics.
* A basic understanding of front-end development, including HTML and CSS, to support collaboration with developers.
* Familiarity with agile product development processes and cross-functional working.
* Experience with animation, transitions or micro-interactions for digital interfaces.
* Basic knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator, to support occasional collaboration with the Graphic Designer.

**Submission Requirements**

Applicants must submit the following as part of their application:

* **A PDF showcasing your strongest design work.** This should highlight relevant UI/UX projects across both web portals and mobile applications.
* The PDF should demonstrate your design approach and decision-making, including relevant user journeys, wireframes, key screens, prototypes or final interfaces where appropriate.
* For each project, clearly outline your individual role, responsibilities and contribution, explaining the problem you were solving, your design approach and the outcome where available.
* Please ensure the PDF showcases your ability to create intuitive, functional and visually consistent digital experiences, rather than focusing solely on final visuals.
* The PDF should be emailed directly to **careers@e9.co.uk**, with reference to your name and Indeed application cited in the email.

Candidates who progress to the second stage will be asked to complete an at-home design task. Further details will be provided to successful applicants, and the task will be discussed during the second-stage interview.

**Please Note:** Only candidates who submit the required **PDF of 2-3 projects of their strongest work** will be considered for the role. Applicants who submit only their CV and link to portfolio will not be considered.

Pay: ₹2,500,000.00 - ₹3,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Can you provide a PDF of your strongest work, ideally 2-3 projects highlighting web application and mobile application work? Notably, this is separate to your portfolio and should be emailed directly to careers@e9.co.uk.

Experience:

* UI design: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: In person
