* Designs and builds AI agents and skills that embed AI across the product delivery lifecycle, partnering with the Technical Lead and borrowed engineering resources, and shares what is learned so the teams' way of working improves
* Contributes to making Deposits 2.0 agentic ready by gathering input from bank experts, documenting gaps and design principles, and drafting the standards that product and engineering teams will use

* Tests new ways of working with AI embedded in team workflows, including more efficient alternatives to the traditional workshop, while supporting training, adoption, and change and guiding teammates and peers where appropriate
* Plans, tracks, and communicates progress by maintaining delivery plans, tracking value derived versus expected, prioritizing across multiple tasks and stakeholders, and raising it early when timelines or quality are at risk

* 3+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area

* Developing knowledge of data analytics and data literacy
* Bachelor's degree in a related area of study, with financial services experience (ideally in consumer banking) and hands-on AI experience, including agentic AI frameworks and large language models
* Naturally curious, with the drive to learn everything and the discipline to do it intentionally: starts learning without being asked, chooses what to learn next based on what the work needs, and actively seeks specific feedback and applies it visibly

* Clear communication and ownership: confirms shared understanding early, speaks up with facts and options, keeps commitments, and owns mistakes promptly

Morgan and Chase brands. title: Product Analyst
description:
**Company Description**
IntegriChain is the data and application backbone for market access departments of Life Sciences manufacturers. We deliver the data, the applications, and the business process infrastructure for patient access and therapy commercialization. More than 250 manufacturers rely on our ICyte Platform to orchestrate their commercial and government payer contracting, patient services, and distribution channels. ICyte is the first and only platform that unites the financial, operational, and commercial data sets required to support therapy access in the era of specialty and precision medicine. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators can digitalize their market access operations, freeing up resources to focus on more data-driven decision support. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators are digitalizing labor-intensive processes – freeing up their best talent to identify and resolve coverage and availability hurdles and to manage pricing and forecasting complexity.
  
  
We are headquartered in Philadelphia, PA (USA), with offices in Ambler, PA (USA); Pune, India; and Medellín, Colombia. For more information, visit www.integrichain.com, or follow us on Twitter @IntegriChain and LinkedIn.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Overview:**
We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented Product Analyst to partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering, and business stakeholders to drive product delivery and continuous improvement.
  
  
This role is critical in translating complex business needs into actionable product requirements, enabling high-quality delivery across our platform. You will serve as a bridge between business users and technical teams, ensuring clarity, precision, and alignment throughout the product development lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Requirements & Solution Definition**

* Elicit, analyze, and document detailed business and system requirements
* Translate business needs into clear, structured user stories, workflows, and technical specifications
* Support solution design in collaboration with Product and Engineering teams

**Product Delivery Support**

* Partner with Product Managers to break down features into deliverable work for agile teams
* Participate in backlog refinement, story creation, and sprint planning
* Ensure requirements are testable, complete, and aligned to business objectives

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across product, engineering, and client-facing teams
* Act as a trusted advisor for feature enhancements, process improvements, and issue resolution

**Testing & Quality Support**

* Support QA efforts by clarifying requirements and validating outcomes
* Assist in defect triage, root cause analysis, and resolution tracking

**Documentation & Release Support**

* Maintain high-quality product documentation, including requirements, process flows, and release notes
* Contribute to ongoing improvement of documentation standards and processes

**Domain Expertise Development**

* Build deep expertise in pharma/life sciences data, processes, and regulatory requirements
* Apply domain knowledge to improve product quality and usability

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**

* 2–4 years of experience as a Product Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
* Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into structured, actionable deliverables
* Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum) and tools such as Jira and Confluence
* Experience working closely with engineering and QA teams
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Proficiency in Excel and other business productivity tools
* 1–3 years of hands-on experience applying AI and automation to improve product development or business processes, including:

+ Using AI tools (e.g., copilots, prompt-based tools, or data analysis assistants) to accelerate requirements definition, analysis, or documentation
+ Identifying opportunities to automate manual workflows (e.g., data validation, testing support, reporting, or operational processes)
+ Partnering with engineering to define automation-ready workflows and scalable solutions

* Demonstrated ability to think in terms of efficiency, scalability, and leverage—not just task execution

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare data domains (e.g., pricing, rebates, chargebacks, aggregate spend)
* Familiarity with US healthcare systems and data environments

**What Sets You Apart:**

* Structured thinker who brings clarity to ambiguous problems
* Strong ownership mindset with a focus on outcomes, not just outputs
* Ability to balance detail orientation with speed and execution
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving product environment
* Collaborative, proactive, and continuously improving mindset

Additional Information
  
  
**What does IntegriChain have to offer?**

* Mission driven: Work with the purpose of helping to improve patients' lives!
* Excellent and affordable medical benefits + non-medical perks including Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and much more!
* Robust Learning & Development opportunities including over 700+ development courses free to all employees

IntegriChain is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. IntegriChain is an equal opportunity employer; committed to creating a community of inclusion, and an environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

title: Associate - Digital Product Management
description:
**Job Description**
The Global Risk & Compliance team is seeking a highly motivated
**Associate, Digital Product Management**
to join the Financial Crimes Products & Capabilities team and support several high-impact modernization initiatives.
  
  
In this role as a data product owner, you will help advance modernization of the Customer Risk Rating (CRR) engine, enhance data sourcing and integration, and transition legacy capabilities to modern, scalable platforms. You will collaborate with Product, Technology, Compliance, Data Governance, and business stakeholders to define requirements, strengthen data quality, and deliver enterprise-wide solutions that enable accurate and consistent customer risk assessments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As an Associate, you will support the delivery of CRR modernization initiatives by performing data analysis, identifying authoritative data sources, improving data quality and defining data standardization to ensure accurate, consistent and reliable data for customer risk assessments.
  
  
You will partner closely with Product, Technology, Compliance, Data Governance, Platforms, and Technology to align priorities and execute modernization roadmaps.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Translate business needs and requirements into clearly defined product capabilities, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog in partnership with Product, Technology, and business stakeholders.
* Drive alignment across stakeholders on data requirements, business rules, product, delivery and data decisions, balancing trade-offs, dependencies, and enterprise impact.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies and partner with cross-functional teams to identify challenges, evaluate solutions, and support successful delivery.
* Analyze data requirements, identify appropriate sources of record, and define data mapping and standardization logic.
* Partner with use-case owners and stakeholders to deliver end-to-end products and capabilities while identifying opportunities, dependencies, and gaps.
* Assess data availability, completeness, quality and gaps across products, markets and customer segments to support reliable customer risk assessments.
* Facilitate cross-functional working sessions, document decisions, and ensure clear ownership and follow-through on action items.
* Support modernization of roadmaps, including milestone planning, dependency tracking and risk identification.
* Communicate the value, progress, and impact of shared platform capabilities to leadership and partner teams.

**The Ideal Candidate Is**

* Comfortable with ambiguity: Able to operate effectively in strategic platform environments where solutions may not be fully defined.
* A systems thinker: Understands how decisions within one component or platform can impact upstream and downstream products, processes, and teams.
* Self-directed and proactive: Identifies areas requiring analysis, documentation, or alignment and moves work forward with appropriate autonomy.
* Highly collaborative: Builds effective partnerships across Product, Technology, Compliance, Data, and other disciplines.
* Detail-oriented: Maintains attention to execution details while keeping broader business and platform objectives in view.
* An effective communicator: Builds credibility across technical and non-technical stakeholders and communicates complex topics clearly.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in product management, product analysis, business analysis, or a related role.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated experience gathering and documenting requirements, including user stories, product requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience working with platforms, infrastructure, data, or other technically complex products.
* Ability to identify and manage cross-team dependencies, trade-offs, and competing priorities.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe.
* Familiarity with product and delivery tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to synthesize complex information and develop clear narratives and presentations for senior leaders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with data migration, data analysis, or platform modernization initiatives.
* Technical fluency with data flows, APIs, system integrations, and modern platform architectures.
* Experience with data strategy, data quality, data governance, or related data management disciplines.
* Working knowledge of SQL, Database design or similar data querying and analytical tools.
* Familiarity with dashboarding, reporting, or data visualization tools.

**Nice to Have**
We do not expect candidates to be experts in all the following areas. We are looking for someone who is curious, technically minded, and eager to continue developing their skills alongside the team.
  
  

* Familiarity with Financial Crimes domains such as AML, KYC/EDD, sanctions screening, Customer Risk Rating, or transaction monitoring.
* Interest in AI-assisted product workflows.
* Experience with GCP or other modern data and analytics platforms.
* Experience with software development or technical product management.
* Willingness to learn new tools and technology
* Candidate must be comfortable working in 2pm - 11pm IST shift timings.

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

* Author, co-author, and support updates to CEPs, CERs, PMCF Plans and Reports, SLR protocols/reports, and related clinical evaluation documentation for assigned medical device products.
* Apply clinical evaluation requirements, internal procedures, templates, and evidence appraisal expectations to produce clear, traceable, scientifically sound, and audit-ready deliverables.
* Ensure clinical evaluation deliverables are developed in alignment with EU MDR 2017/745, applicable MDCG guidance, MEDDEV guidance where relevant, internal procedures, and other applicable regulatory, clinical evaluation, and post-market guidance.
* Perform structured literature review activities, including search strategy development and execution, screening, data extraction, appraisal support, evidence synthesis, and documentation of rationale and traceability.
* Integrate clinical, post-market, risk management, PMS, PMCF, labeling, and state-of-the-art evidence into clinical evaluation deliverables with appropriate guidance and review based on deliverable complexity.
* Support cross-functional review with Regulatory Affairs, Medical Safety, Design Excellence, and Quality teams to resolve comments and maintain alignment across lifecycle documentation.
* Manage assigned deliverables to agreed timelines, proactively communicating risks, dependencies, open questions, and escalation needs.
* Contribute to clinical evaluation process improvements, template refinements, reusable content, and knowledge-sharing practices that improve consistency and efficiency.
* Demonstrate familiarity with and compliant use of approved clinical evaluation systems, Microsoft Office tools, literature databases, reference management tools, document management platforms, templates, and other authorized clinical evaluation or literature review tools, including appropriate documentation, version control, traceability, data integrity, and adherence to applicable procedures and tool-use requirements.
* Develop increasing independence, technical judgment, and ability to manage clinical evaluation deliverables of increasing complexity.

**Key Requirements/Minimum Qualifications:**

* Quality, accuracy, traceability, and defensibility of assigned clinical evaluation deliverables.
* Timely completion of assigned CERs, CEPs, PMCF Plans/Reports, SLRs, and lifecycle updates against agreed project timelines.
* Effective incorporation and resolution of cross-functional review comments with clear rationale and documentation.
* Consistent use of approved templates, procedures, literature review methods, and evidence appraisal expectations.
* Demonstrated growth in independence, technical judgment, and ability to manage increasingly complex clinical evaluation deliverables.
* Bachelor’s Degree / Master’s Degree / PhD / Pharm D
* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in EU MDR 2017/745 medical device regulations, clinical evaluation, clinical evidence, regulatory medical writing, systematic literature review, clinical research, or a related scientific/regulatory function.
* Experience in ophthalmic medical devices is preferred.
* Foundational to strong working knowledge of EU MDR clinical evaluation expectations, MEDDEV 2.7/1 Rev. 4, applicable MDCG guidance, PMCF, PMS, risk management interfaces, and benefit-risk concepts
* Ability to author, update, and support technical review of CERs, CEPs, PMCF

* Plans/Reports, SLRs, and related lifecycle documentation
* Understanding of research methodology, clinical study design, literature review methods, evidence appraisal, and data interpretation
* Ability to follow approved templates, procedures, and document control expectations in a regulated medical device environment
* Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, documentation discipline, and ability to maintain audit-ready rationale and traceability
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Regulatory Affairs, Medical Safety, Quality, Design, and clinical stakeholders
* Ability to manage assigned deliverables, communicate status and risks, and escalate open issues appropriately.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, document management systems, literature databases, reference management tools, and approved clinical evaluation or literature review platforms, with compliant use consistent with applicable procedures and data integrity expectations
* Experience within a global environment, including flexibility to work off-peak hours as needed to accommodate multiple time zones

title: Report and proposals specialist
description:

\* Analyse audit findings, customer feedback, survey results and operational data.

\* Convert raw data and observations into clear, meaningful business insights.

\* Identify service gaps, operational weaknesses and areas for improvement.

\* Develop executive summaries, key findings and actionable recommendations.

title: Product Specialist
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
  
  
We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
As a
**Product Specialist**
, you will be part of a dynamic engineering team based in Bengaluru /Pune, supporting the development and maintenance of industrial automation configuration and selection tools. Your role will involve collaborating with Product Management, Engineering, Commercial Engineering, UX, Development, and QA teams to analyse product requirements, define business rules, validate tool functionality, and improve product accuracy and user experience. You will report to the Team Lead and work in a hybrid environment, following the 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM shift from Bengaluru/Pune, India.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Provide product and technical expertise to support development and maintenance of industrial automation configuration and selection tools.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Commercial Engineering, UX, Development, and QA teams to define, document, and validate product requirements.
* Analyse product, system, and business rules to ensure accurate functional and technical specifications.
* Support discovery, requirement-gathering, UAT, and validation activities to improve tool accuracy, usability, and customer experience.
* Maintain product data, configuration rules, and supporting documentation for implementation by development teams.
* Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and improvement opportunities that impact tool functionality and user experience.
* Monitor market and competitor tools to provide practical insights and recommendations to product stakeholders.

**The Essentials - You Will Have**

* 4–6 years of experience in pre-sales, post-sales engineering, technical support, product specialist, or product configuration roles within industrial automation.
* Experience supporting product selection tools, configuration platforms, product data, or software-enabled engineering applications.
* Ability to analyse product requirements, business rules, and system logic to prepare clear functional specifications, user stories, and validation scenarios.
* Hands-on exposure to Rockwell Automation products and tools such as Integrated Architecture Builder, Motion Analyzer, Studio 5000, or Logix Designer is preferred.
* Experience working with Agile/Scrum teams and tools such as Jira for backlog updates, issue tracking, testing support, and sprint execution.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with Product Management, Engineering, Development, QA, Technical Support, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to identify gaps, support process improvements, and contribute practical recommendations to improve tool accuracy, usability, and operational efficiency.

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Academic or practical exposure to industrial automation, control systems, software applications, and engineering workflows.
* Knowledge of software development concepts, system design, product configuration, and selection tools is preferred.

Ability to apply engineering and software knowledge to support product accuracy, tool usability, and business process improvements.
  
  
**What We Offer We Offer**
Our benefits package includes …
  
  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!

*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Business Process Analyst/Specialist
description:
**Role Purpose**
(Why do we need this role?)

The Business Process Analyst supports the Business Excellence function by assisting with the documentation, analysis, and improvement of processes.

The role supports the build of a high-quality, structured, and audit-ready process repository. This includes assisting with the mapping of current-state processes, helping identify gaps, and enabling standardization across functions and regions by linking process maps, SOPs, work instructions, roles, controls, systems, and improvement opportunities within the process mapping tool and associated document repositories.

The role is based at the Swire Digital Centre (SDC) in Bangalore or Chennai and is currently setup to primarily deliver to the Transformation division in Swire Shipping.

**Role Accountabilities**
(What is this role responsible for delivering?)

Scope Ownership & Ways of Working

* Work to the process architecture, taxonomy, modelling conventions and documentation standards as defined by the business.
* Support named business process owners, who retain ownership of process content, approval of documentation, and decisions on standard process design.

Process Mapping, Documentation & Governance

* Support detailed process discovery sessions across functions, working closely with global operating teams to help capture accurate end-to-end workflows.
* Assist in developing and maintaining process maps (L2–L4) using
  **BPMN standard**
  s in ADONIS or equivalent tools, supporting consistency in structure and level of detail.
* Support governance processes including documentation reviews, approvals, publication, and periodic updates to help ensure accuracy and currency.
* Assist in tracking documentation coverage and completeness across priority processes and support the expansion of visibility across global functions.

Gap Identification & Process Analysis

* Support the analysis of current-state processes to help identify inefficiencies, control gaps, duplication, and non-standard practices.
* Assist in highlighting improvement opportunities related to quality, turnaround time, and operational efficiency.
* Support root cause analysis using structured problem-solving approaches.
* Assist in providing clear, data-backed insights to support prioritisation of improvement initiatives.

Process Standardisation & Improvement Support

* Support the design of standardised processes aligned with best practices and business requirements.
* Assist in implementing improvements, supporting alignment between documented processes and actual operations.
* Collaborate with global operations and business teams to support the validation of proposed improvements and help assess feasibility.
* Contribute to reducing process variation and improving consistency across teams.

Stakeholder Collaboration

* Work closely with global business stakeholders to support the capture of accurate process flows.
* Engage with cross functional teams across regions to support the validation of end-to-end processes and help ensure alignment with business intent.
* Act as a bridge between operations and Business Excellence to help translate operational workflows into structured, standardised documentation.

**Key Qualifications & Skills**
(What knowledge will ensure success in the role?)

**Qualifications**

Required -

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline.
* 5–7 years of experience in process mapping, business analysis, shared services, or operations.
* Experience supporting workshops and translating operational activities into structured documentation.

Preferred -

* Experience in shipping, logistics, or complex service environments.
* ADONIS, ARIS, Signavio, Visio, or similar BPM tool experience.
* BPMN Knowledge
* Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt preferred) or equivalent process improvement training is an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in process mapping methodologies (BPMN, SIPOC, value stream mapping).
* Experience with process modelling tools such as ADONIS, ARIS, Signavio, or similar.
* Ability to support the documentation of processes at multiple levels (L2–L4) with clarity and consistency.
* Analytical skills to help identify gaps, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities.
* Familiarity with shared services operations, workflows, and SLA-driven environments is advantageous.
* Understanding of systems, workflows, and digital process enablement.

**Professional Skills**

* Strong facilitation skills to gather information from operational teams.
* High diligence and commitment to documentation quality and standards.
* Clear and structured communication, both written and verbal.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume environment with competing priorities.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across teams and geographies.
* Problem-solving approach with an improvement-oriented mindset.

title: Product Application Engineer
description:
**Senior Applications Engineer**
**Ethernet Validation & Test Solutions**
**Location: Bangalore, India**
**About The Role**
Tektronix is seeking a Senior Applications Engineer to support industry-leading Ethernet validation and test solutions across all Ethernet speeds, from legacy standards through 800G and beyond.
  
  
This position will serve as a global technical resource working directly with customers, field teams, product management, and engineering to solve the industry's most demanding networking and high-speed communication challenges. The successful candidate will become a recognized subject matter expert in Ethernet test and measurement methodologies while helping drive the future direction of Tektronix networking solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the technical leader for Ethernet validation, debug, compliance, and interoperability applications.
* Support customers developing next-generation networking, telecommunications, datacenter, storage, and AI infrastructure products.
* Independently resolve complex customer technical issues involving Ethernet physical layer measurements, signaling integrity, compliance, and protocol analysis.
* Conduct customer demonstrations, evaluations, workshops, and technical deep-dive sessions.
* Develop technical content including application notes, training materials, videos, reference workflows, and customer presentations.
* Partner with sales and marketing teams to identify and develop new business opportunities.
* Support product launches, release readiness, beta programs, and customer adoption initiatives.
* Analyze industry standards and technology trends to identify future customer requirements.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve product performance, usability, and customer workflows.
* Provide technical mentorship and contribute to organizational knowledge sharing across the global Applications Engineering team.
* Represent Tektronix at industry events, standards organizations, consortium activities, and customer meetings.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, or related discipline.
* 8+ years of industry experience in networking, Ethernet design, validation, test engineering, or applications engineering.
* Strong knowledge of Ethernet technologies, including:

+ 10G, 25G, 50G, 100G, 200G, 400G, and emerging 800G standards
+ PAM4 signaling
+ Ethernet compliance methodologies
+ Optical and electrical Ethernet interfaces

* Strong understanding of:

+ High-speed signal integrity
+ Oscilloscope-based measurements
+ Eye diagrams and jitter analysis
+ Channel characterization and debugging

* Excellent communication and customer engagement skills.
* Ability to work effectively across global teams and customer locations.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Ethernet compliance standards and interoperability testing.
* Familiarity with IEEE Ethernet standards development.
* Knowledge of optical communications, SerDes architectures, and datacenter networking technologies.
* Experience with BERT solutions, protocol analysis tools, and automated test software.

title: Sr Engineer - Customer Interaction Suite
description:
**About The Company**
Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
  
  
**Job Description: Solution Engineer – Context Graph Demo Specialist**
**Company:**
Tata Communications
  
  
**Function:**
Solution Engineering
  
  
**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor (IC)
  
  
**Experience:**
Fresher – 2 years
  
  
**Locations:**
Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Gurugram
  
  
**Travel:**
40–50% (on-site customer demos)
  
  
**About The Role**
Tata Communications is looking for an early-career Solution Engineer to join the Solution Engineering team, focused on building and delivering demonstrations of our Context Graph capabilities. This is a highly visible, customer-facing role for someone who enjoys translating technical concepts into compelling business stories, thinks logically under pressure, and is comfortable being on the road to present in front of customers.
  
  
You'll work closely with senior solution architects, product, and sales teams to build demo environments, customize them for specific customer use cases, and present them live — both virtually and on-site.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Demo Build & Ownership: Build, configure, and maintain demo environments for Context Graph, ensuring they reflect current product capabilities and are tailored to different industry use cases.
* Customer-Facing Demos: Travel to customer locations (40–50% travel) to deliver live product demonstrations, walk through use cases, and answer first-level technical questions.
* Use Case Translation: Work with sales and solution architects to understand a prospect's business problem and translate it into a relevant, believable demo narrative — not just a feature walkthrough.
* Troubleshooting on the Fly: Diagnose and resolve demo environment issues quickly, including during live customer sessions, with a calm and structured approach.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to stay current on roadmap changes, feedback loops from the field, and competitive positioning.
* Documentation: Maintain demo scripts, environment setup guides, and reusable assets so demos can scale across the team.
* Continuous Learning: Build depth in graph data concepts, knowledge graphs, and how Context Graph fits into broader enterprise data and AI strategies.

**Must-Have**
**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (freshers welcome) or up to 2 years of relevant experience.
* Strong logical and analytical thinking — able to break down a customer problem and map it to a technical solution.
* Ontology-first thinking — demonstrated ability to model an enterprise’s objects, actions and processes as a reusable semantic layer, with metadata, permissions and data structures kept consistent, secure, and scalable Ontology.
* Basic understanding of data structures, databases, or graph concepts (formal experience not required, but genuine curiosity and aptitude expected).
* Good business acumen — able to understand a customer's commercial context, not just their technical ask.
* Comfortable with public speaking / presenting to small and large groups, including senior stakeholders.
* Willingness and ability to travel 40–50% of the time for on-site customer demos.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Good To Have (not Mandatory)**

* Exposure to graph databases (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph, etc.) or knowledge graph concepts.
* Familiarity with SQL, Python, or basic scripting.
* Prior internship or project experience involving customer-facing work, hackathons, or product demos.
* Understanding of enterprise IT, telecom, or B2B SaaS environments.

**What Success Looks Like In This Role**

* Demo environments are reliable, current, and reusable across the team.
* Customers leave demo sessions with a clear understanding of how Context Graph solves their specific problem.
* You build a reputation internally as someone who can be trusted to represent the product in front of a customer.
* You progress toward owning more complex, custom-built demos and eventually pre-sales solutioning independently.

**Why Join Tata Communications**

* Front-row seat to how enterprise customers evaluate and adopt cutting-edge graph and AI-driven solutions.
* Direct mentorship from senior solution architects and exposure to the full sales cycle.
* Fast-tracked learning curve: technical depth + commercial exposure + customer-facing skills, all in one role.
* Clear growth path into Solution Architecture, Pre-Sales, or Product roles.

title: RFP Writer- Asset Management - Associate/ Sr Associate
description:
**RFP Writer @ Acuity Analytics**

**Job Description**

Do you have a strong interest in understanding the nuances of Asset and Wealth Management space? Does the idea of working on marketing & client servicing collaterals—intended towards winning new businesses and defending existing relationships—excites you? Do you have the aptitude to analyze financial data, identify complex firm and product information embedded within client questionnaires, and craft responses in a clear and compelling manner? Do you embrace change positively and like to operate within a collaborative environment and consistently? If the answer to above questions for you is a definite 'yes', the position of Request for Proposal (RFP) and Due Diligence Questionnaire (DDQ) Writer at Acuity might be ‘just right’ for you.

**Fund Marketing Services – RFP Practice**

RFP Services is one of the key practices within the Fund Marketing Services line of business at Acuity where we create necessary specialisms to respond to asset and wealth management RFPs and DDQs. As part of the practice, we also review and analyze content databases in their as-is states and provide recommendations for fully capturing their potential, and support with content restructuring to ensure better tagging, archiving and overall usability.

RFP and DDQs are Q&A documents (questionnaires) including standard and non-standard questions asked by prospects/clients to request information and conduct due diligence on an investment manager to ensure their investments are in “safe hands”.

**Position and Expectations**

As an RFP/DDQ Writer, you will be part of client-dedicated RFP/DDQ platforms Acuity builds for its asset and wealth management clients. These strategic platforms, developed in close collaboration with our clients, provide capacity augmentation, recommendations and share industry best practices, and overall work as an extension of our client’s own team.

title: Associate Value Engineering - Orbit India
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**The Team:**
As an Associate Value Engineer, you are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. As a so-called Value Engineer (VE), you partner with sales and customers to create compelling and innovative technical solutions to critical business problems leveraging cutting edge (AI) capabilities within our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A great VE understands the customer, the technology, and the sales cycle making it what may be the most interesting, challenging, and fulfilling role in Enterprise Software.
  
  
You will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to a community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching & mentoring.
  
  
**The Role:**
Talented individuals launch their careers in the enterprise software world by joining the Orbit Graduate Program as an Associate Value Engineer.
  
  
The
**12-month program**
is a unique experience to fast start your career in the SaaS Industry that highlights hands-on learning, mentorship, and a team culture where we rely on each other to learn, grow and achieve. The program is designed to develop essential VE skills & competencies and establish strong lasting relationships allowing you to grow your career at Celonis.
  
  
Your journey will start with onboarding & enablement to develop your business and Celonis skills through a combination of hands-on experience in customer engagements and different pieces of training which cover amongst others the Celonis Process Intelligence, domain knowledge, presentation & demo skills, discovery & objection handling as well as value selling.
  
  
**The work you’ll do:**

* Work as part of the Global VE CoE to support the Benelux Value Engineering team on customer engagements
* Collaborate with customers to uncover their core business challenges and determine how Celonis Process Intelligence can help them achieve their business objectives and AI Strategy
* Execute proof projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence, frame a quantitative business value and deliver presentations to senior executives to drive investment decisions
* Prototype and develop AI solutions tailored to customer needs, including both traditional machine learning, LLM-based solutions and orchestration technology
* Drive change management and value realisation and ensure a positive return on investment
* Build strong relationships with our customers by winning their trust through technical, product expertise, and business acumen to act as a trusted advisor
* Collaborate and share customer insights & feedback with internal Product and Engineering teams to influence and co-develop (AI) product innovations
* Create re-usable collateral, best practices & tools within the Global VE Center of Excellence and feed them back to the regional Value Engineering team
* Travel to the Benelux region to meet clients in person to ensure the success of customer engagements

**The qualifications you need:**
We are looking for people who enjoy solving problems, think outside the box, and are not afraid to make and learn from mistakes. In particular, we seek “builders” who thrive in fast-paced environments and can rapidly develop solutions and pilots using our platform and AI technologies.
  
  
You have a bachelors and/or masters degree in (Industrial) Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science / Business Analytics, AI/ML, Mathematics or other related fields, as well as valuable work/internship experience. You’re curious, self-motivated, enjoy continuous learning, and you want to work in a lively environment characterized by high growth.
  
  
**You are successful as a Value Engineer if you:**

* Have a passion for technology, data and AI and the impact it can have on the world.
* Have a hunger to learn new technologies and bring at least basic knowledge or hands-on experience in SQL and/or Python.
* Any exposure to process mining principles and completion of Celonis Rising Star modules would be a welcome indicator of your eagerness to develop in this field.
* Are able to think analytically and creatively, especially in applying technology solutions to core business problems.
* Are focused on creating and adding value for customers.
* Have an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to multi-task, prioritize and execute.
* Are able to build relationships with senior management and influence decision-makers.
* Are confident to present to C-level executives and larger audiences.
* Are willing to travel to India region to meet clients in person.
* Are an effective communicator and fluent in English.

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
  
  
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
  
  
**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

title: Learning & Development Specialist
description:
**Position purpose**
  
The Learning & Development Specialist partners with business stakeholders and subject matter experts to identify learning needs and design, develop, implement and evaluate effective learning solutions.
  
  
The role manages the end-to-end learning development lifecycle, translating complex technical content into engaging and accessible learning experiences. Solutions may include self-paced learning, virtual and instructor-led training, videos, simulations, assessments, job aids and other performance-support resources.
  
  
The position also supports the delivery and continuous improvement of assigned learning programs, ensuring solutions are aligned with business priorities, adult learning principles, Novotech standards and applicable regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key responsibilities**
  
**1. Learning needs analysis and consultation**

* Partner with key stakeholders to clarify learning requests and identify the underlying performance or capability need.
* Conduct learning needs analyses using stakeholder consultation, performance data, learner feedback and available business information.
* Determine whether learning is the appropriate intervention and recommend alternative performance-support solutions where required.
* Define target audiences, learning objectives, success measures and evaluation approaches.

**2. Instructional design**

* Apply adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies to create effective and learner-centred solutions.
* Translate complex technical content into clear and practical learning experiences.
* Ensure learning solutions support knowledge application and performance rather than focusing only on information presentation.
* Design learning journeys, curricula, course structures, storyboards, facilitator guides, participant materials and performance-support resources.
* Design solutions that can be delivered through self-paced learning, virtual instructor-led training, instructor-led training, blended learning, microlearning or workplace performance support.

**3. Digital learning development**

* Develop engaging modules using approved authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Articulate Rise and other digital learning applications.
* Develop interactive learning activities, branching scenarios, simulations, software demonstrations and assessments.
* Use approved generative AI tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude and ChatGPT, to support instructional design and digital learning development, as needed.
* Create and edit basic learning videos, screen recordings and other multimedia assets using tools such as Camtasia and Canva.
* Create professional, visually engaging presentations, facilitator decks and learning materials in Microsoft PowerPoint.
* Use AI-assisted development approaches to create, adapt or troubleshoot simple interactive learning pages, where appropriate.
* Apply Novotech templates, branding and user-experience standards consistently across learning solutions.
* Maintain source files, published packages, content versions and supporting documentation in approved repositories.

**4. Learning program implementation**

* Coordinate with SMEs, facilitators, vendors and internal stakeholders to plan and support timely implementation.
* Develop learner communications, facilitator briefing materials and implementation resources.
* Support pilot sessions and incorporate feedback before broader deployment.
* Work with the L&D Coordinator or L&D administrator to arrange enrolment, scheduling, communications and LMS assignment.

**5. Evaluation and continuous improvement**

* Analyse learner feedback, assessment results, completion data, stakeholder input and available performance indicators.
* Evaluate whether learning objectives have been achieved and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain and update existing learning solutions based on learner feedback, business changes, process updates and regulatory requirements.

**6. Stakeholder and SME management**

* Establish productive working relationships with business stakeholders, SMEs, Quality, Compliance, IT and other relevant functions.
* Guide SMEs through the learning development and review process.
* Facilitate content reviews and manage stakeholder feedback through agreed review cycles.

**7. Project management**

* Manage multiple learning projects concurrently from initiation through implementation and evaluation.
* Communicate progress and constraints clearly to stakeholders.
* Manage assigned work within agreed scope, quality, timelines and budget.
* Identify when a requested change affects project scope, timeline, resources or solution quality.
* Use Microsoft Excel to track, analyse and report learning and project data.

**8. L&D standards and capability**

* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Novotech's learning development processes, templates and quality standards.
* Maintain awareness of developments in adult learning, instructional design, digital learning technology, accessibility and learning evaluation.
* Support the development of reusable learning assets and standardised design approaches.
* Provide guidance or mentoring to coordinators, facilitators or less-experienced team members when required.

**Qualifications and experience**
  
**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in instructional design, education, learning and development, organisational development, human resources, communications or a related field.
* 4-6 years of relevant experience in learning and development, instructional design or digital learning development.
* Experience developing eLearning and other media assets using Articulate Storyline, Articulate Rise, Camtasia, Canva or comparable tools.
* Demonstrated experience using generative AI tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude or ChatGPT, to support instructional design and digital learning development, including storyboarding, content development, scenario creation, assessment design or rapid prototyping.
* Experience designing instructor-led, virtual and digital learning solutions.
* Strong understanding of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, engaging and practical learning content.
* Strong writing, editing, and visual communication skills.
* Proficiency in using Microsoft Office tools like PowerPoint, Excel, Word and so on.
* Strong stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities with limited supervision.
* High level of attention to detail and commitment to quality.

**Desirable**

* Experience working in a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare or another regulated industry.
* Knowledge of the clinical research environment and applicable GCP or GxP requirements.
* Experience developing clinical, technical, procedural or compliance-related learning.
* Basic understanding of HTML and web-page structure, sufficient to use AI-assisted tools to create, edit and troubleshoot simple interactive learning pages.
* Knowledge of accessibility principles and standards relevant to digital learning.
* Experience measuring learning effectiveness beyond learner satisfaction and completion.
* Experience managing external learning vendors or development partners.

**Core capabilities**
  
The successful candidate should demonstrate:

* Instructional design and digital learning development
* Learning needs analysis
* Project management
* Stakeholder and SME management
* Learning evaluation
* Technical quality assurance
* AI-assisted design and development
* Continuous improvement
* Authoring and Media development tools
* Microsoft Office
* Business and learner focus
* Video and multimedia development

Novotech is proud to offer a great workplace. We are committed to being an employer of choice for gender equality and providing an inclusive work environment where everyone is treated fairly and with respect. Our team members are passionate about what we do, but we understand work is only one of the things that is important to them. We support our team members with flexible working options, paid parental leave for both parents, flexible leave entitlements, wellness programs and ongoing development programs. We are looking for people who are passionate about working in clinical research and biotech, including people who identify with LGBTIQ+, have a disability or have caring responsibilities. We are a Circle Back Initiative Employer and commit to responding to every application. We look forward to talking to you about working at Novotech.

title: QMS Specialist
description:
Job Title
  
  
QMS Specialist
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job title:**
QMS Specialist
  
  
**Your Role**
The QMS Specialist is responsible for supporting the establishment of a compliant and effective Quality Management System (QMS) for the activities in scope. The role participates in developing and revising QMS process documents, such as SOPs and quality manuals, ensuring their accuracy and currency. The role works under general supervision, and collaborates with cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues through root cause analysis and corrective actions. The role collects and reports data on QMS performance metrics and tracks non conformance reports, contributing to continuous improvement activities.
  
  
**You're the right fit if: (4 x bullets max)**

* Experience: 6–10 years; mid-level professionals.
* Skills:
* Strong experience in document control and QMS documentation, including use of PLM and electronic document management systems such as Windchill; managing controlled documents, revisions, approvals, and change workflows; and maintaining device master record (DMR) or equivalent product documentation files.
* Good understanding of QMS standards and regulations, including ISO 13485, FDA QMSR, and EU MDR; experience with QMS processes like training, and participation in internal and external audit.
* Participates in the effective deployment and continuous improvement of QMS processes in the assigned area/ areas such as document control, training, and audits, by providing technical expertise and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.
* Collects, compiles, and reports data on QMS performance metrics, such as non-conformances, critical findings, and training completion rates, to support management in decision-making.
* Contributes to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities for enhancing efficiency and compliance within existing QMS processes and providing support in implementing improvements.
* Participates in the planning and organization of internal audits by preparing necessary documentation, assisting audit teams during audits, and ensuring follow-up actions are completed.
* Ensures the proper maintenance, organization, and archiving of quality records in accordance with QMS procedures, regulatory requirements, and company policies to maintain audit readiness.
* Collaborates with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to ensure effective communication and understanding of QMS processes, and provide basic guidance on compliance-related inquiries.
* Participates in problem-solving sessions by providing data and insights related to quality processes, supporting the identication of root causes, and recommending potential corrective actions.
* Works under general supervision and established processes, utilizing independent judgment to navigate and adhere to operational policies, ensuring compliance and optimal performance.
* Engages in risk management activities, identifying potential risks to regulatory compliance, quality and QMS integrity, and proposing mitigation strategies to minimize impact.
* Participates in training sessions to stay updated on quality standards and QMS procedures, actively engaging in learning opportunities to enhance understanding of industry regulations and best practices.
* Develops professional expertise and applies comprehensive knowledge of company products and services to effectively address challenges and opportunities
* Education: Bachelor of Engineering and/or MSc. (Science, Biomedical, Biotech, etc)
* Anything else:
* Regulatory Requirements
* Quality Management Systems (QMS)
* Troubleshooting
* KPI Monitoring and Reporting
* Data Analysis & Interpretation
* Process Improvements
* Agile Methodology
* User Training & Support
* Training Content Development
* Business Acumen

title: R&D Substation Automation - Verification & Validation Engineer - IDC
description:
Job Summary\*\*
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and innovative R&D Engineer to join our dynamic team at Hitachi, Ltd. This role involves contributing to the research, design, and development of cutting-edge technologies and products, pushing the boundaries of innovation within our diverse industrial sectors.
  
  
Job Responsibilities\*\*
  
  

* Perform verification and validation of Substation Automation and Protection products, systems, and engineering tools.
* Design, execute, and document functional, integration, interoperability, regression, performance, and system-level test cases.
* Validate IEC 61850 services and system engineering, including MMS, GOOSE, Sampled Values, SCL files, and time synchronization where applicable.
* Test communication interfaces and protocols such as IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-101/104, DNP3, OPC UA, SNMP, and other relevant industrial protocols.
* Analyze network communication and troubleshoot system-level issues using tools such as Wireshark and protocol/test tools.
* Validate integration between IEDs, protection and control devices, SCADA systems, gateways, engineering tools, and communication networks.
* Integrate the industry standard redundancy protocols and time synchronization between devices.
* Identify, reproduce, document, and track defects, working closely with development teams through resolution and verification.
* Contribute to test automation using Python or similar scripting technologies to improve test coverage and efficiency.
* Participate in cybersecurity and secure communication validation, including authentication, secure protocols, certificates, role-based access, and network security features where applicable.
* Prepare clear test specifications, test reports, defect reports, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with local and global R&D teams to continuously improve test methods, automation, product quality, and validation efficiency.

Job Qualifications\*\*
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, Power Systems, or a related engineering discipline.
* Good understanding of Substation Automation, Protection & Control, or power automation systems.
* Knowledge of IEC 61850 concepts and communication architecture.
* Familiarity with at least some industrial protocols such as IEC 60870-5-101/104, DNP3, OPC UA, Modbus, or SNMP.
* Basic understanding of Ethernet networking, TCP/IP, VLANs, redundancy, and time synchronization concepts.
* Experience with system testing, product validation, integration testing, or troubleshooting.
* Ability to analyze communication/network traces using Wireshark or similar tools.
* Basic programming or scripting knowledge, preferably Python.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.

description:
**Summary**
Java Application Support Engineer (Japanese Speaking)
  
  
Are you passionate about customer success? Do you like digging into code, and have a drive to continuously learn and solve problems? Do you want to be part of a global team that provides the best customer service in the industry, including the customers in Japan? If so, come join us at Guidewire!
  
  
Guidewire’s Application Support team is part of the Guidewire Global Support organization, delivering 24x7 service to customers who are using Guidewire software both in the Guidewire Cloud and on-premise. We are searching for people who are as passionate about working together to deliver quality products and support as we are.
  
  
As an Application Support Engineer you will learn everything there is to know about Guidewire’s products, and you will communicate and share that knowledge with Guidewire’s internal and external customers, including our Japanese customers. Join us and enjoy a career where you can make an impact. You will be inspired by those around you, and you’ll be trusted and empowered to go further.
  
  
**Job Description**
What You’ll Do
  
  
A Guidewire Application Support Engineer is primarily responsible for providing technical support to Guidewire customers using Guidewire products.
  
  
Develop and maintain deep expertise in Guidewire’s suite of products
  
  
Troubleshooting and resolution of incoming support cases. This includes identifying root causes of issues, providing workarounds or solutions, and collaborating with other teams to resolve complex problems.
  
  
Communicate with customers and ensure that they receive timely and accurate updates on the status of their support requests. This includes providing clear and concise technical explanations to non-technical customers, and managing customer expectations.
  
  
Create and maintain knowledge articles related to the resolution of customer-reported problems with Guidewire products.
  
  
Execute operational tasks to provision, rebuild, configure, and restore services for customer cloud environments as needed.
  
  
Identify areas for service improvement, and collaborate with other teams to implement changes that improve the customer experience.
  
  
Manage and resolve incidents within contractual service level agreements (SLAs). This includes coordination with other teams and stakeholders, and providing timely updates to customers.
  
  
Share your technical knowledge and expertise with other team members, and contribute to the development of team training materials and processes.
  
  
As part of a global team, we provide 24x7 support using a Follow-the-Sun model across our three regions (APAC, EMEA and AMER). You will enjoy local daytime working hours Monday-Friday while participating in occasional weekend shifts on a rotating basis to cover production emergencies.
  
  
At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

* Sound troubleshooting skills. Ability to think critically and display an aptitude for problem solving.

* Demonstrate strong follow-through and consistently keep commitments to customers and employees.
* Understand customer empathy, sense of urgency and commit to customer satisfaction.

**About Guidewire**
Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

**Job Title: Risk Management & Usability Engineer**

**Job Summary**

Responsible for planning, executing, and maintaining Risk Management and Usability Engineering activities throughout the product lifecycle of Medical Devices and Software as a Medical Device (SaMD). The role ensures compliance with applicable regulatory standards and supports product safety, effectiveness, and user-centered design.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Risk Management**

·        Lead and facilitate Risk Management activities in accordance with
**ISO 14971**
.

·        Develop and maintain Risk Management Plans, Risk Analyses, Hazard Analyses, Risk Assessment Reports, and Risk Management Files.

·        Conduct Product, System, Software, and Use-related Risk Assessments.

·        Perform risk evaluations and define risk control measures.

·        Ensure traceability between hazards, hazardous situations, harms, risk controls, and verification activities.

·        Support post-market risk review and complaint trending activities.

**FMEA Activities**

·        Conduct and facilitate:

o   Design FMEA (DFMEA)

o   Usability FMEA (UFMEA)

o   Use FMEA (URFMEA)

o   Software FMEA (as applicable)

·        Coordinate cross-functional discussion and meeting to identify failure modes and mitigations.

·        Analyze Severity, Occurrence, and Detection ratings.

·        Drive implementation and verification of risk control actions.

·        Maintain FMEA documentation throughout product development and sustaining activities.

**Usability Engineering**

·        Execute usability engineering activities in accordance with
**IEC 62366-1**
and FDA Human Factors guidance.

·        Develop Use Specifications and User Profiles.

·        Identify Use-related Hazards and Hazardous Use Scenarios.

·        Perform Task Analysis and Use Error Analysis.

·        Create and maintain Usability Engineering Files.

·        Plan and support formative and summative usability evaluations.

·        Participate in human factors validation testing and reporting.

**Regulatory & Compliance**

·        Ensure compliance with:

o   ISO 14971

o   IEC 62366-1

o   IEC 60601-1 (where applicable)

o   IEC 62304 (for software-based products)

o   FDA Human Factors Guidance

o   MDR/EU Regulations and applicable quality procedures

·        Support design reviews, audits, and regulatory submissions.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

·        Work closely with R&D, Systems Engineering, Software, Clinical, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Product Management teams.

·        Participate in design control and change management activities.

·        Support CAPA, complaint investigations, and field actions related to risk and usability.

**Required Qualifications**

·        Bachelor's or Master's degree in:

o   Biomedical Engineering

o   Electronics Engineering

o   Mechanical Engineering

o   Software Engineering

o   Human Factors Engineering

o   Related discipline

**Required Experience**

·        5-7 years of experience in Medical Device Product Development.

·        Hands-on experience in Risk Management and FMEA execution.

·        Experience developing and maintaining Risk Management Files.

·        Experience conducting usability engineering and human factors activities.

·        Exposure to regulatory audits and design control processes.

**Required Skills**

**Technical Skills**

·        ISO 14971 Risk Management

·        DFMEA / PFMEA / UFMEA

·        Hazard Analysis

·        Risk-Benefit Analysis

·        Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)

·        IEC 62366 Usability Engineering

·        Human Factors Engineering

·        Design Controls

·        Traceability Management

·        Medical Device Development Lifecycle

**Soft Skills**

·        Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills

·        Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities

·        Effective communication and technical writing skills

·        Ability to work in global cross-functional teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

·        Experience with Class II/IIb/III Medical Devices.

·        Experience with Software as a Medical Device (SaMD).

·        Knowledge of cybersecurity risk assessments.

·        Certified Human Factors or Risk Management training.

·        Experience supporting FDA, MDR, and notified body audits.

**Keywords:**
ISO 14971, IEC 62366, DFMEA, PFMEA, UFMEA, Risk Management File, Human Factors, Usability Engineering, Hazard Analysis, Medical Devices, SaMD, Design Controls, IEC 62304, Regulatory Compliance.

title: Global C and I Strategic Operations Support
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Clients & Industries: Global C&I Strategic Operations Support**
**About EY**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. Join EY and help build a better working world. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Global Operations Support plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.
  
  
The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.
  
  
This position sits within the Business Enablement – Business Management Office which supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.
  
  
Success in this model depends on agility — the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.
  
  
The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the rest of the Domain team. This position works directly with the Operations Senior Specialist or Operations Specialist.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Operations**

* Manage and execute domain initiatives and projects by working closely with senior stakeholders, applying strong project management discipline.
* Maintain project plans, timelines, documentation, and next steps, ensuring accuracy and timely updates.
* Drive project meetings, coordinate actions across contributors, advance activity as appropriate and track progress against milestones.
* Support preparation of leadership‑ready materials (presentations, updates, trackers), ensuring they meet EY standards and are ready for circulation.
* Identify project risks, dependencies, and opportunities to improve processes, escalating issues as appropriate.
* Act as a single point of coordination with relevant C&I domains and CBS Functions (e.g., BMC, Finance, Technology, AWS) to support delivery of project outcomes.

**Operational Excellence**

* Support consistent execution of operational processes by maintaining clear documentation, governance artifacts, and reporting.
* Proactively identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance ways of working within the domain.
* Maintain and manage knowledge repositories, databases, SharePoint sites, and content libraries, including regular review and validation of materials.
* Share knowledge, insights, and updates with stakeholders using agreed communication channels.
* Support preparation of status reporting and dashboards, ensuring clarity in coordination with Performance & Data Insights where applicable.
* Assist the triage of requests for ad‑hoc analysis, reporting, and information, helping to embed new ways of working and reinforcing self‑service where possible.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Develop strong working relationships across domains, functions, and pods, anticipating needs and supporting broader team objectives.
* Manage stakeholder communications and expectations, providing clear, timely updates on progress, risks, and next steps.
* Act as a trusted delivery partner to leadership by ensuring follow‑through on actions and high‑quality execution.
* Participate actively in regular update calls and forums, contributing insights and supporting other team members as needed.
* Facilitate coordination across geographically dispersed teams to enable smooth execution and alignment.

**Skills & Attributes For Success**

* Good analytical and problem‑solving skills, with attention to detail.
* Experience supporting operational process design, improvement, and handoff.
* Competence in reporting, data visualization, and storyboarding, with the ability to translate data into clear insights.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders, delivering high‑quality outputs under tight timelines.
* A client‑focused mindset, with the ability to respond to changing needs and redirect effort as required.

* Resilient, adaptable, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment with evolving priorities.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
