title: Analyst, Information Technology
description:
**This is where**
your work makes a difference.
  
  
At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
  
  
Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
  
  
Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride. 
  
  
**Your Role at Baxter:**
 
  
  
As a member of the Global IT Function, you as Business Analyst plays a critical role in identifying, designing, and delivering technology solutions that optimize business processes across Medical, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain functions within a medical device organization. This role bridges business strategy, data science and technology execution, ensuring technology initiatives are compliant, scalable and aligned with the company’s digital transformation roadmap and regulatory requirements Food and Drug Administration (FDA), ISO 13485, Good "X" Practice (GxP). 
  
  
This individual partners closely with cross‑functional teams to translate complex business problems into a configurable solution, define data and process requirements, support solution development, manage validation needs and measure impact.
  
  
 
  
  
 
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
 
  

* Partner with business leaders to identify high‑value improvement opportunities in areas such as regulatory affairs, patient safety, process optimization, product quality, complaint analytics and regulatory intelligence.
* Conduct feasibility assessments and prioritization of user stories.
* Stay current on emerging regulatory developments and industry best practices within regulated healthcare environments.
* Lead detailed discovery sessions to understand business workflows, data sources, constraints and pain points.
* Translate business needs into clear functional requirements for technical and vendor partners.
* Map current‑state and future‑state processes to identify automation and optimization opportunities.
* Review and analyze user requirements prior to submission and implementation; participate in validation activities as required.
* Ensure solutions comply with company Quality Management Systems (QMS) requirements, Good Automated Manufacturing Practice (GAMP 5), 21 Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) Part 11 regulations.
* Support the creation, review, and execution of validation deliverables, including Validation Plans, Risk Assessments, Risk Management Reports, Traceability Matrices, Validation Reports, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Regression Testing activities.
* Partner with QA / RA / Business teams to implement configuration and perform validation execution.
* Develop user stories, Formal Requirements, UAT scripts, test cases, test plans and training materials.
* Lead UAT cycles, gather feedback and ensure readiness for go‑live.
* Drive adoption through ongoing user engagement, training and performance monitoring.
* Understand, follow and implement appropriate Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), computer system validation, quality validation processes and application lifecycle processes including those specific to AI project lifecycles.

  
  
**What You'll Bring**
 
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics or related field.
* 6–10+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, Data Analyst or similar role.
* Experience working in a regulated Life science, medical device, pharmaceutical, or healthcare environment.
* Experience working with validation, implementation of GxP applications such as Veeva RIM, Veeva PromoMats, Patient Safety, Medical Systems.
* Strong understanding of computer system validation, computer system assurance processes, analytics workflows and system integrations.
* Ability to translate complex business needs into structured requirements and user stories.
* Excellent communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills.
* Familiarity with GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 13485 and validation principles.

title: Specialist- Expert Publication Writer
description:
Job Title: Specialist- Expert Publication Writer
  
  
Career Level: D2
  
  
**About AstraZeneca**
AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to transform sophisticated, developed evidence for publications that compose scientific understanding and responsible clinical decision-m aking? Based at Manyata Tech Park, Bengaluru, this role places you at the center of high-priority publication programmes where clarity, scientific rigor, and strategic influence directly supply to better outcomes for patients.
  
  
Do you thrive at the intersection of scientific depth, collaborator leadership, and operational excellence? As a Specialist in Publication Writing, you will set publication strategy and guide narratives using multi-study and real-world datasets. You will manage customer concerns related to the most challenging disclosures. This helps ensure outputs achieve the highest standards of ethics, visibility, and quality while increasing impact across our portfolio.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
Publication leadership: Provide end-to-end scientific and delivery leadership for sophisticated, strategically critical, or high-risk publication programmes. Resolve approaches in ambiguous scenarios, align multiple workstreams, and remain accountable for quality, risk management, and outcomes that advance our therapeutic narratives.
  
  
Scientific narrative and critical review: Lead writing and guide review for research papers and symposium content involving multi-study, pooled, indirect-comparison, epidemiological, and health-economic evidence. Resolve difficult methodological and interpretive challenges and guide teams to balanced, defensible conclusions.
  
  
Sophisticated disclosure strategy: Set the document and evidence strategy for combined data evaluations, detailed analyses, post-hoc assessments, HEOR, and epidemiology publica tions. Anticipate cross-publication dependencies and own escalation for material scientific or delivery risks.
  
  
Data interpretation and evidence assessment: Challenge assumptions, evaluate analytical choices, and advise on scientifically sound communication of efficacy, safety, real-world evidence, and health economics. Define and lead all aspects of evidence-synthesis approaches that guide publication planning and future disclosures.
  
  
Submission excellence: Direct submission and resubmission strategies for high-priority or challenging publications. Lead responses to substantive reviewer concerns, guide rejection or transfer decisions, resolve authorship issues, and navigate sophisticated editorial queries to secure the right route to publication.
  
  
Data visualization standards: Resolve visual approaches for unfamiliar or integrated datasets. Establish standards for clear, responsible figures and guide writers and design partners to innovative, high-quality visual solutions.
  
  
Compliance and publication ethics leadership: Interpret and apply Good Publication Practice, ICMJE guidance, and internal policies in sophisticated or precedent-setting situations. Act as the escalation point for authorship, disclosure, visibility, and data-integrity matters, collaborating with governance collaborators on defensible resolutions.
  
  
Collaborator influence: Serve as a trusted adviser to publication leaders, authors, investigators, external experts, and cross-functional teams. Resolve competing perspectives, influence decisions without direct authority, and build alignment across interconnected workstreams and programmes.
  
  
Capability development: Coach Publication Writers and Senior Publication Writers on sophisticated scientific and operational challenges. Identify capability gaps, design sophisticated learning interventions, and develop guidance that elevates consistency and expertise across the function.
  
  
Quality and consistency: Establish and evolve standards, review frameworks, and decision tools for sophisticated publications. Analyze recurring issues, implement systemic improvements, and provide expert oversight for high-risk deliverables.
  
  
Innovation and automation: Identify and sponsor high-value opportunities for AI, automation, and new publication approaches. Lead pilots, evaluate implications for scientific integrity and compliance, and scale successful solutions responsibly.
  
  
Therapeutic area expertise: Build deep expertise in assigned disease areas and translate knowledge into strategic advice, process improvements, and knowledge sharing that strengthens publication impact and credibility.
  
  
**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Master’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, biochemistry, biotechnology, pharmacology, public health or a related discipline.
* Six to ten years of medical or scientific writing experience, including demonstrated leadership of complex manuscripts and congress disclosures.
* Advanced understanding of clinical research methods, biostatistics, publication ethics and relevant standards, including Good Publication Practice and ICMJE guidance.
* Proven ability to interpret complex analyses and communicate scientific evidence clearly, accurately and persuasively.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation and organisational skills, with the ability to lead multiple high-priority deliverables.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, reference-management tools, publication-management platforms such as iEnvision and data-visualisation standards.
* Working knowledge of authorship criteria, data transparency and sharing requirements, journal and congress systems, and development of training content.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Advanced degree such as PharmD, PhD, MD or MPH, or a recognised qualification in medical writing or communications.
* Experience leading integrated disclosures, including pooled analyses, meta-analyses, health economics and outcomes research, and coordinating multi-author manuscripts through acceptance.
* Knowledge of one or more relevant therapeutic areas, including Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolism; Respiratory and Immunology; Vaccines; and Immune Therapies.
* Experience collaborating with investigators, external experts and multidisciplinary teams and engaging with journal editors or congress secretariats.

**Why AstraZeneca?**
At AstraZeneca, we 're dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.
  
  
When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
Also You can find alternative messaging to use in the ‘Global Talent Attraction Story messaging’ section of the Global Playbook on the Employer Brand Portal - try to use other examples in order to make it different for candidates!

Ready to lead complex publications from Bengaluru and transform integrated evidence into influential, high-quality communications that make a real difference for patients—step forward and make your mark today!

title: Lead, Engineering Talent & Learning
description:
**Purpose**
The Lead, Engineering Talent & Learning is accountable for leading the research, design, development and delivery of technically rigorous learning solutions that accelerate engineering capability and time‑to‑productivity across early careers and engineering new joiners and adjacent engineering talent pipelines as required.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role, leading through deep expertise and influence across Engineering. It sits at the intersection of engineering practice, learning design and modern developer tooling. It is expected to operate with engineering credibility — able to challenge, shape and improve solutions through technically grounded judgement.
  
  
The role exists to empower engineers to learn fast, grow their skills and build durable capability through learning experiences that are practical, technically grounded and built for adoption at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
As Lead, Engineering Talent & Learning, you will:
  
  

* Lead the research and design of learning solutions informed by business needs analysis, ensuring alignment with divisional and functional objectives.
* Lead the design, development and delivery of learning solutions, selecting the most appropriate learning modalities for technical audiences (e.g., hands‑on labs, coached practice, blended pathways).
* Translate complex technical concepts into engaging, accessible learning experiences without losing technical credibility or depth.
* Work closely with engineering leaders, internal SMEs and stakeholder groups to ensure learning reflects real engineering environments, current tech stacks and modern development practices.
* Stay current with changes across the engineering and technology landscape (cloud platforms, developer tooling, modern programming practices, AI‑enabled development) and continuously refresh learning content to keep pace with change.
* Recommend and apply modern learning technology and creative solutions to enhance learner engagement and improve the learning experience for engineers.
* Apply performance consulting approaches to diagnose capability needs and performance barriers (skills, behaviours, ways of working, enablement constraints) and translate these into clear learning problem statements.
* Map identified needs to engineering expectations (e.g., career stage expectations, engineering principles/standards, role outcomes) to prioritise what matters most.
* Define practical, measurable success signals for interventions and iterate based on evidence of application and impact.
* Monitor the effectiveness of learning initiatives and recommend remedial actions as necessary to improve outcomes.
* Identify gaps in learning evaluation standards and reporting within scope and recommend remedial actions to ensure performance and growth.
* Gather learner feedback and insights and use data to drive continuous improvement across programmes in scope.
* Assess stakeholder requirements to identify innovative learning and development solutions; issue guidance on standard practices and policy applications, ensuring follow‑through.
* Collaborate with senior stakeholders to identify existing skills, learning and development needs and skills gaps; ensure learning activities align with divisional / functional objectives.
* Contribute to global learning design and development projects (or phases of larger projects), ensuring alignment with business needs.
* Communicate difficult subject material by adapting communication style to different audiences, ensuring clarity and engagement.
* Provide performance coaching on an individual and/or team basis, as needed, to enhance learning outcomes and application in role.
* Leverage AI and automation to streamline learning design, delivery and operations, reducing manual effort and maximising time spent on high‑value work.

**Skills & Capabilities**

* Strong technical literacy and confidence engaging on engineering topics (cloud technologies and architectures, modern development stacks, developer experience / developer enablement, modern SDLC and tooling, developer‑focused AI tools and agents).
* Ability to lead credible technical conversations with engineers and technical SMEs — asking the right questions, challenging assumptions, and turning technical reality into effective learning design.
* Strong learning design capability, with a focus on learner‑centred, outcome‑driven experiences suited to technical audiences.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross‑functional collaboration; able to influence through expertise and clarity rather than formal authority.
* Strong evaluation mindset: monitors effectiveness, uses feedback loops, and recommends remedial actions to improve outcomes and adoption.
* Comfort working in ambiguous, fast‑changing environments; able to adapt quickly as priorities and technologies evolve.
* Clear communication and facilitation skills across technical and non‑technical audiences.
* Practical curiosity for applying AI to increase speed, scale and quality of learning outcomes.

**Qualifications & Experience**
To be successful in this role, you will typically have:
  
  

* Extensive experience in Learning & Development, Engineering Enablement, Technical Training, or Developer Education, ideally in engineering‑led environments where technical credibility matters.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with engineering leaders and SMEs to build learning that reflects real delivery environments and modern engineering practice.
* Experience supporting early‑career talent and/or large‑scale onboarding and ramp‑up programmes in complex organisations.
* Comfort operating in technical contexts is essential, hands‑on engineering experience would be considered an advantage.

**Career Stage:**
Manager
  
  
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

title: Application Engineer - Signal Processing & HDL
description:
**Summary**
MathWorks has a hybrid work model that enables staff members to split their time between office and home. The hybrid model provides the advantage of having both in-person time with colleagues and flexible at-home life optimizations. Learn More: https://www.mathworks.com/company/jobs/resources/applying-and-interviewing.html#onboarding.
  
  
As an Application Engineer for Signal Processing, Communications, and FPGA Design, you will partner with our most innovative customers to establish MATLAB and Simulink as a platform for a variety of application areas including:
  
  

* Prototyping and Implementing Designs on FPGAs and SDRs
* HDL (VHDL / Verilog) Code Generation and Verification

You will work in a pre-sales manner with our customers to identify and understand their technical and business challenges. You will develop and deliver compelling demonstrations of solutions that help customers appreciate how the adoption of MathWorks products adds value towards enhancing their workflows. You will also engage strategically with customers in developing long-term adoption plans that will enable them to progressively roll-out increasingly productive workflows in their organizations.
  
  
Using your technical expertise as well as your excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, you will engage customers and prospects in seminars, conference calls, meetings, and through product evaluations to develop a shared vision for success.
  
  
MathWorks nurtures growth, appreciates inclusivity, encourages initiative, values teamwork, shares success, and rewards excellence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Provide technical pre-sales support and guidance to the India sales organization, prospects, and customers in the domains of signal processing, communications, and radar system design, as well as implementing these designs on FPGAs SoCs and SDRs through automatic HDL code generation and verification techniques by:
  
  

* Preparing and delivering presentations, demonstrations, and application examples in customer meetings, seminars, and other public events
* Managing product evaluations and developing adoption plans that assist customers in adopting MathWorks products
* Partnering with Sales Account Managers to help develop account and territory level selling strategies
* Identify new trends and application areas and provide feedback to development and marketing teams. Collaborate with the worldwide team on developing compelling messages and demonstrations.
* Advocate for the future direction of MathWorks products based on customer interactions.
* Establish rapport and credibility with our customers across multiple hierarchy levels to build champion users and supporters of our solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* A bachelor's degree and 6 years of professional work experience (or a master's degree and 3 years of professional work experience, or a PhD degree, or equivalent experience) is required.

**Additional Qualifications**

* Post-graduate degree in Engineering (M.E./M.Tech./Ph.D)
* 3-7 years of relevant industry experience preferably in the Communications, Electronics, Semiconductors, or Aerospace/Defence (Avionics) industries.
* Strong knowledge and experience in modeling and simulating signal processing and/or communications and/or radar systems using MATLAB and Simulink.
* Strong knowledge and experience in digital hardware design and implementation of signal processing/communications/radar algorithms on FPGAs. Strong knowledge of either VHDL or Verilog.
* Experience in using EDA tools for hardware design (Xilinx Vivado, System Generator, etc).
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Highly motivated toward working directly with customers
* This position is based in Bangalore with travel generally throughout India for various customer visits and seminars. Travel time can be expected to amount to approximately 30-40% with trips generally no longer than five days. Though far less frequent, some international travel is expected.

title: Analyst- Publication coordinator/iEnvision Specialist
description:
**Title: Analyst- Publication coordinator/iEnvision Specialist**
**Career Level: C3**
**About AstraZeneca**
AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to turn operational perfection into faster, compliant scientific publications that inform clinical decision-making? As an i Envision Specialist, you will orchestrate the end-to-end publication lifecycle, connecting Global Scientific Communications and cross-functional partners to deliver timely, high-quality outputs for the BioPharmaceuticals Business Unit.
  
  
Based in Manyata Tech Park, Bengaluru, you will be part of a Centre of Excellence that uses iEnvision to make sophisticated work simple, transparent, and compliant. Your ability to anticipate risks, structure plans, and elevate data quality will help our teams communicate evidence with transparency and speed—so insights reach healthcare professionals and patients when they matter most.
  
  
Do you see patterns in processes others miss, and enjoy shaping systems so teams can move faster with confidence? This role puts you at the heart of how we plan, govern, and deliver publications across a global, multicultural environment in a hybrid model with three days on site each week.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
Publication Lifecycle Management: Coordinate the planning, tracking and delivery of assigned publication activities across all phases to accelerate high-quality outputs and improve predictability.
  
  
Collaborator Communication: Support publication writers and delivery leads in communicating with internal and external collaborators so decisions and achievements progress on time.
  
  
Scheduling and Risk Management: Maintain accurate schedules, milestones, dependencies and status updates; escalate potential delays where appropriate; identify, track and support the mitigation of project issues and risks early.
  
  
Compliance and Standards: Help ensure that publication work follow AstraZeneca procedures, quality standards, ethical requirements and relevant external publication guidelines, protecting trust and enabling approvals.
  
  
iEnvision Leadership: Promote consistent and effective use of iEnvision as the end-to-end solution for publication oversight; maintain high-quality, complete and accurate records and metadata.
  
  
Access and Protection Management: Lead all aspects of user access and security, including crafting and disabling user accounts and handling access-related requests to protect data.
  
  
Release Readiness and UAT: Support validation by end users and business readiness for system upgrades, releases, implementations and system improvements to minimize disruption and unlock new capabilities.
  
  
Training and User Support: Coordinate and maintain system training records and materials; support users with process and system queries to build confident adoption.
  
  
Data Quality and Ongoing Improvement: Conduct routine data-quality reviews and clean database regularly. Find ways to improve publication operations and system use. Encourage adoption of effective methods.
  
  
Global Collaboration: Collaborate across global, matrixed and multicultural teams to support consistent ways of working and continuous improvement, expanding impact from individual projects to enterprise-wide performance.
  
  
**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in any discipline.
* Three to five years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry or a medical communications agency, preferably within a publications function.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience using and supporting iEnvision or a comparable publication management system.
* Highly organized and detail oriented
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* Experience working effectively in a global, matrixed and multicultural pharmaceutical or medical communications environment.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgement and a commitment to data quality, compliance and operational excellence.
* Agility, adaptability and a proactive learning mindset.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience administering iEnvision user access, security, training records and data-quality activities.
* Experience supporting user acceptance testing, system releases, implementations or enhancements.
* Knowledge of recognised ethical publication practices and relevant industry guidelines.

**Why AstraZeneca?**
At AstraZeneca, we 're dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.
  
  
When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help build a better working world.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centres. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service focuses on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery, and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a skilled Senior Regulatory Reporting Professional to support the delivery of technology-enabled regulatory reporting services for digital asset clients. The role focuses on end-to-end report production, data validation, reconciliations, controls, issue management, and regulatory change across U.S. and global reporting obligations. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with clients, onshore teams, technology teams, and operations stakeholders to strengthen reporting accuracy, improve governance, support automation, and build scalable processes aligned with evolving products, entities, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Regulatory Production & Submissions: Lead regulatory reporting workstreams, including end-to-end preparation, review, and timely submission of U.S. and global filings such as MTL reporting, transaction reporting, financial condition reporting, and capital calculations.

title: Validation and Compliance Engineer
description:
Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid-flow technology, with over 1,400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.

As part of our team, you'll be immersed in an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Here, you'll have the opportunity to push boundaries, tackle exciting challenges, and develop cutting-edge solutions that promote energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact. Every day offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution to a more sustainable future, driving innovations that help lower global carbon footprints. Together, we’re creating a legacy that goes beyond business—one that’s changing the world for the better.

In this role, you are responsible for ensuring Armstrong products meet regulatory standards globally and helping to move products through the regulatory process.

In addition to annual initiatives, the key accountabilities of this position are:

**Key Responsibilities**

**Ensure Regulatory Compliance and Audit Readiness**

* Monitor regional and international regulatory standards (e.g., BIS, CE, SABRE, GSO, SASO, MOHAP, GOEIC, CPSO) relevant to value streams such as HVAC, plumbing, and fire protection and works with product development to ensure products comply with relevant standards, including submitting products for approval when required.
* Interpret evolving compliance requirements and communicate changes to product teams and leadership.
* Develop and implement regulatory compliance strategies and procedures throughout the product lifecycle.
* Collaborate with offering managers, QA, and manufacturing teams to ensure alignment with mandatory and customer-driven compliance requirements.
* Analyze and improve compliance workflows, identifying gaps and driving corrective actions.
* Maintain organized documentation of validation reports, DFMEAs, certifications, and compliance records to ensure audit readiness.
* Support and lead internal audits; assist during external audits and inspections led by regulatory authorities.
* Serve as an internal auditor when required, leveraging expertise to support broader compliance assessments across the organization

**Lead Product Risk Assessments and Develop Design Validation Plans**

* Facilitate and update Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA) to identify, assess, and mitigate risks across mechanical, electrical, and control systems.
* Ensure alignment of DFMEAs with current product designs and maintain traceability of risk mitigation measures throughout product lifecycle.
* Conduct risk workshops, train teams on hazard/risk analysis and FMEA methodologies, and foster a culture of proactive risk management.
* Integrate DFMEA outputs into design validation and product certification strategies.
* Create and support comprehensive Design Validation Plans (DVPs) based on DFMEA and regulatory requirements to verify product functionality, reliability, and compliance.
* Collaborate with engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing teams to define test methods, develop test procedures, and coordinate testing activities.
* Manage relationships with external test laboratories when specialized testing is required beyond in-house capabilities.
* Analyze validation results, drive root cause analysis for failures, and coordinate design or process improvements.

**Manage Product Certification Processes**

* Lead the end-to-end certification process for products, including preparation and submission of technical documentation, test samples, and justifications to third-party certification bodies (UL, NSF, CE, etc.).
* Estimate and communicate certification costs (initial and recurring), assess feasibility, and support offering managers in budget and ROI discussions.
* Ensure timely availability of safety and regulatory certifications aligned with key project milestones.
* Maintain certification and compliance records, prepare Declarations of Conformance, and oversee certification renewals and updates due to revised standards.

**Collaborate Cross-Functionally and Integrate Projects**

* Actively participate in PI Planning, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and other cross-functional meetings to integrate regulatory and validation activities into project plans.
* Serve as the key liaison between offering managers, project technical leads, design engineers, and validation teams to ensure regulatory considerations are embedded in product development timelines.
* Coordinate resource allocation and prioritization of regulatory and validation tasks across multiple concurrent projects.
* Facilitate compliance plan reviews, safety design reviews, and regular status updates to stakeholders.

**Train Teams and Drive Continuous Improvement**

* Provide training and mentorship on regulatory compliance, hazard/risk analysis, FMEA, and validation processes to engineering, QA, and manufacturing teams.
* Develop and maintain compliance manuals, procedural documents, training materials, and FAQs for consistent regulatory knowledge sharing.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by researching and implementing best practices in compliance, validation, and certification management.
* Encourage innovation in testing, validation, and certification approaches to improve efficiency and reduce time to market.

**What We’re Looking For**

**To thrive in this role, you should bring:**

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or related Engineering fields.
* 3–5 years of experience in validation and compliance engineering, preferably in a manufacturing or product development environment.
* Proven experience with product certification processes and working alongside regulatory bodies or test labs (e.g., CSA, UL, ULC).
* Exposure to national and international regulatory frameworks; experience interpreting technical codes and developing test strategies.
* HVAC or building services industry experience is considered an asset.
* Experience conducting internal audits and assessments of new products against safety, environmental, and compliance standards.
* Experience working within agile development teams and cross-functional engineering environments
  **.**

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of compliance engineering, safety standards, and product validation methodology.
* Familiarity with ISO, ANSI, IEC, and industry-specific compliance frameworks.
* Proficient in FMEA, root cause analysis (RCA), and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) processes.
* Working knowledge of lean principles, process mapping, and value analysis/value engineering (VA/VE).
* Familiarity with CIBSE (Chartered Institute of Building Service Engineers) standards, specifically applicable to the UK market.
* Skilled in hypothesis testing, data analysis, and statistical test design for validation.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and Bills of Materials (BOMs).
* Hands-on involvement with validation plans, protocols, and documentation (e.g., IQ/OQ/PQ, DFMEA, PFMEA).
* Familiarity with ISO 17025 (testing and calibration competence), ISO 14001, ISO 9001, and ISO 45001 (facility standards).

**About the Role:**
We are seeking a highly capable Level 2 Information Security professional who effectively bridges the gap between hands-on technical operations and governance. This role demands a unique combination of technical expertise across endpoint, network, and email security systems, paired with a Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) mindset.
  
  
Beyond managing technical controls, the ideal candidate must be an exceptional communicator capable of collaborating across diverse internal teams, managing security risk exceptions, and meticulously tracking open compliance and remediation items to closure.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain security baselines and configuration checklists for Windows/macOS endpoints, corporate networks, firewalls, Microsoft 365, email security, and Data Loss Prevention (DLP).
* Work with respective technical teams to perform periodic security assessments, identify gaps, and track remediation.
* Perform or support vulnerability assessments and penetration testing, including validation of findings and remediation.
* Prepare and maintain security assessment reports, technical documentation, SOPs, and compliance evidence.
* Support internal and external audits by coordinating with Audit, Compliance, and technical teams.
* Track security findings, vulnerabilities, and audit observations to ensure closure within agreed timelines.
* Communicate identified security gaps and recommended remediation actions to relevant stakeholders.

**Skills:**
Hands-on experience in at least one security domain, with a good understanding of other enterprise IT security domains.
  
  

* Microsoft Security: Understanding of Microsoft 365 security, Intune, Microsoft Defender, and identity access controls.
* Networking: Understanding of LAN, WLAN, WAN, firewalls, network security, and secure configurations.
* Email Security: Understanding of email routing, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and anti-phishing controls.
* Operating Systems: Good understanding of Windows, Linux, and macOS security and hardening.
* Scripting: Basic scripting knowledge in Python, PowerShell, or Bash/Shell for automation and log analysis.
* Security Assessments: Understanding of vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, endpoint security, and Identity and Access Management (IAM).
* Security Frameworks: Familiarity with CIS Benchmarks, NIST, PCI DSS, and SOC 1/SOC 2 requirements.
* Documentation: Ability to prepare security checklists, assessment reports, SOPs, and audit evidence.

**Experience and Qualifications:**

* 3 to 5 years of experience in Information Security, Risk & Compliance, Endpoint Security, Network Security or Technical GRC role.
* Bachelor of Technology (BE/B.Tech) in Computer Science or equivalent
* Certifications (At least one of the following or equivalent is required):
* Identity & Cloud Security: Microsoft Certified Associate (SC-200, SC-300, or SC-900).
* Security Fundamentals: ISC² CC (Certified in Cybersecurity), CompTIA Security+ or CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker).
* Network Security: CCNA (Cisco), Certified Security Associate (Cisco/Check Point), NSE 4 (Fortinet), or JNCIA (Juniper).

title: Founder's Office, Marketing Associate
description:
**About Origin**
Origin is building general-purpose autonomous robots for US construction to tackle rising costs, safety risks, and labour shortages. Our modular, multi-trade platform combines purpose-built hardware with real-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 3x faster execution, 250%+ margin expansion, and significant cost savings. Join World's most talent-dense robotics team consisting of individuals from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, etc.
  
  
**About The Role**
Origin builds one general-purpose robot, OG-1, that performs interior-finishing trades: compound application, sanding, priming and painting, with more workflows coming. The buyer has been sold construction robotics before and it did not work. Our marketing wins on proof from real sites, not renders.
  
  
You will work directly with the Founders to turn what OG-1 does on live sites into stories, content and conversations that reach contractors, partners, press and investors. You'll own execution end to end: capture the footage, write the case study, ship the founder post, build the company brand on social platforms, staff the booth during the events and log the lead. This is a hands-on role with a visible scorecard, built for someone who wants to grow into owning a marketing function.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Proof and content from the field
* Work with Deployment to capture footage, photos, data and operator quotes from live sites every month
* Turn them into case studies, short videos, ROI one-pagers and before/after comparisons that Sales can use the same week
* Ensure all product claims and marketing communications are supported by real-world deployment data, customer experiences and evidence from live sites, using renders primarily to explain the product and its capabilities.
* Founder voice and employee content
* Run the publishing cadence for three co-founders with distinct territories: company thesis, autonomy and physical AI, and hardware reality. Draft, edit and schedule without flattening them into one house tone
* Run the employee-content programme for deployment and engineering: prompt packs, capture kits and a simple approval flow
* Events and showcases
* Track trade shows, demo days, awards and speaking slots across India, the US, Europe and APAC against a deadline calendar
* Draft abstracts, nominations and event briefs; run logistics, collateral, demo plan and lead capture for each appearance
* Score every paid appearance against cost within 30 days of the event
* Website, demand and data
* Keep the website and OG-1 pages current; write explainers that answer what contractors actually ask, structured for search and AI answer engines
* Run CRM hygiene, UTM tracking and source capture; report qualified conversations by channel each month
* Route inbound enquiries to Sales quickly, with source, segment and region recorded
* Brand consistency and sales enablement
* Keep one approved boilerplate, product description and terminology live across the web, decks, job posts and investor material
* Maintain the sales kit: pitch deck, RaaS ROI material, case studies, objection library and competitor comparisons
* Brief and coordinate the Creative Content Producer, agencies and freelancers against the release calendar
* Public Relations and media communications
* Develop and execute PR strategies to strengthen Origin's brand visibility, industry positioning and credibility across relevant markets
* Build relationships with journalists, media publications and relevant technology, robotics and business platforms to drive media coverage, interviews and feature stories
* Draft and manage press releases, media pitches, company announcements, founder narratives and spokesperson briefs
* Identify PR opportunities and track media coverage, mentions and campaign outcomes to measure brand visibility and impact

**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* 2-4 years in B2B marketing, content, growth, consulting or a founder's office role at a startup
* Strong writing: a case study, a cold email and a founder post in the same day, each in the right voice
* Can learn a technical, physical product well enough to explain it to a general contractor without an engineer in the room
* Comfortable with a CRM, LinkedIn, Canva/Figma, basic video editing and web analytics
* Comfortable around engineers, robots, workshops and live construction sites; willing to travel domestically and internationally
* High ownership and pace: ships weekly, closes loops, and measures work by pipeline, not likes

**Preferred Experience**

* Marketing a physical or technical product in robotics, hardware, construction tech, industrial automation or deep tech
* Experience with B2B buyers who decide by committee over long sales cycles
* Experience producing video or site content, or running event and field marketing
* Exposure to US or international markets and localizing messaging
* An engineering degree, or real interest in how robots and construction work

**Application Requirement**
Applicants must share 2-3 pieces of their own work: a case study, a campaign with its results, a founder or brand post they wrote, or a piece of sales material. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to turn raw site footage and notes from an OG-1 deployment into a case study and a LinkedIn post.
  
  
**What You'll Gain**

* Direct work with three founders, the robots and live deployments in the US
* Hands-on experience across positioning, content, events and demand generation in one role
* International scope from day one across India, the US, Europe, Middle-East and APAC
* A path to owning a marketing function as Origin scales

title: Manufacturing Engineer - Engine Design
description:
**Career Area**
Manufacturing
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Caterpillar Inc is the world’s leading manufacturer of off-highway machinery and diesel and natural gas engines. The Caterpillar brand is recognised worldwide and is synonymous with quality and reliability.
  
  
The Industrial Power Systems Division currently has a new and exciting opportunity for a Manufacturing Engineer. This position works both independently and as part of a team to maintain and improve processes and systems used in manufacturing. In addition, Manufacturing Engineers function as a specialist and subject matter expert for technical planning throughout a manufacturing facility. As Manufacturing Engineer, you will have an opportunity to provide the technical expertise necessary to design, develop, and implement manufacturing systems, manufacturing operations and state of the art machines.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes by leveraging advanced technologies, AI-enabled solutions, digital dashboards, and lean manufacturing principles. The role focuses on improving safety, quality, productivity, and cost efficiency through data-driven decision making, low-cost automation, and smart manufacturing initiatives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Assist in developing, implementing, and improving manufacturing processes for engine assembly, testing, paint, and related operations.
* Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and Concurrent Process and Product Development (CPPD) activities.
* Participate in process validation, manufacturing readiness reviews, and production launch activities.
* Develop and update assembly procedures, process flows, work instructions, BOMs, PFMEAs, and standard work documentation.
* Support implementation of AI-based manufacturing solutions for safety, quality, and productivity improvement.
* Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and digital visual management tools for manufacturing performance monitoring.
* Analyze manufacturing data to identify trends, bottlenecks, quality issues, and improvement opportunities.
* Support MES, SAP, and shop-floor device integration initiatives to improve process traceability and operational visibility.
* Participate in Industry 4.0 and digital transformation projects involving IoT, smart devices, and connected manufacturing systems.
* Contribute to safety improvement initiatives through risk assessments, ergonomic studies, and implementation of safety controls.
* Support deployment of digital safety technologies such as vision systems, interlocks, and process monitoring solutions.
* Design and develop assembly fixtures, jigs, gauges, work-holding devices, poka-yoke solutions, and ergonomic tooling to support safe and efficient manufacturing operations.
* Participate in prototype development, validation, and implementation of assembly tooling and fixtures.
* Work closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders to procure, manufacture, install, and commission tooling solutions.
* Ensure tooling designs comply with safety, ergonomics, quality, and Caterpillar manufacturing standards.
* Participate in root cause analysis and corrective action activities to improve safety, quality, and process reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement and waste reduction initiatives using Lean Manufacturing principles.
* Assist in the design, procurement, installation, and commissioning of tooling, fixtures, gauges, and manufacturing equipment.
* Support implementation of low-cost automation and mistake-proofing (Poka-Yoke) solutions.
* Contribute to evaluation of new technologies and preparation of business cases for process improvements.
* Monitor equipment performance and support troubleshooting activities.
* Support factory layout modifications and workstation improvements to enhance safety, productivity, and material flow.
* Assist in capacity analysis, line balancing, and space optimization initiatives.
* Participate in manufacturing process improvement projects aimed at reducing cycle time and improving efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering.
* 4 to 6 years of manufacturing engineering or production engineering experience.
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes, assembly operations, and industrial engineering principles.
* Experience with CAD tools such as CREO and AutoCAD.
* Exposure to Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement methodologies.
* Knowledge of data analysis, root cause analysis, and problem-solving techniques.
* Familiarity with SAP ERP, MES, or manufacturing information systems.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and Power BI.
* Strong communication, teamwork, and stakeholder engagement skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to AI-based manufacturing applications, machine vision systems, or digital manufacturing technologies.
* Experience with IoT, Industry 4.0, automation, robotics, or smart factory initiatives.
* Understanding of engine assembly, testing, leak testing, or torque-controlled assembly processes.
* Exposure to APQP, PFMEA, and manufacturing process validation activities.
* Knowledge of low-cost automation and productivity improvement projects.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Process Engineering
* Digital Manufacturing
* Tooling & Fixture design
* AI & Industry 4.0
* Safety First Mindset
* Power BI & Dashboards
* Data Analytics
* Lean Manufacturing
* Continuous Improvement
* Problem Solving
* Low-Cost Automation
* Manufacturing Systems (MES/SAP)
* NPI & Process Validation

**Additional information:**
This job requires 5 working days from office.

It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties and effort required of employees assigned to this job. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of the organization. This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  
  
Relocation is available for this position.

November 5, 2026 - November 19, 2026

title: Technical Writer & Editor (AEO)
description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

AI coding is transforming how software is built, but it is also creating new security challenges. As developers increasingly rely on AI coding agents, securing code, open-source dependencies, and software supply chains has become more critical than ever.

Endor Labs is building the next generation of application security solutions to help organizations secure software across the development lifecycle. Our platform combines deep code intelligence with advanced security capabilities to help teams identify exploitable vulnerabilities, prioritize risks, and fix issues without disrupting development.

As AI continues to change how developers discover information and solve technical challenges, the way organizations build their online presence is evolving too. We believe the next generation of technical content needs to be optimized not just for traditional search engines, but also for AI-powered answer engines.

At Endor Labs, we're looking for people who are excited to solve complex problems, move fast, and help shape the future of software security. Join us in building a world where software can be trusted.

**How You'll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------

* Execute Endor Labs' Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) strategy by building and maintaining a consistent pipeline of high-quality technical content.
* Create how-to guides, integration walkthroughs, technical explainers, FAQs, glossaries, and comparison pages across application security, AI code security, software supply chain security, and DevOps.
* Develop content covering technical topics such as CI/CD, Kubernetes, containers, infrastructure-as-code, and AI coding agents.
* Apply AEO best practices across all content, including answer-first writing, question-led headings, concise explanations, structured tables, lists, schema markup, and semantic HTML.
* Refresh and optimize existing blogs, documentation, and website content to improve visibility and relevance across AI-powered answer engines and traditional search.
* Build repeatable content workflows, templates, and briefs using AI writing tools to improve content production and scale output without compromising quality.
* Validate technical content by testing code snippets, configuration examples, and CLI commands, and verifying technical claims with product documentation and engineering teams.
* Collaborate with Product Marketing, Engineering, and Digital teams to ensure technical accuracy, consistency, and alignment with content priorities.
* Own the editorial quality of content produced by internal teams, freelancers, and AI tools, ensuring clarity, accuracy, consistent terminology, and AEO readiness.
* Track content output, publishing timelines, and AI visibility metrics, including citation share and answer accuracy for target prompts.
* Share insights and performance learnings with the marketing team to continuously improve the AEO strategy and content approach.

**What You Bring to the Table**
-------------------------------

If you enjoy working at the intersection of technical content, developer education, and AI-powered search, and the requirements below match your background, we'd love to hear from you!

* 5+ years of experience in technical writing and editing, preferably for developer, DevOps, application security, or infrastructure audiences.
* Strong understanding of DevOps concepts and hands-on familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containers, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Ability to build and test sample CI/CD pipelines to validate technical workflows and examples before publishing.
* Comfortable working with command-line tools, APIs, YAML, JSON, and reading at least one programming language such as Python, Go, Java, or JavaScript.
* Strong understanding of technical documentation practices and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, structured, and accessible content.
* Familiarity with SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) principles, including content structuring for AI-powered search and answer engines.
* Experience using AI writing tools to improve content creation workflows, scale production, and maintain editorial consistency.
* Excellent editing and proofreading skills, with a strong eye for technical accuracy, clarity, consistency, and detail.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple content priorities, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Why Endor Labs**
------------------

We're building at the intersection of developer productivity and security — one of the fastest-growing spaces in software. Our dev-loved platform has real ROI, strong momentum, and customers who care about doing things right.

At Endor Labs, we think big, start small, and learn fast. We take ownership, move with purpose, and always start with the customer’s success. We debate with data, make the complex simple, and challenge each other with kindness and candor. We celebrate wins, learn from misses, and have fun along the way — because when our customers win, we all win.

**Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if you don't fit every requirement above, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and experiences, so we encourage all talented individuals to apply—there's no one-size-fits-all here.

title: DE-Manager-Java

* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 500 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. title: Content Curator
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The KLA Services team consists of Service Sales, Marketing, Spares Supply Chain Management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, Digital Solutions and Analytics, and Technical Product Support. Our services organization maximizes the value of our customers' KLA assets – with highly trained service and product support engineers providing installation services and 24/7 technical support and parts delivery through our extensive supply chain network.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Curate and govern knowledge assets
  
  

* Manage priority content through creation, review, publication, maintenance, republishing, and archival.
* Apply approved information models, templates, metadata standards, style guidance, and lifecycle controls.
* Conduct content audits and coordinate remediation with authors, reviewers, and content owners.

Improve findability and reuse
  
  

* Classify and connect content using consistent metadata, taxonomy, relationships, and navigation patterns.
* Identify reuse opportunities across products, subsystems, libraries, and divisions.
* Find duplicate or near-duplicate content and support consolidation, rationalization, and modularization.

Enable AI-ready content
  
  

* Validate structure, context, terminology, metadata, source quality, and traceability for machine consumption.
* Prepare governed content for search, knowledge retrieval, AI assistants, bots, and other delivery experiences.
* Apply human-in-the-loop review and escalation practices to protect accuracy and trust.

Use insights to improve the ecosystem
  
  

* Monitor content health, reuse, metadata, quality, and discoverability indicators.
* Turn findings into practical recommendations for content architecture, standards, workflows, and enablement.
* Partner with Technical Writers, Information Architects, Knowledge Engineers, Content Ontologists, Engineering, and Product teams.

**Qualifications**




+ Professional experience in Technical Publications, Information Architecture, Content Strategy, Knowledge Management, or a related discipline.
+ Demonstrated experience with structured content, metadata, enterprise content platforms, or content governance.
+ Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
+ Preferred: Experience with DITA/XML, IXIASOFT or another CCMS, Fluid Topics or a comparable delivery platform, taxonomy or ontology concepts, content analytics, or AI-assisted content workflows.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Information Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Knowledge Management, or a related field.
* 15+ years of experience in Information Architecture, Content Strategy, Technical Documentation, or Knowledge Management.

* Strong knowledge of structured authoring, XML/DITA, content reuse, and content governance.
* Experience with CCMS platforms, metadata-driven publishing, and digital content delivery solutions.
* Strong analytical skills with experience defining content metrics, KPIs, and governance dashboards.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and influencing skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable content and information architecture solutions.
* Experience leading cross-functional content, process, and technology transformation initiatives.

**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

title: Associate, AI Solutions & Implementation
description:
Fieldproxy (YC W22) builds the operating system for field service companies: HVAC, electrical, plumbing, facilities and installation businesses in the US, UK, Australia and New Zealand. Most of them still run on spreadsheets, WhatsApp and software from 2005. We rebuild how they work, using AI.

This role sits between the customer and the product. You'll talk to owners and operations heads, understand how their business really runs day to day, and redesign it: what should be automated, what an AI agent should handle, what the office and the technicians should see. Then you build it on Fieldproxy with our team and take it live.

What you'll do

• Run discovery calls with business owners and operations leaders in the US, UK and ANZ, and turn what they say into a clear plan

• Map their current tools and workflows, and find where time and money are lost

• Design the new workflow: screens, automations and AI agents, and configure it on our platform

• Move their data from old systems and spreadsheets, and make sure the numbers match

• Demo the solution, train their team and stay with them until it's working

Who we're looking for

• 1–4 years of work experience, ideally in consulting, business analysis, implementation or operations

• An MBA or a postgraduate management degree is a strong plus

• You think in terms of how a business makes money and where it leaks

• Comfortable with data: Excel, basic SQL, or willing to pick it up fast

• You already use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or similar) in your own work

• Clear spoken and written English; comfortable leading a call with a business owner

• Able to take some early-morning or evening calls for US and ANZ time zones

• Based in Chennai or willing to move; this role is on-site

Why join

• Work directly with the founders and with customers from day one

• Real ownership: you'll own customer projects end to end

• See how dozens of businesses run, and help rebuild them for the AI era

title: QRM- Confidentiality & Privacy - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**CMAT**
CMAT, a key Strategic Enabler in our new model, is comprised of professionals with various areas of focus that collectively provide mission critical services to support Deloitte’s overall success. Whether focused on project financials, quality and risk management, methods and tools, sales excellence, talent, leadership support, or other activities these professionals ensure that our Firm operates efficiently, and our people are able to effectively serve clients every day.
  
  
**Level:**
Senior Consultant
  
  
**Work you'll do**
Key job responsibilities include:
  
  

* Provide review and summary assessments based on key contractual documents (e.g., Master Services Agreement (MSA), Statement of Work, Amendment, Engagement Letter, Change Order, etc.)
* Review proposals and provide recommendations for terms that provide additional protections for data access, storage, and transfer
* Deployment of Confidential Information Management Plans (CIMPs) across accounts and engagements to all industries, Operating Portfolios, Products, and Acquisitions
* Prepare MSA summary, CIMP recommendations, and CI/CIMP training documentation
* Support the development and update of General Guidance, Market Offering Playbooks, and Account/Engagement CIMPs, as required
* Identify key contractual terms and requirements, including obligations and deliverables, related to CI terms
* Conduct Insider Risk investigations, evaluate risk indicators, analyze evidence, and drive timely resolution of cases in accordance with organizational policies and procedures
* Perform Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) reviews and assess associated risks
* Conduct privacy verification activities to evaluate requests, validate compliance requirements, and ensure adherence to data protection and privacy policies
* Facilitate live CIMP training sessions for practitioners and stakeholders, providing guidance on processes, controls, and compliance requirements
* Develop and maintain training materials, e-learning content, job aids, and awareness resources to support learning and adoption of risk and compliance programs
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance processes, deliver training initiatives, and promote a culture of risk awareness and regulatory compliance
* Deliver CI Program and provide customized CI training to account or engagement teams as required
* Follow up with accounts/engagement data managers on tracking CIMP development and fulfillment progress
* Attend calls with C&P Risk Managers identifying projects to be included in the CI Program
* Assist with C&P website updates, manage team mailbox responses, and develop reports and dashboards to showcase effective monitoring

**The team**
The mission of Quality and Risk Management (QRM) is to manage the risk in our growing and increasingly complex business to improve financial performance and protect the firm’s assets and reputation. The mission of the Consulting Services Office of Confidentiality & Privacy (C&P) within QRM is charged to protect the informational assets of Deloitte and our clients.
  
  
The Consulting Services Office of Confidentiality and Privacy (C&P) is responsible for managing confidential information risk by working directly with delivery leadership and personnel to ensure data security throughout the delivery data lifecycle. The C&P team is responsible for helping to expand the Confidential Information (CI) risk management capabilities across all Deloitte industries in Consulting Services. The Senior Consultant will support the deployment of the CI Program to Industry Accounts and Engagements, working with Consulting Services Risk Managers (RM) to identify CI contractual risks and perform CI risk assessments, including recommendations on risk mitigation strategies and protocols through the deployment of the Confidential Information Management Plan (CIMP). The C&P team is responsible for the mitigation of incidents and the investigation of Insider Risk Program (IRP) cases where professionals have been identified for exfiltrating Deloitte and client sensitive confidential information.
  
  
Location: Hyderabad/ Bengaluru/ Pune/ Chennai
  
  
Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree
* Experience: 10+ years of general contract interpretation and project management experience
* Deep understanding of risks associated with the delivery of professional consulting services and an ability to identify specific approaches to ameliorating such risks
* Basic understanding of cloud and AI applications, tools, methodologies, and software development process
* General understanding of contracts and ability to provide interpretation of contract terms
* Strong analytical, reading, and presentation skills
* Proven track record influencing diverse stakeholders and driving common outcomes with a strong understanding of commercial contracting processes, including terms and conditions
* Excellent leadership skills, including ability to prioritize critical needs, act decisively, and handle a high volume of complex tasks within a given timeframe
* Strong relationship and project management skills
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills
* Proficiency in the use of MS Office - Word, Excel (Formula/Pivot), PowerPoint, Teams and SharePoint
* Ability to build reports and dashboards for leadership review
* Willingness to learn new technical skills such as Smartsheet, Deloitte approved AI tools, and others as identified by project leaders
* Precision and attention to detail with a relentless focus on persistent and timely follow-up
* Accessibility / availability to respond to an unpredictable environment
* Highly collaborative work ethic; committed to team success
* Ability to multi-task across various initiatives and activities and at times work independently
* Work with, manage, and accommodate colleagues in other time zones; flexibility to be on call for urgent matters
* Quick learner, eager to learn new skills and technologies and apply them quickly to produce results

Preferred:
  
  

* Masters’ Degree or data privacy certifications
* Understanding of the different types of sensitive data (PII, PHI, etc.), the associated risk profile of handling each type of data, and the appropriate risk mitigation strategies to be deployed
* Ability to evaluate risks associated with large professional service engagements
* Able to showcase expertise in using any productivity tools (includes AI)

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. title: Technical Consultant - ERP
description:
**Job Description**
The
**Technical Consultant - ERP**
is responsible for the analysis, design, configuration, implementation, and ongoing support of the company’s on-premise SAP HR/Payroll environment. This role will serve as a subject matter expert for SAP HR/Payroll configuration and processing. This role will collaborate with business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and other technology partners to define solutions that meet business requirements and organizational objectives.
  
  
The SAP HR/Payroll Architect will also provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to other team members while ensuring solutions are aligned with established development, change management, security, and support processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implement and/or support on-premise SAP HR/Payroll ECC 6 EHP8 in a manufacturing environment.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for SAP Payroll with experience in Personnel Administration, Organizational Management, and Benefits configuration.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective SAP HR/Payroll designs and configuration solutions.
* Develop alternative solutions, evaluate options, and present recommendations to business stakeholders and IT management.
* Configure, test, implement, and support SAP HR/Payroll changes within a formal System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and change management methodology.
* Provide ongoing production support, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex SAP HR/Payroll issues.
* Implement, maintain, support, and troubleshoot the Rsite Tax Engine , including coordination with Rimini Street and the application, testing, and validation of tax updates and releases.
* Manage the impact of Rsite Tax Engine updates on SAP Payroll, including payroll configuration, tax calculations, testing, regression testing, and production implementation.
* Partner with Rimini Street and other vendors to investigate and resolve tax engine, payroll, and integration-related issues.
* Support payroll tax compliance activities by ensuring applicable federal, state, and local tax updates are appropriately tested and implemented in the Rsite Tax Engine/SAP Payroll environment.
* Understand and manage integration touchpoints between SAP HR/Payroll, Rsite Tax Engine, SuccessFactors, Kronos Workforce Management, and other downstream or upstream applications.
* Implement and support SaaS solutions and their integrations with SAP HR/Payroll.
* Manage, prioritize, and complete support requests for a large and complex organization.
* Estimate and plan work effort for projects, enhancements, upgrades, tax updates, and production support activities.
* Independently perform technical, configuration, testing, documentation, and process-related activities.
* Develop and maintain appropriate system documentation, configuration documentation, test scripts, and support procedures.
* Work collaboratively across HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and external vendor teams with a focus on overall business success.
* Build strong relationships and trust with business users, IT stakeholders, vendors, and management.
* Provide knowledge transfer and training to team members and end users as appropriate.
* Effectively manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced, and constantly changing environment.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5–8 years of hands-on SAP HR/Payroll experience, including configuration and production support.
* Strong technical and functional knowledge of SAP HR/Payroll ECC 6.
* Strong experience with SAP Payroll including experience with Personnel Administration, , Benefits configuration, and Financial Postings.
* Demonstrated experience supporting payroll tax processing and tax-related configuration.
* Hands-on experience with Rimini Street Rsite Tax Engine, including implementation, configuration/support, testing, and application of tax updates. Other tax engine experience will be considered.
* Experience working with Rimini Street and coordinating the implementation and testing of vendor-provided tax and payroll updates is a plus.
* Understanding of integrations between SAP HR/Payroll and external HR, payroll, tax, and other applications.
* Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Experience working within a formal SDLC/change management process, including requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, implementation, and documentation.
* Ability to communicate effectively with end users, IT staff, business stakeholders, and management.
* Excellent communication, documentation, collaboration, and knowledge-transfer skills.
* Proactive self-starter with the ability to learn new technologies and business processes and utilize available resources effectively.
* Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a complex, fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**
