title: Graduate Aerostructures Engineer
description:
**Overview**

This role covers the aerodynamic and structural design, analysis and validation of unmanned aircraft, including aerodynamic assessment, load definition, composite airframe design and structural testing. The engineer works closely with the founders and other engineering disciplines, combining analytical work with hands-on development and testing.

**Core Responsibilities**

1. Carry out aerodynamic analysis of airframes using panel and vortex-lattice methods (XFLR5/Flow5, OpenVSP) and CFD, derive aerodynamic loads for structural design, and prepare clean outer-surface CAD for the analysis.
2. Design composite airframe structures, including material selection, laminate and lay-up design, composite tailoring, and primary structures such as spars, ribs, frames and bulkheads, together with joints and inserts.
3. Perform analytical calculations, including classical laminate theory, and FEA for composite structures, covering strength, buckling, vibration (including modal analysis), fatigue and impact.
4. Support composite manufacturing partners in the review of moulds and tooling, define coupon tests, prepare ply templates, and check manufactured parts against the design.
5. Plan structural tests, including load cases, fixtures and instrumentation, and correlate test results with analysis.
6. Support aircraft assembly, ground and flight testing; analyse flight logs with the flight software engineer to assess aerodynamic and structural behaviour, and document designs, tests and decisions.

**Qualifications**

**Essential**

* B.E./B.Tech in Aerospace Engineering (preferred) or Mechanical Engineering.
* 0-2 years of experience.
* Strong fundamentals in strength of materials, aircraft structures and aerodynamics.
* Proficiency in 3D CAD software, preferably SolidWorks and CATIA.
* Exposure to FEA (ANSYS, Abaqus/SIMULIA, MSC Nastran/Patran, HyperMesh/OptiStruct or equivalent) or CFD (ANSYS Fluent, STAR-CCM+, OpenFOAM or equivalent).
* Knowledge of composite materials, including classical laminate theory.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience of composite layup and vacuum bagging.
* Familiarity with XFLR5, Flow5, OpenVSP or AVL.
* Experience of designing and building an aircraft for SAE Aero Design, Aerothon or a similar competition.
* Knowledge of coupon testing to ASTM methods.
* Knowledge of programming in Python or MATLAB for analysis and automation.

**About Samveksha**

Samveksha Private Limited is an aerospace company specialising in the design, development, manufacture and qualification of unmanned aircraft systems for defence and aerospace applications, including intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR). Its in-house engineering spans aerodynamics, structures, propulsion, electrical power, avionics, flight controls and software.

title: AI Innovation Lead
description:
**Vestas is a major company in sustainable energy solutions and a driving force in the wind energy industry. Our core business encompasses the development, manufacturing, sales, installation, and servicing of wind turbines worldwide. At Vestas, we are committed to accelerating the transition to renewable energy while creating innovative solutions that deliver value to our customers and stakeholders.**
**Digital Solutions & Development > Digital Solutions > Autonomous Flows Advisors**
The Autonomous Flows Advisors team sits within Vestas' Digital Development Platform and accelerates the AI and automation transformation across the business. We act as internal advisors and enablers, partnering with product teams and business areas across the value chain (R&D, commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, services and business services) to help shape the AI strategy, scope high-impact solutions, and ensure responsible, scalable AI adoption. We work closely with cyber, legal, and data governance, and collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels.
  
  
As an AI Innovation Lead, you will redesign and operationalize frontline workflows using AI and automation. Working closely with the business teams, local technology leads, and global product teams, you will translate business priorities into measurable workflow transformations and working operational prototypes. You'll be responsible for running the automation work, aligning scope, implementing the local solutions while keeping in mind potential risks and opportunities to turn your solutions into global product features. This is not a research or purely strategic role. You will be expected to get into the details, test assumptions, and deliver tangible innovation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As an AI Innovation Lead, you will play an instrumental role in our efforts to enable the Vestas AI transformation. You will be responsible for:
  
  

* Coordinating the mapping and redesign of frontline workflows together with the relevant business teams - Partnering with key business stakeholders to identify and scope work packages with clearly defined resource needs, measurable outcomes, and target problems- Assessing data readiness, technical feasibility, and implementation complexity for proposed automation initiatives
* Defining success metrics and expected business outcomes for each AI initiative, in collaboration with stakeholders
* Overseeing the development of local automations in collaboration with business stakeholders and subject matter experts
* Testing deployed prototypes with live frontline data and iteratively improving solution quality based on structured SME feedback and evaluation results
* Working directly with frontline users to embed the redesigned workflow and supporting automation into daily operations
* Identifying recurring workflow patterns, reusable components, and enterprise-scaling opportunities
* Translating learnings into a structured backlog for global solutions product owners

**Qualifications**
This role requires someone who is highly motivated, engaged, and able to work well both on their own and alongside a diverse group of stakeholders. We imagine that you have most of the qualifications and skills below:
  
  

* A relevant degree in a quantitative field (IT, physics, mathematics, etc.), business transformation, or similar, combining solid technical understanding and effective communication skills - At least 6 years of relevant experience in a similar role- Practical understanding of automation and AI use cases, limitations, and pitfalls
* Experience building AI, automation, or software solutions using modern AI development tools
* Experience with product discovery, business process redesign, automation, operational excellence, or digital transformation initiatives

**Competencies**

* Business oriented, value-focused mindset
* Effective communication skills, both spoken and written, plus the ability to navigate complex organizations and align differing stakeholder needs- Ability to translate complex AI concepts into clear, actionable language for non-technical stakeholders
* Pragmatic and structured approach to problem solving, with a focus on value creation
* You seek to constantly acquire new knowledge, stay up to date within AI, and challenge yourself
* Fluent spoken and written English is a prerequisite

**What We Offer**

* Purpose - An opportunity to support climate action and improve the future for people to come using automation and AI
* Steep learning curve - You will be part of a highly knowledgeable AI advisory team with wide-ranging and in-depth experience. That means that you will have somebody to learn from, just as we will invest in continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and upskilling
* Strong relationships - We plan to cultivate an open and supportive atmosphere with a tight-knit team that can learn from one another and contribute meaningful value to Vestas
* Opportunity to shape your role - We have been asked to scale and anchor the impact of AI and automation across Vestas. The rest is up to us
* Healthy work life balance, with flexible working options
* Commitment to building a diverse and inclusive workplace
* Everyone can thrive and bring their unique perspectives and skills to the team

**Additional Information**
Your primary location will be in Chennai, India
  
  
Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 30th Nov 2026
  
  
Learn more about Vestas at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels
  
  
**Our commitment to a fair hiring.**
At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.
  
  
**DEIB Statement**
At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.
  
  
**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process
  
  
**About Vestas**
Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
  
  
Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.
  
  
With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.
  
  
Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.
  
  
To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

description:

How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as #OneSectigo by living out our core values - Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you’d like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we’d like to talk to you.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a talented Advanced Technical Support Engineer to join our growing global team at Sectigo.
  
  
The Advanced Technical Support Engineer works closely with Sectigo’s customer base and sales department and handles the day-to-day customer issues reported and manages identified issues through to resolution, including assisting customers technical issues by researching, diagnosing, troubleshooting, and identifying solutions to resolve reported issues. This position is responsible for handling all issues escalated from the tech support engineering team (e.g. Tier 1).
  
  
  
  
Please Note: The Reporting Manager and the Work Arrangement requirements may be modified and redesigned based on business needs to ensure operational flexibility and organizational effectiveness

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:

* Work closely with Sectigo’s customer base and sales department.
* Handle all issues escalated from the technical support team (e.g. Tier 1) and take ownership of customer issues reported and seeing problems through to resolution.
* Research, diagnose, troubleshoot, and identify solutions to resolve reported issues.
* Ask customers targeted questions to quickly understand the root of the problem.
* Assisting various customers through Phone, E-Mail, or Chat, until they resolve the reported technical issue.
* Provide prompt and accurate feedback to customers.
* Follow up with unresponsive customers.
* Refer to internal database or external resources to provide accurate tech solutions.
* Follow standard procedures for proper escalation of unresolved issues to Shift Lead / Team Lead or to the appropriate internal teams.
* Communicate clearly and effectively with end users, colleagues, and management to quickly resolve issues and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Prioritize and manage several open issues at one time.
* Ensure all reported issues about the system are properly logged and reported.
* Contribute to create Knowledge Base of known issues and their fixes.
* Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.

More information about this role:

* This is a full-time and in-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week.
* This is an individual contributor role, reporting to our Manager, Technical Support.
* The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 9,00,000 and INR 11,00,000.

**Qualifications**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience) is strongly preferred.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 3+ years of experience in technical support or help desk environments is required; ideally 3 to 5+ years is preferred with some experience in an escalation role.
* Strong understanding of SSL/TLS, certificate lifecycle, and server/network 3-5+ years of customer support / help desk experience.
* Experience working with large accounts.
* Familiarity with ticketing systems such as Salesforce, Zendesk, or Freshdesk.
* Technical knowledge/experience/certifications with Microsoft, Cisco, (and / or) within the Security Industry.
* Strong knowledge of Linux Apache and Windows operating systems.
* Knowledge of Windows networking.
* Experience with information security products. (antivirus, spam filter, email encryption, etc.)
* Knowledge of Internet protocols and services including TCP/IP, DNS, SMTP, SSH, and SSL http/https.
* Strong knowledge of Active Directory.
* Applied knowledge troubleshooting server-level issues.
* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing, is required.

**Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:**

* Strong communication and organization skills, with attention to detail and must be able to multi-task.
* Superior customer service and phone mannerism are required to handle support of Sectigo’s customer base.
* Computer literacy skills must include the use of e-mail, databases, and word processing applications.
* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills.
* Strong experience on handling customer issues and possess qualities such as integrity, fair mindedness, and a persuasive, congenial personality.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Must have the ability to thrive in a start-up environment while applying existing skill sets and training to increase knowledge base.
* Must be able to work shift work Monday through Friday including holidays based on business needs and possible Weekends and after hours.
* Must be willing to carry the after-hour Support pager.
* Operate well in a fast-paced, dynamic, and global environment without requiring significant supervision.
* Can think creatively and independently to resolve conflict as well as solve problems.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the countries where we operate.

* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Patience, empathy, and a customer-first mindset.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.

**Physical Requirements**

description:
**Company Description**

Ramboll is a global engineering, architecture and consultancy company. Our Energy from Waste & Carbon Capture team is part of Ramboll Energy. Ramboll Energy supports the transition toward more sustainable energy systems through independent technical advice, engineering and consultancy services. **Inviting bright minds**
Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative and empowering culture? We work to create a sustainable future, and our inspiring projects and innovative solutions aim to set the standard among our peers. You will join a global company that has been growing successfully since its founding in 1945. Together, we lead and leave a positive impact on societies, companies and people around the world.
  
  
**You will join our Ramboll Energy from Waste and Carbon Capture Team**
This is an exciting, permanent full-time position for an experienced and proactive Senior Project Engineer.
  
  
To work at Ramboll means being part of a people organisation. We are focused on knowledge sharing and collaboration across competence areas and geographies, and we aim for a strong diversity among our employees. This enables us to collaborate on a broad range of projects, and we firmly believe that cross-collaboration leads to creative and longstanding solutions.
  
  
You will be based in Chennai and will work with a motivated, engaged and inclusive team of professionals. This role supports our global team, where we have a growing presence in India, Denmark, the UK, Switzerland, Singapore and Australia. More information about Ramboll can be found at www.ramboll.com/wte.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
Your primary role will be to support project managers and multidisciplinary engineering teams in delivering feasibility studies, tendering, design review, construction support, commissioning and project close-out services on behalf of project directors / Project Managers. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
  
  
  

* Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering activities and interfaces across process, mechanical, piping, civil, structural, electrical, control and instrumentation, environmental and other relevant disciplines.
* Review EPC contractor, technology supplier and vendor submissions for compliance with the Employer's Requirements, contract documents, applicable codes and standards, design basis, performance requirements and approved project interfaces.
* Coordinate technical reviews, consolidate discipline comments, track their closure and ensure that unresolved matters, deviations, exclusions, assumptions and design changes are clearly recorded and escalated.
* Support preparation and review of feasibility studies, concept designs, technical specifications, Employer's Requirements, tender documents, bid evaluation reports, clarification registers, scope matrices and technical recommendations.
* Participate in bidder clarification meetings, technical negotiations, design review meetings, HAZOP and other project risk review workshops, as applicable to the assignment.
* Monitor engineering deliverables, procurement interfaces, construction readiness and key project milestones against the approved programme, and identify technical risks, constraints and potential schedule impacts at an early stage.
* Assist the Project Manager in defining scope, deliverables, responsibilities, battery limits, interfaces and acceptance criteria, and in managing scope changes in accordance with the agreed project procedures.
* Coordinate with the client, EPC contractor, technology providers, suppliers and internal Ramboll teams to facilitate timely technical decisions while maintaining Ramboll's independent Owner's Engineer position.
* Participate in factory inspections, site visits, construction reviews, commissioning activities and performance tests, and prepare clear reports identifying observations, non-conformities, open items and recommended follow-up actions.
* Support evaluation of technical deviations, concessions and contractor proposals, including assessment of their implications for safety, operability, maintainability, performance, programme, interfaces and whole-life value.
* Promote compliance with applicable health, safety, environmental and quality requirements throughout design review and project delivery activities.
* Prepare concise technical correspondence, meeting minutes, progress inputs, decision papers and reports suitable for issue to clients, contractors and other project stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
**The right person for this job will**

* Hold a bachelor's or master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Control & Instrumentation, Chemical, Civil or another engineering discipline relevant to thermal power, EfW/WtE, carbon capture or major process infrastructure projects.
* Have approximately 10–12 years of experience in engineering consultancy, Owner's Engineer, EPC, technology provider or plant owner organisations, with responsibility for project engineering or multidisciplinary coordination.
* Demonstrate sound understanding of the full project lifecycle, including feasibility, concept and detailed design, tendering, procurement, construction, commissioning, performance testing and handover.
* Have experience reviewing contractor and vendor documentation against contract requirements, technical specifications, design criteria and applicable codes and standards.
* Understand engineering interfaces and battery limits and be able to identify gaps, overlaps, inconsistencies and risks across multidisciplinary scopes.
* Be familiar with project controls, document management, technical query resolution, change management, risk management and quality assurance processes.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or an equivalent recognised project management qualification will be considered an advantage
* Possess strong analytical judgement and the ability to distinguish material technical or contractual issues from minor comments, and to provide clear, proportionate and defensible recommendations.
* Communicate clearly in written and spoken English and be confident engaging with clients, contractors, suppliers and geographically distributed teams.
* Be organised, diligent and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver agreed outputs to programme and quality requirements.
* Be able to work independently while contributing effectively to a collaborative, inclusive and multidisciplinary team environment.
* Be willing to travel to client offices, supplier facilities and project sites when required by the assignment.
* Experience in EfW/WtE, thermal power generation, carbon capture, flue-gas treatment, utilities or comparable process plants will be an advantage.
* Professional registration or progress toward chartered status with a recognised engineering institution will be an advantage.

**Additional Information**
**Working at Ramboll**
To work at Ramboll means being part of a people organisation. We are focused on knowledge sharing and collaboration across competence areas and geography, and we aim for a strong diversity among our employees. This enables us to solve a broad range of projects, and we firmly believe that cross-collaboration leads to creative and longstanding solutions. Thus, the possibilities at Ramboll are many and diverse –we invest a lot in the development of people and offer career paths tailored for each individual.
  
  
**How To Apply**
If you are interested in applying, please send your application through our online recruitment system by clicking the link ‘apply’ below. Attach your CV, cover letter and relevant documents showcasing why you are the right fit for the role, and when you are available to start. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Engineer - Machine Shop (Process Engineering)
description:
VPG is a global leader in precision measurement and sensing technologies. We design and manufacture high-performance products that support critical applications in the industrial, medical, aerospace, and automotive sectors.

We are seeking a highly motivated
**Engineer - Machine Shop**
to join our Production Team on a full-time basis:

**Roles & Responsibility:**

**﻿New Product Industrialization:**

* **﻿**
  Conduct manufacturing feasibility, DFM and process-risk reviews for new and transferred products.
* Review drawings, materials, tolerances, GD&T, surface-finish requirements and CTQ characteristics for machinability.
* Develop process flow, operation sequence, routing, machine selection and manufacturing concept.
* Plan and execute prototype, pilot and pre-production machining activities.
* Lead CNC program prove-out, tooling trials, fixture validation, run-at-rate and stable handover to production.
* Complete assigned APQP and PPAP deliverables within the approved project timeline.

**Machining Process Development:**

* **﻿**
  Develop and optimize CNC turning, VMC, HMC and other applicable machining processes.
* Establish and validate cutting speed, feed, depth of cut, coolant strategy and tool-life parameters.
* Prepare stage drawings, CNC setup sheets, tool lists, process parameters, SOPs and standardized work.
* Develop and validate jigs, fixtures, workholding methods and mistake-proofing controls.
* Ensure controlled creation, review, approval, backup and revision of CNC programs.

**Process Quality and Capability:**

* **﻿**
  Prepare and maintain process flow diagrams, PFMEA, control plans and reaction plans.
* Define process controls and measurement methods for CTQ and special characteristics.
* Coordinate MSA, SPC, capability studies and corrective actions for unstable or incapable processes.
* Lead structured root-cause analysis for machining defects, customer complaints, scrap and rework using 8D, A3, 5 Why or equivalent methods.
* Verify corrective-action effectiveness and sustain improvements through updated controls and layered audits.

**Productivity and Cost Improvement:**

* **﻿**
   Conduct time studies, bottleneck analysis and capacity reviews for priority products and machines.
* Improve cycle time, setup time, OEE, machine utilization and process flow using Lean, SMED, Kaizen, 5S and TPM principles.
* Optimize tool life, insert consumption, fixture utilization and machining cost per component.
* Lead approved VA/VE, automation and productivity projects and validate realized savings against the agreed baseline.

**Production and Cross-Functional Support:**

* **﻿**
  Provide timely technical support for daily machining-process issues and abnormal conditions.
* Coordinate directly with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Planning and Tool Room for rapid containment and resolution.
* Support machine loading, capacity planning, engineering changes and controlled production release.
* Train and qualify operators, setters and technicians on new or revised processes.
* Support internal, customer and certification audits relevant to assigned processes.

**Safety, Compliance and Documentation:**

* **﻿**
  Complete process risk assessments before introduction or modification of machining processes.
* Ensure compliance with machine safety, guarding, PPE, chip handling, coolant handling and applicable LOTO controls.
* Maintain controlled process documents, validation records, parameter approvals and technical evidence.
* Implement engineering changes with documented impact assessment, validation, revision control and traceability.

**﻿Essential Technical Competencies:**

**﻿**
• CNC turning, VMC and HMC process development

• Cutting tools, parameters and tool-life optimization

• Jig, fixture and workholding design

• GD&T and drawing interpretation

• Surface finish and dimensional control

• Cycle-time and capacity analysis

• CNC program prove-out and revision control

**Process / Systems Competencies:**

• Process flow, PFMEA and control plan

• APQP and PPAP

• MSA, SPC and capability analysis

• 8D, A3, 5 Why and root-cause analysis

• Lean, Kaizen, SMED, 5S, TPM and OEE

• Engineering change control

• SolidWorks / CAD, applicable CAM, ERP/QAD and advanced Excel

**Behavioral Competencies:**

**﻿**
• Analytical problem solving

• Decision making based on data and risk

• Clear written and verbal communication

• Cross-functional collaboration

• Planning and prioritization

• Technical leadership and coaching

• Ownership, accountability and continuous-improvement mindset

Requirements:

**Education: BE**
/ B.Tech in Mechanical, Production or Manufacturing Engineering. Relevant diploma qualifications may be considered in accordance with company policy and demonstrated experience.

**Relevant Experience:**
6 to 8 years of relevant experience in machine-shop process engineering, including CNC machining, New Product Industrialization, tooling, fixture development and process validation.

**Machine Experience:**
Hands-on exposure to CNC turning, VMC and HMC. Experience with applicable controllers, multi-axis machining or in-process probing is preferred where relevant to the plant.

**Quality Systems:**
Working knowledge of IATF 16949 / ISO-based systems, APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, control plan, MSA, SPC, process capability and structured problem solving.

description:

Unlike a traditional Help Desk or Level 1 support role, this position focuses on hands-on technical support, incident resolution, service request fulfillment, asset management, and onsite execution of IT initiatives requiring physical presence. The technician is responsible for maintaining a high level of

customer satisfaction while ensuring adherence to global IT standards, processes, and service levels. The technician operates as an integral part of a globally distributed IT team and may be managed remotely by a regional or global IT Manager. This is a 100% onsite position.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**End User Support**

• Resolve incidents and service requests assigned through ServiceNow, maintaining SLA

compliance at all times.

• Provide Level 2 technical support for desktops, laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, printers,

and meeting room technologies.

• Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity issues requiring onsite physical

intervention.

issues.

• Ensure timely resolution of assigned tickets and maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation

in ServiceNow.

**Workplace Technology Support**

• Support Windows and mobile device (iOS/Android) environments in compliance with

enterprise standards.

• Deploy, configure, troubleshoot, and replace end-user hardware including laptops, desktops,

and peripherals.

• Support conference rooms, audiovisual systems, printers, docking stations, and collaboration

technologies (e.g., Microsoft Teams Rooms).

• Perform hardware lifecycle management activities, including device refreshes, upgrades, and

decommissioning.

**Hands & Feet Support for Global IT Teams**

• Act as the onsite physical representative for Network, Platform, Security, and Workplace teams.

• Execute physical tasks as directed by remote engineering teams, including:

◦ Server installations, replacements, and hardware diagnostics.

◦ Maintain and rotate backup media in tape libraries

◦ Network equipment installation, cable tracing, and connectivity verification.

◦ Rack and stack activities and cable management in data closets and server rooms.

◦ Equipment reboots and smart hands support for remote engineers.

◦ Physical patching, labeling, and port verification.

**Asset & Inventory Management**

• Maintain accurate IT asset records within ServiceNow (CMDB / Asset Management module).

• Receive, inspect, register, and deploy new IT equipment; update inventory records upon

delivery.

• Conduct periodic physical inventory audits and reconcile discrepancies with CMDB data.

• Manage stock levels of consumables and provide timely feedback on inventory requirements.

• Coordinate equipment disposal and asset recovery in accordance with company policies and

data security standards.

**Employee Onboarding & Offboarding**

• Prepare, configure, and deploy equipment for new hires; ensure day-one readiness in

coordination with HR and People Operations.

• Recover devices, peripherals, and access cards from departing employees; wipe and reimage

equipment per policy.

• Update asset records and maintain full compliance with asset management and data handling

processes.

• Support employee moves, additions, and changes (MAC requests) requiring physical IT

involvement.

**Site Operations Support**

• Support local and global IT projects and initiatives that require onsite execution.

• Conduct IT site surveys and infrastructure assessments; document findings for remote

engineering teams.

• Pack, label, and coordinate shipment and receipt of IT equipment between locations following

logistics and security procedures.

• Assist with office expansions, relocations, and technology deployments.

• Support disaster recovery and business continuity activities when required.

**Documentation & Process Improvement**

• Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base articles in

ServiceNow or the designated knowledge platform.

• Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements or permanent fixes to remote

teams.

• Participate in process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives within the global

IT team.

• Provide regular operational feedback to global IT teams regarding site-specific trends,

challenges, and opportunities.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education**

• Associate degree, technical diploma, or equivalent practical experience in Information

Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

**Experience**

• Minimum 3–5 years of experience in IT support, desktop support, or a related technical

role.

• Demonstrated experience providing onsite technical support in a corporate or enterprise

environment.

• Hands-on experience with enterprise hardware, software, and end-user device management.

• Experience working with an ITSM ticketing system; ServiceNow strongly preferred.

• Experience with IT asset management processes and physical inventory management.

**Technical Skills**

• Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365 suite.

• Desktop, laptop, and mobile device hardware troubleshooting (iOS and Android).

• Printers, multifunction devices, docking stations, and peripherals.

• Meeting room and collaboration technologies (Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, AV systems).

• Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VLANs, basic switching and cabling

standards.

• IT asset management processes and ServiceNow Asset/CMDB modules.

• Incident, request, and change management processes (ITIL framework awareness).

**Language Skills**

• Fluent in English — written and verbal — required for communication with global IT

teams and ticket documentation.

• Native or business-level proficiency in the local language of the assigned site.

**Soft Skills**

• Strong customer service orientation — treats every interaction as an opportunity to deliver

an excellent experience.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to explain technical concepts clearly

to non-technical users.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision as part of a geographically distributed

team.

• Strong organizational and time management skills; able to handle multiple open tickets and

competing priorities.

• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities with a methodical, detail-oriented

approach.

• Collaborative mindset; comfortable working across cultures and time zones.

• Professional demeanor with a positive, solution-focused attitude.

**Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)**

• CompTIA A+ — hardware and end user support foundation.

• ITIL Foundation — IT service management processes and best practices.

• Microsoft 365 / Windows Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate.

title: Engineer
description:
* Position Summary

The ESS Specifications, Standards & Guidelines serves as the operational and technical documentation to the Engineering Technical Authority team. This role helps ensure that Engineering Specifications, Standards and Guidelines remain current, internally consistent, easier to find, and better aligned with applicable industry standards and recognized engineering practices.
  
  
The resource will work closely with ETA subject matter experts (SMEs), document owners, to coordinate document updates, support the development of new ESS documents, maintain search and access capabilities, and cascade changes through the EDL platform and established communications.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities

**ESS Maintenance & Industry Alignment:**
Maintain assigned Amgen Engineering Specifications, Standards and Guidelines and coordinate periodic reviews to improve clarity, consistency, usability, and alignment with applicable industry standards and engineering practices.
  
  
**SME Document Revision Support:**
Provide hands-on support to ETA SMEs during document updates and revisions, including document control coordination, incorporation of SME comments, formatting, reference checking, revision history, review-cycle tracking, and preparation for approval.
  
  
**New ESS Development:**
Support ETA in the development of new Specifications, Standards and Guidelines by coordinating inputs, facilitating working sessions, organizing source material, and progressing drafts through the established review and approval process.
  
  
**ESS Change Cascade & Communications:**
Cascade information on new and updated ESS documents to ETA and the broader engineering community through the EDL platform and agreed communication channels. Maintain concise change summaries, effective dates, links to current documents, and communication records.
  
  
**Governance & Coordination:**
Maintain a practical ESS tracker and review calendar; monitor document status, owners, planned revisions, approvals, and publication; identify overdue or high-priority actions; and provide routine status reporting to ETA leadership.
  
  

* EDL Platform & Communication Support

The resource will maintain the operational interface for ESS updates in the EDL environment, including the established "Updated ESS Documents" SharePoint list and related communication process.
  
  

* Post or coordinate publication of approved ESS changes in accordance with ETA governance.
* Prepare short, user-focused update messages covering document title, revision, change summary, effective date, impacted audience, and link to the current version.
* Maintain a communication record so ETA can confirm that updates were cascaded to the intended engineering audience.
* Interfaces & Collaboration

Primary interfaces include ETA Technical Authorities and SMEs, Engineering discipline leads, Facilities/Utilities, project engineering teams, Quality/Validation stakeholders as applicable, document owners, and digital/knowledge-management platform support. The resource is expected to work hybrid time zones and maintain a predictable communication rhythm with global stakeholders.
  
  

* Working Hours & Global Collaboration Model

The role should be structured to provide reliable support to U.S., Europe, and Asia stakeholders. The working model may be established as Hybrid. The selected model should preserve protected time for focused document work while providing planned overlap for SME reviews, global meetings, and ESS change communications.
  
  
**Model**
**Work Hours**
**Global Overlap Reference\***
**Recommended Use**
HYBRID
  
  
Mon-Thu: 9:30 AM-3:30 PM at site, with split remote work before/after site hours; Fri: 9:00 AM-6:00 PM ET
  
  
Per AIN reference: 3 hr with PT; 3 hr with ET; 5 hr with EU; 6 hr with Singapore
  
  
Best when on-site ETA/SME interaction is important while retaining global collaboration flexibility.
  
  

* Skills & Qualifications
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, technical communications, information management, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Experience working with engineering standards, specifications, procedures, technical documentation, or controlled document systems in a regulated or highly structured environment.
* Strong technical writing, editing, document-control, and information-organization skills.
* Ability to work effectively with subject matter experts and translate technical inputs into clear, usable document content without changing technical intent.
* Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, document libraries, metadata/search concepts, and collaboration tools or equivalent engineering knowledge platforms is desirable.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple document revisions, deadlines, reviewers, and approvals simultaneously.
* Comfort working across global time zones and adjusting meeting windows when critical SME or stakeholder participation is required.
* Working knowledge of how external codes, standards, and industry guidance influence engineering requirements; the role is expected to coordinate and research, while technical ownership remains with the designated ETA SME.
* Role Boundaries

This resource supports the ETA team but does not replace the technical authority of the designated ETA SME or document owner. Technical decisions, interpretations of requirements, approvals, and final release authority remain with the assigned Amgen technical and governance owners.

title: AI Knowledge Analyst I
description:
**Role Summary**
The AI Knowledge Analyst is a member of the Customer Care and Managed Services team, responsible for ensuring the knowledge ecosystems that power GHX's operations and AI platforms are accurate, well-governed, and continuously improving. This role works closely with leadership, SMEs, data scientists, and operational teams to identify content gaps, manage knowledge lifecycles, and translate business needs into structured, AI-ready information assets. The AI Knowledge Analyst is equally comfortable working through a detailed content audit and presenting a structured recommendation to leadership. Strong organizational skills, clear communication, and a bias for action are required. This is a role for someone who treats knowledge gaps as solvable problems and can move from gap identification to resolution with minimal direction.
  
  
**Core Focus Areas**
**Knowledge Governance & Lifecycle Management**
Maintain, organize, and govern the knowledge assets that support Customer Care and Managed Services teams. This includes managing intake, triage, and routing of knowledge requests; driving SME review cycles; and ensuring content is accurate, current, and ready for both human use and AI ingestion.
  
  
**AI Knowledge Readiness**
Identify, structure, and groom content that feeds GHX's AI platform. Partner with AI and data teams to ensure knowledge assets are formatted, accurate, and optimized for ingestion. Monitor AI solution performance and drive content improvements that translate into measurable efficiency gains.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Knowledge Management & Content Quality**

* Manage the intake, triage, and routing of knowledge-related requests from operational teams.
* Maintain content lifecycle through SME review checkpoints — flagging material for update, review, or archival on a consistent cadence.
* Identify obsolete, duplicate, or conflicting content and drive resolution through appropriate stakeholders.
* Conduct knowledge audits and implement improvement cycles based on performance data and stakeholder feedback.
* Translate operational knowledge into structured, AI-ingestible formats ensuring accuracy, consistency, and taxonomy compliance.

**AI Knowledge Readiness & Technology**

* Structure and groom knowledge content for ingestion into GHX's AI platforms; ensure format, tagging, and taxonomy standards are met.
* Monitor AI platform performance related to knowledge quality; recommend and track content-driven improvements.
* Partner with data scientists and AI developers to understand ingestion requirements and close content gaps.
* Stay current on trends in AI knowledge management, large language model content requirements, and KM tooling.

**Process Improvement & Analysis**

* Analyze and document knowledge workflows, identifying gaps or structural issues that reduce content usability or AI accuracy.
* Interpret usage data, feedback trends, and engagement metrics to recommend improvement opportunities.
* Support implementation of governance standards, taxonomy structures, and documentation templates.
* Learn and apply Lean/Six Sigma and knowledge-centered service (KCS) frameworks where applicable.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Partner with SMEs, operational leaders, and AI teams to promote adoption of AI-enabled knowledge systems.
* Provide end-user training and support on knowledge tools, systems, and updated content resources.
* Collect stakeholder requirements and develop content solutions that meet operational team needs.
* Present knowledge health findings and recommendations to leadership with clear next steps.

**Required Skills**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to tailor message by audience.
* Familiarity with knowledge management systems (Confluence/Atlassian, Salesforce Knowledge, ServiceNow, or equivalent).
* Analytical mindset with ability to interpret usage data and translate findings into action.
* Detail-oriented with ability to manage multiple knowledge domains and adjust priorities as needed.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, SharePoint, Forms); CRM familiarity a plus (Salesforce preferred).
* Self-directed learner who identifies gaps and takes initiative to close them.
* Understanding of how content structure and taxonomy affect AI/ML model performance preferred.

**Education & Experience**

* 2+ years of related experience in knowledge management, operations enablement, content governance, or business analysis.
* Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining content for both human consumption (training, SOPs) and machine ingestion (AI platforms, knowledge bases).
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Management, Organizational Development, or related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Change management or KM certification (Prosci, KCS, ACMP) a plus.

description:

Hyderabad

Full-time

**Experience:**
0–3 years

Engineering / Science / Food Technology / Environmental Science / Sustainability or related disciplines.

**About Smartedge Consulting**

Established in 2005, Smartedge Consulting provides consulting, implementation, assessment, training and managed services to organizations across manufacturing, engineering, pharmaceuticals, food processing, healthcare, IT and other industry sectors.

Our focus is on developing practical management systems that improve organizational effectiveness, address operational risks and create measurable business value.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for enthusiastic and committed Associate Consultants to join our growing consulting team across the following five practice areas:

1. Quality Management Systems (QMS)
2. Integrated Management Systems (IMS-QEHS)
3. Food Safety Management Systems
4. Environment, Health & Safety (EHS)
5. ESG & Sustainability

Selected candidates will work with senior consultants and practice leads in executing client assignments, conducting assessments, developing documentation, supporting implementation and coordinating project activities.

* Assist senior consultants in executing consulting and implementation assignments.
* Collect and analyse client information, operational data and relevant records.
* Prepare reports, presentations, procedures, SOPs and other project deliverables.
* Participate in client assessments, site visits and internal audits.
* Coordinate with client representatives for implementation and project progress.
* Maintain project documentation and monitor deliverable schedules.
* Support client training and awareness programmes.
* Develop practical knowledge of applicable standards, regulations and industry practices.

**2. Practice-Specific Responsibilities**

**A. QMS – Quality Management Systems**

Applicable areas: ISO 9001 and related quality management practices.

* Assist in quality management system implementation.
* Prepare quality policies, procedures, SOPs and process documentation.
* Support process mapping, risk-based thinking and quality objectives.
* Assist in internal audits and corrective action implementation.
* Support quality improvement initiatives and customer satisfaction processes.

**B. IMS-QEHS – Integrated Management Systems**

Applicable areas: ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001.

* Assist in integrated management system implementation.
* Prepare environmental aspects and impacts registers.
* Support hazard identification and risk assessment.
* Assist in developing operational control procedures.
* Support legal compliance assessments and compliance registers.
* Assist in internal audits, incident reporting and corrective actions.

**C. Food Safety Management Systems**

Applicable areas: ISO 22000, FSSC 22000, HACCP and BRCGS Food Safety.

* Assist in food safety management system implementation.
* Support food safety hazard analysis and HACCP plan preparation.
* Develop prerequisite programmes (PRPs), SOPs and food safety records.
* Assist in hygiene inspections and food safety assessments.
* Support traceability, allergen management and food safety verification activities.
* Coordinate food safety implementation and certification readiness.

**D. EHS – Environment, Health & Safety**

Applicable areas: Industrial safety, environmental management, statutory compliance and occupational health and safety.

* Assist in conducting workplace safety inspections and EHS assessments.
* Support preparation of HIRA, JSA and environmental risk assessments.
* Assist in identifying unsafe conditions, unsafe practices and operational risks.
* Support fire safety, emergency preparedness and disaster management activities.
* Assist in environmental compliance monitoring and statutory compliance documentation.
* Support incident investigation, root cause analysis and corrective action tracking.
* Assist in developing safety procedures, training materials and awareness programmes.
* Support implementation of EHS improvement plans at client locations.

**E. ESG & Sustainability**

Applicable areas: ESG assessments, sustainability reporting, carbon management and supply-chain sustainability.

* Assist in conducting ESG readiness assessments and sustainability gap assessments.
* Collect, organise and analyse Environmental, Social and Governance data.
* Support preparation of ESG reports, sustainability disclosures and management presentations.
* Assist in carbon footprint data collection (Scope 1, Scope 2 and relevant Scope 3 categories).
* Support energy, water, waste and resource efficiency assessments.
* Assist in BRSR, GRI and CDP reporting readiness activities.
* Support EcoVadis assessments, evidence collection and improvement action plans.
* Assist in ESG policy development, sustainability strategy and implementation roadmaps.
* Coordinate with client departments to establish ESG data collection and monitoring systems.

**3. Educational Qualifications**

Candidates should have relevant qualifications in one or more of the following disciplines:

**Practice**

**Preferred educational background**

QMS

B.Tech / Diploma – Mechanical, Production, Industrial, Electrical

IMS-QEHS

B.Tech / Diploma – Mechanical, Chemical, Civil, Environmental

Food Safety

B.Sc / M.Sc / B.Tech – Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology, Biotechnology

EHS

B.Tech / Diploma – Safety, Mechanical, Chemical, Civil, Environmental

ESG & Sustainability

B.Sc / M.Sc – Environmental Science, Sustainability, Chemistry, Life Sciences; B.Tech Environmental; relevant MBA

Additional qualifications or training in ISO standards, industrial safety, environmental management, sustainability or ESG will be an advantage.

**4. Desired Skills & Competencies**

* Good analytical, research and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Good report writing and documentation capabilities.
* Working knowledge of MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
* Data analysis and presentation skills.
* Ability to interact professionally with client representatives.
* Willingness to travel to client locations and industrial sites.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a consulting team.
* Positive attitude, professional discipline and willingness to learn.

**5. Experience**

* Fresh graduates with relevant qualifications and a strong learning orientation are encouraged to apply.
* 1–3 years of experience in consulting, manufacturing, quality, EHS, food safety, environmental management or sustainability will be preferred.
* Exposure to ISO implementation, internal audits, safety inspections, ESG data collection or certification projects will be an advantage.

**6. Career Development**

Selected candidates will undergo structured training and mentoring under senior consultants and practice leads.

The career progression will include:

* Associate Consultant
* Junior Consultant
* Consultant
* Senior Consultant
* Practice Lead

Candidates will have opportunities to develop into independent consultants and handle client assignments across Smartedge's service portfolio.

**7. What Smartedge Offers**

* Exposure to multiple industries and consulting assignments.
* Practical experience in management systems and sustainability implementation.
* Mentoring by experienced senior consultants.
* Opportunity to work on national and international client assignments.
* Continuous professional development and technical training.
* Performance-based career progression.

**Compensation:**
As per qualifications, experience and demonstrated capabilities.

**8. Application**

Interested candidates may share their updated CV at:

**Smartedge Consulting**

Email: info@smartedgeconsulting.com

Website: www.smartedgeconsulting.com

* SaaS/Cloud experience

title: Senior Commercialization Specialist, US Market - Renewable Energy
description:
**About Enfinity Global**

Enfinity Global is a purpose-driven company focused on making a positive impact on the planet by helping companies, governments, and individuals transition to a carbon-free and sustainable economy. Our role as a leading IPP is to develop, finance, build, operate, and own decarbonization assets in the long term in Europe, Asia, and the Americas through our offices in the USA, Spain, Italy, UK, Netherlands, India, and Japan.

 Our team of over 400+ Enfiniters comprises seasoned finance professionals, as well as experienced project developers and operators with extensive industry experience across all stages of the project life cycle. We pride ourselves on being creative and innovative solution providers to our customers and partners.

**Job Summary:**

Enfinity Global is looking for a Senior Specialist- Commercialization to join our Commercial Operations team and drive the commercialization of utility-scale solar PV and battery energy storage (BESS) projects across our US platform. The role owns the end-to-end preparation, coordination and submission of RFP and bid packages, supports PPA and offtake structuring, manages counterparty interactions, and tracks developments across US power markets. Based in our Hyderabad office and working as an integral part of the Enfinity Americas team, this role sits at the intersection of origination, commercial strategy, and project execution, and is suited for someone seeking direct ownership of live deals and growth at the leading edge of the energy transition. We expect this candidate to actively leverage AI and automation to improve the accuracy and efficiency of our commercial processes.

The role works closely with US-based stakeholders and counterparties, and requires a working schedule that is well aligned with US business hours.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Bid and RFP Management**

o   Lead the preparation of complete RFP, RFI and bid packages for utilities, C&I and corporate offtakers, from bid/no-bid assessment through final submission.

o   Conduct detailed reviews of solicitation documents to identify:

§  Scope, eligibility and qualification criteria

§  Submission requirements and deadlines

§  Evaluation methodology and scoring

§  Key commercial, technical and contractual nuances

o   Own the bid calendar and tracker across multiple concurrent solicitations, maintaining clear visibility on status, deadlines and open items.

o   Ensure every submission is compliant, accurate, internally approved and submitted on time.

o   Manage post-submission activity, including clarifications, shortlisting, best-and-final offers and handover to the negotiation team.

**Counterparty Management**

o   Act as the primary point of contact with utilities, offtakers, RFP administrators and independent evaluators throughout the bid process.

o   Manage bidder registrations, Q&A and clarification requests, and portal submissions.

o   Build and maintain professional relationships with counterparties and keep a clear record of all correspondence.

**Cross-functional Coordination**

o   Coordinate inputs from internal teams and stakeholders, including:

§  Finance and Capital Formation (pricing, financial models, credit support)

§  Legal (contract mark-ups, PPA terms, corporate documentation)

§  Engineering (technical design, energy yield and storage performance)

§  Development and Permitting (site control, interconnection and permitting status)

§  Construction and Procurement (EPC and equipment assumptions, schedules and costs)

o   Run bid kick-offs, working sessions and approval meetings; track follow-ups and close loops.

o   Prepare clear, defensible bid summaries for internal approval, covering key terms, pricing, risks, mitigants and decision points.

**PPA Structures and Commercial Support**

o   Apply a working understanding of offtake structures, including physical and virtual PPAs, tolling agreements, resource adequacy / capacity contracts and energy storage agreements.

o   Support Finance and Capital Formation in shaping pricing, contract term and risk-allocation positions in bid responses.

o   Review counterparty term sheets and PPA forms to flag key commercial and risk issues.

**Market Intelligence**

o   Monitor RFP and procurement activity across US power markets, including:

§  Regulated markets (vertically integrated utilities, IRP-driven procurements)

§  Deregulated / ISO-RTO markets (e.g. ERCOT, PJM, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE)

o   Track policy, regulatory and pricing trends relevant to solar and BESS bids, including state procurement programs.

o   Maintain a pipeline of upcoming solicitations and assess their fit with the company's portfolio.

**Process & Discipline**

o   Standardize, automate and maintain bid templates, content libraries and standard documentation.

o   Leverage AI tools and automation to improve the accuracy, consistency and speed of RFP review, proposal drafting, compliance checks and bid tracking.

o   Keep CRM and bid tracking tools accurate and up to date.

o   Capture lessons learned and win/loss feedback, and proactively propose improvements to the bid process.

**Requirements**

**Experience:**

* 3-5 years of experience in commercial roles in the renewable energy sector, such as bids, tenders, RFP management, offtake or business development, with solar PV and/or BESS preferred
* Hands-on experience preparing and submitting RFPs/bids for solar PV and/or BESS projects. Experience in the US market is ideal; experience with competitive tenders in the Indian market (e.g. SECI, NTPC, state utilities, C&I) is the next best fit
* Experience with solar PV and/or BESS technology, with a good understanding of how these projects work technically and commercially, including project economics and key commercial drivers
* Knowledge of US power markets (regulated and deregulated) is a strong plus; otherwise, a clear willingness and ability to learn quickly
* Understanding of PPA and offtake structures; deeper experience in PPA structuring or negotiation will be highly valued
* Comfortable working closely with US-based teams and counterparties, on a schedule aligned with US business hours
* Advanced user of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); working knowledge of PVsyst, CRM tools or Power BI is a plus

**Other competencies valued:**

* Clear and concise communicator, written and verbal, with the ability to draft professional proposals and correspondence
* Honesty and integrity in all interactions, both internally and with counterparties
* Proactive attitude: anticipates issues and acts before being asked
* Curious and comfortable using AI tools to work smarter, and keen to find new ways of doing things
* High accountability mindset: takes ownership, follows through and closes loops
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, able to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines
* Capacity to engage effectively with senior stakeholders and external partners

In Enfinity Global you will find a very dynamic and multinational environment in one of the most exciting and impactful industries. You will work alongside a highly experienced and collaborative team, with a clear path for growth as our US platform expands. Here we will foster your professional and personal growth, and you will have the opportunity to actively contribute and make a real impact on climate change.

title: Associate Director - Grid Integration, US Market - Renewable Energy
description:
**About Enfinity Global**

Enfinity Global is a purpose-driven company focused on making a positive impact on the planet by helping companies, governments, and individuals transition to a carbon-free and sustainable economy. Our role as a leading IPP is to develop, finance, build, operate, and own decarbonization assets in the long term in Europe, Asia, and the Americas through our offices in the USA, Spain, Italy, UK, Netherlands, India, and Japan.

Our team of over 400 Enfiniters comprises seasoned finance professionals, as well as experienced project developers and operators with extensive industry experience across all stages of the project life cycle. We pride ourselves on being creative and innovative solution providers to our customers and partners.

**Job Description:**

Enfinity Global is looking for a Senior Interconnection Leader with 10-15 years of experience who will be responsible for managing the transmission-level interconnection process for utility-scale solar, battery energy storage projects and large load interconnection across the United States.

The candidate should possess deep technical expertise in FERC regulations, interconnection studies, and grid integration, while demonstrating strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills. This position requires extensive collaboration with US-based teams, utilities, Independent System Operators (ISOs), Regional Transmission Organizations (RTOs), and engineering consultants.

The role demands an individual who is highly organized, strategic, and capable of managing complex interconnection processes from initial feasibility through Commercial Operation Date (COD). The successful candidate will serve as the primary point of contact with transmission providers and ISO/RTO interconnection departments, managing a portfolio of projects totaling multiple gigawatts.

This opportunity provides significant exposure to the US energy market and interconnection reform landscape including FERC Order 2023 implementation. Candidates will work closely with key stakeholders based in the US and will require flexibility to overlap 3-4 hours daily with US business hours.

**Key responsibilities:**

***Interconnection Process Management:***

·       Lead and manage the complete interconnection queue process for transmission-level renewable energy projects (solar, wind, and battery storage) from initial site selection and feasibility through Commercial Operation Date (COD), ensuring compliance with all regulatory and technical requirements.

·       Coordinate and submit interconnection applications, deposits, study agreements, and all required technical documentation to utilities, ISOs/RTOs including CAISO, ERCOT, PJM, MISO, SPP, NYISO, and ISO-NE within prescribed deadlines.

·       Manage queue positions and track interconnection study milestones including Cluster Studies, System Impact Studies (SIS), Facilities Studies (FS), and Affected System Studies across multiple ISO/RTO markets simultaneously.

·       Review, analyze, and challenge interconnection study results including load flow analysis, short circuit studies, stability analysis, and network upgrade requirements to optimize project economics and timelines.

·       Negotiate and execute Interconnection Agreements (IAs), Generator Interconnection Agreements (GIAs), and Large Generator Interconnection Agreements (LGIAs), including cost allocation, construction schedules, and milestone payment terms.

·       Manage interconnection financial commitments including study deposits, security postings, milestone payments, and network upgrade funding in accordance with FERC-approved tariff requirements.

***Technical Coordination & Analysis:***

·       Collaborate with internal engineering teams and external consultants to develop technical specifications, electrical one-line diagrams, and three-line diagrams for interconnection applications, ensuring accuracy and compliance with utility standards.

·       Conduct comprehensive due diligence reviews and technical feasibility assessments for potential project sites, evaluating transmission capacity, congestion patterns, and available interconnection options.

·       Evaluate and forecast network upgrade costs including reliability upgrades, delivery network upgrades, stand-alone network upgrades, and cost allocation methodologies under shared funding scenarios.

·       Assess and recommend alternative Point of Interconnection (POI) options, voltage levels, and interconnection configurations to optimize project economics, construction schedules, and commercial viability.

·       Support transmission planning activities including transmission service requests (TSRs), Network Resource Interconnection Service (NRIS) applications, and participation in regional transmission planning processes.

·       Monitor, interpret, and implement changes to utilities, ISO/RTO interconnection procedures, FERC Order compliance (Order 2023, 2023-A), queue reform initiatives, and cluster study process modifications across all relevant markets.

***Stakeholder Management & Communication:***

·       Serve as primary point of contact with transmission owners, transmission providers, utility interconnection departments, and ISO/RTO interconnection staff, building and maintaining productive long-term working relationships.

·       Coordinate closely with US-based development, origination, engineering, legal, and finance teams requiring regular availability during overlapping business hours.

·       Participate in ISO/RTO stakeholder meetings, interconnection working groups, and industry forums to stay current on policy developments and advocate for company positions on interconnection reform matters.

·       Prepare and deliver regular status updates, risk assessments, and executive summaries to senior management on portfolio-level interconnection progress, upcoming milestones, and potential risks.

·       Lead resolution of interconnection disputes, study delays, and billing discrepancies through direct engagement with utility staff, escalation procedures, and formal complaint processes when necessary.

·       Manage and provide technical oversight to external consultants and engineering firms supporting interconnection studies, deliverable preparation, and utility coordination activities.

***Portfolio Management, Data Analytics & Process Improvement:***

·       Maintain comprehensive interconnection tracking systems, databases, and project management tools for a portfolio of projects totaling multiple gigawatts across various development stages.

·       Monitor queue positions, withdrawal risks, restudy impacts, and queue reform implementation effects across multiple utilities and ISO/RTO markets, proactively identifying opportunities and risks.

·       Develop and maintain interconnection cost forecasts, timeline projections, and risk registers for financial modeling, budgeting, and project valuation purposes.

·       Analyze interconnection study data from customer engagement meetings, scoping meetings, and draft study reports to support informed strategic decision-making and site optimization.

·       Track regional transmission planning processes, proposed transmission projects, and policy changes that may impact interconnection feasibility or project economics.

·       Develop and implement best practices, standard operating procedures, templates, and lessons learned documentation to improve efficiency and reduce execution risk across the interconnection portfolio.

·       Create and maintain interconnection playbooks, process workflows, and training materials for internal teams to ensure consistent execution and knowledge transfer.

**Requirements**

The candidate will require exceptional written and verbal communication skills, strong technical analysis capabilities, and experience navigating multiple utilities and ISO/RTO markets. The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with ambitious growth strategies.

**Qualifications & experience:**

***Education:***

·       Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or related technical field (Master's degree preferred).

***Experience:***

·       10-15 years of hands-on experience managing transmission-level interconnection processes for utility-scale renewable energy projects.

·       Proven track record of successfully navigating interconnection queues with at least 5+ projects through to executed Interconnection Agreements.

·       Direct experience working with multiple U.S. Utilities & ISO/RTO markets.

·       Experience with solar, battery energy storage system (BESS), and large load interconnection projects.

·       Background working with IPPs, renewable energy developers, or utilities in project development roles.

***Technical Expertise:***

·       Deep understanding of FERC regulations, NERC standards, and transmission planning principles.

·       Comprehensive knowledge of Large Generator Interconnection Procedures (LGIP), Large Load Interconnection and interconnection study methodologies.

·       Proficiency in interpreting power system studies including load flow, short circuit, stability, and EMT studies.

·       Working knowledge of power systems modeling software and tools such as PSS/E, PSLF, PSCAD, PowerWorld, or TARA for reviewing and validating study results.

·       Familiarity with electrical single-line diagrams, substation design concepts, protection and control systems, and transmission system configurations.

·       Knowledge of reactive power requirements, voltage regulation, and grid code compliance for renewable generation.

***Skills & Competencies:***

·       Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

·       Strong project management capabilities with ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.

·       Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills with utilities, transmission owners, and system operators.

·       Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, project management, and CRM.

·       Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.

·       Self-motivated with ability to work independently in a remote environment.

·       Creative thinker, trying to find new ways of optimizing interconnection strategies.

·       Hands-on mentality and focus on getting things done.

·       Taking ownership and wanting to get things right.

***Preferred Qualifications:***

·       Experience with co-located or hybrid projects (solar + storage, wind + storage).

·       Familiarity with offshore wind interconnection processes.

·       Knowledge of transmission congestion, LMP pricing, and merchant transmission development.

·       Experience participating in ISO/RTO stakeholder meetings and working groups.

·       Background in power systems modeling software (PSS/E, PSCAD, PowerWorld, etc.).

·       Previous experience working for a US-based company from an India office.

In Enfinity Global you will find a very dynamic and multinational environment in one of the most exciting and impactful industries. Here we will foster your professional and personal growth, and you will have the opportunity to actively contribute and make a real impact on climate change.

**Let's build our future together.**

Visit www.enfinity.global to discover more about our culture

description:
**Job Description**
Unleash your expertise in product development and optimization by leveraging user research, analyzing metrics, and collaborating across one of the world's most innovative financial organizations.
  
  
As a Senior Product Associate in Deposits 2.0 AI Enablement, you contribute to the team by leveraging your expertise in product development and optimization to make a significant impact, supported by user research and customer feedback to fuel the creation of innovative products and continuously improve existing offerings. The AI Specialist (Associate) is a core execution role on the Deposits 2.0 AI Enablement team, a lean, hands-on function charged with accelerating product delivery with AI, making Deposits 2.0 agentic ready, and establishing the new operating model for AI ways of working. Specialists work fluidly across all of these priorities, owning workstreams and helping solve real problems that matter to Deposits 2.0. We are looking for team members with financial services domain knowledge and hands-on AI experience. Team members must be naturally curious, wildly collaborative, serious problem solvers, and beyond hard working.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Partners with the Product Manager to identify new product opportunities that reflect the needs of our customers and the market through user research and discovery

* Analyzes, tracks, and evaluates product metrics including work to time, cost, and quality targets across the product development life cycle
* Writes the requirements, epics, and user stories to support product development
* Applies AI to help solve Deposits 2.0's hardest problems, working alongside the AI Enablement team and partners across the bank to deliver practical outputs such as current and target state assessments, discovery enablement, working solutions, or knowledge base updates
* Designs and builds AI agents and skills that embed AI across the product delivery lifecycle, partnering with the Technical Lead and borrowed engineering resources, and shares what is learned so the teams' way of working improves

* Plans, tracks, and communicates progress by maintaining delivery plans, tracking value derived versus expected, prioritizing across multiple tasks and stakeholders, and raising it early when timelines or quality are at risk

* 3+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area

* Experience in product life cycle activities including discovery and requirements definition
* Developing knowledge of data analytics and data literacy

* Clear communication and ownership: confirms shared understanding early, speaks up with facts and options, keeps commitments, and owns mistakes promptly
