title: Sr. Design Evaluation Engineer
description:
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**Senior Design Evaluation Engineer**
– Automotive Networking
  
  
**Role Overview**
Analog Devices International is seeking an experienced Design Evaluation Engineer to join the Automotive Networking Evaluation team in Hyderabad, India. In this Senior technical role, you will lead the definition and execution of evaluation strategies for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs, from initial platform bring-up through system-level validation, characterisation, and release readiness. You will combine hands-on laboratory expertise with strong software development, test automation, data analysis, and technical leadership skills to deliver robust, repeatable, and high-quality evaluation solutions.
  
  
You will work closely with design, verification, applications, systems, software, and product engineering teams to identify technical risks, resolve complex issues, and ensure that silicon and supporting platforms meet product and system requirements. As a Senior Engineer, you will provide technical direction, mentor engineers, and drive improvements in evaluation methodologies, tools, and laboratory practices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Execute comprehensive evaluation strategies, test plans, coverage goals, methodologies, and release criteria for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs.
* Translate product, architecture, and system requirements into measurable laboratory tests, including functional, performance, interoperability, robustness, and corner-case evaluation.
* Develop modular, maintainable test and automation software in C and Python, including instrument control, data acquisition, regression execution, result processing, and report generation.
* Execute and analyse complex silicon and FPGA test cases; debug failures across hardware, firmware, software, interfaces, and system boundaries.
* Perform electrical and functional measurements using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, protocol analysers, signal generators, power supplies, and other laboratory equipment.
* Lead structured root-cause investigations, clearly document findings, and work with cross-functional teams to drive issues to resolution.
* Evaluate automotive Ethernet and related networking functionality, including link behaviour, data-path performance, timing, error handling, diagnostics, and interoperability.
* Develop system-level hardware, embedded software, scripts, user guides, application examples, test procedures, and technical reports that enable internal and external product evaluation.
* Review evaluation results, identify coverage gaps and technical risks, and communicate evidence-based recommendations to engineering and programme stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Four or more years of relevant experience in design evaluation, silicon validation, product engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable role.
* Demonstrated experience evaluating FPGA prototypes and performing bench validation or characterisation of ASICs.
* Strong proficiency in C and Python, with experience developing reliable test, automation, or embedded software.
* Knowledge of embedded systems, digital hardware, laboratory measurement techniques, and hardware/software integration.
* Proven ability to diagnose complex problems using structured debugging, critical thinking, root-cause analysis, and evidence-based decision-making.
* Experience capturing, processing, interpreting, and presenting technical data, with a strong focus on accuracy, repeatability, and traceability.
* Working knowledge of Ethernet and networking concepts, together with experience using serial interfaces such as SPI, I²C, and UART.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical reports and present complex findings to varied audiences.
* Demonstrated collaboration, ownership, and the ability to influence outcomes across cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications And Experience**

* Familiarity with automotive networking architectures, zonal systems, software-defined vehicles, and relevant industry standards.
* Experience with Ethernet protocol analysis, network traffic generation, performance measurement, interoperability testing, or fault injection.
* Experience developing embedded firmware for microcontrollers and integrating host-side software with evaluation hardware.
* Experience with audio and video interfaces or data paths, including PDM and RGB8.
* Familiarity with source control, continuous integration, automated regression frameworks, requirements traceability, and issue-tracking systems.

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*
*Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.*

* Identify opportunities to improve documentation quality, usability, and operational efficiency.

title: Senior SEO Executive USA Shift

1. Production support

• Manage L1/L2/L3 incidents and service requests for Veeva Vault CTMS within agreed SLAs.

• Troubleshoot user issues across studies, sites, monitoring visits, milestones and issue management.

• Investigate and resolve workflow failures, stuck tasks and access or permission issues.

• Perform root-cause analysis on repeat incidents and drive permanent fixes.

• Escalate product defects to Veeva Support and manage vendor escalations through to closure.

• Report ticket volumes, SLA performance and top issues to client stakeholders.

2. Veeva administration

• Manage users, roles, security profiles, permission sets and sharing settings in line with access SOPs.

• Maintain security configuration and support periodic user access reviews.

• Configure and maintain workflows, object and document lifecycles, document types and metadata.

• Set up and maintain notifications, picklists, page layouts and other routine configuration.

• Maintain CTMS master data such as studies, study countries, sites, milestone templates and monitoring visit templates.

3. Release management

• Review release notes for Veeva's three general releases each year and assess impact on client configuration and processes.

• Complete impact analysis and decide which new features to enable, defer or leave off.

• Test new and changed functionality in the sandbox before production.

• Run and maintain the regression test suite for core CTMS processes.

• Update validation documents and confirm production readiness with client QA and business owners.

• Communicate release changes to users before each go-live.

4. Enhancements and change requests

• Gather and analyse requirements for new workflows, fields, objects, reports and dashboards.

• Write user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications and process flows.

• Assess, estimate and prioritise change requests with client Clinical Operations.

• Configure or coordinate configuration changes, then test and deploy them through change control.

• Keep the enhancement backlog aligned with evolving business requirements.

5. Integration and data support

• Monitor integrations between CTMS and connected systems such as eTMF, EDC, IRT and data warehouses.

• Investigate failed interfaces and jobs, identify root causes and coordinate fixes.

• Troubleshoot API and integration issues with technical and vendor teams.

• Resolve data issues, run data reconciliation and perform data corrections through approved processes.

• Keep master data aligned across CTMS and connected systems.

6. Adoption, compliance and continuous improvement

• Deliver user training, onboarding and refresher sessions for CRAs, study managers and other CTMS users.

• Update SOPs, work instructions and process documentation as the system changes.

• Write and maintain knowledge articles and FAQs for users and the support team.

• Keep the system in a validated state under GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 and GAMP 5 through change control, periodic reviews and audit-trail reviews.

• Support client QA during audits and regulatory inspections.

• Monitor system adoption and usage, and recommend process and configuration improvements.

**Required qualifications**

• Degree in life sciences, pharmacy, IT or a related field.

• 3–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst on Veeva Vault CTMS.

• Hands-on experience supporting Veeva Vault CTMS in production after go-live, in an AMS or managed services setup.

• Prior experience supporting a big pharma client.

• Good understanding of clinical trial operations and ICH-GCP (E6).

• Available to join immediately and work remotely.

**Must-have skills**

• Veeva Vault CTMS functional knowledge: studies, study countries, sites, monitoring visits and trip reports, milestones, issue and protocol deviation management, enrollment tracking and trial oversight.

• Veeva Vault administration: users, roles, security profiles, permission sets, workflows, lifecycles, document types, metadata, notifications, reports and dashboards.

• Production support: L1/L2/L3 incident, problem and request management against SLAs, using ITSM tools such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management.

• Release management and testing: release impact analysis, sandbox and regression testing, test script writing and execution, defect management and UAT coordination.

• Validation (CSV): change control, URS/FRS/RTM updates and periodic review under GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 and GAMP 5, with sound Good Documentation Practice.

• Integration and data: monitoring interfaces and jobs, data reconciliation and basic API troubleshooting.

• Requirements and documentation: user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, process flows and knowledge articles.

• Stakeholder management: confident client-facing communication, training delivery and workshop facilitation.

• Ways of working: experience in Agile/Scrum teams; strong planning, organisation and follow-through on commitments.

**Good to have**

• Veeva Vault certification (CTMS, Clinical Operations or Vault Administrator).

• Exposure to the wider Veeva Clinical suite (eTMF, Study Start-Up, Site Connect, Site Payments).

• Experience with Vault Loader, data loads or Vault API.

• Experience migrating from a legacy CTMS such as Siebel.

• ITIL Foundation or a similar service management certification.

• Experience supporting regulatory inspections or client audits of a CTMS.

title: Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Functional Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
The Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Functional Analyst is a key member of the Finance Operations team supporting the Horizon Global ERP platform. This role provides Level 2 functional production support, investigates complex finance-system issues, and delivers controlled configuration changes across Oracle Fusion Financials. Working closely with Finance stakeholders, Global ERP teams, technical teams, and managed service providers, the analyst helps maintain a stable, compliant, and scalable global solution while improving the user experience and supporting evolving business needs
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide Level 2 functional support for Oracle Fusion Financials, with primary focus on General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Subledger Accounting, intercompany processing, and related finance processes.
* Investigate incidents and accounting or transaction exceptions, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate timely corrective actions with internal teams and managed service providers.
* Monitor, run, and troubleshoot scheduled processes, interfaces, data loads, and integrations that support Finance operations.
* Support month-end and year-end close activities, including issue triage and resolution of critical processing exceptions.
* Gather and analyze business requirements, complete fit-gap assessments, and translate approved needs into clear functional specifications and solution designs.
* Configure Oracle Fusion Financials and deliver controlled system changes in accordance with the global template, governance standards, security requirements, and change-management processes.
* Assess cross-functional and downstream impacts of proposed changes, including impacts to integrations, reporting, controls, and regional processes.
* Develop test scenarios and scripts; execute functional, regression, and integration testing; support user acceptance testing; and manage defects through resolution.
* Support release and deployment activities, including Oracle quarterly update impact assessments, readiness testing, and post-release validation.
* Partner with development, integration, reporting, security, quality assurance, and testing teams to deliver reliable solutions on schedule.
* Create and maintain functional designs, configuration records, process documentation, support procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Provide user guidance, knowledge transfer, and recommendations that improve business processes, system adoption, and operational performance.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications and Experience
  
  

* Three to five years of hands-on experience supporting Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials in a production environment.
* Functional knowledge of core Finance processes and Oracle Financials modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Intercompany
* Experience with Oracle configuration, Subledger Accounting, scheduled processes, approvals, period close, and financial transaction troubleshooting.
* Experience gathering requirements, preparing functional specifications, completing fit-gap analysis, and assessing end-to-end process impacts.
* Experience with incident, problem, change, release, and defect-management practices in an ERP support environment.
* Demonstrated experience with functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing.
* Ability to troubleshoot data, integration, reporting, and application issues and clearly explain findings and recommended solutions.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global, cross-functional teams and constructively challenge solutions when appropriate.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials certification in one or more relevant modules.
* Experience with Project Portfolio Management, Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Center, Oracle Integration Cloud, or file-based data imports.
* Experience supporting Oracle quarterly updates, application-managed services, and global ERP templates.
* Knowledge of financial controls, segregation of duties, audit requirements, and IT general controls.
* Experience in the architecture, engineering, and construction industry or another project-based, multi-entity environment.

Reporting and Collaboration
  
  
The Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Functional Analyst reports to the Finance Operations Lead and collaborates with Finance business partners, regional stakeholders, Quality Assurance, Solution Architects, security, development, integration and testing teams, and managed service providers. Success in this role requires clear communication, sound functional judgement, disciplined execution, and a continuous-improvement mindset.

title: Content Creator (Volunteer)
description:

**About Proximity Foundation**
Proximity Foundation runs structured coding education programs for young people aged 14-18 at Community Care Institutions (CCIs). Using a computer-based LMS curriculum covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL, we pair students with volunteer mentors in cohort-based sessions designed to build real technical skills and lasting confidence.
  
  
We are scaling from the first cohort to many cohorts within Mumbai and building the operational team that will carry this program forward. Every role in Proximity Foundation is a direct investment in the young people we serve.
  
  
**Role Type : Volunteer**
**Time Commitment : 2-3 hrs. a week**
**Department : Communication & Outreach**
**Reports to : Communication & Outreach Lead**

Supporting the content engine of Proximity Foundation. title: Associate Manager I - Reg CMC Strategy, NP CMC Support
description:
Provides functional support to the Regulatory CMC Strategist for the Annual Reports & License Renewals, Innovative Products Team, working closely with the CMC Global Regulatory Strategist – CMC (GRS‑CMC) and cross‑functional teams (RIO EH/PCO/RCM/Site CNM) to prepare and submit CMC contributions for Renewal and Annual Report applications across global markets, in line with defined timelines.
  
  
Individual Contributor – responsible for own work (requiring periodic review) under general supervision:
  
  
**Renewals CMC Responsibilities:**
Demonstrates Strong Knowledge and Understanding of Process Principles and Concepts; Activities Include, but Are Not Limited to:
  
  

* Manages day‑to‑day work activities associated with assigned renewal applications within agreed‑upon timelines; utilizes Pfizer systems (e.g., PEARL, GDMS, PDM, SPA), as appropriate.
* Develops renewal regulatory strategies while considering registered content, in collaboration with GRS‑CMC and Group Lead.
* Prepares CMC contributions for renewal applications for assigned products across global markets; authors and/or compiles renewal documentation (e.g., Module 1, Module 2.3.S/P, and Module 3.2.S/P/R/A) under the guidance of GRS‑CMC and/or Group Lead and within agreed timelines.
* Coordinates Module 1 and Module 3.2.R ancillary documents, as needed.
* Reviews technical and supporting information for submission to support renewal applications.
* Develops technical justifications for changes for agency submissions, as required.
* Supports / Author query responses and/or commitment management in collaboration with GRS‑CMC.
* Liaises with Pfizer Global Supply and other support functions, as needed.
* Reviews and applies relevant regulatory guidelines for authoring renewal documentation.
* Makes decisions to resolve minor to moderate issues in standard situations in accordance with guidance and policies; escalates complex issues and identified risks to GRS‑CMC, Group Lead, and/or appropriate leadership.
* Coordinates internal document review and sign‑off activities.
* Utilizes Pfizer systems (e.g., PEARL, GDMS, PDM, SPA) to build expertise and may begin guiding or mentoring colleagues within the Renewals and/or cross‑brand teams.
* Ensures compliance with assigned PLAs, Pfizer compliance training requirements, and Activity Tracker updates.

**Annual Report CMC Responsibilities:**

* Manages day-to-day regulatory activities associated with assigned Annual Reports within agreed upon timelines.
* Reviews changes made during the reporting period for completeness and accuracy. Develops initial Annual Report regulatory strategy while considering registered content and seeks endorsement by the GRS-CMC.
* Authors and/or compiles CMC contributions based on changes made during the appropriate reporting period, i.e. Module 1 & 3 under the guidance from the GRS-CMC as appropriate and within agreed timelines.
* Reviews all appropriate systems for post approval changes submitted and approved along with commitments made and fulfilled
* Reviews technical/supportive information for submission to support AR changes
* Manages and reviews stability contributions for accuracy and consistency with commitments
* Reviews and applies pertinent US regulatory guidelines to confirm Annual Reportable filing classifications.
* Develops technical justification of change for agency submission as needed
* Updates impacted dossier components as needed
* Coordinates M3.2.R Ancillary documents as needed
* Escalates delays in timelines and flags identified risks to the GRS-CMC and/or appropriate leadership
* Coordinates internal document review and sign off.
* Utilizes Pfizer’s CMC systems, i.e. GDMS, PDM, SPA, Veeva) etc., as appropriate.
* Ensures compliance to Pfizer internal procedures and training SOPs (PLA).

Ø
**Preferred Education:**
Minimum – Postgraduate in Pharmacy / Science Bachelors or Master (Biotechnology/ Pharmacy/ Science) or Ph. D (Biotechnology/Biological Sciences)
  
  
Ø
**Preferred Experience:**
Minimum 4-6 Years in leading independently in the Regulatory Affairs function in a reputed Pharmaceutical Organization handling new submissions and / or LCM submission to global health authorities especially USFDA, EMA and other EU authorities. Experience in CMC strategy and legislation that pertains to Biologics and Biosimilars is preferable.
  
  
Ø
**Preferred Attributes:**
Good oral and written English communication skills. Good conceptual, analytical, problem solving, and organizational skills. An assertive, take-charge, proven manager with a strong result orientation, positive “can do” attitude, and a sense of urgency to get things done. Can makes decisions to resolve moderately complex problems in standard situations. Makes decisions within guidelines, policies & procedures. Can work independently in ambiguous situations as part of a work team
  
  
Ø
**Technical Skills:**

* Regulatory requirements of post approval changes for global market.
* Oral Solid Dosage form and sterile injectable manufacturing and regulatory data requirements for submission of License Renewals.
* Knowledge in retrieving information from company’s and regulatory agency databases.

title: Senior Manager - Proposal Specialists
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Sales Enablement CoE team at Marsh. This role will be based in Mumbai. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office. Candidates must be able to work Pacific business hours (i.e., 8:00AM – 5PM IST/12:30PM – 9:30PM AEST) and may occasionally need to work beyond those hours to meet deadlines.
  
  
The Sales Enablement CoE supports various Marsh businesses worldwide primarily across Proposal & Bid Management, Client Research and Creative Services.
  
  
This role involves working with and supporting the Marsh Risk Pacific business through strategic bid management activities. Working alongside a team of bid management and client servicing professionals, you will be an integral part of supporting new business and client retention opportunities across the Pacific region.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**
The Senior Bid Manager handles responses to requests for proposal (RFPs) by coordinating teams, challenging them to effectively create value for the client/prospect, developing persuasive, client-centric content, and ensuring that the team meets deadlines. This includes:
  
  

* Taking ownership of the end-to-end project management for complex RFI/RFP submissions and high-stakes client or prospect pitches, setting clear timelines, managing cross-functional stakeholder engagement, and steering critical meetings to successful outcomes.
* Leading comprehensive analysis of RFPs and client documentation to ensure a thorough understanding of client needs, competitive landscape, and risk factors.
* Managing virtual bid teams, ensuring the right mix of skills and expertise to maximise bid success.
* Driving the development and execution of tailored win plans, ensuring all team members are aligned with client requirements and key deliverables.
* Collaborating at senior levels with commercial, delivery, legal, finance, and other stakeholders to craft compelling, differentiated client value propositions and proposal narratives that resonate with decision-makers.
* Leading strategic discussions with pursuit teams to define and refine client-centric value propositions and Marsh’s unique differentiators, influencing bid strategy.
* Overseeing the creation of persuasive executive summaries and key proposal sections that clearly articulate Marsh’s competitive advantage and “why us” messaging.
* Maintaining accountability for the integrity and version control of master proposal drafts, ensuring timely incorporation of feedback and distribution to stakeholders.
* Conducting rigorous final reviews of proposals and pitch presentations alongside senior Commercial and delivery leaders to ensure quality, compliance, and strategic alignment.
* Carrying out content management activities, including collecting and updating content for proposal database and extracting best practice content

**What you need to have:**

* Graduate in Science, Technology, Engineering, Commerce, etc.
* 12+ years experience in a pre-sales/ proposal writing, bid management environment
* Experience of working as a part of bid teams in large professional services setups
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel
* Business writing ability with strong grammar and proofreading/ editing skills
* Ability to work under pressure and adhere to tight deadlines

**What makes you stand out:**

* Professional Services experience (e.g. Insurance, Consulting, Financial Services, Accounting, Legal, etc.)
* Shipley and/or APMA course work or accreditation is highly regarded
* Experience on Commercial lifecycle and content/proposal management tools like Commercialforce, QorusDocs, Qvidian, Loopio, SharePoint etc. would be preferred
* Analytical and problem-solving skills – solution focused
* Ability to multi-task and to follow instructions, a right first-time approach
* Thrive under pressure, a team player who can support others whilst still managing individual workload

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Senior Consultant- Carbon and Net Zero
description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking a Senior Consultant to join our large and growing Carbon and Net Zero team in India (Mumbai, Bengaluru or Noida), supporting UK and global Sustainability & Climate Change projects. The successful applicant will lead the technical delivery of carbon and net zero workstreams, review and quality-assure outputs, mentor junior colleagues and work closely with project leads and clients to deliver the highest standards of technical work and support the continued success of the Sustainability Advisory business. The role is for an enthusiastic, efficient and highly organised professional with extensive experience of quantifying carbon emissions, compiling carbon footprints and advising clients on decarbonisation. The successful candidate will be driven to take on a varied and influential role in a top-tier consultancy working to address sustainability and climate change challenges.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The successful applicant would be responsible for many of the following:
  
  

* Leading and owning the end-to-end delivery of technical work (e.g. carbon management, quantification and engagement) and outputs (reports, briefing notes, carbon models) relating to climate change mitigation for clients, including scoping, methodology, delivery and quality assurance
* Leading and authoring GHG chapters as part of the consenting requirements for developments, and acting as technical reviewer for outputs prepared by others
* Advising clients on their sustainability and climate change challenges, including net zero target setting (e.g. SBTi), decarbonisation pathways and carbon reduction strategies, using best practice tools and approaches
* Day-to-day project management, including programme, budget, risks and regular updates to project leads and clients
* Mentoring, guiding and reviewing the work of Consultants and Graduates, and supporting their technical development
* Acting as a trusted point of contact for UK and global project leads and clients
* Leading the technical sections of A-class quality proposals, capability statements and strategic documents, including scope, methodology, effort estimates and pricing inputs
* Contributing to team capability building through tools, templates, methodologies and knowledge sharing, and identifying opportunities for follow-on work

**Qualifications**
**Key Competencies / Skills**
We are looking for outstanding candidates with passion and enthusiasm for confronting climate change and sustainability challenges for our clients. You will need to be a proactive individual with a helpful attitude and inquisitive nature, willingness to foster our strong team ethic, with exceptional interpersonal skills.
  
  
The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate these essential skills:
  
  

* A degree (ideally at Master's level) in sustainability, environmental science, engineering, energy, climate change or a related discipline
* Substantial, demonstrable experience in carbon management, net zero, climate change, decarbonisation, sustainability or a related field, gained in consultancy, an in-house team or another relevant organisation, at a level suited to leading workstreams independently
* Project management – planning, reviewing and delivering outcomes on time, to budget and to the expected quality
* Proven expertise in organisational and project GHG accounting, including the GHG Protocol (including Scope 3), ISO 14064 and carbon footprinting, together with carbon assurance, carbon management and climate policy
* Applied knowledge of guidance and best practice in climate change mitigation – in particular PAS 2080, whole life carbon and life cycle analysis (e.g. EN 15978) for infrastructure and energy-based projects
* Experience of setting net zero targets and developing decarbonisation trajectories
* A track record of quality assurance and technical review of carbon outputs
* Experience of leading or supervising small teams and mentoring junior colleagues
* A strong understanding of related sustainability issues and services
* Good knowledge of relevant UK and international legislation, standards, assessment methodologies and market developments, with the ability to keep abreast of and advise clients on emerging requirements
* Strong analytical, research, technical writing and presentation skills, with confident communication with colleagues and clients and experience of authoring and reviewing client deliverables
* Fully competent in conducting numerical analyses in Excel, and the production of concise, impactful written/presentation outputs to clients and the external market.

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* Carbon management, GHG accounting, Climate change, Net zero, Decarbonisation trajectory, LCA, EIA.

Desirable Skills
  
  

* SBTi, PAS 2080:2023, Whole life carbon assessment, Carbon/LCA tools (e.g. One Click LCA, SimaPro), Client management and business development, Professional membership (e.g. IEMA/PIEMA or Chartership)

BGV:

* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

**About Us**
WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than

At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
**Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**
**We are**

You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

Apply today.**

title: Human Resources Information System Specialist
description:
**Job Title: Senior Executive – HR Systems**

**Location:**
Kalina, Mumbai

**Job Type:**
Permanent

**Department:**
Human Resources

**Job Summary**
We are looking for a dynamic HRMS Functional & Technical Support professional with strong expertise in Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud to support regional and country HR operations. The role will act as a bridge between HR users, business stakeholders, and technical teams to ensure effective implementation, configuration, support, and continuous improvement of HR processes within Oracle HRMS. The ideal candidate should possess strong HR process knowledge, Oracle Fusion HCM functional expertise, reporting & analytics capabilities, awareness of emerging HR technology and AI trends, and the ability to drive digital HR transformation initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Oracle HCM Functional Support:**

* Provide end-to-end functional support for Oracle Fusion HCM modules.
* Manage day-to-day HRMS queries, issue resolution, and user support across regions and countries.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into Oracle HCM system configurations and process solutions.

**HR Process Implementation & Optimization:**

* Support implementation and rollout of HR processes, policies, and workflows in Oracle Fusion HCM for regional and country HR teams.
* Collaborate with HR stakeholders to standardize and optimize HR operations through system automation and process improvements.
* Drive SOP creation, SLA governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Stay updated with current HR technology trends, AI-driven HR solutions, and industry best practices to recommend process and system enhancements.

**AI, Digitalization & Innovation**

* Support adoption of AI-enabled HR solutions, automation tools, and digital HR initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve employee experience and HR operational efficiency through technology and analytics.
* Research and recommend current market trends, HRMS innovations, and AI capabilities relevant to HR transformation.

**System Configuration, Functional Support & Enhancements**

* Work closely with the HRMS Support Partner for configuration changes, enhancements and issue resolution.
* Support quarterly releases, system upgrades, patches, and testing activities.
* Perform system validation, UAT coordination, and defect tracking.

**Reporting, Dashboards & Analytics**

* Develop HR dashboards, MIS reports, and analytics using Oracle reporting tools, and MS Excel.
* Create management presentations and analytical insights for HR leadership and business stakeholders.
* Support HR leadership with workforce analytics, compliance reporting, and decision-making dashboards.
* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and reporting consistency.

**Stakeholder & Project Management**

* Collaborate with HR, IT, vendors, and cross-functional teams to implement enhancements and resolve system-related issues.
* Act as a project coordinator/lead for HRMS initiatives and enhancements.
* Support change management and user adoption activities across regions.

**User Training & Documentation**

* Conduct end-user training sessions and prepare user manuals, SOPs, process documents, and knowledge articles.
* Prepare presentations and training materials for business users and leadership reviews.
* Ensure effective communication and support for stakeholders across different geographies.

**Qualifications**

**Education:**
Graduate / Post Graduate in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

**Experience:**

* 2+ years of experience in Oracle Fusion HCM functional support and implementation.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and best practices.
* Experience supporting regional/global HR operations preferred.
* Strong understanding of HR business processes and HR systems.
* Exposure to digital HR transformation initiatives and AI-enabled HR solutions is preferred.

**Technical Skills:**

* Hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion HCM modules configuration and support.
* Strong knowledge of HRMS workflows, approvals, and process mapping.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Office tools.
* Proficiency in HR data reporting and data analysis to support HR metrics, reports and dashboards.
* Awareness of AI tools, HR technology trends, and automation capabilities.

**Soft Skills:**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Strong documentation and presentation preparation skills.
* Detail-oriented with high focus on quality and accuracy.
* Proactive mind set with continuous learning approach toward new technologies and market trends.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Oracle Cloud upgrades and patching.
* Knowledge of additional Oracle Cloud modules.
* Experience in a multinational or complex organizational environment.
* Exposure to AI-driven HR tools, automation platforms is an added advantage.

title: Apprentice, Operations
description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
  
  
**Overview**
  
  
We are inviting final-year and graduate students specializing in Finance, Accounting, Operations to join us as Apprentices - Operations for a 6-month apprenticeship. This program offers immersive exposure to core business functions, enabling apprentices to apply academic knowledge in a structured, professional environment. Apprentices will contribute to live projects, gain cross-functional experience, and build foundational skills for a career in corporate services.
  
This apprenticeship is ideal for students who are passionate about Business operations, eager to learn, and ready to apply their academic knowledge in a dynamic corporate environment. Through this program, apprentices will gain exposure to agile methodologies, and modern tech stacks, while also developing professional skills that will prepare them for a successful career. 
  
  
 
  
**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**
  
Strategic Focus 
  

* Support business initiatives that align with organizational goals across Finance and Operations.
* Participate in data analysis and reporting to support strategic decision-making.
* Contribute to process improvement and automation efforts within assigned functions.

  
Operational Management 
  

* Assist in fund accounting tasks such as NAV calculations, reconciliations, and audit support.
* Support finance operations including invoice processing, expense tracking, and financial reporting.
* Maintain documentation, trackers, and dashboards for internal process monitoring and compliance.

  
People Leadership 
  

* Collaborate with team members and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve project goals.
* Demonstrate initiative, ownership, and a learning mindset in day-to-day tasks.
* Participate in team meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and internal workshops.
* Exhibit professionalism, curiosity, and a growth mindset in all interactions.

  
Governance & Risk 
  

* Adhere to internal controls, compliance standards, and data privacy protocols.
* Ensure accuracy and integrity in financial documentation.
* Escalate risks or discrepancies in operational processes to relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain confidentiality and integrity of business information and systems.

  
The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.
  
  
 
  
**Experience & Personal Attributes**
  

* Experience
* Final year and Graduates with exposure to core business functions including fund accounting, finance operations and corporate governance.
* Hands-on learning in tools such as Excel, ERP systems and reporting dashboards.
* Development of workplace skills including communication, collaboration, and analytical thinking.

  
Personal Attributes
  

* Curiosity and eagerness to learn across diverse business domains.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality in execution.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative mindset.

title: Quality Manager
description:
HERE Technologies is a location data and technology platform company. We empower our customers to achieve better outcomes – from helping a city manage its infrastructure or a business optimize its assets to guiding drivers to their destination safely.

At HERE we take it upon ourselves to be the change we wish to see. We create solutions that fuel innovation, provide opportunity and foster inclusion to improve people’s lives. If you are inspired by an open world and driven to create positive change, join us. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel.

As a
**Quality Manager**
within Platform & Technology, you will be a pivotal leader driving product and process excellence, compliance, and continuous operational improvement. Operating at the intersection of
**Quality Management Systems (QMS)**
and
**advanced problem-solving**
, you will embed risk-based thinking across engineering, data, and delivery pipelines. You will lead cross-functional initiatives to institutionalize standardized quality control frameworks, oversee global certification audits, conduct rigorous root cause investigations, and deploy scalable preventive actions that eliminate defect recurrence and elevate customer satisfaction.

**What’s the Role?**

In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-divisional stakeholders across the organization—including Engineering, Product Management, Operations, and Customer-facing teams—to align and govern end-to-end processes and operating models. You will act as the principal authority on quality standards and operational reliability, serving as both a strategic governance lead and a hands-on problem solver.

From facilitating high-stakes internal and third-party ISO audits to leading multi-stakeholder task forces during critical quality escapes, you will provide the strategic direction and technical rigor needed to protect product integrity and foster a culture of quality ownership across global, distributed teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Process Improvement & Re-engineering:**
  Apply advanced analytical techniques, Lean Six Sigma methodologies, and Agile practices to identify bottlenecks, eliminate waste, and optimize delivery workflows for enhanced efficiency and throughput.
* **ISO Audits & QMS Governance:**
  Plan, facilitate, and lead internal quality assessments and external
  **ISO 9001**
  surveillance/recertification audits; establish, harmonize, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and quality manuals across global sites.
* **Strategic Quality Leadership:**
  Support and drive quality governance at both local and global levels; benchmark organizational practices against industry maturity frameworks (e.g.,
  **CMMI, ASPICE, EFQM, Malcolm Baldrige**
  ).
* **Advanced Problem Solving & RCA:**
  Lead cross-functional teams through complex defect escapes, customer incidents, and pipeline anomalies using structured methodologies (
  **8D, DMAIC, 5 Whys, Fishbone / Ishikawa**
  ).
* **Closed-Loop Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA):**
  Drive the end-to-end execution, tracking, and post-implementation validation of CAPA initiatives, monitoring long-term trends to ensure systemic recurrence prevention.
* **Quality Analytics & Statistical Process Control (SPC):**
  Define, monitor, and report key quality performance indicators (KPIs, SLAs, Cost of Poor Quality); utilize statistical process control tools to monitor process capability (SPC) and variation.
* **Cultural Transformation & Risk Management:**
  Institutionalize a proactive culture of Risk-Based Thinking across the business unit, integrating proactive risk assessments (e.g.,
  **FMEA**
  ) into project lifecycles and release pipelines.
* **Global Team & Stakeholder Leadership:**
  Lead and mentor global quality professionals, providing strategic vision, coaching on quality tools, and aligning cross-functional teams without formal authority.

**Key Qualifications and Skills:**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Quality Management, or a related technical discipline.
* **Experience:**
  **10+ years**
  of total professional experience in quality assurance, process engineering, or operational excellence, including
  **7–8+ years**
  of specialized experience in QMS governance and structured problem solving.
* **Certifications:**
* **ISO 9001 Lead Auditor Certification**
  is
  **required**
  .
* **Lean Six Sigma Green Belt**
  is required (
  **Black Belt**
  is a significant advantage).
* Certifications/experience in
  **CMMI**
  ,
  **ASPICE**
  , or
  **EFQM / Malcolm Baldrige**
  Business Excellence models are highly valued.
* **Problem Solving & Quality Tools:**
  Demonstrated mastery of structured root cause analysis (8D, DMAIC, Fishbone, 5 Whys) and risk mitigation tools (
  **FMEA**
  , Hazard & Risk Analysis).
* **Statistical & Analytical Acumen:**
  Hands-on experience implementing Quality Assurance metrics, Statistical Process Control (
  **SPC**
  ), control charting, and data-driven trend analysis.
* **Agile & Change Management:**
  Proven track record of managing organizational change and driving quality practices within Agile/DevOps and continuous integration environments.
* **Domain Knowledge (Advantage):**
  Domain expertise in
  **GIS / Digital Mapping, Spatial Data pipelines, Automotive OEM data workflows, or large-scale data platform ingestion**
  is a strong plus.
* **Tooling Proficiency:**
  Strong working familiarity with collaboration and analytics platforms such as
  **Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Tableau / Power BI**
  , and statistical tools (e.g., Minitab, Excel analytics).
* **Communication & Influence:**
  Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, and facilitation skills with the ability to influence cross-functional technical teams and present insights to senior leadership.

HERE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

title: Copywriter
description:
**Location: Andheri East, Mumbai**

**Company Description**
The Pain Company creates effective, user-focused products that help reduce pain and improve daily life. The team combines research, design, and innovation to address real human challenges with practical solutions. Joining the company means contributing to work that has a direct, positive impact on people’s well-being. The organization values clear communication, empathy, and thoughtful storytelling around its mission and products.

**Role Description**
The Copywriter will be responsible for developing clear, compelling copy for product descriptions, marketing campaigns, press materials, websites, and other brand touchpoints. Day-to-day tasks include researching product and customer insights, writing and refining messaging, collaborating with marketing and design teams, and ensuring consistency with brand voice across channels. The role involves proofreading and editing content to maintain high quality and accuracy. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Mumbai.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Writing skills for marketing materials, product copy, and brand storytelling
* Ability to craft and manage Press Releases and related external communications
* Excellent Communication skills for collaboration with cross-functional teams and stakeholders
* Attention to detail in Proofreading and editing to ensure error-free, polished content
* Marketing knowledge to align copy with campaign objectives and audience needs
* Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, English, or a related field
* Experience in consumer products or health and wellness sectors is an advantage
* Capacity to work on-site in Mumbai, manage deadlines, and handle multiple projects

title: Senior Medical Writer
description:
**Overview**
Cactus Life Sciences is a remote-first organization, and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
  
  
If you are looking for challenging and rewarding work which combines your understanding of medical science and aptitude for writing into one unique job, the
**Senior Medical Writer-Medical Information**
role is for you. This is an opportunity to grow your career and make a greater impact on the lives around you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Taking ownership and responsibility for development (write, review, proofread, and data-check) of high-quality, client-ready scientific, medical, and educational materials like slides, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, MSL/training slide decks, infographics, congress and meetings materials, literature searches and reviews, standard response letters/medical information letters, and HCP engagement content according to client and audience needs with excellent attention to detail.
* Actively involve in reviewing materials developed by scientific writers to ensure strategic alignment and scientific accuracy as needed and providing clear constructive feedback, support, and supervision to writers. Mentor and train scientific writers by sharing best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the team.
* Having excellent knowledge of product/account to enable meaningful interactions with clients and authors, including consultancy where necessary.
* Building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with international pharmaceutical clients, healthcare professionals, and key stakeholders, including authors, reviewers, and KOLs across therapeutic areas. This involves anticipating client needs, advising on strategic and tactical plans, and recommending improvements to scientific content and new ways to disseminate data effectively.
* Attend workshops/seminars/trainings to hone your skills and contribute to organizational objectives. Attending client and other external meetings and supporting senior team members as needed.
* Apply your scientific and creative knowledge and work closely with client directors in developing ideas and executing effective medical communications initiatives in the digital space, including publication extenders, creation of infographics, interactive assets, website content, patient narratives, and medical information engagement plans. Also, supporting with the development of visual content and materials using effective data visualization techniques and approaches. Contributing to innovative “out of the box” solutions for medical writing projects.
* You will be responsible for ensuring all materials follow/comply with client requirements/SOPs, style guides, client templates, client preferences (as applicable), and CACTUS’ internal SOPs. Any updates to either of these items should be made consistently and documents should remain up to date.
* Perform as a document specialist, provide intellectual input across document types, and contribute to making cutting-edge research accessible to specific audiences as appropriate, by maintaining current awareness of developments across therapeutic areas or disciplines.
* Supporting with pitches, both during the preparation phase and the actual pitch.

**Qualifications And Prerequisites**

* 3-5 year of experience in relevant fields of scientific writing.
* PhD/MD (Pharmacology) OR PhD (Life Sciences) OR PharmD OR M.Pharm/M.Sc with a good understanding of clinical research and medical communication.
* Preferrable to have some experience working on Global Medical Value (GMV) Dossiers.
* Clear, concise, scientific style of writing, with a high level of attention to detail and excellent language skills.
* Ability to adapt writing style to different materials and target audiences.
* Basic knowledge of biostatistics.
* Literature reviewing and evaluation capabilities.
* Very good working knowledge of MS Office.

Application Process
  
  
Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, the process starts with a
**Technical Interview**
with the Hiring Managers, followed by a
**Technical Assessment,**
where candidates will have agreed upon timeline to complete the task. The final round will be the
**HR Interview.**
All interactions will be conducted virtually via
**MS Teams.**
**AI at Cactus Life Sciences**
The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.
  
  
AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.
  
  
We believe in Human-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline - science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.
  
  
You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
  
  
**About CACTUS**
At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

title: Medical Writer
description:
**Job Title**
**Medical Writer**
**Business Unit**
MACR
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you
**“Create your own sunshine”**
— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.
  
  
Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?
  
  
As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”
  
  
**Job Summery**
A Team member of the Trademark department contributes to the execution of trademark-related tasks under the supervision of the Head of Trademark and the Lead Trademark. This role involves supporting brand clearance, prosecution, new brand registration, trademark renewal, litigation, and domain name misuse activities. The team member plays a proactive role during outdoor seizure operations in case of misuse of a brand logo by Infringer.
  
  
**Your Tasks And Responsibilities**

* Develop and update process documents, SOPs and trackers for Medical Writing Function
* Prepare, review and edit clinical trial protocols, investigator’s brochure (IB), Case Report Form (CRF), Informed Consent Document (ICD) and Patient diaries (if applicable)
* Prepare, review and edit Clinical Study Report (CSR), executive summary and study-specific logs
* Ensure all study documents like protocol, ICD, CRF, patient diaries & CSRs are prepared in alignment with ICH-GCP, CDSCO guidelines and all applicable regulatory guidelines
* Conduct quality check (QC) of protocols, protocol amendments, CRF, ICD, CSR and other relevant documents
* Lead review cycles of documents with respective stakeholders for timely completion
* Finalize publication plan for each manuscript in coordination with respective medical affairs personnel
* Prepare and review manuscripts – original research articles, review articles, meta-analyses, consensus / expert opinion, abstracts, posters and other relevant documents, in alignment with IJCME, GPP3 and any other relevant guidelines
* Work cohesively with internal stakeholders including Clinical research team, Medical Affairs team, business team, regulatory affairs, legal team, compliance team and project specific other functions
* Strong coordination with external stakeholders including investigators, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) authors, Biostatisticians, Data management team & medical association office bearers
* Vendor management for Medical writing vendors, in accordance with Sun Pharma policies and procedures.
* Ensure execution of MSAs, project contracts, and invoice management
* Clinical Study Protocol
* Clinical Study Report
* Inform Consent Document
* Abstract Preparation
* Manuscripts - Reviewing & Writing
* Publications and Index Medical Journals
* Research Article, Review Article and Meta Analysis
* Overall Project and Budget Management

**Who You Are**

* Preferably Pharmacy post-graduate /graduate
* Formal training in Medical Writing will be value add
* Well versed with IJCME, GPP3, STROBE, CONSORT, STARD, CARE guidelines and PRISMA statement
* Experience of medical writing for complex publications (e.g. Meta-analysis, consensus, guidelines) with successful outcome will be of added advantage
* Experience in publications in indexed journals
* Training in clinical trial methodologies, research design and ICH – GCP & publication guidelines
* Relevant knowledge of Drugs and Cosmetic Act regulations pertaining to clinical trials and new drug approvals
* Strong academic record with knowledge of research methodologies & publication processes for different type of publications

**Job Requirements**
**Educational Qualification**
Bachelor's or Master's degree in a field related to Science, Healthcare, Clinical Research or Life Sciences like Biology, Pharmacology, Nursing, or a related discipline, and/or Post-graduate in Clinical Research.
  
  
**Experience**
3-5 years’ experience in a CRO/Pharma/Biotech organization in Medical Writing for interventional and non-interventional studies
  
  
**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS/WORKING CONDITIONS**
The role is majority office based but will involve an average 8 to 10 days of travel outside Mumbai.

title: Gid Now-SAP ISU FICA-Senior

* To provide functional knowledge with hands-on experience in electricity, gas and water utilities.

* Drive Business Workshops, Blueprint Sessions, develop BBPs/BBDs FS, Test Scenarios, conduct Trainings, perform Testing and provide defect management support for Device Management module
* Design core / customized business processes and provide best practices for ISU.
* Communicate complex requirements to and from Technical and Non-technical stakeholders
* Willing to travel as per requirement

* Strong knowledge of month-end and period-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.

* Define test scenarios to cover full scope of the business as well as creating master data and carry out the unit, cycle and integration tests

* Must have completed multiple SAP projects and have excellent communication skills
* Confidence working within an offshore/onshore delivery model
* Proven expedience large stream of work across multiple locations
* Consulting experience advantageous
* Strong hands-on experience on FI-CA concepts:

+ Company Code Setup
+ Chart of Accounts and GL setup
+ Main / Sub Transaction Setup
+ Security Deposit Process
+ Incoming Payments (Real Time, Direct Debit, Cash Desk, etc)
+ Outgoing Payments and Returns
+ Collection process using Collection Strategy
+ Collection Agency related process
+ Transfer Posting process
+ Escheatment process

* Strong knowledge of month-end and period-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Implementation experience of BRF Plus.
* Experience and knowledge of using middleware technology to integrate SAP with third party systems for payments, collection agencies, etc
* Experience in data migration.
* Can work under minimum supervision, good time management and work planning

* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 5 to 8 years of experience in a functional role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* Prior SAP BRIM CI role is a must
* Should have worked on minimum 1 implementation from scratch as a lead consultant.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience on integration with third-party applications
* Knowledge of integration with SAP RAR, BRIM CI/SOM/CM
* Hands on experience in SAP S4 HANA Platform
* Experience on tools like JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* SAP Utilities certifications are a plus:
* Certification in SAP FICA (IUT240 / AC240 / BR240)
* Certifications in SAP BRIM Convergent Invoicing (AC245 / BR245)

**Technologies and Tools**

* SAP FI-CA / FI-CAX
* SAP FIORI
* Jira or similar tools
* Azure DevOps or similar tools

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Utilities practices globally with leading businesses across a range of geographies

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manufacturing Digital Initiatives
description:
**Job Title**
**Senior Manager - Manufacturing Digital Initiatives**
**Business Unit**
SUN Global Operations
  
  
**Job Grade**
G9A
  
  
**Location :**
Mumbai/Baroda
  
  
At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you “Create your own sunshine”— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.
  
  
**Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?**
As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”
  
  
We are seeking a seasoned professional to lead certain digital transformation initiatives across our pharmaceutical manufacturing plant. The incumbent will be responsible for identifying, designing, implementing, and scaling digital solutions that improve operational efficiency, compliance, traceability, and user productivity across manufacturing and plant support functions.
  
  
This role will play a key part in driving ownership and continuous improvement of core manufacturing digital systems at Sun Pharma — SAP (PP, MM /WM ,PM modules) along with digitizing paper-based and manual workflows such as eLogbook, Permit to Work, electronic checklists, line clearance, cleaning and equipment usage records, shift handovers, and related GMP workflows. The role requires close collaboration with Manufacturing, QA, Engineering, EHS, IT, CSV/Validation, and external technology partners to ensure solutions are compliant, practical, scalable, and well adopted by end users.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Digital Initiative Identification and Prioritization**

* Identify opportunities to digitize manual, paper-based, and spreadsheet-driven plant workflows.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize initiatives based on business value, compliance impact, feasibility, and scalability.
* Develop and maintain a roadmap for plant digital initiatives.

**Business Process Mapping and Solution Design**

* Understand current-state processes across manufacturing and plant support functions.
* Map process flows, pain points, control points, approval requirements, and compliance dependencies.
* Translate business requirements into digital workflow requirements, use cases, and functional specifications.
* Ensure workflow simplification and standardization prior to digitization wherever necessary.

**Project Delivery and Implementation**

* Lead end-to-end implementation of plant digital solutions from concept through rollout.
* Coordinate with IT, automation, validation, quality, operations, and vendors for design, build, testing, deployment, and support.
* Manage project scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, governance, and stakeholder communication.
* Support pilot deployment, phased rollout, and post-implementation stabilization.

**Compliance and Validation Support**

* Ensure all digital initiatives align with GMP, data integrity, and electronic records requirements.
* Work with QA and validation teams to support URS, risk assessments, test scripts, UAT, SOP updates, training records, change controls, and validation documentation.
* Ensure solutions are audit-ready and support sustainable compliance with applicable regulations and internal standards.

**Change Management and User Adoption**

* Drive user adoption through structured training, communication, and change management.
* Engage with end users on the shopfloor to ensure solutions are practical and fit for purpose.
* Monitor usage, adoption barriers, and user feedback, and drive corrective actions where required.
* Build a digital-first culture within plant operations through effective engagement and problem-solving.

Performance Monitoring and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Define and track KPIs for implemented digital solutions.
* Measure impact in terms of compliance, productivity, turnaround times, reduction in paperwork, reduction in manual errors, and user adoption.
* Identify and drive continuous improvement opportunities post deployment.

**Scope of Work**

* Typical initiatives may include SAP related improvements along with eLogbook implementation, digital Permit to Work workflows, electronic checklists and approvals, digital line clearance records, shift handover digitization, equipment usage and cleaning workflow digitization, maintenance and utility workflow digitization, exception capture and escalation workflows, and other plant digital use cases supporting manufacturing effectiveness and compliance.

**Travel Estimate**
30-40% of time
  
  
**Job Requirements**
**Educational Qualification**
Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy, Engineering, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  
  

* Strongly Preferred (But Not Mandatory)

**Postgraduate Qualification Such As**

* M.Tech / MS (Pharma, Chemical, Industrial, Manufacturing)
* MBA / PGDM (Operations, Supply Chain, or Systems)

**Experience**
**Must-Have:**

* Knowledge on SAP Production related modules - SAP PP/MM/ WM
* Relevant experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, manufacturing IT, digital transformation, plant systems, automation, or operations excellence.
* Experience in digitizing manufacturing or plant support workflows preferred.
* Experience working in cross-functional roles involving plant operations, quality, IT, and vendors
* Strong process mapping, business analysis, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good project management and implementation skills.
* Strong communication, training, and change management capability.
* Familiar with GXP regulations for Pharmaceutical Drug formulation plants.
* Ability to create best practices for batch execution and documentation.

**Good-to-Have**

* Experience with EBR/MES rollouts.
* Knowledge of OT/automation systems.
* Lean Six Sigma certification.
* Prior experience in large-scale process harmonization
* Experience with low-code/no-code applications, or plant digital tools.

Tenure : 10+ years of experience
