title: BPM Automation Specialist – Pega, Power Platform, Camunda & AI
description:
****Job Summary****
Synechron is seeking a BPM, Low-Code Automation and AI Specialist with experience across
**Pega, Microsoft Power Platform, Camunda and AI-enabled process automation**
. The role is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, maintaining and supporting business process management solutions that improve operational efficiency and meet business requirements.The position will work with cross-functional teams to understand business processes, identify automation opportunities and deliver workflow-based solutions. The successful candidate will contribute to business objectives by streamlining operations, supporting reliable BPM platforms, improving process quality and enabling measurable automation outcomes.
  
  
****Software Requirements****
**Required Software Skills**

* Business Process Management software: Knowledge of BPM platforms such as Pega, Appian and IBM BPM. Experience with BPM software should be demonstrated through relevant project delivery.
* Pega: Practical experience designing, developing or supporting Pega-based BPM solutions. Experience level should align with the requirement of at least three years in BPM and process automation.
* Workflow design and modeling: Experience with workflow design and modeling tools such as Microsoft Visio and BPMN.
* Programming languages: Strong programming or scripting capability in one or more of Java, JavaScript and Python, with the ability to apply these languages to integration, automation, validation or support activities.
* Database systems: Working knowledge of Oracle and SQL Server, including data access, queries, troubleshooting and support activities.
* Process automation platforms: Experience with workflow and process automation concepts relevant to Microsoft Power Platform and Camunda, where applicable to project responsibilities.

****Preferred Software Skills****

* Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate, Power Apps or related platform capabilities.
* Experience with Camunda and BPMN-based process orchestration.
* Experience applying AI capabilities to process automation, workflow optimization, decision support or operational use cases.
* Professional certification in BPM software or a related process automation platform.
* Experience working with multiple BPM platforms, including Pega, Appian, IBM BPM, Power Platform or Camunda.
* Familiarity with version-controlled development and release practices for BPM solutions.

*Specific product versions are not prescribed in the requirements. Candidates should demonstrate hands-on experience with versions used in recent enterprise projects and the ability to adapt to platform upgrades.*
****Overall Responsibilities****

* Design and develop BPM solutions that meet documented business and technical requirements.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand current-state and future-state business processes.
* Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and improve business operations.
* Develop and implement process workflows, models and rules using appropriate BPM, low-code and orchestration technologies.
* Apply BPMN and workflow modeling practices to document process logic and process dependencies.
* Integrate BPM solutions with databases, applications and supporting services where required.
* Maintain and support BPM systems, including software upgrades, configuration changes, performance improvements and bug fixing.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting for BPM systems and related integrations.
* Participate in testing, quality assurance, defect resolution and release activities for BPM solutions.
* Communicate technical concepts, process impacts, risks and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Contribute to the responsible use of AI and automation by considering data quality, traceability, security, maintainability and human oversight.
* Support efficient digital processes that reduce unnecessary manual work, rework and paper-based activity where applicable.

**Strategic Objectives**

* Deliver maintainable BPM and automation solutions aligned with business requirements.
* Improve process efficiency, consistency, visibility and operational supportability.
* Promote reusable workflow patterns, clear process documentation and effective quality controls.
* Contribute to successful project delivery through effective collaboration, testing and technical support.

**Performance Outcomes and Expectations**

* BPM solutions are delivered in accordance with approved requirements, design standards and project timelines.
* Workflows and process models are documented, tested and maintainable.
* Defects and production issues are investigated and resolved within agreed support expectations.
* Automation opportunities are assessed using measurable business and operational benefits.
* Stakeholders receive clear updates regarding progress, risks, decisions and dependencies.
* Solutions support appropriate security, data management, sustainability and quality practices.

****Technical Skills (By Category)****

* Programming Languages

****Essential****

* Practical programming or scripting experience using Java, JavaScript or Python.
* Ability to understand existing code, develop application logic and troubleshoot technical issues.
* Ability to use programming skills for workflow automation, integrations, data processing, validation or support activities.

****Preferred****

* Experience using more than one of Java, JavaScript and Python.
* Experience developing custom components, connectors, APIs or automation scripts for BPM platforms.
* Experience applying Python or other programming languages to AI-enabled process automation use cases.
* Databases and Data Management

****Essential****

* Working knowledge of Oracle and SQL Server.
* Ability to write or interpret SQL queries for data retrieval, validation and troubleshooting.
* Understanding of data relationships, data quality and the impact of data changes on process execution.
* Ability to investigate data-related issues affecting BPM solutions.

****Preferred****

* Experience supporting data integrations between BPM platforms and enterprise databases.
* Knowledge of data mapping, transformation and reconciliation.
* Experience applying data governance and data quality practices to automation solutions.
* Cloud Technologies

****Essential****

* Ability to understand the deployment, integration and support considerations of BPM solutions in the relevant project environment.

****Preferred****

* Experience deploying or supporting BPM, low-code or AI solutions in cloud environments.
* Familiarity with cloud-based integration, monitoring, identity and environment management.
* Experience supporting platform upgrades or migration activities in cloud or hybrid environments.
* Frameworks and Libraries

****Essential****

* Working knowledge of BPM concepts, process automation principles and workflow implementation.
* Experience with BPMN for process modeling.
* Ability to work with platform-specific frameworks and configuration capabilities within BPM tools.

****Preferred****

* Experience with Pega, Microsoft Power Platform and Camunda.
* Experience with API integration frameworks, reusable automation components or orchestration patterns.
* Familiarity with AI and machine learning libraries or services used for process automation, where relevant to the role.
* Development Tools and Methodologies

****Essential****

* Experience with workflow design and modeling tools such as Microsoft Visio and BPMN.
* Understanding of software development, testing, defect management and release processes.
* Ability to participate in quality assurance and technical documentation activities.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.

****Preferred****

* Experience with Agile or other structured delivery methodologies.
* Familiarity with source control, continuous integration and deployment practices.
* Experience with application monitoring, logging, incident management and performance troubleshooting.
* Experience using process discovery, process analysis or automation assessment techniques.
* Security Protocols

****Essential****

* Ability to follow applicable security, access control, data protection and environment management requirements.
* Understanding of secure handling of business and process data.
* Ability to identify and escalate security, privacy or access-related risks.

****Preferred****

* Experience implementing role-based access controls within BPM or low-code platforms.
* Familiarity with secure API integration, authentication and authorization practices.
* Experience considering privacy, explainability, auditability and human oversight when applying AI to business processes.

****Experience Requirements****

* At least 3 of experience in BPM and process automation.
* Proven track record of delivering BPM projects from requirements analysis through development, testing, implementation and support.
* Experience designing and developing BPM solutions that address documented business requirements.
* Experience creating process workflows and models using BPMN or comparable workflow modeling practices.
* Experience collaborating with business, technology, operations, quality assurance and support teams.
* Experience maintaining BPM systems, performing software upgrades, resolving defects and providing technical troubleshooting.
* Experience working with Java, JavaScript or Python and with Oracle or SQL Server.
* Experience with Pega, Power Platform, Camunda or comparable BPM and process automation technologies is relevant to the role.
* Experience in financial services, insurance, banking or another regulated industry is preferred but is not required where candidates can demonstrate equivalent BPM project delivery.
* Alternative pathways may include substantial hands-on experience delivering process automation solutions, technical implementation experience with low-code or BPM platforms, or equivalent professional training in place of a directly related degree.

**Day-to-Day Activities**

* Design and develop BPM solutions, process workflows and models using appropriate BPM, low-code, orchestration and integration technologies.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams through process discussions, requirements sessions, design reviews, technical meetings and delivery planning.
* Produce process models, technical documentation, configured solutions, test evidence, defect fixes and implementation deliverables for assigned projects.
* Make technical decisions within assigned responsibilities, escalate risks and dependencies appropriately, and provide ongoing BPM support, troubleshooting and quality assurance.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business Administration or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
* At least three years of experience in BPM and process automation, with evidence of delivering BPM projects.
* Professional certification in BPM software or a related automation platform is preferred but not required.
* Training in BPM concepts, BPMN, workflow design, programming, databases or relevant automation technologies is preferred.
* Ongoing professional development is expected to maintain current knowledge of Pega, Power Platform, Camunda, AI-enabled automation, development practices and applicable technical standards.

**Professional Competencies**

* Critical thinking and problem-solving: Analyze business and technical issues, identify root causes, evaluate options and implement practical solutions.
* Leadership and teamwork: Contribute effectively to team outcomes, take ownership of assigned work and support knowledge sharing without requiring formal people-management responsibility.
* Communication and stakeholder management: Explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and maintain accurate, timely communication with project teams.
* Adaptability and learning orientation: Respond constructively to changing requirements, platform updates and new technologies while maintaining delivery quality.
* Innovation mindset: Identify appropriate opportunities to improve processes through automation, workflow optimization and responsible use of AI.
* Time and priority management: Organize competing tasks, meet agreed commitments, manage dependencies and escalate delivery risks early.

****Soft Skills****

title: Senior Medical Writer- Publications
description:
**Overview**
Cactus Life Sciences partners with global biopharma to drive innovation and improve patient outcomes through agile, science-driven medical communications — transforming complex data into actionable insights.
  
  
Please note: We are a remote-first organization, and we embrace an "accelerate from anywhere culture". You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Use scientific expertise to develop (write, proofread, and data-check) high-quality, client-ready scientific, medical, and educational materials like slides, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, congress and meetings materials, and literature searches and reviews according to client needs with excellent attention to detail under the guidance of the scientific leads.
* Actively involve in reviewing materials developed by scientific writers to ensure strategic alignment and scientific accuracy as needed and provide clear constructive feedback, support, and supervision to writers. Mentor and train scientific writers by sharing best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the team.
* Perform as a document specialist, provide intellectual input across document types, and contribute to making cutting-edge research accessible to specific audiences as appropriate, by maintaining current awareness of developments across therapeutic areas or disciplines.
* Liaise and build trusting and professional relationships with international pharmaceutical clients, healthcare professionals, internal and external stakeholders, including authors, reviewers, and key opinion leaders across therapeutic areas - learning to anticipate their needs.
* Effectively and proactively communicate with team members, authors/faculty, clients, and vendors.
* Attend workshops/seminars/trainings to hone your skills and contribute to organizational objectives.
* Attend client and other external meetings and support senior team members as needed.
* Apply your scientific and creative knowledge and work closely with client directors in developing ideas and executing effective medical communications initiatives in the digital space, including publication extenders, creation of infographics, interactive assets, website content, patient narratives, and medical information engagement plans.
* Ensure all materials follow/comply with client requirements/SOPs, style guides, client templates, client preferences (as applicable), and CACTUS’ internal SOPs. Any updates to either of these items should be made consistently and documents should remain up to date.
* Share best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the medical communications team.

**Qualifications And Prerequisites**

* 4+ years of experience in publications within a pharma company or medical communications agency.
* PhD/MD (Pharmacology) OR PhD (Life Sciences) OR PharmD with a good understanding of clinical research and medical communication.
* Clear, concise, scientific style of writing, with a high level of attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Ability to adapt writing style to suit different materials and target audiences.
* Literature reviewing and evaluation capabilities.
* Very good working knowledge of MS Office and basic knowledge of biostatistics.
* Shows an eagerness to learn and apply AI tools and technologies.

Application Process
  
  
Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process includes two Technical Interviews with the Hiring Manager and peers, and a Technical Assessment, where candidates will have agreed upon timeline to complete the task. The final round will be the HR Interview. All interactions will be conducted virtually via MS Teams.
  
  
**AI at Cactus Life Sciences**
The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.
  
  
AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.
  
  
We believe in Human-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline - science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.
  
  
You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
  
  
**About CACTUS**
At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

title: Program Manager
description:
**About Servify:**

Servify is a global product lifecycle management platform transforming the after-sales service experience. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in India, Servify connects leading OEM brands with their sales and service ecosystems to deliver seamless customer support and service operations. Servify partners with leading brands, retailers, distributors, insurers, service providers, and carriers across Asia, North America, Europe, and the MENA region.

Servify embraces and values diversity and is committed to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all members and will give equal consideration to all irrespective of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief.

**Why Join Servify?**

At Servify, you'll be part of a fast-growing global technology company that encourages innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. We offer competitive compensation, ESOPs, employee-friendly policies, modern collaboration tools, professional development opportunities, and benefits that help you do your best work.

**Position Summary:**

The Program Manager will work with business, technology, operations and other cross-functional teams to implement and manage partner programs from initial planning through go-live and stabilisation. The role combines cross-functional program management with hands-on technical implementation, including program setup, configuration and leading integrations with clients and partners. It also involves supporting new business opportunities, improving operational processes through AI and automation, and ensuring the smooth functioning and continued improvement of existing programs. This is a global role, offering the opportunity to work with clients and partners across India, the Middle East, Europe and the United States, gaining exposure to diverse markets, business models and program requirements.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **New Business and Program Planning:**
  Support Business and Account Management teams in understanding partner requirements, defining implementation scope and preparing inputs for proposals, business cases and program plans.
* **Program Implementation:**
  Drive end-to-end program implementation, coordinating timelines, deliverables, dependencies and readiness across Legal, Finance, Product, Technology, Operations, Customer Support and Marketing.
* **Technical Program Setup:**
  Own the technical setup and configuration of new programs on Servify's platform, including program-specific parameters, business rules, workflows, product configurations and integration requirements. Work with Product and Engineering teams where development or platform changes are needed.
* **Partner Integrations:**
  Lead API integrations with clients and partners, from understanding technical requirements and API specifications to coordinating configuration, data mapping, testing, UAT, issue resolution and production rollout.
* **Go-Live Readiness:**
  Track and drive activities from program initiation through launch and initial stabilisation, identifying gaps, resolving blockers and ensuring teams are ready for go-live.
* **Integration Monitoring and Issue Resolution:**
  Monitor partner APIs and transaction flows through available dashboards, logs and monitoring tools. Identify failures, investigate issues and coordinate resolution with the relevant teams.
* **Existing Program Management:**
  Support live programs through operational follow-ups, issue resolution, performance reviews and implementation of enhancements or changes requested by partners.
* **Turnkey Program Solutions:**
  Support the implementation of turnkey solutions for larger partner programs involving multiple systems, processes, integrations, operational workflows and external stakeholders.
* **AI and Process Automation:**
  Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to simplify recurring operational activities, improve monitoring and reporting, and reduce manual effort in managing programs.
* **Stakeholder Coordination and Reporting:**
  Maintain clear communication with internal and external stakeholders, track action items and risks, and provide regular updates on progress, issues and next steps.

**Requirements :**

* 2–5 years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, Technical Implementations, Partner Integrations or a similar role.
* Experience managing cross-functional implementations involving multiple teams, stakeholders and dependencies.
* Hands-on experience in system or program configuration, with a practical understanding of business rules, workflows and technical setup requirements.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, API documentation, request/response structures, data mapping, testing and troubleshooting. Experience driving partner integrations is preferred.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through on commitments.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with a practical approach to identifying issues and getting them resolved.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
* Willingness to learn and use AI tools and automation to improve day-to-day program operations.
* Based in Mumbai and available to work from the office five days a week.

**Good to Have:**

* Hands-on experience using AI tools to prototype solutions, build workflows and create automations across different applications.
* Experience with API testing and monitoring tools such as Postman, log monitoring dashboards or basic SQL.
* Experience working in a technology-led business, with external partners or on programs spanning multiple markets.
* Exposure to program launches, partner onboarding or ongoing operational support.

title: Senior Medical Writer
description:
Job description:

Cactus Life Sciences is a remote-first organization, and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.

If you are looking for challenging and rewarding work which combines your understanding of medical science and aptitude for writing into one unique job, the **Senior Medical Writer** role is for you. This is an opportunity to grow your career and make a greater impact on the lives around you.

Job responsibilities:

* Taking ownership and responsibility for development (write, review, proofread, and data-check) of high-quality, client-ready scientific, medical, and educational materials like slides, abstracts, posters, MSL/training slide decks, infographics, congress and meetings materials, literature searches and reviews, standard response letters/medical information letters, and HCP engagement content according to client and audience needs with excellent attention to detail.
* Actively involved in reviewing materials developed by scientific writers to ensure strategic alignment and scientific accuracy as needed and providing clear constructive feedback, support, and supervision to writers. Mentor and train scientific writers by sharing best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the team.
Having excellent knowledge of product/account to enable meaningful interactions with clients and authors, including consultancy where necessary. Liaising and building and maintaining strong and long-standing professional relationships with international pharmaceutical clients, healthcare professionals, internal and external stakeholders including authors, reviewers and key opinion leaders across therapeutic areas* - learning to anticipate their needs. This includes educating and advising clients on how to best implement their strategic and tactical plans and proactively provide recommendations to clients on how to improve scientific content and propose new document types/ways to disseminate client date more effectively.
* Effectively and proactively communicate with team members, authors/faculty, clients and vendors.
* Attend workshops/seminars/trainings to hone your skills and contribute to organizational objectives.
* Attending client and other external meetings and supporting senior team members as needed
* Apply your scientific and creative knowledge and work closely with client directors in developing ideas and executing effective medical communications initiatives in the digital space, including publication extenders, creation of infographics, interactive assets, website content, patient narratives, and medical information engagement plans. Also, Supporting with the development of visual content and materials using effective data visualization techniques and approaches. Contributing to innovative “out of the box” solutions for medical writing projects.
* You will be responsible for ensuring all materials follow/comply with client requirements/SOPs, style guides, client templates, client preferences (as applicable), and CACTUS’ internal SOPs. Any updates to either of these items should be made consistently and documents should remain up to date.
* Perform as a document specialist, provide intellectual input across document types, and contribute to making cutting-edge research accessible to specific audiences as appropriate, by maintaining current awareness of developments across therapeutic areas or disciplines.
* Supporting with pitches, both during the preparation phase and the actual pitch.

#LI-Remote

Qualifications and prerequisites:

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in relevant fields of scientific writing.
* PhD/MD (Pharmacology) OR PhD (Life Sciences) OR PharmD OR M.Pharm/M.Sc. with a good understanding of clinical research and medical communication.
* Clear, concise, scientific style of writing, with a high level of attention to detail and excellent language skills.
* Ability to adapt writing style to different materials and target audiences.
* Basic knowledge of biostatistics.
* Literature reviewing and evaluation capabilities.
* Very good working knowledge of MS Office.

Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised.

Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. All interactions will be conducted virtually via MS Teams.

**Equal Opportunity**

Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

**Accelerating from Anywhere**

As a remote-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.

About Us:

At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.

Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyse their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

****Advanced Technical Support Engineer - APJ, EMEA & AMER Shift - copy****
**This role is**
**Office Based, Pune Office**
**Advanced Product Support Engineer | Pune or Hyderabad | APJ, EMEA & AMER Shift**
**About Cornerstone**
Cornerstone believes human potential grows exponentially when AI works in service of people. Global Customer Support is where that promise is kept — one customer, one case, one conversation at a time.
  
  
At Cornerstone, we're passionate about helping organizations unlock the full potential of their people. Our customers rely on our technology to develop talent, build skills, and drive business success. Delivering exceptional customer experiences is at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
Our Global Customer Support team plays a critical role in bringing that commitment to life. We are relentlessly customer-obsessed, focused not only on resolving issues but also on building trust, driving engagement, and ensuring customers realize the full value of their Cornerstone solutions. We believe every customer interaction is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference, strengthen relationships, and help our customers succeed.
  
  
We're looking for individuals who share our passion for delivering exceptional service, embrace innovation and AI-powered technology, and take pride in making every customer interaction count.
  
  
**The Role**
As an Advanced Product Support Specialist (Level 3), you will serve as a technical authority within Cornerstone's Global Customer Support organization, providing deep product expertise to resolve our most complex technical challenges and improve the overall effectiveness of our support teams.
  
  
Working in a collaborative, AI-enabled support environment, you will leverage advanced troubleshooting capabilities, AI-powered insights, and strong partnerships with Engineering and Product teams to identify root causes, resolve critical issues, and proactively address emerging customer challenges. Rather than managing a traditional case queue, you will focus on the most complex, high-risk, and aging cases where your expertise can make the greatest impact.
  
  
You will also play a critical role in developing technical capabilities across the team, strengthening product knowledge, and ensuring our customers receive exceptional support that builds confidence, drives engagement, and maximizes the value of their Cornerstone solutions.
  
  
**In This Role You Will...**
Serve as the technical authority for your assigned product area, proactively identifying and taking ownership of the most complex, high-risk, and aging support cases to drive timely and effective resolution.
  
  
Lead advanced technical investigations, performing in-depth root-cause analysis to identify underlying product defects, configuration challenges, and integration issues.
  
  
Partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to validate defects, ensure accurate reproduction steps, and support prioritization and resolution through established defect management processes, including OneList.
  
  
Leverage AI-powered tools, customer sentiment insights, and support analytics to identify recurring issues, improve troubleshooting effectiveness, and proactively address opportunities to enhance the customer experience.
  
  
Own technical knowledge development for your product area, identifying knowledge base gaps, contributing to certification content, and leading technical deep-dive sessions to strengthen team capabilities.
  
  
Mentor and coach Level 2 support specialists, using case quality insights and Level AI performance data to identify development opportunities and improve technical problem-solving across the team.
  
  
Provide technical expertise on critical customer escalations, partnering with escalation management teams, including DEEP, to validate solutions and ensure accurate, effective resolution.
  
  
Partner directly with the Pod Director to identify technical risks, improve support processes, and strengthen overall pod performance, including case aging, backlog health, defect quality, and customer satisfaction.
  
  
**You've Got What It Takes If You...**
Have 5+ years of experience in advanced technical support, SaaS product support, or a similar technical role, with deep expertise in complex enterprise software environments.
  
  
Possess advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, with demonstrated experience resolving complex product, integration, configuration, and data-related challenges.
  
  
Are recognized as a trusted technical expert who can confidently diagnose complex issues, validate solutions, and guide others through challenging technical situations.
  
  
Have experience collaborating with Engineering and Product teams to investigate defects, document technical findings, and drive effective issue resolution.
  
  
Are comfortable leveraging AI-powered tools, support analytics, and customer sentiment data to identify trends, improve technical support quality, and drive operational improvements.
  
  
Demonstrate strong mentoring, communication, and knowledge-sharing skills, with the ability to develop technical capabilities across a team and influence others without direct authority.
  
  
Are proactive, collaborative, and customer-obsessed, with a strong sense of accountability and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer outcomes.
  
  
Are committed to completing required Expert-tier certification within your first 90 days, maintaining deep expertise in your primary product area, and expanding your knowledge across related Cornerstone solutions.
  
  
**Our Culture**
Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.
  
  
Check us out on LinkedIn , Comparably , Glassdoor , and Facebook !

description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 3 years of experience of Workday product experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* At least one of the following: One or more Workday certifications aligned to Human Capital Management solutions, including Core HCM, Talent and Performance, Recruiting, Benefits, Payroll, or related HR platform credentials
* Applying Workday Benefits knowledge in client service engagements
* Translating Benefits processes into Workday configuration recommendations
* Interpreting data for insights on employee benefits administration
* Navigating complex client needs across changing Workday environments
* Mentoring junior team members through Workday deliverables

title: Sustainability Manager
description:
****About SKF****

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms. About the organization: www.skf.com/in

**Job Title:**
Sustainability Manager

**Reports to:**
Head - Sustainability & CSR, Industrial ISEA

**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor

**Job Location:**
Pune

****Key Responsibilities****

- Sustainability Reporting & ESG Data Management
- Support the preparation and coordination of SKF ISEAM Sustainability Report, including double materiality assessment, data collection, validation, analysis and consolidation of inputs from different functions and locations.
- Manage and coordinate the UPDAPT sustainability/ESG data platform, ensuring timely collection, completeness and quality of sustainability data being uploaded.
- Undertake sustainability data analysis to identify trends, performance gaps, improvement opportunities and areas requiring management attention/reporting.
- Coordinate inputs for BRSR and other applicable external sustainability/ESG reporting requirements.
- Develop, review and strengthen sustainability policies, frameworks, standards, guidelines and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
- Support internal and external audits/assurance and closure of sustainability/ environment-related observations.
- Facilitate sustainability communication, awareness campaigns, employee engagement programs, e-learning, digitisation programme, customer presentations, and leadership reviews.
- Decarbonisation & Climate Action
- Lead and support projects aimed at reducing the operational, upstream and downstream carbon footprint (Scope 1,2 and 3) across ISEAM.
- Develop and track decarbonisation roadmaps and site-level action plans.

* Identify and facilitate implementation of initiatives involving but not limited to fossil fuel elimination, Renewable Energy (RE)-VPPA, third party PPA, on-site, Energy efficiency etc
* Establish robust processes for validation and analysis of Scope 3 activity and emissions data, including supplier and transportation data.
* Partner with Logistics and Supply Chain teams on opportunities such as route optimisation, load optimisation, modal shifts, localisation and lower-emission transportation solutions.
* Track energy and emissions performance in line with the Group methodology and support corrective actions where performance deviates from Group targets.
* Drive Climate risk awareness and mitigation plan across sites.
* Water Stewardship
* Drive water conservation and efficiency programmes across relevant operations.
* Identify opportunities for water-use reduction, reuse, recycling and replenishment.
* Support site water-balance assessments and development of water-management action plans.
* Lead/co-ordinate initiatives towards Water Positive certification, including data preparation, documentation and stakeholder coordination.
* Circularity, Plastics & Waste Management
* Develop and implement programmes to strengthen circularity across operations.
* Lead initiatives for plastic waste reduction, including optimisation and reduction of plastic packaging.
* Monitor waste streams and identify opportunities for source reduction, reuse, recycling and resource recovery.
* Drive and support locations towards Zero Waste to Landfill certification.
* Environmental & Extended Producer Responsibility Compliance
* Coordinate and support EPR compliance (Plastic, Battery, Used Oil, etc) requirements applicable to the business.
* Establish mechanisms for tracking regulatory obligations, data requirements and compliance documentation.
* Customer ESG Assessments & Sustainability Support
* Coordinate responses to customer ESG and sustainability assessments, questionnaires and information requests.
* Work with Sales, Key Account Management (KAM), Sustainability and other functions to ensure responses are accurate, consistent and evidence-based.
* Co-coordinate frequently with KAMs to enable integration of sustainability into customer meets and capability building for sales enablement.
* Product Material Compliance (PMC) Support
* Manage compliance programs related to REACH, RoHS, SCIP, ELV, POPs, Conflict Minerals, TSCA, PFAS, Prop 65, and other product-related regulations
* Lead supplier material declaration and data collection activities through IMDS and other customer platforms.
* Review and evaluate raw materials, components, lubricants, coatings, and packaging materials for regulatory compliance.
* Conduct substance assessments against global regulatory requirements and customer-specific restricted substance lists.
* Provide technical guidance and awareness training on product stewardship and chemical compliance requirements

**Key Deliverables / Success Measures**

Success in this role would be demonstrated through:

* High-quality and timely sustainability data and reporting.
* Effective management and adoption of the UPDAPT platform.
* Progress against energy, carbon, renewable-energy and other environmental targets.
* Implementation and benefits realisation from decarbonisation and energy-efficiency projects.
* Improvements in water efficiency and progress towards Water Positive certification.
* Reduction and optimisation of plastic packaging.
* Progress towards Zero Waste to Landfill certification.
* Timely and robust BRSR/external ESG reporting.
* Effective management of EPR requirements.
* Timely, evidence-based responses to customer ESG assessments.
* Timely closure of PMC request

****Experience & Qualifications****

**Essential**

* 10–12 years of professional experience in Sustainability, ESG, Environment, Energy, Climate Change or related areas, preferably within a manufacturing/industrial environment.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Sustainability, Energy, Environmental Management or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience in sustainability/ESG reporting, environmental data management and performance analysis.
* Hands-on experience in implementing sustainability programmes in areas such as decarbonisation, renewable energy, energy efficiency, water management, waste and circularity.
* Experience working across manufacturing sites and with multidisciplinary teams.
* Understanding of sustainability-related environmental regulatory and compliance requirements and other global reporting frameworks (CDP, DJSI, CSRD etc)
* Environmental and sustainability management systems

**Key Stakeholders**

**Internal:**
Sustainability & CSR, Manufacturing/Plant Operations, EHS, Engineering, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Service, Sales & Key Accounts, Product Engineering, Quality, Communications and relevant regional/global sustainability teams.

**External:**
Customers, sustainability/ESG partners, certification and assurance organisations, relevant service providers and other sustainability stakeholders.

Interested candidate/s can share their resume to
**prachi.p.gupta@skf.com**

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

title: AI Solutions Engineer Intern (Forward Deployed)
description:
**AI is changing how businesses operate. You'll be the person helping them make that transition.**

📍
**Pune-based candidates only:**
On-site at our Pimpri office, Monday–Friday. No relocation.

**Availability:**
Must be able to start within a week and commit to the full 3 months without daily classes or exams.

**Were you the person who ran the college fest while everyone else just showed up?**

The organiser, the communicator, the one who convinced sponsors, brought people together, and somehow got everyone on board?

We'd like to meet you.

About Prepreater

Prepreater is an applied AI and software startup based in Pune. We build AI Staff Bots, websites, and automation solutions that help businesses work smarter.

The Role

You'll work directly with the founder, taking our AI products to real businesses.

You'll understand business problems, demonstrate our solutions, help clients get started, and contribute to the growth of an AI startup.

**This is a client-facing, field-oriented role, not a conventional coding internship.**
You'll interact with business owners, demonstrate technology, and help businesses understand how AI can work for them.

We'll train you on our products. You don't need to be an AI expert.

What You'll Do

* Visit businesses across Pune, including shops, clinics, offices, and startups.
* Approach business owners, understand their challenges, and identify opportunities.
* Demonstrate AI products and explain their benefits in simple language.
* Help clients get started with our solutions.
* Build relationships, follow up with prospects, and contribute to closing deals.
* Share ideas and contribute to product and business growth.

*Client visits around Pune are part of the role. Local travel expenses are covered by the ₹10,000 monthly stipend; there is no separate travel allowance.*

Who We're Looking For

You might be a great fit if you're someone who:

* Has organised college events, led clubs, managed teams, or handled sponsorships and outreach.
* Is confident approaching and speaking with new people.
* Can explain ideas and technology in simple language.
* Is curious about AI, startups, and how businesses operate.
* Speaks English and Hindi and/or Marathi.
* Is comfortable travelling locally and meeting business owners.

**All educational backgrounds are welcome:**
BE/BTech, MBA, BBA, BCom, and others. Fresh graduates and final-year students can apply if they can commit to the full schedule.

No prior sales experience, coding skills, or AI knowledge required. Initiative, communication, and curiosity matter more.

What You'll Get

* **₹10,000/month fixed stipend**
  for 3 months.
* Additional commission on every deal you help close.
* Direct mentorship and experience working with the founder.
* Hands-on exposure to real-world AI products and implementation.
* Experience in customer interactions, product demonstrations, and startup growth.
* Internship certificate and
  **potential full-time opportunity after 3 months, based on performance.**

Internship Details

* **Location:**
  Pimpri, Pune — on-site, with local client visits.
* **Schedule:**
  Monday–Friday, 10 AM–5 PM.
* **Duration:**
  3 months.
* **Joining:**
  Within one week.

How to Apply

Tap
**Apply**
, then hit
**Send**
on the message that opens in WhatsApp.

Our selection process has three rounds:

**Round 1: Voice Note**

We'll start with a few quick questions, followed by a
**1–2 minute voice note challenge**
.

Imagine you've walked into a business owner's shop. Introduce yourself and pitch how AI could help their business.

**Round 2: In-person Interview**

Strong pitches will be invited for an in-person interview at our Pimpri office.

**Round 3: One-week Working Trial**

Before confirming the internship, you'll spend one week working with us at our office, Monday–Friday, 10 AM–5 PM.

It's an opportunity for both of us to experience the actual work, understand expectations, and see if we're a good fit.

**We're looking for people who take initiative, communicate confidently, and aren't afraid to make things happen. If that sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.**

title: Oracle/ServiceMax Techno Functional Engineer
description:
**Oracle/ServiceMax Techno-Functional Engineer**
Johnson Controls creates smarter, healthier, and more sustainable buildings and connected operations. In this role, you will help support the business systems that keep service teams, internal users, and integrated enterprise processes running effectively.
  
  
You will work across Oracle and ServiceMax/SalesForce environments, combining functional understanding with hands-on technical troubleshooting. The successful candidate will possess strong technical expertise in Oracle E-Business Suite R12 and Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications, along with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical and functional solutions. This role is well suited to an experienced professional who enjoys solving complex platform issues, improving processes, and partnering with both business and technology teams.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As an Oracle/ServiceMax Techno-Functional Engineer, you will support day-to-day operations, incident resolution, enhancements, and system stability across Oracle-related and ServiceMax processes. You will be an Oracle ERPs expert that extends the scope of this role to Salesforce and ServiceMax processes to ensure smooth processes execution through the ecosystem. You will translate business needs into practical solutions, validate fixes through testing, and help ensure reliable performance across integrated systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide techno-functional support for Oracle and ServiceMax users, resolving issues related to functionality, data accuracy, integrations, and performance.
* Analyze incidents, service requests, and enhancement needs, then define practical solutions that align with business and system requirements.
* Support configuration, testing, deployment, and release activities across Oracle and Salesforce/ServiceMax environments.
* Review Oracle EBS, PL/SQL, and SQL-related issues, and support functional analysis across Oracle Financials or other ERP processes when needed.
* Partner with business SMEs, architects, administrators, delivery teams, and project managers to drive effective resolution and delivery.
* Document root causes, fixes, workarounds, technical notes, and support procedures to strengthen knowledge sharing and future supportability.
* Support ERP and field service process improvements by identifying opportunities for automation, simplification, and better user experience.

**How You Will Do It**

* Take ownership of enhancements and projects from triage through closure, with accountability, integrity, and a strong focus on system reliability.
* Stay close to the business process and user impact, removing friction for service and operations teams by prioritizing work that matters most.
* Use structured analysis, testing, and follow-up to improve every day through clear problem-solving, candor, and root-cause thinking.
* Collaborate across Oracle, ServiceMax, and integration stakeholders, working as one team and balancing functional insight with technical detail.
* Communicate status, risks, and resolution steps clearly so that business and technical teams can make informed decisions.
* Act as level 2 to support our Run team on complex support tickets related to Orace and Service ecosystem.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8+ years of overall IT experience.
* 3+ years of experience working in Agile and DevOps environments.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle EBS, PL/SQL, and SQL.
* Experience leading full lifecycle Oracle ERP implementations.
* Excellent communication skills in English.
* Experience in one or more of the following Oracle modules:

+ General Ledger (GL)
+ Accounts Payable (AP)
+ Accounts Receivable (AR)
+ Fixed Assets (FA)
+ Cash Management (CM)
+ Procurement
+ Purchasing
+ Inventory
+ Order Management
+ Manufacturing
+ Projects

**Nice to Have**

* Experience integrating ServiceMax or Salesforce with ERP systems.
* Knowledge of Oracle Database, SQL Server, or Oracle Integration Cloud.
* Experience with Asure Integration Services or other integration platforms.
* Experience with Lightning components, SOQL, SOSL, or web services.
* ServiceMax or Salesforce administration certifications.

title: Customer Support Associate
description:
**Job Title: Customer Support Associate**

**Experience Required: 3+. Years**

We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused
**Customer Support Associate**
with strong experience in providing technical and functional support to enterprise customers in a SaaS environment. The ideal candidate will have excellent troubleshooting abilities, strong analytical thinking, and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences.

In this role, you will serve as a key point of contact for customers, helping them navigate the platform, resolve technical issues, understand product functionalities, and maximize the value of the solution. You will work closely with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams to ensure timely issue resolution and continuous improvement of the customer support experience.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling complex customer queries, managing support tickets independently, and working with global customers and distributed teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Customer Support & Issue Resolution**

* Provide timely and effective customer support through multiple channels, including live chat, email, and ticketing platforms.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customer queries, technical issues, and product-related concerns.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve technical and functional issues related to SaaS applications and platform workflows.
* Manage customer support tickets throughout their lifecycle, ensuring appropriate prioritization, follow-ups, resolution, and closure within defined SLAs.
* Handle complex issues independently and coordinate with Engineering, Product, and Subject Matter Experts for advanced troubleshooting and resolution.
* Maintain clear and consistent communication with customers regarding issue status, resolution timelines, and next steps.

**2. Product Knowledge & Customer Enablement**

* Develop a strong understanding of the SaaS platform, its features, functionalities, and workflows.
* Guide customers on product usage, configuration, navigation, and best practices.
* Help customers understand product capabilities and direct them to relevant knowledge-base articles, documentation, and self-service resources.
* Identify recurring customer challenges and proactively recommend training or product education initiatives.
* Support customer onboarding and product adoption activities, wherever required.

**3. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Customer Success Managers to understand customer expectations, address concerns, and improve overall customer satisfaction.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to communicate product defects, recurring issues, enhancement requests, and customer feedback.
* Ensure effective escalation and coordination of critical or high-priority customer issues.
* Act as a bridge between customers and internal technical teams to ensure smooth communication and timely resolution.

**4. Process Improvement & Support Operations**

* Identify recurring support issues and recommend improvements to support workflows, processes, and documentation.
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and escalations.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of FAQs, knowledge-base articles, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Monitor support metrics such as ticket resolution time, first response time, SLA adherence, customer satisfaction (CSAT), and ticket backlog.
* Recommend process improvements to enhance support efficiency, service quality, and customer experience.

**5. Team Development & Knowledge Sharing**

* Contribute to the training, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing initiatives within the Customer Support team.
* Assist in onboarding and developing new support team members.
* Share technical knowledge, troubleshooting approaches, and best practices with team members.
* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and leadership in managing customer issues and improving team performance.

Required Skills

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Support, Technical Support, or Customer Success roles.
* Strong experience supporting enterprise (B2B) customers in a SaaS or technology-driven environment.
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting technical issues related to web-based applications, software platforms, and enterprise workflows.
* Hands-on experience writing and executing SQL queries to retrieve, analyze, validate, and troubleshoot data within databases.
* Experience working with ticketing and customer support platforms such as Zendesk, Freshdesk, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with IT, Healthcare IT, or enterprise software environments is highly preferred.
* Experience working with international customers and remote or offshore support teams is an added advantage.
* Demonstrated career progression, increased responsibilities, or contributions toward team and process improvements.

**Company Overview:**

Aventior is a leading provider of innovative technology solutions for businesses across a wide range of industries. At Aventior, we leverage cutting-edge technologies like AI, ML Ops, DevOps, and many more to help our clients solve complex business problems and drive growth.

We also provide a full range of data development and management services, including Cloud Data Architecture, Universal Data Models, Data Transformation & and ETL, Data Lakes, User Management, Analytics and visualization, and automated data capture (for scanned documents and unstructured/semi-structured data sources). Our team of experienced professionals combines deep industry knowledge with expertise in the latest technologies to deliver customized solutions that meet the unique needs of each of our clients. Whether you are looking to streamline your operations, enhance your customer experience, or improve your decision-making process, Aventior has the skills and resources to help you achieve your goals.

We bring a well-rounded, cross-industry, and multi-client perspective to our client engagements. Our strategy is grounded in design, implementation, innovation, migration, and support. We have a global delivery model, a multi-country presence, and a team well-equipped with professionals and experts in the field.

title: Senior Oracle EBS Tax Functional Consultant
description:
**About Us**
We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
  
  
As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
  
  
**About GSS**
As the internal support organization for DNV and DNV owned companies, we deliver shared services within Human Resources, Finance, IT and Real Estate & Procurement to DNV globally. Our mission is to enable DNV to grow, succeed with its business goals and improve competitiveness. Customer experience is at the core of everything we do. GSS is responsible for many of the tools, processes and daily routines that create the backbone of DNV.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Finance Applications team is part of the Core Applications unit within DNV’s Global Shared Services IT. The team focuses on establishing, maintaining, and supporting a full overview of finance applications to ensure stable end-to-end operations across the globe. With Oracle eBusiness Suite at its core, additional products to complement the key processes such as purchasing, banking, credit collection, and invoicing, are also part of the finance suite. A well-functioning and up-to-date finance system acts as a key engine to support our organization’s commercial and financial commitments, with integrations to our business production and reporting tools.
  
  
**Role Description And Responsibilities**
The Intercompany and Tax Functional Expert is part of Intercompany and Tax team within Finance Applications unit. As with all Finance Applications (FA) teams, the employees are located across the globe, with most of the team members based in the Global Shared Service Centers in Pune (India) and Gdynia (Poland). The team works as one unit regardless of location, and work is prioritized based on customer needs and skills, not location. The Intercompany & Tax team supports Project Intercompany, AGIS, Oracle E-Business Tax (eBTax), and LATAM tax solutions, including Latin Tax Engine and Integrated Receiving. Oracle E-Business Suite is the primary application supported, with close collaboration across Basware Cloud, integrated production systems, and other FA streams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain Finance Applications solutions in line with the global template while supporting relevant country-specific requirements.
* Collaborate with the Intercompany & Tax team and other Finance Applications teams to resolve customer and production issues quickly and to a high standard.
* Assess tax regulation changes and business requirements and translate them into appropriate tax solutions.
* Align proposed solutions with Solution Architects and Global Process Experts before development and implementation.
* Manage the functional delivery lifecycle, including solution design, configuration, documentation, testing, implementation, and production support.
* Maintain high-quality functional documentation in accordance with agreed standards and best practices.
* Engage with customers and stakeholders at all organizational levels to explain supported solutions, clarify requirements, and provide progress updates.

What we offer
  
  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work-life balance.
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave).
* Medical benefits (Insurance and Annual Health Check-up).
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance).
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On-The-Job Training, Training Programme).
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement).
* Company bonus/Profit share.

\*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*
  
  
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
  
  
**About You**

* Senior level with at least 4 years of experience in Oracle Financials and Oracle E-Business Tax (eBTax)
* Hands-on experience with tax localizations, preferably:

+ India
+ US/Canada
+ Brazil

* Experience with tax determination across Oracle E-Business Suite transactions originating from Service Contracts, Service Requests, Projects, Project Intercompany, Receivables, and Payables.
* Strong understanding of Oracle E-Business Tax configuration and tax determination rules.
* Experience with troubleshooting tax calculation and transaction issues in Oracle E-Business Suite.
* Experience with translating tax regulation changes and new business requirements into solution design, configuration, testing, implementation, and production support.
* Proven ability to meet timelines and deliver high-quality results.
* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
* Proactive and self-driven, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to identify issues, drive improvements, and work independently.
* Well-organized, detail-oriented, and capable of producing high-quality documentation, analyses, presentations, and user guidance.
* Fluent in written and spoken English.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional environment.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

*Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.*

title: AI Marketing Associate
description:
**ABOUT CLARO ENERGY**

Claro Energy is a leading clean energy company in India with 15+ years of experience in building decentralized renewable energy solutions. We have delivered 1,00,000+ solar projects across solar irrigation pumps, rooftop solar, and large-scale clean energy programs, working closely with farmers, households, institutions, and government initiatives across 18+ states.

**MISSION**

We are not building a traditional marketing department. We are building an autonomous growth engine. We're looking for a technically curious, high-energy fresh graduate, someone hungry to learn and eager to get hands-on to help build and run our AI-native marketing pod. You'll work alongside a small team armed with an outsized AI tech stack, punching above your weight to execute with the volume and precision of a 10-person enterprise team.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Run the Content Factory: Shift from "writing" to "prompting and editing" to help build the templates and system prompts that let AI generate high-quality SEO, social, and ad copy at scale, using gen-AI content tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway, Higgsfield, HeyGen, and ElevenLabs
* Build Reusable Playbooks: Create and maintain AI skills and templates (e.g., on Claude) that encode our brand guidelines, tone, and design language so every new campaign, post, or asset stays consistent and on-brand without starting from scratch each time
* Support the Pod: Work closely with marketing interns and the wider team to help sharpen daily workflows, focusing on data quality, AI output auditing, and community engagement
* Execute Agile Campaigns: Help deploy intent-based outbound campaigns, set up dynamic website personalizations, and test ad variants using AI-driven platforms
* Protect the Brand Soul: Support quality control to help ensure our output never sounds like a generic robot, and stays true to our voice and strategic edge across every marketing touchpoint
* Learn the AI Stack: Get hands-on with workflows linking our CRM, website, and outbound channels using automation tools (n8n, Make) and AI agents

**WHO YOU ARE**

* Experience: 0–2 years, fresh graduates welcome; what matters most is curiosity, hustle, and a genuine appetite to learn.
* AI-Native: You use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Perplexity daily, and are comfortable writing detailed, context-rich prompts, you're curious about agentic workflows
* Gen-AI Content Curiosity: You're excited about tools like Midjourney, Runway, Higgsfield, HeyGen, and ElevenLabs, you don't need hands-on experience with these specific tools, just the interest and aptitude to pick them up fast
* Technical Chops: You don't need to be a software developer, but you're not afraid of webhooks, APIs, CRM data structures, or vibe-coding tools like Lovable, Bolt.new, or Replit Agent
* Antifragile: You thrive in iterative environments when a platform algorithm changes or an AI model updates, you're excited to adapt rather than wait for a new playbook

**WHY THIS ROLE**

You'll skip the traditional corporate marketing ladder from day one. Instead of managing spreadsheets of manual tasks, you'll be learning to build and command the systems that do the work with direct exposure to company revenue and a seat close to the founder's office.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Click Apply! You'll be redirected to our careers portal. Once there, click Apply Now and fill out the short form with your LinkedIn ID, resume, and contact details.

title: Content Manager (Research (Machinery and Electricals)

**Position Summary**
The Content Manager serves as the Machinery & Electrical Equipment subject matter expert within the Energy & Industrials pod and owns its expert research content coverage. The role identifies the companies, themes and investor questions that warrant coverage; defines and validates the Network Member profiles needed; designs differentiated interview agendas; leads human-moderated one-to-one interviews; and develops recurring programs for execution by Associates. The Content Manager reviews content for research quality and relevance and works with Associates and Compliance through publication.
  
  
The role requires an investor mindset and deep knowledge of Machinery & Electrical Equipment, including its companies, value chain, financial statements, operating drivers, industry cycles and current debates. The Content Manager must also understand relevant credit, private-market and other investor perspectives well enough to assess the sub-sector broadly; ask incisive questions; challenge superficial answers; and produce content that leaves investors materially better informed.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Coverage ownership and research agenda**

* Set and maintain the research agenda for Machinery & Electrical Equipment, including priority companies, themes, catalysts, investor debates and underserved information needs.
* Identify emerging themes, inflection points and content gaps early, connecting macro, sector and sub-sector developments to company-level implications.
* Translate earnings calls, conferences, market events, client demand and usage signals into timely interviews and recurring content programs for Machinery & Electrical Equipment.
* Use a shared research foundation to develop several distinct conversations on the same company or topic without producing repetitive content.

**Network Member strategy and interview leadership**

* Build and maintain a map of the roles, organizations, value-chain positions and geographies needed to answer priority research questions.
* Define and validate Network Member profiles, screening criteria and briefing context that distinguish direct visibility from nominal seniority.
* Design investor-focused interview agendas and questions that go beyond public commentary and generate original insight.
* Lead human-moderated one-to-one interviews, listening actively, probing inconsistencies and redirecting the conversation toward material investor questions.

**Structured programs, quality and collaboration**

* Define the research objective, respondent criteria, question sets and cadence for channel checks and other recurring structured programs within Machinery & Electrical Equipment.
* Brief Associates executing those programs, review representative output and determine whether it meets substantive research and quality standards.
* Work with Associates and Compliance to resolve substantive questions and carry approved content through publication.
* Capture company briefs, Network Member knowledge, question frameworks and findings in reusable form to strengthen future coverage of Machinery & Electrical Equipment.
* Collaborate across the sector pod when sub-sector, asset-class, regional or thematic perspectives would materially improve the research, and contribute to team ideation, knowledge sharing and quality calibration.
* Use AI-enabled research and moderation tools to deepen preparation and improve efficiency, applying judgment to validate outputs.

title: Research And Development Associate (Biotechnology / Clinical Trials)
description:
Cosma is building a non-hormonal, CDSCO-approved fertility support device, developed at IIT Bombay, for couples who sit between “keep waiting” and IVF. The science is ours.
**What decides whether doctors trust us is the quality of our evidence.**

This role has three jobs.
**Research:**

biotechnology and nanotechnology work, publications, and the institutes we partner with.
**New product development:**

taking Cosma’s next products from idea to prototype to evidence.
**Clinical:**

owning trial data, visiting trial sites and giving clinical updates. You always know where each project and trial stands, and you tell the founder before she has to ask.

**How level works:**

PhD holders lead projects, own the trial data and manage the clinical field team on the data side. Master’s-level associates run trackers, data checks, follow-ups and visits, and grow into the lead role.

**1. RESEARCH AND R&D**

* **Visit research institutes, universities and laboratories**

  in person. Build the relationships, agree scopes, MoUs and timelines, review progress on site, and keep every collaboration moving with named owners and dates.
* **Source and meet scientists, PhD scholars and postdocs**

  at these institutes, both as collaborators and as future hires.
* Support projects in drug development, biotechnology, nanotechnology and reproductive health.
* Prepare and deliver scientific presentations, reports and project updates to the internal team, doctors and external stakeholders.
* Contribute to manuscripts, publications and technical documentation.
* Maintain accurate research records and project documentation, always ready to be shown to a regulator, a partner or an investor.
* **Be our biotech and nanotech expert.**

  You are the scientific voice on the nano-engineered technology behind FertiGen, in the lab, with partners and with doctors.

**2. NEW PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT**

* **Scout and shape new products**

  in fertility and reproductive health: review the science, the gaps doctors and patients describe, and the technology options with our institute partners.
* **Run each new product as a project:**

  concept note, feasibility, prototype, lab or pilot validation, regulatory pathway (CDSCO), with milestones, owners and a budget.
* **Work with external labs, formulators and manufacturers**

  on prototypes and testing; keep specifications, test reports and vendor records in order.
* **Prepare product dossiers and evidence summaries**

  that the team, doctors and regulators can use. File patents and publications where the work deserves it.
* Present progress and decisions to the founder monthly: what is working, what it costs and what to drop.

**3. CLINICAL TRIALS AND DATA (THE MANAGER PART)**

The Research Associate is accountable for the trial data across every site.

* **Own the trial data end to end.**

  Case report forms, enrolment logs, consent records, follow-up data. Nothing lives only on a phone or in someone’s head.
* **Track enrolment site by site.**

  GTB, private hospitals and sites routed through an Institutional Ethics Committee (IEC): protocol, approvals, enrolment started, patients enrolled, patients due for follow-up.
* **Close follow-up loops fast.**

  Data for previously enrolled patients is chased and updated within 1 to 2 working days of it being due.
* **Prepare and track protocol and IEC paperwork.**

  Draft, version-control and submit documents; keep the founder briefed on what is pending and what is approved.
* **Manage the clinical field team on the data side.**

  Clinical research coordinators, nurses and MRs deployed to trial sites report data to you. You set the format, check quality and flag gaps the same day.
* **Visit hospitals and trial sites regularly.**

  Camps at facilities, ashram areas and NGOs: registrations, screening and referral data captured properly.

* You hold a

  with real hands-on research experience.
