a PhD; fertility or reproductive biology exposure; drug development experience; clinical trial or GCP training; publications, patents or conference presentations.

title: Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Functional Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
The Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Functional Analyst is a key member of the Finance Operations team supporting the Horizon Global ERP platform. This role provides Level 2 functional production support, investigates complex finance-system issues, and delivers controlled configuration changes across Oracle Fusion Financials. Working closely with Finance stakeholders, Global ERP teams, technical teams, and managed service providers, the analyst helps maintain a stable, compliant, and scalable global solution while improving the user experience and supporting evolving business needs
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide Level 2 functional support for Oracle Fusion Financials, with primary focus on General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Subledger Accounting, intercompany processing, and related finance processes.
* Investigate incidents and accounting or transaction exceptions, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate timely corrective actions with internal teams and managed service providers.
* Monitor, run, and troubleshoot scheduled processes, interfaces, data loads, and integrations that support Finance operations.
* Support month-end and year-end close activities, including issue triage and resolution of critical processing exceptions.
* Gather and analyze business requirements, complete fit-gap assessments, and translate approved needs into clear functional specifications and solution designs.
* Configure Oracle Fusion Financials and deliver controlled system changes in accordance with the global template, governance standards, security requirements, and change-management processes.
* Assess cross-functional and downstream impacts of proposed changes, including impacts to integrations, reporting, controls, and regional processes.
* Develop test scenarios and scripts; execute functional, regression, and integration testing; support user acceptance testing; and manage defects through resolution.
* Support release and deployment activities, including Oracle quarterly update impact assessments, readiness testing, and post-release validation.
* Partner with development, integration, reporting, security, quality assurance, and testing teams to deliver reliable solutions on schedule.
* Create and maintain functional designs, configuration records, process documentation, support procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Provide user guidance, knowledge transfer, and recommendations that improve business processes, system adoption, and operational performance.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications and Experience
  
  

* Three to five years of hands-on experience supporting Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials in a production environment.
* Functional knowledge of core Finance processes and Oracle Financials modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Intercompany
* Experience with Oracle configuration, Subledger Accounting, scheduled processes, approvals, period close, and financial transaction troubleshooting.
* Experience gathering requirements, preparing functional specifications, completing fit-gap analysis, and assessing end-to-end process impacts.
* Experience with incident, problem, change, release, and defect-management practices in an ERP support environment.
* Demonstrated experience with functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing.
* Ability to troubleshoot data, integration, reporting, and application issues and clearly explain findings and recommended solutions.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global, cross-functional teams and constructively challenge solutions when appropriate.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials certification in one or more relevant modules.
* Experience with Project Portfolio Management, Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Center, Oracle Integration Cloud, or file-based data imports.
* Experience supporting Oracle quarterly updates, application-managed services, and global ERP templates.
* Knowledge of financial controls, segregation of duties, audit requirements, and IT general controls.
* Experience in the architecture, engineering, and construction industry or another project-based, multi-entity environment.

Reporting and Collaboration
  
  
The Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Functional Analyst reports to the Finance Operations Lead and collaborates with Finance business partners, regional stakeholders, Quality Assurance, Solution Architects, security, development, integration and testing teams, and managed service providers. Success in this role requires clear communication, sound functional judgement, disciplined execution, and a continuous-improvement mindset.

description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking a Senior Consultant to join our large and growing Carbon and Net Zero team in India (Mumbai, Bengaluru or Noida), supporting UK and global Sustainability & Climate Change projects. The successful applicant will lead the technical delivery of carbon and net zero workstreams, review and quality-assure outputs, mentor junior colleagues and work closely with project leads and clients to deliver the highest standards of technical work and support the continued success of the Sustainability Advisory business. The role is for an enthusiastic, efficient and highly organised professional with extensive experience of quantifying carbon emissions, compiling carbon footprints and advising clients on decarbonisation. The successful candidate will be driven to take on a varied and influential role in a top-tier consultancy working to address sustainability and climate change challenges.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The successful applicant would be responsible for many of the following:
  
  

* Leading and owning the end-to-end delivery of technical work (e.g. carbon management, quantification and engagement) and outputs (reports, briefing notes, carbon models) relating to climate change mitigation for clients, including scoping, methodology, delivery and quality assurance
* Leading and authoring GHG chapters as part of the consenting requirements for developments, and acting as technical reviewer for outputs prepared by others
* Advising clients on their sustainability and climate change challenges, including net zero target setting (e.g. SBTi), decarbonisation pathways and carbon reduction strategies, using best practice tools and approaches
* Day-to-day project management, including programme, budget, risks and regular updates to project leads and clients
* Mentoring, guiding and reviewing the work of Consultants and Graduates, and supporting their technical development
* Acting as a trusted point of contact for UK and global project leads and clients
* Leading the technical sections of A-class quality proposals, capability statements and strategic documents, including scope, methodology, effort estimates and pricing inputs
* Contributing to team capability building through tools, templates, methodologies and knowledge sharing, and identifying opportunities for follow-on work

**Qualifications**
**Key Competencies / Skills**
We are looking for outstanding candidates with passion and enthusiasm for confronting climate change and sustainability challenges for our clients. You will need to be a proactive individual with a helpful attitude and inquisitive nature, willingness to foster our strong team ethic, with exceptional interpersonal skills.
  
  
The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate these essential skills:
  
  

* A degree (ideally at Master's level) in sustainability, environmental science, engineering, energy, climate change or a related discipline
* Substantial, demonstrable experience in carbon management, net zero, climate change, decarbonisation, sustainability or a related field, gained in consultancy, an in-house team or another relevant organisation, at a level suited to leading workstreams independently
* Project management – planning, reviewing and delivering outcomes on time, to budget and to the expected quality
* Proven expertise in organisational and project GHG accounting, including the GHG Protocol (including Scope 3), ISO 14064 and carbon footprinting, together with carbon assurance, carbon management and climate policy
* Applied knowledge of guidance and best practice in climate change mitigation – in particular PAS 2080, whole life carbon and life cycle analysis (e.g. EN 15978) for infrastructure and energy-based projects
* Experience of setting net zero targets and developing decarbonisation trajectories
* A track record of quality assurance and technical review of carbon outputs
* Experience of leading or supervising small teams and mentoring junior colleagues
* A strong understanding of related sustainability issues and services
* Good knowledge of relevant UK and international legislation, standards, assessment methodologies and market developments, with the ability to keep abreast of and advise clients on emerging requirements
* Strong analytical, research, technical writing and presentation skills, with confident communication with colleagues and clients and experience of authoring and reviewing client deliverables
* Fully competent in conducting numerical analyses in Excel, and the production of concise, impactful written/presentation outputs to clients and the external market.

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* Carbon management, GHG accounting, Climate change, Net zero, Decarbonisation trajectory, LCA, EIA.

Desirable Skills
  
  

* SBTi, PAS 2080:2023, Whole life carbon assessment, Carbon/LCA tools (e.g. One Click LCA, SimaPro), Client management and business development, Professional membership (e.g. IEMA/PIEMA or Chartership)

title: Data Analyst
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To collect, analyze, interpret, and report security-related data to enhance the operational efficiency, risk mitigation capabilities, and decision-making processes within the organization. The role involves performing vulnerability assessments, developing insights from data trends, and contributing to the continuous improvement of security systems.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Data Analyst - Security**
**Data Management**
Collect data from primary and secondary sources, maintaining and managing securityrelated databases to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
  
  
Implement data collection systems and strategies to optimize statistical efficiency and data quality.
  
  
Ensure proper documentation of data collection and analysis processes for easy replication by stakeholders.
  
  
**Data Analysis And Reporting**
Develop and execute data analysis plans, identifying patterns, correlations, and trends from securityrelated data.
  
  
Create reports and dashboards using data visualization tools like Tableau or Qlik to communicate actionable insights.
  
  
Interpret data findings in the context of organizational security, recommending datadriven improvements to senior management.
  
  
**Threat And Vulnerability Assessments**
Conduct regular vulnerability testing and threat analysis, ensuring early detection and resolution of potential risks.
  
  
Analyze security breaches to identify root causes and recommend necessary countermeasures.
  
  
Contribute to updating and refining the organization’s incident response and disaster recovery plans based on analysis findings.
  
  
**System Upgradation**
Identify areas of improvement in security systems through data analysis and coordinate system upgrades.
  
  
Collaborate with IT teams to implement enhanced security software, minimizing risks and improving operational efficiency.
  
  
**Process Excellence**
Evaluate and refine data collection, storage, and usage processes, improving overall process maturity.
  
  
Standardize datadriven decisionmaking frameworks to support governance and operational excellence.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Site Security Lead
  
  
IT Management Specialist
  
  
Corporate Security Team
  
  
Risk Management and Audit Teams
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
Vendors and service providers for security software and tools
  
  
External departments for integration and support during upgrades
  
  
External auditors (for compliance and system validation)
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Utilize advanced data analysis techniques to identify trends, patterns, and correlations within complex data sets
* Develop and implement data models, algorithms, and statistical methods to analyze and interpret data
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and provide data-driven insights and recommendations
* Design and create data visualizations, dashboards, and reports to communicate findings and support decision-making processes
* Conduct thorough data validation, cleansing, and quality assurance processes to ensure accuracy and reliability of data
* Contribute to the development and optimization of data management processes and systems
* Stay updated with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in data analysis and management
* Communicate complex technical findings and insights to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and understandable manner
* Adhere to data privacy and security regulations and best practices
* Participate in continuous learning and professional development activities to enhance skills and knowledge in data analysis

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related fields.
  
  
**Certification**
Proficiency in database languages such as SQL, Python, or R.
  
  
Knowledge of data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or Qlik).
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
1 year in data management, analytics, or operations, preferably in security or technology-related roles or 0.6-1 year Internship with Adani group in the related field.
  
  
Worked on interpreting data trends, perform root cause analyses, and create actionable reports.

description:
**Job Description: Product Development Engineer – GD&T & Tolerance Analysis**

**Experience:**
5–10 Years

**Industry:**
Medical Devices / MedTech

**Location**
: Coimbatore

**About the company:**

**NovintiX**
is a fast-growing engineering and digital transformation company serving top Life Sciences, MedTech, and Healthcare clients across the US, Ireland, and Europe. We specialised in delivering high-impact digital programs, engineering services, and talent solutions that accelerate innovation, efficiency, and compliance.

**Role Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Product Development Engineer with strong expertise in GD&T and Tolerance Analysis within the Medical Device / MedTech industry. The candidate will be responsible for supporting product design and development activities, developing and reviewing mechanical engineering drawings, performing tolerance stack-up analysis, and ensuring product functionality, dimensional accuracy, reliability and manufacturability. The role involves working closely with cross-functional engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle, from design concept and development to verification, validation and manufacturing transfer.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support mechanical product design and development activities for medical device components, assemblies and products.
* Develop, review and interpret engineering drawings using GD&T principles in accordance with ASME Y14.5 standards.
* Perform 1D and 3D tolerance stack-up analysis to evaluate dimensional variations and ensure proper product fit, form and function.
* Define and validate dimensional tolerances, datum structures, geometric controls, fits and clearances.
* Evaluate design concepts for functionality, manufacturability, assembly requirements and dimensional performance.
* Collaborate with Design, Manufacturing, Quality and Supplier Engineering teams to resolve design and dimensional challenges.
* Review supplier drawings, CMM reports and dimensional inspection results to ensure compliance with engineering specifications.
* Support design reviews, engineering changes, design verification and validation activities.
* Perform root cause analysis and support corrective actions for design-related and dimensional nonconformances.
* Apply DFM and DFA principles to improve product design, manufacturing efficiency and assembly processes.
* Maintain engineering drawings, design documentation and technical records in accordance with applicable medical device quality requirements.

**Preferred Skills**

* 5–10 years of experience in Product Development, Mechanical Design or Product Design Engineering within the Medical Device / MedTech industry.
* Strong hands-on experience in GD&T and ASME Y14.5 standards.
* Experience performing 1D and 3D tolerance stack-up analysis for mechanical components and assemblies.
* Proficiency in engineering drawing interpretation, dimensional tolerancing, datum schemes and geometric controls.
* Experience with CAD tools such as Creo, SolidWorks or Siemens NX.
* Exposure to tolerance analysis tools such as CETOL or 3DCS.
* Knowledge of mechanical design, precision components, material selection and manufacturing processes.
* Experience with CMM, dimensional inspection and measurement techniques.
* Understanding of ISO 13485, DFM, DFA and medical device product development lifecycle.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration skills.

title: SENIOR TECHNICAL OFFICER-Research and Development (FULL-TIME)
description:
**Company Description:**
International Register of Shipping (INTLREG), established in 1993, is an independent classification society that safeguards life, property, and the environment. The organization provides classification, certification, verification, training, engineering, and advisory services to clients across the global maritime industry. INTLREG operates through a worldwide network of surveyors and auditors based in major ports, supported by highly qualified naval architects, marine engineers, master mariners, and technical personnel. The administrative office is located in Panama City, Panama, with the Technical Head Office in Miami, Florida, USA. INTLREG maintains an ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system aligned with international and national standards.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

* The candidate will be responsible for research and development activities to ensure appropriate development and updating of the classification rules for ships and offshore vessels, and the design and development of new services for the International Register of Shipping.
* To monitor the new international regulations, industry trends, innovations related to the maritime industry, IMO, and other forums for their applicable inclusion and implementation into INTLREG classification rules.
* Updating and maintain the classification rules and related guidance for use of all technical departments and surveyors and other stakeholders who are involved in ship building, modifications or conversions.
* The publication of incidents and statistical analysis of trends related to losses and damages within the industries, Development of new products and services for INTLREG or affiliates
* Design, create, and test various INLREG class and statutory services for any new implementation or amendment in the online platform before use by other staff and surveyors.
* Monitor various projects related to rule development or engineering or other services assigned to R&D and act as Project Manager
* Supervise other staff in the Project team / R&D and monitor various project progress as required.
* Coordinate with Technical Appraisal Department or other departments related to classification / statutory services in compliance with INTLREG Classification Rules, IMO regulations and Flag administration, providing up to date information and making sure that surveyors, ship-owners/ship managers are meeting the requirements and new amendments.
* Preparation of training course for stakeholder related to new services or amendment when implemented.
* Any other technical or special projects as assigned by management.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Masters or, Bachelor’s degree in Marine Engineering/Mechanical or any related maritime/ marine machinery design areas. Chief Engineer License / MOT Class I marine engineer

**DESIRED EXPERIENCE**

Candidates with at least 10 years of  experience in any significant combination of the below proficiencies are encouraged to apply for this position: 

* Experience as a surveyor/specialist/design appraisal engineer or in Research & Development functions in a Classification Society.
* Experience in design/production/quality department in a ship building/repair yard, handling classification and statutory compliance of ship/offshore/marine structures.
* Experience in leading design companies involved in new building, conversion, energy efficiency etc.

*(Those with less than a total of 10 years’ experience need not apply)*

**DESIRED SKILLS**

* Familiarity with Classification Rules, IMO Codes/ conventions and regulations such as SOLAS, MARPOL, ISM, ISPS, MLC and other maritime technical codes.
* Knowledge of the process and procedures related to ship-classification/certification for both ships in service as well as new building of merchant ships.
* Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills in English. Professional document writing skills is recommended.
* Proficiency to handle computational tools for design assessment.
* Technical Writing Skills is essential.
* Project Management Skills.

Build and maintain the Kochi AI/digital roadmap and backlog, prioritizing use cases by business value, effort and risk.

CAD: Design automation, rule-based modeling, design reuse and similar-part search in Creo or NX.

DFM: AI-driven DFM checklists and design reviews for stamping, molding, plating and assembly.

DFMEA: AI-generated draft failure modes, cause/control suggestions from past data, and cross-program consistency checks.

Develop and maintain the Engineering SharePoint portal for tools, documentation, KPIs, project trackingand knowledge management.

Amphenol Power Solutions, Kochi | Page 2

Integrate digital systems (SharePoint, Clarizen, PLM, Teams) to streamline data flow and reduce manual work.

•

Build solutions using Power Platform, SharePoint and other approved technologies.

•

Technical Reports and Documentation: Automate trackers, action-item follow-up and leadership reports.

5. Adoption, Support & Governance

•

Provide training and user support to drive adoption of new tools and processes; build internal champions.

•

Maintain, enhance and continuously improve implemented digital solutions.

•

Ensure solutions comply with Amphenol IT security, data confidentiality and IP protection policies.

•

Work with global sites to reuse proven solutions and avoid duplicate effort.

6. Predictive Engineering & Digital Twin Enablement (Future Scope)

•

Partner with the site and global Engineering Excellence teams on a long-term roadmap for predictive engineering and digital twins.

•

Help build predictive models from test, simulation and field data (e.g., T-rise, LLCR, mating forces) to reduce prototype and validation loops.

Python programming, plus data handling and scripting for engineering automation. Additional programming/scripting languages such as C#, JavaScript or VB.NET.

Practical experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG and agent frameworks.

SharePoint development and administration, including sites, lists and workflows. Database management and SQL.

Microsoft automation tools: Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint and Power BI.

Process automation and system integration.

Machine learning for engineering data, such as defect prediction or surrogate models.

Understanding of the product development process: DFM, DFMEA, GD&T and tolerance stack-up.

CAD/PLM tools (Creo, NX, Windchill, Teamcenter) and their APIs.

title: Sales Executive
description:
**Earn a CTC of ₹1.8 LPA – ₹2.4 LPA fixed + uncapped incentives.**

Sell services every business needs, sit face to face with founders, and earn more every time you close.

**Role Snapshot**

* Location: Whitefield, Bengaluru (office-based)
* Work mode: Full-time, in-office. NOT work from home.
* Fixed package: ₹1.8 LPA – ₹2.4 LPA per annum, based on experience
* Incentives: Commission on every deal + performance bonus (uncapped)
* Experience: 0–3 years (freshers with strong communication welcome)
* Reports to: Founder / Business Head

**Why This Role Is Different**

We are a full-stack digital marketing agency that helps businesses grow revenue, not just followers. Under one roof we deliver SEO, Google and Meta Ads, social media management, content and video, website development, copywriting and digital transformation.

That means you never walk into a meeting with one product to push. Whatever the client's problem is (low leads, a weak website, invisible on Google, poor ad returns), you have a solution to sell.

If you like talking to people, hate sitting idle, and want your income tied to your effort, this role is built for you.

**What You'll Do**

**Find and open doors**

* Generate leads through cold calls, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, email and in-person visits to businesses across Bengaluru
* Qualify inbound leads from our website, ads and referrals within 24 hours
* Book discovery meetings with business owners, founders and marketing heads

**Pitch and close**

* Run discovery calls to understand each client's goals, budget and marketing gaps
* Present the right service mix (SEO, ads, social, website, content) with the strategy team's support
* Share proposals, handle objections and negotiate pricing within approved limits
* Close deals and collect advance payments to hit your monthly target

**Grow the pipeline**

* Follow up consistently until every lead is a clear yes or no
* Upsell and cross-sell additional services to existing clients
* Ask happy clients for referrals and testimonials

**Report and improve**

* Update every lead, call and deal stage in the CRM daily
* Share a weekly report on calls, meetings, proposals sent and revenue closed
* Feed client objections and market trends back to the team

**Your weekly scorecard (indicative)**

* Outreach calls / messages: 250+
* Discovery meetings booked: 8–10
* Proposals sent: 4–5
* Deals closed: set monthly with your manager

**Who We're Looking For**

**Must have**

* Clear, confident spoken English and Hindi; Kannada is a strong plus
* Comfort with cold calling and walking into a business unannounced
* Graduate in any discipline
* Lives in or can relocate to Bengaluru and commute to the office daily
* A hunger to earn: motivated by targets, not scared of them

**Good to have**

* 1–3 years in B2B sales, agency sales, SaaS, advertising or media sales
* Basic understanding of SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads or social media
* Experience with a CRM (Zoho, HubSpot or similar)
* Own two-wheeler for client visits

**What You'll Earn**

* Fixed package: ₹1.8 LPA – ₹2.4 LPA per annum, based on experience and interview performance
* Sales incentives: commission on every deal you close, paid monthly
* Performance bonus: extra bonus when you hit or beat your monthly or quarterly target
* Uncapped earnings: top performers can earn well above their fixed package
* Growth path: Sales Executive → Senior Sales Executive → Business Development Manager

**Also included**

* Hands-on training in digital marketing services, pitching and closing
* Ready sales collateral, case studies and proposal templates
* Direct mentoring from the founder
* Performance reviews every 6 months, with salary revisions for top performers

**How To Apply**

Send your CV with the subject line "Sales Executive – Bengaluru" on WhatsApp: +91 80995 64306

In 3 lines, tell us about the best sale you've ever made, even if it wasn't in a job. Shortlisted candidates will hear back within 3 working days.

Hiring process: Phone screening → In-office interview with a sales role-play → Offer

This is a full-time, office-based role in Whitefield, Bengaluru. Work-from-home applications will not be considered.

As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. title: Account Executive – BFSI & Healthcare
description:
**Role:Account Executive – Insurance, Healthcare & Financial Services**

**Location:**
Bengaluru, India

**Work Model:**
Hybrid

**Experience: 5+years**

If you've been selling into carriers, hospitals, banks or wealth managers and hitting your number for someone else, come own the territory here.

**About Engineersmind**

Engineersmind builds AI-powered products and delivers digital engineering for regulated industries. We are a team of 150+ engineers, product and delivery people across Jersey City, Dublin, Dubai, Noida and Bengaluru. We are profitable and growing without outside capital.

**Our Products**

Our five products are built for the buyers you already know:

* **CXHealth:**
  A remote patient monitoring and care-coordination platform in production with health systems and payers, and our most-referenced deployment.
* **InsuredDesk:**
  AI-powered policyholder engagement and agency automation for US independent insurance agencies, built TCPA-first and integrated with the agency management systems agencies already run.
* **Fylix:**
  An enterprise wealth management and advisory platform for RIAs, broker-dealers and private banks. It includes an advisor workspace, client portal, portfolio and account aggregation with custodian integrations, and embedded analytics, with role-based access for advisors, assistants, clients and leadership.
* **XCSM:**
  A client engagement and governance platform for wealth managers and banks, designed around the AI-governance guidance regulators are now issuing to licensed financial institutions.
* **PollenX:**
  Our private AI layer: models, guardrails and audit trails deployed inside a client's own cloud or data center, for institutions that will not send data to public models.

**Our Engagements**

Around the products, we deliver fixed-scope, fixed-price engagements:

* AI Readiness & Governance Review (3 weeks)
* Six-Week AI Pilot
* Compliance-Readiness Sprint against a named regulation
* Data Foundations Assessment
* Private AI Landing Zone

These are the doors. Multi-year platform work is what is behind them. Our marketing is already producing the signal: senior buyers engaging with our campaigns, attending our webinars and visiting our site. What we need is a closer who turns that signal into meetings, and meetings into contracts.

**The Role**

You'll work a defined book of named Tier 1 and Tier 2 accounts across the target markets.

**Target industries include:**

* Carriers and MGAs
* Health systems and health plans
* Regional and mid-market banks
* RIAs and wealth managers

**What you'll own:**

* A six-month ramp, with a stepped quota and a non-recoverable draw
* An annual quota based on first-year contract value
* Intent data and account engagement signals to identify potential opportunities
* Entry engagements designed to expand into larger platform deals
* Enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders

**What You'll Do**

* Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, run discovery, build the business case, negotiate, close. No handoffs.
* Lead with a packaged offer. Every first conversation opens with one of our fixed-scope engagements, so the buyer gets a short, priced, low-risk yes. You expand from there.
* Get in front of the people who own the problem. Heads of Claims and Underwriting at insurers. CIOs, CMIOs and VPs of Revenue Cycle at health systems. Heads of Digital Transformation at banks. COOs, Chief Compliance Officers and Heads of Advisory at wealth firms.
* Be first on the trigger. New executives, funding rounds, regulatory deadlines, enforcement actions, revealing job posts. Marketing surfaces them; you are in the inbox within 48 hours with something specific to say.
* Multi-thread every account using Sales Navigator, webinars and executive content, so you never depend on a single champion.
* Mine your network. Five named introduction asks a week into customers, partners and former colleagues. Referrals convert at several times the rate of anything cold, and we protect the time for them.
* Run a disciplined pipeline in HubSpot. Every lead accepted or rejected with a reason, every touch logged, every opportunity with a dated next step. If it isn't in the CRM, it didn't happen.
* Partner with Marketing weekly to sharpen campaigns, case studies and targeting based on what you hear in the field.
* Travel as needed to close, including occasional overnight regional trips.

**Who you are**

* 4+ years closing B2B SaaS or technology-services deals.
* 2+ years selling into at least one of our verticals: insurance, healthcare, banking or wealth management. You don't need all four; deep expertise in one is what matters.
* A consistent record of hitting or exceeding quota on high-value deals, and at least one seven-figure deal you can walk us through.
* **Experience working with customers and markets in both India and the Middle East.**
* Comfortable selling AI and data products to compliance-conscious buyers. You can talk human-in-the-loop workflows, audit trails, model inventories and regulatory exposure with confidence, and you know when to bring in the product expert.
* Experienced with account-based selling, Sales Navigator and a modern CRM (HubSpot preferred).
* A strong writer and presenter. Your first email to a new CRO gets read because it is about them, not about us.
* Self-directed and hungry. You would rather be measured on outcomes than watched on activity.

**Why here**

You won't be one of 400 reps dialing the same list. You'll be one of a handful of sellers building the go-to-market for five products that are already generating senior-level demand, with a founder-led company behind you that has been shipping production software to regulated clients for years.

The accounts are identified, the content is running, the intent data is live, and a partnerships lead is opening doors with the carriers' and health plans' own technology vendors.

The gap between our pipeline and our revenue is a closer.

title: Customer Relationship Executive
description:
Experience - 1 - 3yrs

Location : Sector 7th HSR Layout, Bangalore

Immediate Joiner

Good Communications

Job Summary

We are looking for a dynamic, result-oriented
**Sales Executive**
with experience in the interior design industry. The ideal candidate should have strong communication, client-handling, lead qualification, and sales conversion skills.

The candidate will be responsible for qualifying incoming leads, understanding client requirements, conducting office/showroom walkthroughs for walk-in clients, coordinating with the interior design team, and converting potential customers into successful projects.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

**1. Lead Qualification & Management**

* Handle incoming leads generated through digital marketing, Meta Ads, website enquiries, referrals, and other sources.
* Qualify leads based on client requirements, budget, project location, timeline, and purchase intent.
* Identify potential customers and prioritize high-quality leads.
* Maintain accurate lead information and follow-up records in the CRM system.

* Welcome and professionally engage clients visiting the office or showroom.

* Understand client expectations, design preferences, budget, and project requirements.

* Build strong relationships with walk-in clients and convert enquiries into potential business opportunities.

**3. Sales Conversion & Client Follow-ups**

* Convert qualified leads and walk-in enquiries into confirmed interior design projects.
* Conduct regular follow-ups with prospective clients through calls, WhatsApp, emails, and meetings.
* Explain service offerings, project timelines, pricing structures, and design packages.
* Handle client objections and negotiate professionally to close deals.
* Achieve monthly sales targets and improve lead-to-conversion ratios.

**4. Coordination with Interior Design Team**

* Coordinate with interior designers to understand client requirements and arrange design consultations.
* Schedule client meetings, design presentations, and project discussions.
* Ensure smooth communication between clients, designers, and project execution teams.
* Support the preparation and explanation of project proposals and quotations.

**5. CRM Management & Sales Reporting**

* Update daily lead status, follow-up activities, and client interactions in the CRM.
* Maintain accurate records of qualified leads, walk-ins, scheduled meetings, and conversions.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance reports.
* Track conversion rates and identify opportunities to improve sales performance.

**Job Title:**
Business Development Executive

**Organisation:**
Aastrika Midwifery Centre (A unit of AUHC)

**Organisation Website:**
www.aastrika.com

**Work Location:**
Koramangala, Bangalore

**Reports to:**
Client Relationship Manager

**Job Type:**
Full-time

**Required Experience:**
Experienced (2+ years in sales/business development, preferably healthcare, wellness or consumer services)

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a proactive, people-focused Business Development Executive to own our lead-to-booking journey. You will respond to incoming leads, build trust with expectant parents and families, and guide them until they book with us. You will also represent Aastrika at offline events to meet potential clients and generate new leads, manage our WhatsApp channel, and work with the marketing team to improve the quality and volume of leads. The ideal candidate is a warm, confident communicator fluent in English and Kannada, and can present sensitive healthcare services with empathy and clarity.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Lead Management & Conversion**

·      Respond promptly to all incoming leads from calls, WhatsApp, website forms, social media and events.

·      Understand each client's needs and explain Aastrika's services, packages and care model clearly and with empathy.

·      Follow up with and nurture leads through regular, personalised contact until they reach the booking stage.

·      Schedule centre visits, consultations and tours for prospective clients, and coordinate with the clinical team as needed.

·      Meet monthly lead-conversion and booking targets.

**WhatsApp Channel Management**

·      Manage Aastrika's WhatsApp Business channel, answering client questions quickly and professionally.

·      Use approved templates, broadcasts and follow-up messages to keep leads engaged.

·      Hand queries to the right team (clinical, front desk, billing) when needed and close the loop with the client.

**Offline Events & Lead Generation**

·      Attend offline events such as antenatal fairs, corporate wellness sessions, community meet-ups, hospital and clinic partner events, and Aastrika-hosted sessions.

·      Talk with attendees, capture their details and turn event contacts into qualified leads.

·      Follow up with event leads within agreed timelines.

**CRM, Reporting & Pipeline Tracking**

·      Keep accurate, up-to-date records of every lead and interaction in the CRM or lead tracker.

·      Classify leads by source, stage and quality (genuine or non-genuine).

·      Prepare weekly/fortnightly/monthly reports on lead volume, conversion rates, booking status and lost-lead reasons for the Client Relationship Manager.

**Collaboration with Marketing**

·      Share regular feedback with the marketing team on lead quality, common client questions and objections.

·      Help refine campaigns, messaging and lead sources to improve lead generation and conversion.

·      Coordinate with marketing on event participation and materials needed on the ground.

**Qualifications and Requirements**

·      Any Bachelor's degree; or background in Sales or Marketing is a plus.

·      Proven experience in sales, lead conversion or client relationship roles. Healthcare, wellness, maternity or premium consumer services experience is preferred but not compulsory.

·      Excellent spoken and written communication in English and Kannada (Hindi is an advantage).

·      Strong interpersonal skills, empathy and the ability to build trust with clients.

·      Comfortable using WhatsApp Business, CRM tools and basic Excel or Google Sheets.

·      Target-driven and organised, with strong follow-up habits.

·      Able to work independently and as part of a team, and willing to attend events on weekends when needed.

**What We Offer**

·      A collaborative, growth-oriented work environment

·      The chance to work with a dedicated clinical and client relationship team in a purpose-driven organisation

·      Exposure to a fast-growing, specialised healthcare brand

**Salary:**
Competitive and based on experience and ability

* To apply, please send your detailed resume to hr@aastrika.com

title: Senior Territory Account Executive, Bengaluru
description:
**About Us**
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
  
  
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
  
  
**Please note: This role will require you to be based in Bengaluru.**
About the Department Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.
  
  
Based in India (Bengaluru), you will drive sales into commercial and enterprise accounts across Karnataka and South India for Cloudflare’s solutions. Your strategic selling activities will include "hunter" type activities to proactively penetrate target named accounts, detailed account planning, focused relationship building and leading effective sales campaigns to successful closure of high-value, multi-product architectural transformations.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess both a major account sales background in technology solutions, primarily software and cloud-based, that enables them to drive engagement with senior level decision makers (CISOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering) within Cloudflare’s target customers. Industry experience selling into Digital Natives, IT/ITES, SaaS scale-ups, and other Enterprise verticals is desired in this role. You must be capable of orchestrating complex six-figure ($100K+) expansions encompassing Zero Trust/SASE, Developer Platforms (Workers/R2), and Application Security.
  
  
As an Account Executive, you'll be responsible for developing and executing against a Sales strategy/plan for assigned vertical or accounts, as well as driving large account sales into India markets to achieve revenue targets. Therefore, you must have a strong network of contacts with decision makers in enterprise accounts across the region, and have experience selling complex solutions to these accounts. You will have an intuitive understanding and experience with the key business and technical needs of these large accounts and will create and deliver compelling value propositions to them for Cloudflare solutions, specifically targeting competitive displacements of Cybersecurity SaaS like Akamai, AWS, Azure, GCP, legacy appliances, Zscaler, or Cisco Umbrella.
  
  
**Additional Responsibilities Will Include**- Manage complex contract negotiations for high-AOV, multi-product enterprise deals
- Maintain a robust sales pipeline through proactive outbound targeting and whitespace mining within your installed base
- Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts to convert variable usage into committed enterprise contracts
- Collaborate closely with the regional partner ecosystem (e.g., Tech Data, Softcell) to accelerate deal velocity
< 50% travel
  
  
**Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree required
* Fluent in English
* Relevant direct experience, track record, and relationships within corporate enterprise accounts in the India market (specifically Karnataka and South India)
* Minimum 10 years of direct B2B selling experience, preferably managing internet, cloud, and security accounts
* Direct experience selling network security, Zero Trust/SASE (Cloudflare One), and/or CDN / Application Security solutions preferred
* Proven track record of executing competitive takeout campaigns against legacy hardware and cloud point solutions
* Prior experience being part of an early sales team helping drive traction in India market for a US-based SaaS company highly preferred
* Experience managing longer, complex sales cycles and cross-functional evaluations
* Basic understanding of computer networking, cloud architectures, and “how the internet works”
* Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science, or MIS a plus)
* Strong interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organisational skills
* Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit
* Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment

What Makes Cloudflare Special?
  
  
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
  
  
**Project Galileo**
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
  
  
**Athenian Project**
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
  
  
**1.1.1.1**
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
  
  
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
  
  
Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

**About Glean:**

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

**About the Role:**

The Solution Engineer role sits within the GTM organisation in India, making you a trusted technical advisor to the local sales team, our partners, and our customers. In this role, you will support the EMEA region, working closely with EMEA Account Executives, partners, and customers. You will work on exciting projects with some of the most forward-thinking organisations, helping guide the start of their Generative AI journeys. This role has a strong technical skill set and is not a classic SE profile. At Glean, our Solution Engineers work with our customers to help them connect Glean to their most important decision-making platforms. These platforms include Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Jira, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Zendesk, and everything in between! As an SE, you will work closely with our Account Executives (AEs) and will be responsible for the technical success and delivery of our sales opportunities.

**You will:**

* Perform interactive demonstrations of the Glean platform to prospective customers.

title: Sr. Manager, Digital Product Management
description:
**Work Schedule**

**Environmental Conditions**

**Job Description**

When you're part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll do meaningful work that enables our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. As the world leader in serving science, our digital ecosystem powers billions of dollars in customer interactions and supports scientists, researchers, healthcare professionals and industrial customers around the globe. Our Digital Customer Experience organization is responsible for defining and delivering the future of digital commerce across our digital experiences.

As a Senior Digital Product Manager, APAC, you will serve as the regional product leader connecting Asia Pacific market performance, customer needs and commercial priorities to Thermo Fisher Scientific's global digital product strategy. You will develop a fact-based point of view on where Digital can improve customer outcomes and commercial performance across the region, with particular attention to the different market structures, customer behaviors, dealer models and platform maturity that shape digital adoption in APAC.

This role is intentionally positioned in-region. You will work closely with regional Commercial, Marketing, and eBusiness leaders while partnering with global Product Management, UX, Analytics and platform teams. Your responsibility is not simply to represent regional requests. You will co-create product direction with the markets, distinguish local requirements from scalable patterns and ensure regional insights influence enterprise product decisions.

Success requires strong product judgment, commercial acumen and the ability to operate across a complex portfolio of global and localized digital experiences. You will be expected to understand revenue and funnel performance across the region, develop hypotheses about performance drivers, identify opportunities for experimentation and bring a clear recommendation back to the broader product organization. You will also identify successful regional capabilities and operating models that may warrant broader global scale.

**How You Will Make an Impact**
===============================

**Regional Product Vision and Strategy**
----------------------------------------

* Define and evolve the digital product vision for APAC, grounded in customer evidence, regional commercial priorities, competitive context and measurable business outcomes.
* Translate differences across markets into a contextualized regional strategy that clarifies what should be globally standardized, regionally adapted or locally differentiated.
* Develop and maintain a multi-year regional product roadmap that connects APAC priorities to global platform and experience roadmaps.
* Distinguish business requests from underlying customer and commercial problems, then recommend the most effective product intervention.
* Identify opportunities that span markets, sites or organizational boundaries and drive alignment on reusable capabilities rather than one-off solutions.
* Bring a clear APAC point of view into global product planning, investment discussions and roadmap trade-offs.

**Revenue, Funnel and Market Performance Leadership**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Develop command of digital revenue, engaged traffic, funnel performance, adoption and conversion across APAC markets and the digital platforms available to local teams.
* Partner with Finance, Commercial and regional stakeholders to understand performance versus plan and prior year, identify meaningful trends and explain the drivers behind regional variation.
* Build hypotheses that distinguish macroeconomic or market softness from addressable digital performance gaps.
* Bring regional insights back into the corporate product organization so market learning informs enterprise priorities, investment decisions and roadmap sequencing.

**Customer, Market and Dealer Insight**
---------------------------------------

* Establish a disciplined customer and market insight cadence using direct customer engagement, Sales and service feedback, behavioral analytics, CAS or satisfaction signals and competitive benchmarking.
* Develop a strong understanding of dealer and distributor personas across APAC, including which needs are common across markets and which are country-specific.
* Partner with UX and Research to validate customer problems before committing to solutions and ensure regional experiences reflect real customer behavior.
* Monitor local competitors, digital commerce practices and emerging market behaviors to identify opportunities for differentiation.

**Global-to-Local and Local-to-Global Product Leadership**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Accelerate adoption of global digital capabilities across APAC by translating enterprise products into relevant regional use cases, enablement plans and measurable adoption outcomes.
* Identify successful regional capabilities, market practices or customer solutions that have the potential to scale beyond a single country.
* Build the business and customer case for when localized innovation should be standardized or incorporated into global platforms.
* Anticipate dependencies across markets and product portfolios and proactively align roadmaps to reduce fragmentation.

**Cross-Functional Product Leadership**
---------------------------------------

* Serve as a strategic product partner to APAC Marketing, eBusiness and regional leadership teams.
* Make and communicate prioritization recommendations when customer, regional, commercial and technical needs compete for investment.
* Clearly articulate expected customer and business outcomes, trade-offs, risks and strategic rationale to both senior executives and delivery teams.
* Create operating mechanisms that keep regional teams informed while avoiding a model centered on status reporting or request intake.
* Influence without direct authority and create momentum across globally distributed teams.

**Product Discovery and Delivery**
----------------------------------

* Lead discovery for regional customer and commercial problems before committing teams to specific solutions.
* Translate validated opportunities into clear product outcomes, requirements and MVP strategies that enable UX and Engineering teams to execute effectively.
* Determine the smallest meaningful intervention needed to validate a hypothesis and define criteria for scaling, iterating or stopping.
* Balance immediate market needs with the development of reusable global or regional platform capabilities.
* Maintain accountability for customer and business outcomes throughout the product lifecycle rather than measuring success primarily through feature delivery.

**Minimum Qualifications**
==========================

* Bachelor's degree required.
* 7+ years of experience in Digital Product Management, Digital Commerce, Customer Experience or closely related roles.
* Demonstrated experience defining product strategy and owning roadmaps for customer-facing digital products.
* Experience leading product decisions in complex, cross-functional and geographically distributed environments.
* Experience using revenue, funnel, behavioral analytics, customer insights and experimentation to make prioritization and investment decisions.
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer and business problems into product strategy, measurable outcomes and executable roadmaps.
* Strong ability to communicate strategy, recommendations and trade-offs to senior executives, commercial leaders and technical teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience with dealer or distributor portals, localized commerce models, market expansion or regional digital transformation.
* Experience delivering digital commerce capabilities for B2B customers, distributors, dealers, procurement organizations or enterprise purchasing workflows.
* Experience managing digital revenue or funnel performance and translating business performance into product interventions.
* Experience with global digital platforms that must support regional and market-specific requirements.
* Experience collaborating across cultures and time zones and influencing teams without direct authority.
* MBA or advanced business education.

**Key Capabilities for Success**
================================

* Regional strategic product leadership: Builds a clear product point of view from customer, commercial and market evidence rather than serving primarily as a conduit for requests.
* Commercial acumen: Understands revenue, funnel and market performance and can identify where Digital has meaningful levers to change outcomes.
* Customer and market grounding: Uses direct customer evidence, analytics, Sales insight, competitive context and emerging market or technology signals to challenge assumptions and guide priorities.
* Systems thinking: Understands how local market decisions interact with global platforms, shared capabilities and the broader customer journey.
* Global-local judgment: Recognizes when a market need should be localized, when a global capability should be adopted and when regional innovation has potential for enterprise scale.
* Influence and alignment: Builds trust across regional and global teams while remaining comfortable making recommendations and difficult trade-offs.
* Clear communication: Synthesizes complex performance and customer signals into a concise point of view for executive, commercial and technical audiences.
* Ownership: Takes accountability for customer and business outcomes from discovery through delivery, adoption and optimization.

title: Sr Manager Internal Audit
description:
**About Target**
----------------

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that purpose to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

You’ll bring your unique point of view, experience and passion for the work to your team and internal clients. You’ll be an integral voice in discussions that lead to Target’s unparalleled shopping experience. Your analysis and recommendations will be directly applied to critical business decisions, from sales to merchandising and beyond. You’ll enjoy the interesting challenges of the competitive retail space. You’ll see your contributions come to life in virtually every area of this dynamic enterprise. And you’ll grow and be challenged in your career while having a healthy balance with life outside of work.

**About Internal Audit**
------------------------

Internal Audit brings Target’s purpose to life by providing independent assurance and risk insights that matter to the Audit & Risk Committee, executive leaders, business owners, support functions, and risk-focused partners across the enterprise. Our objective insights help strengthen performance, resilience, and confident decision-making across Target.

**About the Role**
------------------

As Senior Manager, Internal Audit, you will partner with the Internal Audit Director to translate the team’s vision and strategy into action. You will lead assurance and compliance work, develop high-performing talent, strengthen stakeholder relationships, and help transform Internal Audit through the responsible use of data and emerging technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Lead assurance and compliance delivery:** Lead a team of audit professionals across SOX IT general controls, business process controls, and automated controls.
* **Support enterprise and India-focused assurance:** Perform varying roles in assurance activities related to Target enterprise business capabilities and Target in India capabilities, including regulatory requirements. Support or lead IFC compliance for the Target in India entity.
* **Advance Internal Audit transformation:** Set direction for and drive the responsible use of data analytics, automation, GenAI, and agentic AI to improve the efficiency, quality, and effectiveness of audit work.
* **Provide forward-looking risk insights:** Monitor current, emerging, internal, and external risks. Evaluate governance, risk management, processes, technology, data, and controls, and communicate timely recommendations that strengthen business results and resilience.
* **Build high-performing teams:** Set clear expectations, coach with care, hold team members accountable, and support meaningful development. Enable the team to deliver quality work, exercise sound judgment, and communicate with impact.
* **Manage stakeholders effectively:** Build productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders through clear, timely communication. Constructively challenge perspectives when needed to support effective execution and strong outcomes.

**Leadership and Transformation Expectations**
----------------------------------------------

Success in this role requires inclusive and caring leadership that fosters belonging, critical thinking, professional skepticism, courage, candor, curiosity, adaptability, and enterprise-minded partnership. You must be able to lead teams through ambiguity and change while communicating with clarity and impact.

You will play a pivotal role in building an AI-enabled, human-led Internal Audit function. This requires hands-on familiarity with GenAI, agentic AI, agile ways of working, and data analytics, as well as the ability to guide the team in using these capabilities responsibly. Human judgment, quality, confidentiality, independence, and objectivity must remain central to the work.

**Qualifications and Experience**
---------------------------------

* **Education and credentials:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in commerce, accountancy, management, or a related field. Relevant professional certifications are preferred based on the portfolio, including Chartered Accountancy, ACCA, CPA, CIA, CISA, CISM, CRISC, PMP, data and analytics, AI, cyber, or other risk-related credentials.
* **Relevant experience:** **Eight or more** **(8+)** years of post-qualification experience, excluding internships, in audit, risk, compliance, retail, data, technology, cyber, or a related area. Experience in both SOX or IFC and internal audit is preferred; Big Four or retail industry experience is an advantage.
* **Audit and risk expertise:** Strong knowledge of internal audit and enterprise risk management, including risk assessment and prioritization, governance, processes and internal controls, root-cause analysis, issue remediation, and assurance or advisory delivery.
* **Strategic assurance leadership:** Demonstrated ability to lead a risk-based assurance strategy, develop a forward-looking audit pipeline, prioritize work across evolving risks, and influence enterprise-minded decisions that improve business outcomes and resilience.
* **Judgment and integrity:** Strong professional judgment, critical thinking, professional skepticism, curiosity, and courage, with the ability to make sound decisions amid ambiguity while preserving independence, objectivity, and quality.
* **Communication and influence:** Demonstrated executive communication, storytelling, stakeholder partnership, and influencing skills, including the ability to translate complex risk and control topics into clear, actionable messages.
* **People leadership:** Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop team members through ambiguity and change while fostering belonging, accountability, inclusive and caring leadership, and future-ready skills and mindsets.
* **Technology enablement:** Experience applying or leading the use of Gen AI, Agentic AI, data analytics & visualization, automation and other technology-enabled capabilities to solve business problems.

*Core responsibilities may change at any time based on business needs.*
