title: Sales Data Steward & Salesforce Administration Associate
description:
Huron is redefining what a global consulting organization can be. Advancing new ideas every day to build even stronger clients, individuals and communities. We re helping our clients find new ways to drive growth, enhance business performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. And, we re developing strategies and implementing solutions that enable the transformative change they need to own their future. 

 As a member of the Huron corporate team, you ll help to evolve our business model to stay ahead of market forces, industry trends and client needs. Our accounting, finance, human resources, IT, legal, marketing and facilities management professionals work collaboratively to support Huron s collective strategies and enable real transformation to produce sustainable business results. 

 Join our team and create your future. Position Summary
The Growth Enablement Team (GET) is a robust sales support team with the goals of improving sales experiences, efficiency, and win rates. GET provides support across several key pillars: sales education programming; sales technology, reporting, and analytics; sales prospecting; sales opportunity support (RFPs, orals); and sales asset content and visual design. This remote team consists of US-, Canada- and India-based team members that support all industries and capabilities within Huron.
Huron is seeking an Associate to execute CRM data management and Salesforce administration in support of sales data quality across our internal CRM and analytics ecosystem, with a primary focus on Salesforce, our enterprise data lakehouse, and BI tools. Working within the Data, Analytics & AI pillar and partnering closely with the data governance function, this role keeps opportunity, account, contact, lead, case, and pipeline data clean, consistent, and reporting-ready. The role is hands-on: investigating data quality issues, executing mass updates and remediation safely, and helping bring consistency to standardized reporting. This is an execution and analysis role operating inside a heavily customized, multi-system integrated ecosystem. It does not own system design: changes to validation rules, automation, code, security model, or integrations remain with IT Salesforce Product Support, and all configuration changes follow the standard design review and approval path before implementation.
The position consolidates routine CRM data execution that currently passes between GET Data & Analytics, GET Salesforce Ops/Business Support, and IT Salesforce Product Support, giving that work a dedicated owner. The ideal candidate is a certified Salesforce Administrator with 2-4 years of relevant experience who works on more complex issues following defined parameters and methodologies, requires limited oversight to complete assignments, is genuinely curious about applying AI and automation to manual data work, and is eager to develop data engineering and Databricks capability over time. Responsibilities The Associate executes and maintains sales data quality within Salesforce and downstream systems, turning governance standards into clean, trustworthy data in the system. They partner cross-functionally with Growth Enablement, IT Salesforce Product Support, Analytics, and the Data Governance function to investigate and resolve data issues, execute large-scale corrections, and support trusted sales data that enables effective decision-making. Supports the quality, integrity, and ongoing management of sales and CRM data across Salesforce and related systems. Performs data quality analysis, bulk data remediation, and approved Salesforce data administration activities; investigates and resolves data issues; and applies established governance standards to maintain accurate, consistent, and reporting-ready data. Partners with Growth Enablement, IT, Analytics, and Data Governance teams to support trusted sales data and improve data management processes, including opportunities for automation and AI-enabled efficiencies Key responsibilities include: Mass Data Operations & Remediation: Execute bulk updates, corrections, and remediation across Salesforce objects (Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Activities, Cases) safely and accurately when data issues arise, applying validation, backup, and rollback discipline to protect data integrity. Routine operations run with limited oversight; changes above an agreed risk threshold are reviewed before execution. Data Quality Investigation & Root-Cause Analysis: Investigate data quality problems (completeness, conformity, validity, duplicates, hierarchy integrity, stage aging, activity hygiene), trace where issues originate, identify patterns, and recommend upstream fixes rather than repeated manual cleanup. Salesforce Data-Scoped Configuration & Execution: Execute approved, data-scoped configuration that directly supports data quality, working to IT Salesforce Product Support technical standards and testing in sandbox before production. Representative work includes: field-usage analysis and deactivation of unused or deprecated fields; duplicate and matching rule tuning and record merges; configuration of CRM data quality tooling (e.g., RingLead normalization, segmentation, and enrichment mappings); picklist value maintenance and restricted-picklist hygiene; account hierarchy, ownership, and record-type corrections; and report type, list view, and dashboard inventory cleanup. This role does not design or independently modify validation rules, flows, triggers, Apex, the security model, or anything affecting integrations or managed/shared components; it analyzes, recommends, and executes those changes only after IT design review and approval. AI & Automation of Manual Data Work: Identify recurring manual data tasks that could be automated or AI-assisted, maintain and prioritize a working backlog of those opportunities, prototype approaches using approved tools, and report results with evidence such as effort saved, error rate, and records affected. Reporting Consistency & Governance Support: Help bring order to standardized reporting by maintaining an inventory of reports and dashboards and identifying redundant, conflicting, or ungoverned assets that undermine trust in the numbers; support consistent report and field standards. Data Quality Execution in Partnership with Governance: Operationalize the standards, DQ rules, and stewardship model defined by the Data Governance function - applying policy as executed, maintained data quality in Salesforce and downstream systems. Master & Reference Data Maintenance: Support client/account and contact mastering, de-duplication and matching, survivorship, and account hierarchy maintenance in line with governance-defined rules, including enrichment and normalization rules in CRM data quality tooling. Monitoring & Issue Triage: Assist in profiling and monitoring data quality, running issue triage, and reporting on DQ metrics and remediation progress to the engineering and governance leads. Data Engineering & Pipeline Support (developing): Over time, contribute to data pipeline, integration, and Databricks work alongside the engineering team, building toward a broader data engineering skill set. Documentation & Standards: Produce and maintain clear documentation of data operations, remediation procedures, and standards; contribute to playbooks and quick-reference guides for consistent execution. Position Requirements The role requires hands-on Salesforce administration and CRM data management experience, with demonstrated ability to execute data operations and investigate data quality issues in enterprise environments. The ideal candidate is a certified Salesforce Administrator who works effectively within defined methods with limited oversight and collaborates across functions and time zones. Key Qualifications Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Analytics, or related field. Salesforce Administrator certification (required): current, active certification with demonstrated hands-on administration experience. 2-4 years of relevant experience in CRM data management, Salesforce administration, data quality, or data operations, with the ability to work on more complex issues following defined parameters and methodologies and to complete assignments with limited oversight. Demonstrated experience executing mass data updates and bulk operations in Salesforce (e.g., Data Loader, data import/export tools), with careful validation and rollback practices. Data investigation and troubleshooting skills: able to analyze data to identify gaps, diagnose root causes, and recommend or execute resolutions. Solid understanding of the Salesforce data model, records, fields, matching/duplicate rules, reporting structures, and sharing/visibility basics, with the ability to read and interpret existing validation rules, automation, and integration touchpoints well enough to diagnose where a data issue originates and escalate appropriately. Hands-on experience with duplicate management and data quality tooling (e.g., RingLead, LeanData, DemandTools), including normalization, segmentation, matching/merge criteria, and enrichment rules. Demonstrated curiosity about AI: uses AI tools in day-to-day work and can describe something they have automated or simplified as a result. Proficiency with data manipulation (e.g., SQL or spreadsheet-based transformation) and familiarity with data quality concepts (completeness, conformity, deduplication, hierarchy integrity). Strong communication and organizational skills; able to convey data issues, status, and risks clearly, translate technical terms for non-technical audiences, and work effectively with US- and Canada-based analytics leads across time zones. Ability to work to another team s technical standards and receptive to coaching and review from outside the direct reporting line. Work standards and accountability: sets high standards for accuracy and completeness, takes ownership of assignments, and escalates issues appropriately. Preferred Skills Databricks experience (strongly desired): exposure to the data lakehouse and a willingness to develop data engineering capability; training will be provided. - Exposure to data pipeline / data engineering concepts and CRM-to-warehouse/BI integration patterns. Familiarity with BI/analytics platforms, especially Salesforce CRM Analytics (CRMA / Analytics Studio) and Microsoft Power BI. Experience with sales data lifecycles (lead to opportunity to booking), pipeline management, and RevOps metrics. Familiarity with data governance or stewardship practices, DQ scorecards, and business glossary concepts. Exposure to marketing automation data (Pardot), third-party data enrichment providers (e.g., ZoomInfo), and ERP (Workday) integrations affecting sales data. Relevant Salesforce certifications beyond Administrator (e.g., Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder) a plus. Experience with Agile delivery and tools (e.g., Azure DevOps) and creating enablement materials such as playbooks and quick-reference guides. Associate Competencies This role is expected to demonstrate Hurons Associate competencies. At this level, the individual works on more complex issues following defined parameters and methodologies, receives general instructions, and requires limited oversight to complete assignments. Expectations are organized under the four core competencies below. Teamwork & Organizational Commitment Lives Hurons Values: Leads with Hurons values - Integrity, Collaboration, Impact, Intellectual Curiosity, Inclusion, Humility, and Excellence - in day-to-day interactions across the analytics, engineering, and IT teams. Client Service Focus Communication: Conveys data issues, status, and risks clearly and concisely; adjusts to the listener and translates technical terms for those without a technical background; listens actively and confirms understanding. Adaptability: Maintains effectiveness through change; approaches new tools and processes with a positive mindset and adjusts approaches rather than persisting with ineffective methods. Critical Thinking: Identifies data problems and opportunities, gathers and interprets information from multiple sources to detect trends and cause-effect relationships, generates and evaluates alternatives against clear criteria, and commits to action with appropriate urgency. Client Focus: Treats internal stakeholders (analytics leads, sales ops, governance, IT Salesforce Product Support) as clients - understands their needs, identifies service issues, and drives practices that improve data trust and satisfaction. Planning & Organizing: Prioritizes activities, breaks assignments into tasks, establishes timelines and milestones for recurring data quality cycles, and leverages available resources and tools to complete work efficiently. Work Standards: Sets high standards for data accuracy and quality, ensures no aspect of remediation is neglected, and takes responsibility for outcomes. Initiating Action: Responds promptly when data issues surface, implements improvements without waiting to be prompted, and takes action beyond the minimum required to resolve recurring problems at the source. Developing Self & Others Continuous Learning: Actively identifies learning needs, seeks out learning opportunities (including Databricks, data engineering, and AI tooling), applies new knowledge on the job, and takes on challenging or unfamiliar assignments to grow. Building Self Insight: Proactively seeks feedback and uses it constructively; assesses own impact and development needs; modifies approach based on feedback and self-assessment. Technical Knowledge Technical & Professional Knowledge/Skills: Understands and can explain relevant technical terminology and developments; knows how and when to apply Salesforce administration and CRM data management skills; performs complex tasks in the area of expertise to solve difficult data problems and accomplish challenging goals. Our data strategy is focused on connecting, curating, and operationalizing enterprise data to drive measurable business outcomes, accelerate product delivery, and fuel innovation across service lines. 

 Role Overview 
 The GTech Data Analytics function partners closely with Product, Data Engineering, and Enterprise Architecture to design and deliver modern data platforms and capabilities that are product-ready, reusable, and built for scale. The Data Architect (Product) is responsible for shaping and enabling the data architecture that underpins product development, from rapid pilots and proofs of concept through durable, enterprise-grade platforms. This role is critical to ensuring data is modeled, integrated, governed, and operationalized in ways that support product roadmaps, iterative delivery, and AI-enabled use cases while maintaining alignment with enterprise standards. 

 Responsibilities 
 Partner with Product, Data Analytics, and Enterprise Architecture to interpret and execute data architecture strategies that support product roadmaps, pilots, and scalable platform capabilities. Design and evolve data architectures that underpin product platforms and AI-enabled capabilities, including databases, data warehouses, lakes, and analytical data stores, ensuring alignment with product outcomes and enterprise standards.  We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled individual to lead the Model Validation function with Risk Management Group. Key Accountabilities

Methodology Review: Critically evaluate model development methodologies, underlying assumptions, conceptual soundness, and quantitative techniques. Data Quality Assessment: Assess the quality, completeness, and appropriateness of data used in model development and ongoing monitoring. Implementation Review: Verify the accurate and robust implementation of models within relevant systems. Performance Monitoring: Review and challenge ongoing model performance monitoring frameworks and results, including backtesting, benchmarking, and sensitivity analysis. Governance and Policy: Establish Governance processes and Model validation Policy in line with local regulatory and group requirements. Documentation & Reporting: Prepare comprehensive validation reports detailing findings, limitations, recommendations, and conclusions. Present findings to model owners, developers, and relevant committees. Regulatory Compliance: Ensure models and validation practices comply with internal policies and external regulatory requirements (e.g., SR 11-7, CECL, IFRS 9, Basel Accords). Challenging Model Development: Proactively engage with model developers to provide constructive challenge and guidance throughout the model lifecycle. Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate effectively with model development teams, risk management functions, business lines, internal audit, and regulators. Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the enhancement of validation processes, methodologies, and tools. Job Duties & responsibilities Required Experience

Demonstrable experience with model review and validation pertaining to both wholesale banking and retail banking Understanding of technical modelling requirements throughout model life cycle covering data analytics, coding, development, deployment, monitoring and maintenance for both traditional AI and Gen AI models Capacity to adopt new modelling areas (e.g., climate risk & Agentic AI) and problem solving Understanding of model governance requirements and principles Education / Preferred Qualifications

Analytical & Critical Thinking: Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills with the ability to identify subtle model weaknesses and propose practical solutions. Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences. Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to producing high-quality work. Collaboration: Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Experience in a regulated financial institution environment. Technical Competencies

Expertise in programming languages for data analysis and statistical modeling: Python, R, SAS. Familiarity with database querying tools (SQL) is a plus. Join us to turn securities-trading data and AI concepts into stable, scalable enterprise solutions. This is a consulting role for a strong Python engineer who can understand trading workflows, shape requirements with business and data stakeholders, and industrialise analytics or AI use cases for production. 
 BUSINESS OUTCOMES 
 Convert trading and execution data into dependable analytics and near-real-time decision support. Industrialise proofs of concept into secure, resilient and supportable enterprise applications. Create reusable data and AI engineering patterns for securities-trading use cases. 
 WHAT YOU WILL DO 
 Engage business users, product owners, data scientists and architects to define use cases, data needs, controls and measurable outcomes. Design and develop Python, Kafka and big-data applications for trading analytics and AI-enabled insights. Engineer experimental models and prototypes into tested, deployable and operationally resilient software. Analyse data lineage, quality, mappings and business rules across order, trade, instrument and execution datasets. Design for non-functional requirements including stability, capacity, scalability, performance, security and manageability. Support cloud and platform decisions by assessing technical, economic and risk considerations. Own code quality, automated tests, release readiness, observability and production-issue resolution. Apply AI-assisted development techniques with appropriate review, validation and documentation. 
 DOMAIN CAPABILITIES (DESIRABLE) 
 Working awareness of securities-trading workflows, with emphasis on listed securities. Basic understanding of order, execution, trade and instrument data and how these datasets support analytics and control use cases. Ability to translate trading questions into data products, rules, features, metrics and testable acceptance criteria. Awareness of front-to-back dependencies and data-quality risks in regulated trading environments. 
 ENGINEERING CAPABILITIES 
 Expert-level Python development and practical use of pandas and NumPy. Big-data engineering using technologies such as Spark, Parquet and Hive; familiarity with distributed processing concepts. Kafka or comparable messaging middleware and event-driven solution patterns. Oracle or PostgreSQL, relational modelling and advanced SQL. Unix/Linux, shell scripting, Git/GitLab and build or dependency-management tooling. API and integration engineering, automated testing, CI/CD and production support. Experience deploying analytics or AI workloads to enterprise infrastructure or cloud platforms. 
 CONSULTING AND CLIENT ENGAGEMENT 
 Facilitate use-case discovery and convert business problems into an executable engineering backlog. Explain data, architecture and AI trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Produce consulting deliverables such as data-flow views, source-to-target mappings, control definitions, solution options and implementation roadmaps. Bridge data scientists, platform engineers and trading stakeholders to avoid the gap between prototype and production. Contribute accelerators, reusable components and delivery playbooks. 
 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 
 8+ years of professional Python engineering experience with demonstrable production code ownership. Experience in data-intensive enterprise applications, preferably in capital markets, securities trading or transaction processing (domain exposure is an advantage, not a prerequisite). Hands-on experience with Kafka, big-data technologies, relational databases and Linux-based platforms. Ability to combine business analysis, data analysis, solution design and software engineering. Experience resolving complex production issues across distributed teams. Hands-on experience in AI-based development, including delivery using AI coding assistants and AI-enabled engineering practices. Excellent written and verbal communication skills (essential). Location: Pune preferred. 
 PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

description:
Senior Techno-Functional Data & AI Engineering Consultant 
 Securities Trading Analytics | Python, Kafka, Spark 
 ROLE PURPOSE 
Join us to turn securities-trading data and AI concepts into stable, scalable enterprise solutions. This is a consulting role for a strong Python engineer who can understand trading workflows, shape requirements with business and data stakeholders, and industrialise analytics or AI use cases for production. 
 BUSINESS OUTCOMES 
 Convert trading and execution data into dependable analytics and near-real-time decision support. Industrialise proofs of concept into secure, resilient and supportable enterprise applications. Create reusable data and AI engineering patterns for securities-trading use cases. 
 WHAT YOU WILL DO 
 Engage business users, product owners, data scientists and architects to define use cases, data needs, controls and measurable outcomes. Design and develop Python, Kafka and big-data applications for trading analytics and AI-enabled insights. Engineer experimental models and prototypes into tested, deployable and operationally resilient software. Analyse data lineage, quality, mappings and business rules across order, trade, instrument and execution datasets. Design for non-functional requirements including stability, capacity, scalability, performance, security and manageability. Support cloud and platform decisions by assessing technical, economic and risk considerations. Own code quality, automated tests, release readiness, observability and production-issue resolution. Apply AI-assisted development techniques with appropriate review, validation and documentation. 
 DOMAIN CAPABILITIES (DESIRABLE) 
 Working awareness of securities-trading workflows, with emphasis on listed securities. Basic understanding of order, execution, trade and instrument data and how these datasets support analytics and control use cases. Ability to translate trading questions into data products, rules, features, metrics and testable acceptance criteria. Awareness of front-to-back dependencies and data-quality risks in regulated trading environments. 
 ENGINEERING CAPABILITIES 
 Expert-level Python development and practical use of pandas and NumPy. Big-data engineering using technologies such as Spark, Parquet and Hive; familiarity with distributed processing concepts. Kafka or comparable messaging middleware and event-driven solution patterns. Oracle or PostgreSQL, relational modelling and advanced SQL. Unix/Linux, shell scripting, Git/GitLab and build or dependency-management tooling. API and integration engineering, automated testing, CI/CD and production support. Experience deploying analytics or AI workloads to enterprise infrastructure or cloud platforms. 
 CONSULTING AND CLIENT ENGAGEMENT 
 Facilitate use-case discovery and convert business problems into an executable engineering backlog. Explain data, architecture and AI trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Produce consulting deliverables such as data-flow views, source-to-target mappings, control definitions, solution options and implementation roadmaps. Bridge data scientists, platform engineers and trading stakeholders to avoid the gap between prototype and production. Contribute accelerators, reusable components and delivery playbooks. 
 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 
 8+ years of professional Python engineering experience with demonstrable production code ownership. Experience in data-intensive enterprise applications, preferably in capital markets, securities trading or transaction processing (domain exposure is an advantage, not a prerequisite). Hands-on experience with Kafka, big-data technologies, relational databases and Linux-based platforms. Ability to combine business analysis, data analysis, solution design and software engineering. Experience resolving complex production issues across distributed teams. Hands-on experience in AI-based development, including delivery using AI coding assistants and AI-enabled engineering practices. Excellent written and verbal communication skills (essential). Location: Pune preferred. 
 PREFERRED EXPERIENCE 
 Java development capability. Cloud-native engineering and container platforms. MLOps, model monitoring, retrieval-augmented generation or agentic AI patterns applied in controlled enterprise environments. Experience with real-time trading analytics, execution data or market-data integration.

title: MLOps Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a Senior MLOps / ML Engineer to own, develop, and maintain ML deployment and data processing workflows, spanning an Argo-based workflow orchestration platform and Python-based frameworks for large-scale AI model inference. The ideal candidate should have strong Python and problem-solving skills, be comfortable designing and troubleshooting workflows, and be able to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies. A pure MLOps background is not mandatory if the candidate has strong ML/software engineering fundamentals and can work effectively with technologies such as Databricks, Argo, Azure Pipelines, and Ray. 

 Responsibilities 

 Infrastructure Pipeline Development 
 Design and maintain Argo Workflows / Argo Events-based ML and data processing pipelines across environments (dev / QA / staging / prod). Design and maintain WorkflowTemplates, DAGs, fan-out patterns, scheduled workflows, and event-driven triggers following GitOps best practices. Design and develop Python-based workflows and components for ML data processing and model inference. Work with Databricks and Spark-based workloads for data processing, transformation, and pipeline execution. Build and maintain Docker images for ML and GPU-accelerated workloads, including multi-stage builds and container optimization. Develop scalable inference workflows using Ray where required. Integrate with Azure ML and Azure cloud services for model versioning, model artifacts, training workflows, and deployment. Maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, quality gates, and environment-specific deployment processes. 

 Model Deployment Operations 
 Automate deployment, monitoring, and rollback of machine learning and deep learning models on production Kubernetes environments. Manage model versioning and artifact movement from cloud ML workspaces and storage systems to production workloads. Maintain configuration systems and reusable workflow components to ensure reproducible pipeline execution across environments. Monitor model and pipeline performance, data processing health, resource utilization, and infrastructure reliability. Troubleshoot production issues involving failed workflows, data bottlenecks, resource contention, GPU utilization, and latency regressions. Identify reliability and performance issues proactively and implement improvements to ML and data processing workflows. Collaborate with data scientists and engineering teams to improve model deployment, inference, and pipeline reliability. 

 Expertise and Qualifications 

 Must-Have Technical Skills 
 Python - strong programming and problem-solving skills; experience with application development, scripting, and Python packaging. Workflow Design - ability to design reliable workflows with dependencies, parallel execution, retries, failure handling, scheduling, and event-driven execution. Argo Workflows / Argo Events - understanding of WorkflowTemplates, DAGs, event-driven workflows, and workflow execution. Databricks / Data Processing - hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark/Spark SQL, or similar large-scale data processing platforms. Kubernetes - understanding of workload orchestration, resource management, namespaces, and production troubleshooting. Git / Version Control - strong understanding of Git or equivalent version control systems, including branching, merging, pull requests, and maintaining code/configuration changes. Docker - containerization, multi-stage builds, and optimization of ML workloads. CI/CD - experience designing pipelines with automated testing, quality gates, artifact management, and deployment processes. Azure Cloud - working knowledge of Azure ML, Azure Blob Storage, AKS, and Azure-based ML workflows. Problem Solving - ability to troubleshoot unfamiliar technical problems and identify practical solutions. 

 Good-to-Have Technical Skills 
 Ray - distributed data processing and inference at scale. Deep Learning frameworks - PyTorch, TensorFlow; model formats such as ONNX, SavedModel, and TorchScript. Helm / ArgoCD and GitOps-based deployment practices. Prometheus / Grafana and production observability. Experience with Azure Pipelines or similar CI/CD platforms. Experience with ML model monitoring, data drift, and model performance monitoring. Large-scale data processing - experience working with large volumes of structured, unstructured, image, or video data, particularly for ML/AI workloads.

Job Summary 
 Grant Thornton GTech's vision is centered around three strategic pillars: Application Modernization, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Data. As GTech accelerates its product-led transformation, data plays a foundational role in enabling scalable platforms, AI-powered capabilities, and differentiated digital products. Our data strategy is focused on connecting, curating, and operationalizing enterprise data to drive measurable business outcomes, accelerate product delivery, and fuel innovation across service lines. 

 Role Overview 
 The GTech Data Analytics function partners closely with Product, Data Engineering, and Enterprise Architecture to design and deliver modern data platforms and capabilities that are product-ready, reusable, and built for scale. The Data Architect (Product) is responsible for shaping and enabling the data architecture that underpins product development, from rapid pilots and proofs of concept through durable, enterprise-grade platforms. This role is critical to ensuring data is modeled, integrated, governed, and operationalized in ways that support product roadmaps, iterative delivery, and AI-enabled use cases while maintaining alignment with enterprise standards.

 Partner with Product, Data Analytics, and Enterprise Architecture to interpret and execute data architecture strategies that support product roadmaps, pilots, and scalable platform capabilities. Design and evolve data architectures that underpin product platforms and AI-enabled capabilities, including databases, data warehouses, lakes, and analytical data stores, ensuring alignment with product outcomes and enterprise standards. Define data models, schemas, integration patterns, and platform components that are reusable across multiple products and service lines. Design and enable data ingestion, transformation, and integration patterns (e.g., ELT/ETL, streaming, APIs) that support rapid product iteration while remaining production-ready and secure. Translate product and platform requirements into logical and physical data models, metadata, data quality rules, and governance controls that support analytics and AI use cases. Work closely with Product Managers and Engineering leads to ensure data architecture decisions align with delivery timelines, release planning, and longer-term product roadmaps. Enable the creation of reusable data services, platform capabilities, and cost-efficient patterns that accelerate product delivery and reduce duplication across teams. Participate in architecture reviews, design forums, and governance checkpoints to balance speed with compliance, security, and architectural integrity. Define, document, and enforce data standards, best practices, and guardrails that enable autonomy while ensuring consistency and trust in data assets. Collaborate with data engineers, analytics teams, and downstream consumers to understand usage patterns and ensure data products are discoverable, accessible, and fit for purpose. Evaluate and recommend modern data and analytics technologies to support evolving product, AI, and platform needs. Contribute to solution architecture documentation and SDLC artifacts, ensuring traceability from product requirements through implementation. Kafka or comparable messaging middleware and event-driven solution patterns. Oracle or PostgreSQL, relational modelling and advanced SQL. Unix/Linux, shell scripting, Git/GitLab and build or dependency-management tooling. API and integration engineering, automated testing, CI/CD and production support. Produce consulting deliverables such as data-flow views, source-to-target mappings, control definitions, solution options and implementation roadmaps. Location: Pune preferred.

Implementation Review: Verify the accurate and robust implementation of models within relevant systems. Performance Monitoring: Review and challenge ongoing model performance monitoring frameworks and results, including backtesting, benchmarking, and sensitivity analysis. Governance and Policy: Establish Governance processes and Model validation Policy in line with local regulatory and group requirements. Documentation & Reporting: Prepare comprehensive validation reports detailing findings, limitations, recommendations, and conclusions. Present findings to model owners, developers, and relevant committees. Regulatory Compliance: Ensure models and validation practices comply with internal policies and external regulatory requirements (e.g., SR 11-7, CECL, IFRS 9, Basel Accords). Challenging Model Development: Proactively engage with model developers to provide constructive challenge and guidance throughout the model lifecycle. Demonstrable experience with model review and validation pertaining to both wholesale banking and retail banking Understanding of technical modelling requirements throughout model life cycle covering data analytics, coding, development, deployment, monitoring and maintenance for both traditional AI and Gen AI models Capacity to adopt new modelling areas (e.g., climate risk & Agentic AI) and problem solving Understanding of model governance requirements and principles Education / Preferred Qualifications

title: Sales Operations Lead
description:
About the Group The Group is a diversified Indian enterprise with established businesses across FMCG and flexible packaging. Priyagold is one of India's leading FMCG businesses with an annual turnover exceeding 3,000 Crore, deep distribution reach, and strong manufacturing capabilities across biscuits, bakery products, confectionery, and packaged foods. Surya Global Flexifilms is one of India's fastest-growing flexible packaging companies with world-class manufacturing capabilities across BOPP, BOPET, BOPE, Metalized, and specialty films, serving customers across India and global markets. As the Group continues to scale, it is investing significantly in enterprise technology, data, automation, and Artificial Intelligence to build a modern, intelligence-led organization capable of making faster, smarter, and more informed business decisions. Department: Sales / Sales Operations / Founders Office Company: Priyagold Industry: FMCG 
 About the Role Priyagold is looking for an experienced Sales Operations Lead to establish, strengthen and lead its Sales Operations and Coordination function. The role will lead a team of capable Sales Coordinators, each responsible for coordinating with one or more states and their respective sales teams. The objective is to build a well-organised, responsive and effective central coordination function that enables seamless collaboration between the field sales organisation, Corporate Sales Office, Founders Office, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing and other business functions. The incumbent will own the sales planning, target deployment and forecasting process, while ensuring that sales performance, business information and management reporting are accurate, timely and actionable. A key expectation from this role is to bring structure, discipline and consistency to sales coordination without creating unnecessary layers or friction within the sales organisation. The incumbent must work as a collaborative partner to State Heads and other functional leaders, while ensuring that important business priorities, commitments and issues receive the required attention and follow-through. 
 Key Roles & Responsibilities 1. Leadership of Sales Coordination Team Lead and develop the Sales Coordination team, ensuring clear allocation of state-wise and functional responsibilities. Establish common processes, reporting formats, operating standards and timelines across the team. Ensure that each coordinator works effectively with their respective State Heads and sales teams, while maintaining strong coordination with central functions. Review the quality, accuracy and timeliness of reports, information and deliverables generated by the team. Establish regular team reviews to monitor priorities, pending actions, operational issues and commitments. Build a culture of ownership, responsiveness, collaboration and accountability within the team. Develop the team's capabilities in MIS, business analysis, reporting, coordination and problem-solving. Ensure that the team operates as one integrated function, rather than as independent state-wise coordinators. 
 2. Sales Planning, Target Deployment & Forecasting Own and coordinate the annual, quarterly and monthly sales planning process in consultation with the Founder and Sales Leadership. Coordinate with State Heads to develop sales plans, consolidate business inputs and establish realistic sales targets. Ensure timely deployment and communication of targets across states, territories, channels and sales teams. Lead periodic sales forecasting exercises and coordinate inputs from State Heads and Supply Chain. Monitor forecast accuracy and identify significant deviations between projected and actual performance. Ensure that changes in market demand, sales trends and business priorities are appropriately reflected in forecasts and communicated to relevant functions. Establish a structured review mechanism for tracking sales plans, targets, forecasts and achievement. 
 3. Sales MIS, Performance Monitoring & Management Reporting Establish a reliable and standardised sales MIS and reporting framework across the organisation. Ensure timely consolidation of daily, weekly and monthly sales reports from all states. Monitor sales performance against budgets, targets and forecasts, highlighting gaps and significant deviations. Develop and maintain dashboards covering region-wise, state-wise, product-wise, channel-wise and other relevant business parameters. Analyse primary and secondary sales, growth trends, sales productivity, distribution performance and other relevant indicators. Ensure accuracy, consistency and integrity of sales information and management reports. Prepare periodic business reviews and management presentations for the Founder and Sales Leadership. Translate business data into meaningful insights, highlighting trends, risks, opportunities and areas requiring management attention. Establish standard reporting formats and ensure that management receives relevant information within defined timelines. 
 4. Cross-Functional Coordination & Business Execution Act as the central coordination link between the sales organisation and other key business functions, including Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing, IT and the Founders Office. Work closely with State Heads to understand business requirements, address operational challenges and ensure effective execution of agreed priorities. Coordinate with Manufacturing and Supply Chain to align product availability, production plans and dispatch requirements with sales forecasts and market demand. Work with Finance on distributor outstanding information, credit-related matters, sales reconciliation, claims and other sales-related financial information. Coordinate with Marketing on product launches, promotional activities, trade schemes and communication to the field organisation. Ensure timely communication and implementation of management decisions, business initiatives, pricing changes, schemes and other sales-related directives. Track important cross-functional commitments and ensure that pending matters are followed through to resolution. Identify recurring coordination gaps and work with relevant stakeholders to improve processes and turnaround times. 
 5. Sales Operations, Distributor & Channel Processes Establish and strengthen SOPs, workflows and operating processes governing sales coordination and sales operations. Monitor the availability and accuracy of distributor-wise, state-wise and channel-wise business information. Coordinate with relevant teams on distributor onboarding, master data, sales claims, incentives, schemes and settlements. Monitor primary sales, secondary sales, distributor stock positions and channel performance, wherever data is available. Support analysis of distribution reach, market coverage, channel productivity and sales effectiveness. Ensure that sales schemes, discounts, claims and other operational transactions follow defined company policies and approval processes. Identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate duplication and improve operational efficiency. 6. Systems, Technology & Process Improvement Drive effective utilisation of sales technology platforms, including Distributor Management Systems (DMS), Sales Force Automation (SFA), FieldAssist and other sales-related applications. Ensure effective utilisation of ERP platforms such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics NAV (Navision) and other business applications used across sales, supply chain and finance. Work closely with IT and technology teams to improve system usage, reporting capabilities, data availability and integration across platforms. Identify opportunities to automate routine sales coordination, data consolidation and reporting activities. Ensure accuracy and consistency of sales master data, distributor records and reporting databases. Support system enhancements, user acceptance testing, implementation and adoption of new technology initiatives. Drive digitalisation and standardisation of sales processes to improve transparency, efficiency and operational control. 
 7. Management Reviews, Escalations & Stakeholder Alignment Establish a structured operating rhythm for sales reviews, coordination meetings and follow-up on business priorities. Ensure that critical issues relating to sales performance, product availability, dispatches, distributor matters and cross-functional dependencies receive timely attention. Work collaboratively with State Heads and functional leaders to resolve issues at the appropriate level. Identify matters that remain unresolved, have significant business implications or require management intervention, and escalate them directly to the Founder with relevant facts and recommendations. Ensure that decisions and management directions are communicated, tracked and followed through to closure. Provide the Founder with timely visibility of business performance, significant developments, risks and operational bottlenecks. 
 This Role Will Suit You If You have led Sales Operations, Sales Coordination, Sales MIS or a similar function in a sizeable FMCG organisation. You enjoy building capable teams and creating systems that help people work together more effectively. You can combine strong analytical abilities with practical business understanding and execution. You are comfortable working closely with senior sales leaders, State Heads, the Founder and multiple functional teams. You believe in collaboration and influence rather than relying on hierarchy to get things done. You are organised, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of important business deliverables. You have the maturity to distinguish between matters that can be resolved through coordination and those that require senior management intervention. 
 This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If Your experience is limited to preparing MIS reports without managing the underlying business coordination and execution. You prefer working independently rather than leading a team and collaborating with multiple stakeholders. You are uncomfortable working in a fast-paced business environment with frequent priorities and cross-functional dependencies. You see Sales Operations primarily as a reporting function rather than an integral part of business execution. 
 Experience & Educational Background 15+ years of overall experience in Sales Operations, Sales Coordination, Sales Planning, Sales MIS or related functions. At least 35 years of experience leading a Sales Operations, Sales Coordination or similar team. Experience in a mid-sized or large FMCG organisation, preferably with a multi-state and multi-channel distribution network. Experience working closely with State Heads, senior sales leadership and cross-functional business teams. MBA / PGDM in Sales & Marketing, Operations, Business Management or an equivalent qualification. Graduation in Commerce, Management, Economics or a related discipline. 
 Skills & Competencies Functional & Technical Competencies Strong understanding of FMCG sales and distribution operations, including primary and secondary sales processes. Excellent capabilities in sales planning, target setting, forecasting and performance monitoring. Advanced MS Excel proficiency: Strong command over advanced Excel functions, Pivot Tables, complex formulas, lookups, data modelling, data consolidation and management reporting. This is a critical requirement. BI & Dashboard Reporting: Practical experience with Power BI or equivalent business intelligence tools, including dashboard development, data visualisation and performance reporting. SQL & Data Extraction: Working knowledge of SQL, with the ability to extract, query, analyse and interpret data from business databases. Sales Technology: Hands-on familiarity with DMS, SFA platforms and tools such as FieldAssist. ERP Systems: Experience working with SAP, Microsoft Dynamics NAV (Navision) or equivalent ERP platforms, preferably in an FMCG environment. Ability to work with large volumes of sales data and convert them into meaningful business insights and management reports. Strong understanding of distributor management, trade schemes and sales-related operational processes.
